In this role, you will work directly alongside our Licensed Immigration Adviser (LIA) to manage a diverse case portfolio. The ideal candidate must be equally proficient in mapping out Student Pathways (from enrollment to visa), assessing eligibility for Skilled Migration and Residency, and accurately processing other temporary, work, and family visa types under Immigration New Zealand (INZ) policies. Key Requirements & Qualifications • Experience: Minimum 2 year of direct experience as a Migration Admin or Assistant, with a proven track record handling New Zealand visas. • LIA Support: Proven experience assisting a Licensed Immigration Adviser (LIA) or Registered Migration Agent, with excellent case management preparation skills. • Full-Spectrum Visa Knowledge: Strong, up-to-date understanding of the INZ Operational Manual across multiple streams • Profile Assessment: Ability to accurately analyze client CVs, qualification credentials against the ANZSCO framework, and evaluate Genuine Student Intentions (GSI). • Tools: Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Microsoft Teams, Canva, and CRM/case management software. Key Responsibilities 1. Student Pathway & Enrollment Management • Map out strategic education-to-migration roadmaps for international students, ensuring chosen programs align with long-term skilled career pathways or Green List profiles. • Review and help clients refine their Statements of Purpose (SOP) to ensure they strongly reflect credible Genuine Student Intent criteria. • Coordinate directly with New Zealand education institutions to secure Offers of Place and manage student enrollment deadlines. • Check critical financial evidence markers, such as tracing genuine fund sources for student visa applicants. 2. Skilled Migration & Residency Pathway Assistance • Support the LIA in evaluating client employment offers, ensuring duties match ANZSCO definitions and remuneration meets mandated Median Wage thresholds. • Assist the LIA with checking and preparing Expressions of Interest (EOI) for the Skilled Migrant Category. • Assemble evidence logs, tax summaries (IRD records), and employment references to prepare robust Residency and Permanent Residency packages. 3. Diverse Visa Processing & Administrative Support • Populate and manage visa application forms accurately via the INZ online platform or paper channels across a wide array of categories (e.g., Student, Partner, Visitor, AEWV). • Coordinate and track critical application steps, including NZQA International Qualifications Assessments (IQA), professional body registrations, and medical panel bookings. • Conduct rigid internal audits to verify data consistency, completeness, and compliance across all documentation files before handing them to the LIA. • Assist the LIA in drafting technical responses to INZ Requests for Further Information or Potentially Prejudicial Information (PPI) letters. 4. Records, Research & Client Communication • Maintain regular, clear, and proactive communication with individual clients and corporate employers regarding application milestones and INZ processing statuses. • Securely manage highly sensitive personal and financial client data under strict confidentiality protocols. • Stay continuously updated on shifting immigration policies, sector agreements, and NZQA updates to ensure case accuracy. We already hold a library of influencer and UGC content, and more arrives continuously. Your job is to turn that supply into a consistent, well-edited output across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook - and to keep two very different brand voices distinct. Short-form vertical video is the default format. This is a hands-on content role - not posting-only, and not purely strategic. You edit, you publish, and you run our creator pipeline. What You'll Own - Editing short-form vertical video to a publishable standard- on your own, quickly, without waiting for anyone. - Turning raw creator footage, stock and product assets into finished posts, native to each platform - the same idea shaped differently as a Reel, a TikTok and a Short. - Sourcing, vetting, briefing and negotiating creators for both brands, with usage rights agreed in writing before the shoot. - Running the UGC pipeline: brief what you need, chase delivery, keep a clear record of every asset - who made it, what rights we hold, how long they run. - A short weekly report: what published, what worked, audience growth. What You'll Grow Into Setting the social strategy and content pillars for both brands; running paid social on Meta and TikTok; email capture and follower-to-customer flows; and TikTok Shop's affiliate programme. Who We're Looking For - A fast, self-sufficient editor with a portfolio you edited or directed. - 3+ years running social and creator content for a consumer brand. - You know why a video holds attention in the first two seconds. - Comfortable with CapCut, Meta's Edits or Premiere, and Canva. - You can tell a valuable, relevant audience from a large-but-low-quality follower count. - Solid written English. - E-commerce experience, ideally website + marketplace, is a plus. Tools - Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook (and their native analytics) - CapCut / Meta Edits / Premiere · Canva · - Notion or ClickUp - a cross-posting tool like Later Compensation & Setup - $900–$1,000/month - Full-time, 40h/week, remote - 14 days paid leave per year To Apply - Required Answer only from your own experience, and name the real company or account each answer comes from. Take one creator you sourced and worked with at a company on your CV — who were they (handle or follower band), what did you pay, what usage rights did you agree, and how did the content perform? 3. Tell us about a time you turned down or dropped a creator or audience that looked good on paper — big follower count - because you judged it wasn't worth it. What told you? 4. One piece of content or campaign from your CV that drove a measurable result — the numbers, and where they came from. Please include your salary expectation and availability.

description: Who We Are BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across the US, CA, UK, EU, AU and JP, and expanding into Saudi Arabia — two brands (travel accessories and beauty devices), 52+ active SKUs. You own the P&L, the launches and the positioning for both brands, and you make the day-to-day commercial calls that today land on the founders' desk. You report to the two Founders. If you need to be told what to do each day, this isn't for you. If you read a portfolio yourself, commit to a decision and defend it with numbers rather than hand it back - read on. What You'll Own - The P&L at ASIN level across both brands and every marketplace — built by you, after fees, ads, returns and storage. - A quarterly kill / hold / invest call on every product, and a weekly report to the founders. - Every launch end to end, from the pre-launch gate to the scale-or-stop decision. - Positioning, SEO / keywords, and the commercial PPC targets (TACOS / ROAS) — PPC is run day-to-day by an in-house specialist, so you own the targets and steer performance, not the campaign build. - Diagnosing underperformance — traffic, conversion, price, reviews and product each need a different fix. - Final approval on creative, copy and packaging before it publishes or prints — produced by two in-house designers who also edit video — judged on conversion, not taste. - What we build next, together with R&D. title: Klaviyo Email Copywriter & Campaign Manager
description: Read this part first You get 5% of every euro of revenue Klaviyo attributes to the emails you write and send. Uncapped. Forever, for as long as you're the one running the account. This job offer is commission based only. If the emails you write do €50,000 in a month, you make €2,500. If they do €150,000, you make €7,500. Nobody caps you, nobody renegotiates you down, and nobody takes the account away from you because you got too expensive. Who we are We're a DTC health and beauty brand selling to women & men aged 45–75. Cold traffic from Meta into direct response funnels, advertorials, VSLs, long-form sales pages. We've been running since 2023 with multiple products live across several markets. We are a direct response shop. Everything is measured. Nothing is decorative. Our copy has a job and the job is revenue. The list is there. The traffic is there. The products convert. Email is currently the most underworked asset we own, which is exactly why I'm willing to hand 5% of it to the right person instead of squeezing it myself. What you'll actually do Daily campaigns. You write and send to the list every day. Not "a few times a week when there's a promo." Daily. Story emails, offer emails, curiosity emails, urgency emails, re-engagement emails, plain-text emails that read like a message from a friend. You own the calendar. Flows. You own and continuously improve the full Klaviyo flow architecture — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, subscription retention, winback. Not "set it and forget it." Tested, iterated, rewritten. Segmentation and list health. Testing Subject lines, offers, angles, send times. You bring hypotheses, you run the tests, you report what won. Reporting. A short weekly number: revenue generated, open/click rates, what you tested, what you're shipping next week. The copy standard I'm a direct response copywriter myself. I will read your emails closely and I will tell you exactly what's wrong with them. What I want: Subject lines built on curiosity, specificity, or self-interest, not clever wordplay Emails written to one person, not to a list Story and mechanism-driven copy, not "Shop our bestsellers ????" One idea per email, one clear CTA Copy that respects that our customer is 45–75, not a 24-year-old on TikTok Voice-of-customer language, pulled from reviews and support tickets, not invented in your head What I don't want: Template emails with a product grid and a discount code ChatGPT output pasted in with a hero image on top "Hi [First Name], hope you're having a great week!" Emails that could be sent by any brand in any category If you know Schwartz's awareness levels and can tell me which stage a given email is written for, we will get along fine. Requirements Proven Klaviyo experience. You've owned an account, not just "helped with email." Native or near-native English writing. Your emails go out unedited. If I have to rewrite them, the arrangement doesn't work for either of us. Direct response background. Health, beauty, supplements, or info products preferred. If your experience is fashion drops and B2B newsletters, this will be a hard adjustment. You can write fast. Daily sending means daily writing. If a single email takes you four hours, the math doesn't work for you. You're comfortable with commission-only. You believe in your own copy enough to bet on it. Reliable internet and daily availability. Emails don't skip days. How to apply Send your application with all three of these. Applications missing any of them get archived without a reply. 1. Klaviyo attribution screenshots. Screenshots from inside Klaviyo showing revenue you generated. Campaign performance, flow performance, or the account overview. Blur the client name if you need to — I don't need to know who they are, I need to see the numbers are real. Include the date range. 2. Three emails you wrote. Actual sent emails, not spec work. One campaign, one flow email, and one of your choice. Tell me in one line what each one was supposed to do and whether it did it. 3. Your best subject line and your worst. With the open rates. I want to see that you track this and that you're honest about what flopped. The process I review applications and reply to the ones that clear the bar. Short call to talk through the account, the products, and the numbers. You write two campaign emails on a real product. Paid at the commission rate if we send them. If they perform, you take the account and start the 5%. No unpaid test that runs for three weeks. Two emails, we send them, you get paid on what they earn.

title: Fractional Brand & Creative Designer
description: About the Role FounderSquare and Global Founder Index are looking for a part-time creative partner to elevate our marketing and sales materials to a best-in-class, editorial standard. You'll be the person who takes our brand from good to unmistakably premium: sponsorship decks that make a $50K commitment feel obvious, program brochures that read like a magazine, and social content that stops the scroll. We already have a strong point of view and existing brand systems across three channels. What we need is someone with the taste and craft to push the execution further than we can take it ourselves, and enough range to move fluidly between polished investor-facing decks and punchy, modern social content. About Us FounderSquare (FSQ) and Global Founder Index are sister brands under FounderSquare LLC. Founder Index is a quarterly founder discovery and recognition program, currently spanning 15 founder communities and reaching 250,000+ founders. Each of the first three quarters spotlights a Top 26 founders, culminating in a Q4 Gala Award Summit in Manhattan that names the Top 26 of the year, six category winners, and Founder of the Year. The program is backed by family offices and VCs, Microsoft, and PwC sitting on the independent selection committee. The Gala itself is produced by the same team behind the WSJ's annual galas. What You'll Work On - Sponsorship and investor-facing decks for our corporate partners program - Program brochures for each quarterly edition, at or above the production quality of our current ones - Visual content for our social channels across a few distinct brand identities - Editorial-style portraits and features for program participants - Ad hoc marketing and sales collateral as the program grows (media kits, one-pagers, event signage, etc.) What We're Looking For - A portfolio that shows premium, editorial-grade design work - think luxury brand collateral, high-end event or media branding, or investor/sponsorship materials, not template-driven marketing design - Strong typography and layout instincts; comfortable designing for print-quality brochures as well as social-first formats - Experience building or working within multiple brand systems without losing consistency - Fluency in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop) - Ability to take a rough brief from a solo founder and turn it into something polished, fast, with minimal back-and-forth - Comfortable working independently, flexible-hours basis Nice to Have - Experience designing for finance, venture, or luxury/hospitality brands - Familiarity with HTML/CSS-based rendering pipelines for producing static image assets - Light motion or animation skills (GIFs, animated carousels) Engagement Part-time / fractional, ongoing basis with flexible hours built around deliverable deadlines each quarter (heavier workload around each Top 26 announcement and the Q4 Gala). Remote-friendly. To Apply Please send a portfolio or work samples, particularly anything in the brochure, sponsorship deck, or premium brand collateral space, along with your typical rate structure for fractional/part-time engagements.

title: Outbound Sales Representative — Australian Warehouse & Logistics Market
job_title: Outbound Sales Representative — Australian Warehouse & Logistics Market
description: Wise Solutions Group is an Australian labour hire and recruitment business based in South East Queensland, covering Brisbane, the Gold Coast and the Sunshine Coast. We supply warehouse and production staff — pick packers, forklift operators, machine operators and general labour — to warehousing and distribution centres, 3PL and logistics operators, food processing plants, manufacturers, e-commerce fulfilment sites and cold storage facilities. We also place permanent management roles: warehouse managers, operations managers, supervisors and team leaders. We are a small, direct team. There are no layers of management here. You will work directly with the business owner, and the work you do will visibly change the size of the company. Website: ---------- The role in one line: You find Australian warehouses that are short-staffed right now, you call them, and you turn that call into a client. What you'll actually do: Research. Our best prospects are businesses currently advertising for warehouse staff. An open job ad means they are short on the floor today, they have budget approved, and they are in pain. You will work job boards (Seek, Indeed), company career pages and LinkedIn to build a list of real employers — not recruitment agencies — across our target suburbs and industries. Call. You will phone those businesses on an Australian number and get through to the person who feels the pain: usually the Operations Manager, Warehouse Manager or Production Manager. You will find out what roles they are short of, what volumes they run, whether they already use labour hire, and who makes the decision. Qualify and log. Every conversation goes into HubSpot with proper notes. Our whole process runs on that data being accurate. Follow up. Most of these will not close on the first call. You will send the rates email, call back, keep the prospect warm and keep the deal moving. This is where most salespeople give up and where you will make your money. Hand over and grow into closing. For your first three months, once a lead is genuinely interested you hand it to the business owner to close, and you stay involved through the follow-up. After a successful three-month review, you take the process end to end yourself, right through to the first job order — at which point our account management team takes over the client relationship. You are not responsible for managing clients after they sign. You open doors, you convert them, and you move to the next one. Pay All figures in Australian dollars. The peso equivalent will be agreed at signing and reviewed quarterly so exchange rate movement isn't your problem. Months 1–3 Month 4 onwards Hours 30 per week 40 per week Base rate $9–10 AUD per hour $10–12 AUD per hour Per qualified lead $10 $10 Per new client won $100 flat $100 / $200 / $350 — see below Qualified lead — $10 each A lead counts as qualified when you have: spoken with the Operations, Warehouse or Production Manager, or someone more senior confirmed they use labour hire, or would consider it captured which roles they need and roughly what volumes got their agreement to receive our rates logged the contact and your notes in HubSpot New client bonus Paid once the client's first invoice has been settled, based on the total hours our workers place with that client in their first four weeks: Hours placed in first 4 weeks Bonus Under 75 hours $100 75–250 hours $200 Over 250 hours $350 Bigger accounts pay you more, because they're worth more to us. There is no cap on how many clients you can bring in. What you could realistically earn Once you're up to speed at 40 hours a week: base of around $1,730 per month, plus roughly $650 from a typical month of 25 qualified leads and two new clients — around $2,380 AUD per month, or approximately ₱90,000. A strong month pays more. There is no ceiling on the bonuses.

title: Job Title: Social Media Growth Manager & Video Editor (Food Brand / TikTok & Reels)
job_title: Job Title: Social Media Growth Manager & Video Editor (Food Brand / TikTok & Reels)
description: About Rice Rice Baby Rice Rice Baby is an exciting, high-energy Asian-inspired food brand based in Nashville, Tennessee. We operate a popular food truck, cater private events/festivals, and are opening our first Ghost Kitchen in Midtown Nashville at the end of August! We’re not looking for someone to simply post static graphics—we’re looking for a creative short-form video editor and growth manager who wants to help build a brand that people know, trust, and crave. Our mission: Make Rice Rice Baby one of Nashville’s most recognizable and cravable food brands, with customers lining up to order the ---------- nt our Ghost Kitchen opens. How We Work Together (The Workflow) You do not need to film on-site! * Our On-Site Team: Films raw, high-quality phone videos daily (cooking, sizzling food, order assembly, customer reactions) and dumps them into a shared Google Drive/Dropbox. * Your Role: You take those raw clips, edit them into high-converting TikToks, Reels, and Shorts, write engaging captions, schedule posts, and manage our growth strategy. Position Overview * Location: Remote (Philippines) * Employment: Full-Time (40 hours/week, Long-Term) * Working Hours: Flexible, with 2–3 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time (Nashville, TN) for quick check-ins and communication. * Primary Platforms: TikTok, Instagram (Reels & Stories), Facebook, YouTube Shorts. Our 90-Day Goals Together, over the next 90 days, we will: * Build a loyal, engaged local Nashville audience. * Create massive viral excitement leading up to our Ghost Kitchen opening. * Grow our social media following organically through high-quality video. * Drive online delivery orders from Day 1 of our launch. * Increase food truck traffic and private catering bookings. * Establish Rice Rice Baby as one of Nashville’s go-to food brands. Your Key Responsibilities * Video Editing & Content Creation: Cut raw phone clips into fast-paced, engaging TikToks, Reels, and YouTube Shorts using CapCut or Premiere Pro (trending audio, dynamic captions, text overlays, sound effects). * Strategy & Scheduling: Maintain a weekly content calendar focused on food truck schedules, catering, and the Ghost Kitchen launch. * Daily Stories: Create 4–6 interactive daily Stories (behind-the-scenes prep, truck location pins, countdown timers, polls). * Community Engagement: Build community by responding to comments and direct messages promptly in an authentic brand voice. * Trend Research: Stay on top of viral TikTok/Reel food trends and adapt them quickly for our brand. * Local Outreach: Use our pre-written templates to DM local Nashville food influencers, Vanderbilt students, hospital staff, and apartment concierges. 2-Week Paid Trial Period & Daily Expectations To ensure we are the right long-term fit for each other, all new hires begin with a 2-week paid trial period. Trend-based content being published regularly. * Day 14 (Trial Completion): Flawless execution of content workflow, proven reliability, growing engagement, and a clear 30-day marketing plan submitted for our Midtown Ghost Kitchen grand opening. Skills & Experience We Look For * Proven experience editing short-form videos (CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, Canva). * Deep understanding of TikTok, YouTube and Instagram Reel algorithms and viral food trends. * Experience in restaurant, food truck, hospitality, or local business social media marketing. * Excellent, natural English writing skills for casual and witty captions. * Self-starter mindset—you bring ideas to the table without waiting to be told what to do. Bonus Skills: * Basic Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram Ads) * Google Business Profile management * Local influencer outreach experience What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days) * Consistent, daily video publishing across all core channels. * Steady organic follower and engagement growth in the local Nashville area. * High-performing video edits that generate local buzz. * Increased website traffic, catering inquiries, and a high volume of Day 1 delivery orders for our Ghost Kitchen. Who You Are * You think like a business owner, not just an employee. * You are passionate about food content and love seeing videos go viral. * You meet deadlines consistently and communicate proactively. * You bring creative solutions and ideas—not excuses. * You want a long-term position where you can grow with a brand for years. Successful completion leads directly to a permanent full-time role. * Perks: Performance bonuses for viral content/milestones, and long-term career growth. How to Apply ?? title: Content Operations Manager / Content Coordinator
description: We’re looking for a highly organized, resourceful Content Operations Manager to own the day-to-day content pipeline for a fast-growing personal brand and online education company. This is less of a traditional “social media strategist” role and more of a **content project manager + implementer**. We already have editors, existing content, established brand messaging, sales initiatives, AI tools, and systems for generating ideas and copy. What we need is someone who can take all of those moving pieces and make sure content actually gets created, approved, published, and used to grow the audience and support the business — every single day. The primary goal of this role is simple: **Make sure the content machine runs even when the founder isn't personally running it.** ## What You'll Own ### Content Pipeline Management You will own the content calendar and production pipeline across multiple social media accounts. You'll make sure we're consistently publishing approximately **3–5 pieces of content per day**, which may include: * Clips from podcasts, interviews, trainings, Lives, and long-form content * Re-edited or repurposed existing content * “Fan edit” / personality-driven edits * Educational posts and carousels * Promotional and direct-response content * Trend-based or timely content * Occasional newly created content * Content for secondary brand accounts You are not expected to personally edit every piece. Instead, you'll identify what needs to be created, assign work to editors, track it through completion, gather assets and feedback, and make sure everything gets posted. ### Daily Instagram Stories A major responsibility of this role is making sure **sales-focused Instagram Stories go live every day.** Stories should consistently move followers toward actions such as: * Applying to work with the company * Joining a program * Watching a training * Registering for an event * Responding to a CTA * Engaging with a current campaign We have custom AI tools, existing messaging, testimonials, offers, and campaign materials that can help generate the copy. You'll be responsible for using those resources to turn the strategy into polished, on-brand Stories in Canva and getting them published. You do not need to be an elite copywriter, but you should understand basic direct-response marketing and be comfortable using AI thoughtfully rather than simply copying and pasting whatever it produces. ### Editor & Team Coordination You'll act as the central point of contact between the founder, editors, and the sales/marketing team. This includes: * Assigning content to editors * Providing clear briefs, references, hooks, and source footage * Tracking deadlines * Following up when projects are stalled * Organizing revisions * Making sure completed edits don't disappear into Slack or a Drive folder * Knowing what sales initiative we're currently prioritizing * Translating promotions and launches into content needs * Maintaining a backlog of content so we're not creating from zero every morning If the sales team says, “We need more applications this week,” your job is to help turn that into an actionable content plan. ### Lightweight Content Creation You should be comfortable creating simple content yourself when necessary. Examples include: * Canva carousels * Quote graphics * Instagram Stories * Simple Reel edits * Text overlays * Basic montage or fan-style edits * Resizing existing assets * Repurposing existing posts * Pulling clips or assets from existing content You do **not** need to be an advanced video editor or motion graphics designer. We care much more about speed, taste, resourcefulness, and consistency. ### Publishing & Quality Control You will help ensure content is: * Posted on schedule * Correctly formatted for each platform * Captioned appropriately * Using the correct CTA * Tagged and linked correctly * Visually consistent with the brand * Free of obvious errors * Supporting current business priorities The standard is not perfection. The standard is **high-quality content consistently going live.** ### Content Performance You'll monitor basic performance and help us learn from what's working. You should be able to identify things like: * Which hooks are outperforming * Which topics drive applications or leads * Which formats get shared * Which posts generate follower growth * Which Stories generate clicks, replies, or conversions From there, you'll help us create more iterations of what is already working. ## What Success Looks Like You're succeeding in this role when: * 3–5 pieces of content are consistently publishing every day * Sales-focused Instagram Stories are publishing every day * The founder does not have to personally project-manage the content pipeline * Editors always know what they're working on next * There is a healthy backlog of upcoming content * Promotions and sales initiatives are consistently supported by organic content * Great footage and ideas aren't getting lost because nobody followed up on them * The best-performing content gets identified and replicated * The founder's involvement is increasingly concentrated on creating, performing, and making high-level creative decisions rather than chasing deliverables ## You Might Be Great for This Role If... You're: * Extremely organized * Fast-moving and proactive * Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously * Good at following up with people * Comfortable holding editors accountable to deadlines * Strong in Canva * Capable of making simple video edits * Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, and short-form content * Familiar with ChatGPT and/or Claude * Able to learn and use established AI prompts, agents, and workflows * Comfortable working inside project-management systems * Familiar with Google Drive and Slack * Detail-oriented without becoming paralyzed by perfectionism * Able to recognize what looks polished, modern, and native to social media * Comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment Bonus points if you understand: * Direct-response marketing * Personal brands * Online education businesses * Creator businesses * Instagram Story selling * Content repurposing * Short-form video analytics ## This Role Is NOT This is not primarily a: * High-level video editor position * Graphic designer position * Copywriter position * Sales setter position * Community manager position Those skills are helpful, but your superpower should be **making sure things get done and go live.** We're looking for the person who sees 15 pieces of unfinished content spread across Slack, Google Drive, Canva, and multiple editors and thinks: **“Perfect. I'll organize this.”**

description: REMOTE VIDEO & AUDIO PODCAST EDITOR Freelance | Philippines-Based | Four Episodes per Month We are a Singapore-based medical and wellness brand seeking an experienced video and audio editor for an ongoing interview podcast. Each podcast episode consists of approximately 60–90 minutes of conversation, usually involving two or three speakers. Recordings may include footage from multiple cameras and separate audio tracks. We prefer clean, restrained editing rather than excessive animations, distracting effects or gimmicky social-media styling. DELIVERABLES FOR EACH PODCAST EPISODE • One professionally edited 60–90-minute YouTube episode • Synchronisation of multicamera footage and separate audio tracks • Natural camera changes based on the person speaking and the flow of the conversation • One mastered audio-only podcast file • Five to six vertical YouTube Shorts selected from the strongest moments in the episode • Accurate, professionally formatted captions for every Short • Clean branded opening, closing and speaker-name graphics • Balanced dialogue volume, noise reduction, EQ and audio mastering • Natural, flattering and consistent colour correction • Removal of mistakes, long pauses, technical interruptions and unnecessary repetition • Three high-resolution stills suitable for use in episode thumbnails • Correctly named and organised final files • Complete editable project and source files upon request The five to six Shorts should not simply be random extracts. The editor must identify compelling, useful or surprising moments that can stand alone and encourage viewers to watch the full conversation. RESPONSIBILITIES Long-Form Podcast Editing • Synchronise footage from multiple cameras and audio sources • Select appropriate camera angles for conversations involving two or three speakers • Maintain natural pacing while removing obvious errors and unnecessary pauses • Remove excessive filler words where this can be done without making the conversation sound unnatural • Preserve the intelligence and substance of the discussion • Use close-ups, wide shots and reaction shots appropriately • Apply the established podcast graphics, fonts, colours and visual style • Correct audio inconsistencies between different speakers • Correct colour and maintain natural, flattering skin tones • Check the entire episode before delivery for audio, visual, spelling and export errors YouTube Shorts • Identify five to six strong moments from every episode • Edit each selection into an engaging vertical video • Create a strong opening hook based on what was genuinely said • Use accurate and readable captions • Reframe footage correctly for vertical viewing • Keep speaker faces and important visual information within the safe viewing area • Avoid misleading hooks, exaggerated claims or removing statements from their proper context • Export each Short in the correct vertical format for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok Audio Editing • Clean and balance all dialogue tracks • Reduce background noise, echo, clicks and other distractions where possible • Apply appropriate EQ, compression and loudness levels • Ensure that all speakers remain clear and easy to understand • Export a properly mastered audio-only version suitable for podcast platforms MEDICAL AND WELLNESS CONTENT STANDARDS The podcast discusses medical, aesthetic, health and wellness subjects. Accuracy is essential. • Medical terminology in captions and graphics must be spelled correctly • Names, professional titles, medications, treatments and scientific terms must not be guessed • Any uncertain terminology must be flagged for confirmation • Statements must not be edited in a way that changes their original medical meaning • Short-form hooks must not exaggerate, sensationalise or misrepresent what the speaker said AI tools may be used to accelerate transcription, captioning and clip identification, but every output must be reviewed and corrected manually. TURNAROUND REQUIREMENTS Prompt and reliable delivery is essential because we intend to publish approximately one full episode every week. For each episode: • Confirm receipt of all files within 12 hours • Report missing, damaged or unusable files immediately • Deliver the first full-length edit within four working days • Deliver the five to six Shorts and complete content package within six working days • Return reasonable revisions within two working days • Complete up to two reasonable revision rounds per episode Applicants should only apply if they have sufficient weekly capacity to meet these deadlines consistently. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE • At least two years of professional video-editing experience • Demonstrable experience editing long-form interviews, podcasts or multicamera conversations • Experience editing videos involving two or three speakers • Strong audio-editing and dialogue-cleaning ability • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve • Competence with Adobe Audition, Fairlight or equivalent audio software • Strong judgement regarding pacing, storytelling and camera selection • Ability to identify compelling short-form moments from long interviews • Excellent written English and caption accuracy • Strong attention to detail • Good understanding of natural skin tones and clean, premium visual presentation • Reliable high-speed internet capable of transferring large video files • Ability to manage approximately four 60–90-minute episodes every month We are not looking for someone who relies exclusively on automatic AI clipping or unreviewed captioning software. Technology may support the workflow, but the final work must demonstrate human editorial judgement. COMPENSATION • Approximately four episodes per month • Up to two reasonable revision rounds included • Long-term opportunity for the right editor • Compensation will be reviewed if the workload or number of required deliverables increases materially PAID EDITING TEST Shortlisted applicants will be offered an editing test using supplied footage. The test will involve: • Editing a short multicamera interview segment • Cleaning and balancing the audio • Applying basic colour correction • Producing one vertical YouTube Short with captions HOW TO APPLY Please provide: 1. At least three examples of vertical podcast clips or YouTube Shorts 4. A clear explanation of which parts of each example you personally completed 5. title: PC Developer Claude Code
description: Interesting project to interact with windows from a PC application. Do you have experience with?: Claude Code Google Drive API Google Calendar Project Top Level Query: how do i go about using AI to build an install pc program to pretend to be a person enter data into windows of another pc program running on the same desktop Building this is basically classic desktop automation / RPA (robotic process automation), and it's a solved problem — AI (like this session or Claude Code on your own machine) is genuinely useful for writing the glue code once you've identified the right approach. Here's how I'd think about it. Two fundamentally different techniques, pick based on the target app: 1. Accessibility/UI Automation API — the robust option. Windows exposes a UI Automation (UIA) tree for most native apps (and even many Electron/Java/legacy Win32 apps), which lets you find a specific text box, button, or dropdown by its name/automation ID and set its value or send keystrokes directly, without needing pixel coordinates. In Python this is pywinauto (wraps both UIA and the older Win32 API); ---------- it's FlaUI; AutoHotkey can also address controls this way if the app cooperates. 2. Simulated input / image matching — the fallback for apps that don't expose a usable control tree (old terminal emulators, some games, custom-drawn UIs). Here you move the mouse and send keystrokes as if a person were doing it, using screen coordinates or template-matching (pyautogui, SikuliX, OpenCV). It's more fragile — breaks if a window moves or resizes — but it works on literally anything you can see. The actual workflow: • First, inspect the target program's window. Use Accessibility Insights for Windows (free, from Microsoft) or the older inspect.exe from the Windows SDK to click on each field you need to fill and see its automation ID, name, and control type. This tells you which of the two techniques above will work — if fields show up with real names/IDs, go the UIA route. • Feed those control names/IDs (or screenshots, if you're going the image-matching route) to an AI coding assistant and have it write the automation script: find the window by title/class, locate each control, set its value or send keystrokes, handle timing (waiting for the window/dialog to actually be ready before typing). • Iterate by actually running it against the real app — automation scripts against GUIs almost always need a few rounds of "it clicked before the dialog opened" type fixes. • If you want typing to look human-paced rather than instantaneous, add small randomized delays between keystrokes • (pywinauto's .type_keys() and pyautogui.write(interval=...) both support this natively). One thing worth checking before you build this: if the target program has licensing terms or built-in protections that specifically prohibit automated/bot input (some enterprise, exam, or ticketing software does this to stop exactly this kind of automation), that's worth reading first — the technique itself is standard, but whether it's allowed depends on that specific app's terms.

construction risks and tender assumptions * Price preliminaries, supervision, cranage, transport, temporary works and site establishment * Prepare tender clarifications and qualifications * Prepare detailed tender breakdowns and cost plans * Assist with value engineering and alternative construction solutions * Review tender documentation for commercial risk * Maintain estimating databases and historical rates * Assist with tender programmes and construction methodology * Support preparation of high-quality client-facing tender proposals Essential Experience Applicants must have: * Significant Australian commercial construction estimating experience * Strong knowledge of Australian construction methods, terminology and procurement * Previous experience preparing major commercial tenders * Experience working with or tendering to top-tier or major Australian commercial contractors * Strong understanding of subcontract trade packages * Ability to independently review a complete tender package and determine the full scope * Proven ability to proactively identify tender and construction opportunities * Familiarity with Australian tender portals and procurement systems * Strong construction sequencing and methodology knowledge * Excellent quantity take-off skills * Experience analysing subcontractor quotations * Strong Excel capability * Excellent written English * High commercial awareness * Excellent attention to detail Highly Desirable Experience with: * Government procurement * Education construction * Childcare facilities * Commercial offices * Industrial projects * Design & Construct * Modular and prefabricated construction * Civil and site works * Services coordination * TenderLink, VendorPanel, AusTender and similar procurement platforms * CostX, Cubit, Buildsoft, Bluebeam or similar estimating software * Expressions of Interest and prequalification submissions * Tender clarifications, exclusions and departures * Head contract tender submissions * Lump sum commercial tenders The Person We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who thinks commercially, takes ownership and is naturally proactive. title: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist
description: Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist Full-Time Remote | Flexible Schedule | Philippines Growth Path: Digital Marketing Manager We’re not looking for someone to simply complete a list of marketing tasks. We’re looking for someone who wants to OWN digital marketing and grow with us. Lambert Home Inspections is a fast-growing home inspection company based in Northern Virginia. Along with our residential inspection company, our team operates National Commercial Inspections and Capital Environmental, giving our marketing team the opportunity to build and grow three different brands. We’re looking for a creative, analytical, tech-savvy Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist in the Philippines who wants to become a long-term part of our team. This is NOT a typical Virtual Assistant position. You’ll work directly with our leadership and growth team and eventually take ownership of digital marketing across all three companies. Our goal is simple: Hire a great Digital Marketing Specialist → develop them → give them ownership → grow them into our Digital Marketing Manager. WHAT YOU’LL OWN PAID DIGITAL MARKETING You’ll help manage and eventually take ownership of: Google PPC campaigns Google Local Services Ads (LSA) Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising Retargeting campaigns Keyword and search-term optimization Negative keywords Geographic targeting Advertising budgets A/B testing Conversion tracking Cost-per-lead and customer-acquisition tracking We currently work with an outside digital marketing agency. During your first few months, you’ll learn how our existing campaigns are managed, review their reporting and help us build our own internal systems. The goal is for you to eventually take ownership of our digital advertising in-house. WEBSITE + GOHIGHLEVEL You’ll help us move and manage our websites through GoHighLevel (GHL) and continually improve them. This includes: Website updates Creating landing pages Building city/location pages Creating service pages Forms and funnels CRM integrations Conversion tracking Website optimization Marketing automations We don’t want websites that just look good. We want websites that generate leads. SEO + AEO You’ll help us dominate search across the markets we serve. Responsibilities may include: Local SEO Keyword research City and service landing pages On-page SEO Internal linking Technical SEO Schema Google Business Profile optimization Backlink opportunities Search ranking tracking AI search / Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Optimizing content for Google and AI platforms SOCIAL MEDIA + CONTENT Our Growth team will capture real-world content from inspections, events, real estate agents, our team and the field. Your job is to turn that raw content into something people actually want to watch. You’ll help create: Instagram/Facebook Reels Short-form videos Social media posts Hooks and captions Graphics Educational content Before/after content Team/culture content YouTube content Content calendars We want someone who understands that social media in 2026 shouldn’t feel like a corporate brochure. We want content that’s modern, authentic, entertaining and educational. ✍️ EMAIL + CONTENT MARKETING You’ll also help create: Weekly/monthly blogs Realtor newsletters Client newsletters Email campaigns Lead nurture campaigns Past-client campaigns Referral campaigns Seasonal marketing campaigns Automated follow-up sequences You’ll be working across three different brands, which means there will always be something new to build, test or improve. ANALYTICS + KPI TRACKING This is a major part of the position. We don’t want to guess whether our marketing works. We want the numbers to tell us. You’ll help maintain our marketing dashboards and track: Leads by source Bookings by source Revenue by source Cost per lead Cost per booked customer Customer acquisition cost Return on ad spend Advertising conversion rates Website conversion rates Organic traffic SEO rankings Google Business Profile performance Social media performance Email performance Lost leads Marketing-generated revenue Cross-company referrals You’ll help prepare the numbers for a monthly marketing meeting with company leadership where we review what worked, what didn’t and what we’re doing next. WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR You don’t need to know absolutely everything on Day One. But you should be someone who loves learning, figuring things out and getting better. We’re looking for someone who is: Creative Analytical Organized Tech-savvy Detail-oriented Comfortable with numbers Comfortable using AI A strong communicator Self-motivated Curious Reliable Excited about digital marketing Interested in building a career rather than jumping from client to client Experience with some combination of the following is strongly preferred: Google Ads • Meta Ads • SEO • GoHighLevel • GA4 • Google Search Console • Google Tag Manager • WordPress/Web Design • Canva • Video Editing • Social Media • Email Marketing • CRM Automations • AI Marketing Tools YOU’LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS JOB IF… You watch marketing videos because you actually enjoy them. You see a bad website and immediately start thinking about how you’d improve it. You want to know why one advertisement generated 50 leads while another generated five. You like experimenting with AI and new marketing technology. You’d rather be given a goal than have someone tell you exactly what button to click every five minutes. And you want the opportunity to eventually say: “I run digital marketing for three growing U.S. companies.” WHERE THIS POSITION CAN GO We’re hiring a Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, but we don’t want you to stay a Specialist forever. As our companies grow and you demonstrate that you can manage our marketing successfully, our goal is to develop this position into: DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER You could eventually oversee digital marketing strategy across: - Lambert Home Inspections - National Commercial Inspections - Capital Environmental As the companies continue growing, this could eventually mean helping build and manage a larger internal marketing team. We want someone who grows as we grow. THE POSITION Location: Philippines – Remote Schedule: Full-Time – 40 Hours Per Week. Flexible Scheduling and Workweek Compensation: $7–$10 USD/hour depending on experience and demonstrated skills This is intended to be a long-term position dedicated to our companies, not a temporary freelance project. OUR HIRING PROCESS We’re less interested in how impressive your résumé sounds and more interested in what you can actually do. STEP 1 — APPLICATION Send us: Your résumé A short introduction Your digital marketing experience Examples of campaigns you’ve managed Websites/landing pages you’ve created SEO results Social/video examples GHL experience Any marketing dashboards or reporting you’ve created Don’t have examples of everything? That’s okay. Show us what you’re great at. STEP 2 — SHORT VIDEO Selected applicants will submit a short video introducing themselves and answering a few questions. We want to meet the person behind the résumé. Tell us what you’re good at, what you’re currently learning and where you want your career to be three years from now. STEP 3 — INTERVIEW Top applicants will meet with our team by video. This isn’t meant to be an interrogation. We want to learn how you think, how you communicate and whether you’ll fit with our team. STEP 4 — PAID MARKETING CHALLENGE Finalists may complete a short paid skills challenge involving real-world marketing situations similar to what you’ll encounter here. Examples could include: Reviewing a sample Google Ads campaign Evaluating a website page for SEO Creating a landing-page concept Analyzing marketing KPIs Turning raw video into a social Reel Creating a marketing campaign idea We’re looking at how you think, not just whether you know every answer. STEP 5 — FINAL INTERVIEW + OFFER We’ll discuss the challenge, answer your questions and determine whether we’re a good long-term fit for each other. If we are… Welcome to the team. ???? ONE LAST THING… We move fast. We try new things. We use technology. We aren’t afraid of AI. We measure results. We have fun. And we’re building something much bigger than where we are today. If you’re looking for a position where you can learn, experiment, take ownership and eventually lead digital marketing across multiple growing companies… we want to hear from you.

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
job_title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description: Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it. REQUIRED: 1) MUST have industrial piping estimation (quantity surveying and costing) experience including labor takeoff from piping ISOs. 2) Can work roughly 3-8pm EST, Mon-Thurs THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL QUANTITY SURVEYING/ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do. WHAT YOU'LL DO - QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs for our customers: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts - Do independent manual labor take-offs from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy. This means genuinely interpreting the ISO drawings, not just counting symbols WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Industrial Piping Estimators - Real experience doing material AND labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome - You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. - Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught - Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team -Part time and full time are both a possibility OUR HIRING PROCESS Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live. WHY JOIN - Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up - Work directly with the founders and engineering team - Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence TO APPLY Tell us briefly about your experience doing industrial piping estimation from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

is comfortable asking for the sale Confident speaking with homeowners and decision-makers Excellent at building rapport and trust Experienced in objection handling Strong in negotiation Comfortable discussing large financial decisions Motivated by commissions and measurable results Persistent without being overly aggressive Strong at follow-up and relationship building Organized and able to manage a sales pipeline Comfortable working independently in a virtual environment Coachable and willing to follow a proven sales process Competitive and motivated to improve Able to adapt quickly in a fast-paced company Professional, reliable, and accountable Preferred Experience Experience in any of the following is highly preferred: Real estate wholesaling Real estate acquisitions Seller lead conversion Investment real estate High-ticket sales Inside sales Phone sales Mortgage or financial sales Home improvement sales Solar sales Insurance sales B2B sales Commission-based closing roles Wholesale real estate experience is preferred, but not required. A candidate with a proven history of closing high-ticket products or services may be a great fit even without direct real estate experience. Real Estate Knowledge Experience understanding the following is a major advantage: Motivated sellers Cash offers Wholesale real estate ARV / After Repair Value Property condition Seller motivation Property equity Investment properties Distressed property situations Negotiating below-market purchases Real estate contracts We can train the right experienced closer on our specific real estate processes. Systems Experience Experience with the following is a plus: Follow Up Boss ReadyMode Real estate CRMs Google Workspace Zoom SMS follow-up systems Dialers Sales platforms What Success Looks Like We are looking for someone who can take a qualified seller opportunity and confidently guide the conversation toward a decision. title: Video Editor
description: This is a long-term position with opportunities for raises and performance bonuses based on quality, reliability, turnaround time, and channel growth. Please include your expected monthly salary in your application. Applicants seeking significantly higher compensation may still apply, but priority will be given to candidates who fit our current budget. ### Expected Workload We are looking for an editor who can consistently edit approximately 10-15 long-form videos per month. description: * YOU MUST SPEAK FLUENT ENGLISH * We're a US-based virtual real estate company looking for a detail-oriented Data Manager to run our daily lead pipeline. Every morning you'll pull fresh distress lists from county sources, scrub the data, run skip tracing and phone verification, then import clean, dial-ready leads into our CRM before our acquisitions team starts calling. The work is consistent, structured, and rewards accuracy. If you're the kind of person who notices a misspelled column header and fixes it without being asked — keep reading. This is a long-term role. We want someone who will own this pipeline for years, not weeks. Schedule - Hours: 40 hours per week - Days: Monday through Friday - Time zone: 9am-6pm (CST) - Deadline: All daily lists must be live in our CRM daily. Pay - $4–6 USD/hour depending on experience - Paid bi-weekly via Payoneer or PayPal - Performance bonus for clean data quality and on-time delivery - Raise review at 90 days What You'll Do Every Day: 1. Pull distress lists from county government portals: probate, auction, tax delinquent, pre-foreclosure, and auction. 2. Scrub the data in Google Sheets — dedupe by APN, standardize addresses to USPS format, remove vacant land, cross-check against our CRM. 3. Organize each list into our standard 14-column upload format 4. Run the cleaned list through BatchLeads for skip tracing 5. Verify every phone number through Trestle (activity score, line type, connection status) 6. Reorder phones so the highest-scored number lands in Phone 1 7. Import the final file into FreedomSoft with the correct campaign tag and pipeline stage 8. Log every step in our Master Tracker (raw count, scrubbed count, hit rate, etc.) A full Standard Operating Procedure with screenshots and a worked example will be provided. You will not be figuring this out from scratch. Tools You'll Use: - Google Sheets (heavy daily use — formulas, filters, dedupe, VLOOKUP) - FreedomSoft (our CRM — we'll train you) - XLeads (skip tracing) - Trestle (phone verification) - County government websites (varies by list type) - Slack (daily check-ins and questions) What We Need From You: - Strong Google Sheets skills — you should be comfortable with formulas, filters, dedupe, and conditional formatting - Sharp attention to detail — bad data costs us real money - Comfortable navigating unfamiliar government websites and exporting CSVs - Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet workspace - Good written English for daily Slack updates - Available Mon–Fri without exception (this is a daily pipeline — one missed day backs up the whole team) - Able to start As Soon As Possible Bonus Points If You Have: - Prior US real estate experience - Experience with FreedomSoft, BatchLeads, PropStream, or any real estate CRM - Background in data entry, list management, or data cleaning roles - Skip tracing experience (Xleads, Skip Genie, IDI, TLO, etc.) - Familiarity with US county records systems What Makes This Role Different: - Structured, repeatable work. This is not a "wear many hats" VA role. You'll do the same workflow every day and get faster at it every week. - Clear ownership. You own the pipeline. Your numbers (hit rate, dead phone rate, on-time delivery) are visible to the team every Friday. - Long-term growth. As we scale, you'll have the chance to train other VAs on this workflow and move into a team lead role. You won't be making cold calls. This is back-office data work. We have a separate Acquisitions Team for outreach. How to Apply 1. Include the word PIPELINE at the top of your application. Applications without this word will be deleted unread. 2. Briefly describe one time you cleaned a messy data set: what was wrong with it, how you fixed it, and how long it took. 3. Tell me what daily hours you would work in Philippine time. 4. Tell me your minimum acceptable hourly rate in USD. 5. Confirm you have a stable internet and a quiet workspace. We will respond to the strongest applicants within 3 business days. Thank you for reading the full post. We're looking forward to building a long-term team with the right person.

title: Deal Origination Associate
description: Who we are We are a technology-driven capital advisory firm. We connect institutional investors such as family offices and funds with large private investment opportunities in infrastructure (data centers, power, energy) and late-stage technology companies. We are a small senior team that runs on modern tools: AI does much of our drafting and analysis, and we hire people who love working that way. You will report directly to the founder. The company name is shared with shortlisted candidates. What this role is: deal origination You will be in charge of originating deals. In our world, origination means finding the investment opportunities before they become deals: identifying the right companies, investment firms, and asset owners, reaching out to them at scale, and starting the conversations that put a real opportunity on the founder's desk. Nothing in this business happens without origination. It is the top of everything. The deals we work on are large, private transactions that most investors never get access to: minority stakes in infrastructure platforms such as data centers and power and energy companies, and investments in late-stage private technology and AI companies before they go public. These opportunities typically range from $75 million to $200 million. Our investors want into these deals; the companies and sponsors who hold them want serious, discreet capital. Your job is to build the target universe, run the outreach machine that connects the two sides, and keep the pipeline of conversations always full. You don't need to understand any of this industry today. We will teach you how these deals work, step by step, with recorded training for everything. What you need to bring is the operational sharpness to run the machine flawlessly. Qualifications The person, first: Sharp and logical: you think in systems, spot what doesn't add up, and reason before you act A fast learner who genuinely wants to master a new industry A self-starter: you don't wait to be told twice, you flag problems with a proposed fix, and you ask before acting when instructions are unclear Extremely detail-oriented and process-driven: you follow SOPs exactly, and you notice when something in the SOP is wrong Trustworthy and discreet: you'll sign an NDA; our work is confidential The skills: Hands-on experience running B2B outbound, email or LinkedIn: you have personally managed campaigns in tools like Smartlead, Instantly, PlusVibe, Apollo, or similar (not just uploaded leads for someone else), and you understand deliverability basics such as warmup, bounce management, and account safety limits Experience building and cleaning prospect lists: sourcing contacts, verifying emails, deduplicating, and keeping data accurate Excellent written English: you'll handle replies from senior finance executives Comfortable using AI tools (Claude) daily to work faster Finance or investment industry experience is NOT required; we will teach you everything about our world. Agency lead-gen experience is a big plus What you'll do You own the origination machine end to end, working with our AI systems that accelerate the heavy lifting: Build and maintain the target lists: source the right companies and decision-makers using our data tools and AI systems, verify emails, deduplicate, tag by segment, and keep the lead base clean and always full Run our cold email campaigns in PlusVibe (similar to Smartlead/Instantly): staging, test sends, merge-field checks, daily deliverability monitoring (bounce rates, mailbox warmup health), and pausing per our rule card when thresholds trip Operate our LinkedIn outreach tool (signal-based outreach): review the leads it surfaces, judge which signals are real, edit and approve AI-drafted messages before anything is sent, and respect strict account-safety caps Triage all replies on both channels: tag them, handle routine ones from approved templates, escalate important ones fast, and book qualified conversations onto the founder's calendar Keep our CRM perfect: every lead imported, deduplicated, and tagged; every touch logged; no stale records; weekly pipeline report every Friday After the founder's calls: log notes, send templated follow-ups within 24 hours, and chase documents and signatures so nothing goes quiet Send a short end-of-day report daily You will NOT do: cold calling, selling, or writing free-form messages in the company's name. Everything external runs from approved templates. This is a regulated industry and we take that seriously. When something isn't covered by a checklist, the right answer is always to ask, never to improvise. We reward asking. Why this role is worth it Direct daily access to the founder, real experience inside institutional finance and high-level outreach that very few remote roles offer, serious training with recorded SOPs for everything, and a genuine growth path: part-time grows into full-time, and this role is designed to grow into our Operations Lead position as you master each part of the business. How to apply Include both of the following in your application: Describe one outbound campaign you personally ran, email or LinkedIn. Tell us: the tools you used, the list size, your reply or connection-acceptance rate, and one thing that underperformed and what you changed. Below is a LinkedIn message an AI tool drafted for us. Would you send it as-is? If not, rewrite it and briefly say what was wrong. "Hi James, congrats on the fund launch!!! We work with elite investors deploying $10-20M and can guarantee you access to exclusive off-market deals with exceptional returns. When can we hop on a call this week?" Shortlisted candidates complete a short paid test task (about 2 hours, paid whether or not you advance), then a video interview, then a 2-week paid trial. We move fast: expect a response within 3 business days if shortlisted.

description: WHAT THIS IS I'm building an app called The Perfect Walk. Before I hire anyone long-term, I'm paying several developers to each build their own version of it. Whoever builds the version that best captures the idea gets brought onto the project. You are not applying to follow a spec someone else wrote. You are applying to show me your version. THE IDEA The Perfect Walk turns an ordinary morning walk into a five-part practice: 1. Opening Your Heart (always first) 2. Feeling Your Power 3. Letting Go / Presence 4. Connecting with Higher Power 5. Celebrate and Raise Your Vibration (always last) The middle three can happen in any order. Each part has music chosen to bring on a specific feeling. It's done first thing in the morning, every day, before the mind turns on and the phone takes over. It replaces four habits with one: the clarity of meditation, the connectedness of prayer, the benefit of exercise, and the energy of a thousand coffees. Full Guide: ---------- HOW THE HIRING WORKS STAGE 1 - Vision Response (free, about 45 minutes, no code) I send you the guide. You send back short written answers plus 3 rough screens or a 3-minute Loom. I'm checking one thing: did you actually understand the idea? Most of the hiring decision happens here. STAGE 2 - Paid Build (100 USD, 7 days) If you pass Stage 1, I invite you to build it and I pay you 100 USD on delivery. Everyone invited who hits the checklist gets paid, win or lose. The checklist is written down and given to you upfront. No surprises, no "I didn't like it so I'm not paying." That's not how I operate. THE WIN The best version gets a 400 USD bonus on top of the 100, plus the ongoing paid role building this for real. WHAT YOU'D BUILD IN STAGE 2 A web app / PWA, not native. Deployed to a live URL, installable to a phone home screen, works while walking with the screen off. Free hosting is fine. Required to get paid: live URL, all five parts, reorderable middle three, audio per part, a walk you can complete start to finish, a daily streak that persists, and a 3-minute video of you demoing it. Everything else is up to you.
