title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
job_title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description: READ THIS FIRST We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California. This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment. This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here. On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here. If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work. THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT OR A SALE. OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses). 13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top. --- ABOUT THE COMPANY You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years. The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market. You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked. A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time. We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't. --- WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support. Daily: - Call new Facebook/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day) - Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time. - Respond to inbound SMS, Facebook ---------- , and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them - Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel - Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar - Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs - Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM) - Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers Weekly: - One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min) - Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings - Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them During training (first 2–4 weeks): We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence. --- A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY) We use a script. We also need you to think. Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words. Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment. This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you. Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works. If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well. --- SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES) All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning. - US workdays: Monday through Friday - US days off: Saturday and Sunday - Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call) - Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March): Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT - A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time - A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time - Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night) Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November): - Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT - Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit. Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly): - $3 per new client showed appointment - $2 per existing client showed appointment - $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon) Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly): - +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month - +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month - +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month Worked examples: Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 (midpoint) - Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90) - Threshold bonus: $75 - Total: ~$1,250/month Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 - Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120) - Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150) - Total: ~$1,475/month Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked): - Base: $1,000 - Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking) - Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350) - Total: ~$2,025/month This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for: - Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role. - Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings. - Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going. - Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists. Everything else: - ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work. - Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application. - Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait. - You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it. - You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next. - You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking. - You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast. - You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure - You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating" - You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it" - You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term - You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation --- HIRING PROCESS 1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions 2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner 3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay 4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion 5. Offer — targeting hires between August 28 – September 7 6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance --- HOW TO APPLY Submit your application through this Tally form: | ---------- | IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience. The form will ask for: - A screenshot of your typing test results ( ---------- ) - A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net) - A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor) - A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages - A few short questions to gauge fit - A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar) - A short Loom video introducing yourself Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form. --- Looking forward to meeting the right person. Ethan Founder, Midnight Siren --- Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying. --- COMPENSATION Base pay: $900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month. 13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000. Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly): - $3 per new client showed appointment - $2 per existing client showed appointment - $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon) Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly): - +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month - +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month - +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month Worked examples: Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 (midpoint) - Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90) - Threshold bonus: $75 - Total: ~$1,250/month Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month: - Base: $950 - Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120) - Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150) - Total: ~$1,475/month Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked): - Base: $1,000 - Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking) - Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350) - Total: ~$2,025/month This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role. --- OTHER BENEFITS 1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year 2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can. 3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation. To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form --- TARGET KPIs - Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+ - Show Rate: 90%+ - Bookings per day: 4–9 - Showed appointments per month: 100–160 - Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit. --- WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR Background: - Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders. - Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required. Non-negotiable skills: The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for: - Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role. - Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings. - Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going. - Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe. - Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists. Everything else: - ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier. - STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work. - Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application. - Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind. - Script discipline for the structured parts of the call. - Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused. - Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified. - Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising. - Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance. - CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred. - High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one. - Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing. - Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load. Preferred: - Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry - Personal interest in beauty or self-care - Experience working with older female clientele (35–65) - Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster) Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT): We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean: - Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout. - Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words. - Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat. - Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down. - Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses. - KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them. --- TECH REQUIREMENTS Non-negotiable: - Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire. - Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application. - Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop - Mouse - Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods. - Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls. - Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients. Preferred: - Second monitor - You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster) --- DO NOT APPLY IF: - You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait. - You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it. - You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next. - You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking. - You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale. - Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker - You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. title: HOA Manager
description: The HOA Property Manager is responsible for the day?to?day operations, governance support, vendor oversight, and owner/resident experience across an assigned portfolio of homeowner associations. This role requires strong analytical ability, impeccable attention to detail, and exceptional written and verbal communication skills. The manager serves as the primary liaison among the Board of Directors, unit owners, residents, vendors, and internal teams (Maintenance and Finance), ensuring that association operations comply with governing documents, applicable laws, and company standards while meeting service-level and financial targets. Key Outcomes (What Success Looks Like): Accurate, timely Board packets and meeting facilitation with clear minutes and action logs Portfolio-level adherence to budgets, assessments, and reserve funding plans in partnership with Finance HOA Proactive maintenance planning and on-time completion of preventive and corrective work with Maintenance HOA High owner/resident satisfaction, timely resolution of requests, and transparent communications Clean annual audits, renewed insurance policies, and documented compliance with statutes and governing documents Up-to-date task/project management in Asana and on-time delivery of recurring HOA cycles and filings Key Responsibilities: 1) Board & Governance Management Serve as the primary point of contact for Board members; prepare agendas, Board packets, and management reports for regular and special meetings. Interpret and apply governing documents (CC&Rs, bylaws, rules) and relevant state statutes in daily operations; coordinate with counsel when required. Facilitate annual meetings, elections, and owner notices in accordance with legal and governing document requirements. 2) Owner & Resident Relations Maintain responsive, professional communication with trustees/Board, unit owners, and residents via email, phone, and portal. Issue timely association-wide notices (policy changes, maintenance schedules, community events, compliance reminders). Manage and resolve escalations, complaints, architectural review requests (ARC), violations, and hearings within established SLAs. 3) Financial Coordination & Reporting Support budget development, reserve study implementation, and monthly variance commentary; review financials for accuracy. Monitor assessment billing, collections, payment plans, and delinquency follow-up in alignment with collection policies. Review and approve invoices, code expenses to budgets, and validate vendor work completion prior to payment. 4) Maintenance, Projects & Vendor Management (with Maintenance HOA) Translate Board priorities into annual maintenance calendars; schedule and track preventive maintenance and inspections. Open, monitor, and close work orders; ensure scope, SLA, and quality standards are met; maintain accurate asset records. Bid, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts (landscaping, janitorial, security, pools, roofing, elevators, etc.); perform periodic vendor reviews. Coordinate capital improvement projects (RFPs, proposals, schedules, owner notifications, punch lists, closeout documents). 5) Information Management & Systems Keep all HOA Asana projects/boards current with daily updates, dependencies, and follow-ups; maintain recurring tasks and automations. Process resale and lender questionnaire packages accurately and within service timelines; maintain fee schedules. Maintain organized digital records (governing docs, minutes, contracts, insurance, warranties, architectural files) in the association’s repository. 6) Team Leadership & Development Train and onboard new APMs/PMs on processes, systems (Asana, accounting/portal), compliance, and customer service standards. Promote a collaborative, service-oriented culture aligned with company values; escalate staffing/resource needs to the Unit Head. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): On-time completion rate for recurring HOA tasks and compliance filings Work-order first-response and average time-to-close (by priority) Delinquency rate and collections effectiveness; percent of assessments collected Budget adherence (OPEX/CapEx) and variance accuracy; invoice cycle time Owner/resident satisfaction score; complaint resolution time Board satisfaction score (post-meeting surveys) and action-item closure rate Qualifications: 3+ years of HOA/condo association management or related property management experience Demonstrated proficiency with task/project management tools (Asana) and owner portals; strong Excel/Google Sheets skills Exceptional communication (written and verbal), meeting facilitation, and stakeholder management Strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills; high attention to detail Working knowledge of governing documents, meeting procedures, collections, elections, and common HOA statutes

title: Accounting Automation Engineer
description: *TO APPLY CLICK HERE: ---------- Spotter Labs is hiring Accounting Automation Engineers to help automate manual processes across accounting, finance, and related business systems. This role is for someone who can understand how work is being done today, identify repetitive manual steps, connect data across systems, build automation, and create cleaner workflows that are accurate, repeatable, and scalable. The initial focus will be Accounting and Finance, but strong performers may also support automation projects in other departments as the company continues to grow. *What You Will Do Review manual accounting and finance workflows and identify opportunities for automation. Build repeatable processes across multiple systems, exports, reports, and data sources. Improve reconciliations, journal-entry preparation, close tracking, reporting, and exception management. Help connect operational data to accounting and finance processes. Create templates, scripts, dashboards, workflows, and documentation that reduce manual work. Work with accounting, finance, operations, and technology teams to understand process gaps and build practical solutions. Design controls so automation improves accuracy rather than simply speeding up bad processes. Create exception-based workflows so teams can focus on issues instead of routine data entry. Document processes clearly so they can be maintained and improved over time. *What We Are Looking For We are looking for practical automation builders who can work across business systems and messy real-world data. *The ideal candidate has: Experience automating manual processes using tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, Python, Power Query, VBA, Google Apps Script, Zapier, Make, Power Automate, APIs, or similar platforms. Strong ability to work with data exports, reports, spreadsheets, and system-generated files. Understanding of accounting or finance processes, including reconciliations, journal entries, month-end close, AP, payroll, reporting, or financial analysis. Ability to map a current process, identify failure points, and build a cleaner workflow. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Ability to work with non-technical users and translate business problems into automated solutions. Good documentation habits. Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where systems and processes are still being built. *Preferred Experience Experience working with accounting, ERP, banking, payroll, expense management, inventory, reporting, or operational systems. Experience building dashboards, exception reports, reconciliation tools, or workflow automations. Experience with multi-system data matching and process improvement. Experience supporting accounting, finance, operations, logistics, transportation, or other data-heavy business environments. Accounting, finance, data analytics, systems, or engineering background preferred. *The Type of Person Who Will Succeed This role is best for someone who likes solving practical business problems. You should be able to look at a manual process and ask: *Why is this being done manually? What data is needed? Where does the data come from? What can be automated safely? What should remain subject to review? How do we prove the output is accurate? How do we make the process repeatable? We do not need someone who only writes code in isolation. We need someone who can understand the business process, work with the people doing the work, and build useful automation that holds up in the real world. *Hiring Process Candidates may be asked to complete a practical work sample involving process mapping, data cleanup, reconciliation logic, automation design, reporting, or workflow improvement. We are looking for candidates who can understand a problem, organize the data, build a practical solution, document their work, and explain how the process could be improved or automated. *Why This Role Matters As Spotter Labs grows, the company needs scalable processes instead of more manual work. This role will help build the systems, workflows, and automation needed to support faster reporting, better controls, cleaner data, and more efficient operations.

title: Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate Dubai Market · Fully Remote
job_title: Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate Dubai Market · Fully Remote
description: About us IMSOLD Agency is the agency arm of an AI-first venture studio. We don't run campaigns for clients and hand over a report — we build and operate brands end to end: research, creative, funnels, media buying, tech, and the teams that run them. Our portfolio spans health, wellness, B2B software, and real estate across the US, Europe, and the Middle East. This role sits on our Dubai real estate lead-generation account — a fast-moving operation connecting property owners and investors with licensed Dubai real estate professionals. About the role You orchestrate the complete marketing flow of the brand — from verified research foundations to a running content calendar — then hand off to production, which runs on our proprietary operations platform. You do not produce the work. Specialist teams handle research, copywriting, design, video, publishing, and legal review. Your job is rather: to see the whole machine, verify that every input exists and is sound before work starts, spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and keep a dozen specialists in time. Six verbs describe the day-to-day: verify ? chase ? assemble ? agree ? build ? hand off. What you'll do Verify the brand's marketing foundations — market and competitor research, audience definitions, messaging inputs, legal constraints — and trigger the right specialist team when a layer is missing or below the bar Assemble all verified inputs into one content plan for the brand Agree the content rhythm — channels, campaign mix, volume — directly with the brand's leadership Build the content calendar so that every slot has its creative, caption, call-to-action, and a destination that actually exists Hand off cleanly to production and keep the machine flowing: chase blockers, reconcile numbers, route every creative through compliance review before launch Quality-control what comes back: catch contradictions, impossible numbers, and unsourced claims before they reach anyone downstream What we're looking for 3+ years running performance-marketing, direct-response, or growth projects — owning the system, not just executing tasks in it Hands-on familiarity with paid social funnels (Meta especially): you don't have to be the media buyer, but you must understand CPMs, CTR, CPL, and funnel math well enough to manage one Proven ability to orchestrate a team of specialists to ship on deadline — and to tell someone their work is broken when it is An instinct for dependencies: you naturally order work by what must exist first, and you treat "done" as something to verify, not something to accept Fluent, precise written English — this is an async, remote, documentation-heavy environment Real estate experience — a strong plus Dubai / UAE property market experience You've marketed in or to the Dubai real estate market — brokerage marketing, property portals or proptech, developer marketing, or lead generation for UAE realtors — and you know its advertising rules and market dynamics first-hand. Property-market experience anywhere You've run marketing operations or lead generation in any serious property market. The instincts transfer; the Dubai specifics are teachable. What this role is not Not a real estate sales role — no transactions, no client calls, no commissions Not a content-production role — you won't write scripts, design, or edit video Not a media-buying role — specialists run the ads; you run the flow What we offer Fully remote work with high autonomy and high standards — you'll be trusted to run things, and held to the results A documented, systemized operation: you inherit a complete written playbook, not chaos Exposure to a multi-brand venture studio and a modern AI-native marketing stack Long-term growth: strong moderators take on additional brands across the portfolio How to apply Send your CV to ---------- with the subject line "Marketing Project Manager — Real Estate" and include, in the body of your message: In exactly five sentences: describe one system or process you personally kept on the rails — what its moving parts were, what broke most often, and how you caught it early Your real estate / Dubai market experience, if any (be specific — markets, companies, campaigns) Your monthly salary expectation and earliest start date Applications that skip the five-sentence answer will not be reviewed — following the instruction is part of the test. Shortlisted candidates complete a recorded 20–25 minute first-line interview conducted by our AI interviewer, followed by a live assessment session and a paid trial task.

title: AI Automator / Project Manager — Automation & Marketing Ops (UK AI-First Studio)
job_title: AI Automator / Project Manager — Automation & Marketing Ops (UK AI-First Studio)
description: We're a fast-moving AI-first venture studio running multiple D2C and B2B brands across health, wellness, aesthetics and SaaS — and we need someone who lives and breathes AI tools. If you're the type who spends your evenings watching YouTube tutorials on the latest n8n workflows, testing new LLM APIs before anyone else has heard of them, and genuinely gets excited when a new tool drops — this role is for you. What you'll be doing You'll be our in-house AI tinkerer and the person who keeps the work moving. Half the job is building: connecting APIs, testing automation workflows, integrating tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Base44 and whatever drops next week, and turning them into working proofs of concept we can plug into our stack. The other half is running the flow. You'll own a brand's marketing pipeline end to end — checking that the foundations are actually in place before work starts, handing tasks to the right people (editors, copywriters, researchers, media buyers), chasing the pieces that are late, and keeping a dozen moving parts in time with each other. The most valuable thing you'll do is spot the missing dependency before it breaks something downstream, and then tell the person responsible that their work needs fixing. If you've ever been the one quietly keeping a chaotic project on the rails, you'll recognise the seat. You're a great fit if you: Can set up and troubleshoot API integrations without hand-holding Stay ahead of the curve on AI tools (image gen, video gen, voice, LLMs, automation) Have experience with tools like n8n, Make, Zapier, Airtable or similar Have run projects or teams before — agency, ops, BPO team lead, or your own brand Can look at AI output and tell whether it's actually good or just sounds good Communicate clearly in English and document what you build Nice to have: Meta ad tech, CRM integrations, direct-response funnels, or content production pipelines. This is a full-time remote role with room to grow fast. We move quickly and we'll keep you busy with interesting problems. HOW TO APPLY We're an AI-first company, and we hire the way we operate. We don't run a hundred intro calls. We built our own AI voice interviewer — it talks to you for about 15 minutes and asks the things a CV can't answer. Everyone goes through it, and we only send the link to applicants worth our time. If you're up for it, reply with exactly this line: YES SEND ME THE AI AGENT Underneath it, tell us in a short note why you're the best person for this role — what you've actually built or run, and what makes you better than the rest of the pile. A few sharp paragraphs beat a full CV. Get the link, get through the interview, and you're talking to us directly.

title: Hiring / Onboarding Specialist
description: # Rescuer Onboarding Specialist **Road Rescue Network** **Full-Time | 100% Remote / Work From Home** Road Rescue Network is hiring a **Rescuer Onboarding Specialist** to help onboard independent service providers joining our nationwide roadside assistance network. Our Rescuers include towing companies, mobile diesel mechanics, mobile truck and trailer repair technicians, commercial tire providers, roadside assistance technicians, heavy-duty recovery operators, and other independent service professionals. Your job is simple: **take qualified Rescuers from application to ACTIVE.** You will guide new Rescuers through the onboarding process, verify their information and documentation, help configure their accounts, teach them how to use the Road Rescue Network platform, and make sure they are ready to accept their first rescue. ## THIS IS A 100% REMOTE POSITION This position is completely **work from home**. There is no office to report to. You must have a professional and reliable home working environment with: * Reliable high-speed internet * Reliable computer * Quality headset * Quiet workspace suitable for professional phone calls * Reliable backup plan for internet or power interruptions * Ability to work independently without direct in-person supervision ## FLUENT ENGLISH IS REQUIRED — NO EXCEPTIONS **You must speak and write fluent English to be considered for this position.** This is a phone-heavy position. You will communicate every day with towing company owners, mechanics, technicians, independent contractors, and other service providers throughout the United States. You must be able to: * Speak English clearly, confidently, and fluently * Easily understand native English speakers during live telephone conversations * Hold professional conversations without relying on scripts * Explain processes and technology clearly * Write professional emails and chat messages in English * Communicate naturally and confidently with U.S.-based business owners **If you are not completely comfortable conducting professional telephone conversations in English, please do not apply.** Applicants may be required to submit a voice recording and complete a live English phone interview before being considered. ## CORE RESPONSIBILITIES ### Rescuer Onboarding Guide new Rescuers through the complete onboarding process, including: * Account creation * Business profile setup * Service selection * Coverage areas and service regions * Custom service rates * Payment and payout setup * Required documentation * Platform configuration * Final account activation ### Verification & Compliance Review Rescuer applications and verify required information and documentation. This may include: * Identification * Driver's licenses * Business information * Insurance documentation * Professional credentials * Service capabilities * Banking and payment information * Other documentation required for activation You must be extremely detail-oriented. Accounts should not be activated until required onboarding information has been completed and verified. ### Application Follow-Up Many applicants will begin onboarding but not finish. You will proactively contact incomplete applicants by phone, email, and messaging to determine what is preventing them from completing onboarding and help move them forward. You are expected to **follow up — not simply wait for applicants to contact us.** ### Platform Training Teach newly approved Rescuers how to use the Road Rescue Network platform. This includes helping them understand how to: * Log into their account * Manage their profile * Configure services and service areas * Set and update rates * Manage availability * Receive rescue opportunities * Accept or decline dispatches * Update job statuses * Communicate through the platform * Use dispatch and live-tracking features * Manage payment and payout information ### Rescuer Activation Your primary responsibility is getting qualified Rescuers **ACTIVE and ready to work.** You will own your applicants from the beginning of the onboarding process through activation. We don't measure success by how many applications you look at. **We measure success by how many qualified Rescuers you successfully activate.** ### Network Growth Support Work with Road Rescue Network operations to identify cities, regions, and service categories where additional Rescuers are needed. When certain markets need additional towing companies, mechanics, tire technicians, or other service providers, those applicants may be prioritized for onboarding. ### Onboarding Performance You will be expected to track and improve key onboarding metrics, including: * New applications * Application-to-contact time * Application completion rate * Verification turnaround time * Activation rate * Average time from application to activation * Incomplete applications * First-rescue readiness ## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We want someone who is: * Extremely comfortable speaking on the telephone * Fluent in spoken and written English * Professional when communicating with U.S.-based businesses * Friendly but persistent * Highly organized * Detail-oriented * Comfortable handling a high volume of applicants * Comfortable learning new technology * Able to explain software to people who may not be technical * Able to manage multiple applicants at different stages simultaneously * Comfortable working independently * Reliable in a remote work environment * Good at following up without being reminded * Focused on completing tasks rather than simply staying busy Experience in customer service, BPO operations, logistics, transportation, vendor onboarding, account activation, CRM systems, SaaS platforms, roadside assistance, towing, trucking, or similar industries is a plus. Experience with platforms such as Stripe, CRM software, applicant tracking systems, dispatch software, or other web-based business systems is also a plus. ## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Success in this position is straightforward: **Qualified Rescuers move through onboarding quickly, their information is accurate, they understand the platform, and they become active and ready to accept rescue opportunities.** We are looking for someone who takes ownership of that process. If 20 qualified applicants enter your onboarding pipeline, your job is not to simply send them an email. Your job is to find out what each applicant needs, follow up, remove roadblocks, complete verification, get their account configured, and move as many qualified Rescuers as possible to **ACTIVE**. ## ABOUT ROAD RESCUE NETWORK Road Rescue Network is a technology platform connecting motorists, trucking companies, fleets, and businesses with independent roadside service providers. Our network includes towing and recovery operators, mobile mechanics, commercial tire providers, roadside assistance professionals, and other independent service providers. Our technology handles service requests, real-time dispatch, provider communication, live tracking, payments, and other tools used to manage roadside service from request through completion. ## POSITION DETAILS **Position:** Rescuer Onboarding Specialist **Company:** Road Rescue Network **Employment:** Full-Time **Location:** 100% Remote / Work From Home **Schedule:** 40 Hours Per Week **English Requirement:** Fluent Spoken & Written English — REQUIRED **Work Environment:** Professional home workspace with reliable internet and computer ## HOW TO APPLY Please include the following with your application: 1. A brief introduction about yourself. 2. Your previous customer service, onboarding, BPO, logistics, or similar experience. 3. Your experience working with U.S.-based customers or businesses. 4. Your experience working remotely. 5. A **60–90 second voice recording in English** introducing yourself and explaining why you would be good at this position. 6. Your internet speed and backup internet/power arrangements. 7. The word **RESCUER** somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire job posting. **Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.** Use ---------- Road Rescue Network is looking for people who communicate well, learn quickly, follow through, and take ownership of getting Rescuers successfully onboarded and activated. Starting Hourly rate is $4.00 USD with plenty of room for growth based on your work ethic and performance.

title: Controller
description: We are seeking an experienced Controller to lead and oversee the company’s accounting and financial operations. This role requires a hands-on finance leader who can manage the full accounting cycle while providing management with clear visibility into cash flow, profitability, margins, inventory, and overall financial performance. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in distribution or wholesale, particularly with inventory accounting, COGS management, equipment sales, and margin analysis. Experience working with a U.S.-based company and understanding U.S. GAAP is required. Because the company has recently undergone an acquisition, the Controller will also play an important role in post-acquisition financial integration, including improving reporting processes, supporting system integration, and developing reliable financial reporting for the new ownership structure. Key Responsibilities Accounting & Financial Operations * Manage the company’s full-cycle accounting operations, including: * General Ledger * Accounts Payable * Accounts Receivable * Payroll * Bank and account reconciliations * Month-end and year-end close * Maintain accurate and timely financial records in accordance with U.S. GAAP. * Prepare and review financial statements, including: * Balance Sheet * Profit & Loss Statement * Cash Flow Statement * Supporting schedules * Establish and maintain strong internal controls and accounting procedures. * Coordinate with external CPAs, auditors, tax professionals, and other financial partners. * Ensure accounting deadlines, reporting requirements, and compliance obligations are consistently met. Cash Flow & Financial Management * Own the company’s cash flow management and forecasting process. * Develop short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts. * Monitor incoming customer payments and outgoing vendor, payroll, tax, and operating obligations. * Identify potential cash flow issues and proactively communicate them to leadership. * Provide recommendations to improve working capital and cash availability. * Analyze financial performance and provide management with actionable recommendations. Inventory, COGS & Distribution Accounting * Oversee accounting for inventory, including: * Inventory costing * Valuation * Cycle counts * Adjustments * Shrinkage * Monitor and analyze Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) and gross margins. * Review equipment sales margins and identify profitability trends. * Analyze inventory purchases, vendor costs, freight, and other costs affecting product margins. * Work with operations and sales teams to ensure inventory and project costs are accurately captured. * Develop reporting that provides visibility into profitability by product, customer, project, or business segment. Post-Acquisition Integration * Support the financial integration of the company following the recent acquisition. * Assist with the integration of accounting processes, systems, financial records, and reporting requirements. * Help establish consistent accounting policies and procedures under the new ownership structure. * Support potential ERP or accounting-system migration and implementation. * Develop and maintain accurate reporting for ownership and executive leadership. * Prepare or support monthly management and board-level financial reporting packages. * Establish KPIs and dashboards that provide ownership with clear visibility into financial performance. * Ensure financial data from multiple entities or business units can be consolidated accurately when required. Financial Analysis & Strategic Support * Provide leadership with financial analysis to support business decisions. * Analyze revenue, expenses, gross margins, operating costs, working capital, and profitability. * Develop budgets, forecasts, and financial models. * Identify cost-saving opportunities and areas for improving profitability. * Evaluate the financial impact of major purchases, vendor agreements, projects, and business initiatives. * Partner with leadership to establish financial targets and monitor performance against them. Industry & Compliance Responsibilities * Apply accounting knowledge relevant to medical equipment and distribution businesses. * Understand the financial impact of OEM/vendor relationships, rebates, discounts, and partner agreements. * Understand the accounting differences between capital equipment and consumable products. * Maintain awareness of applicable sales-tax considerations related to medical equipment. * Support compliance requirements applicable to the company’s healthcare-adjacent business relationships. * Maintain appropriate documentation for financial transactions and vendor/customer relationships. Qualifications Required Experience * 5–8+ years of accounting or finance experience. * 2–3+ years of experience in a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager role. * Strong background in distribution, wholesale, or equipment-based businesses. * Demonstrated experience managing full-cycle accounting. * Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP. * Experience with inventory accounting, COGS, and gross-margin analysis. * Experience with cash flow forecasting and financial planning. * Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements. * Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and financial modeling capabilities. * Experience with accounting/ERP systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, or similar platforms. * Excellent written and spoken English. Preferred Experience * Medical device, medical equipment, healthcare, or healthcare-adjacent industry experience. * Experience with post-acquisition integration. * Experience working under a private equity, holding company, or investor-owned structure. * Experience with multi-entity accounting and consolidation. * Experience implementing or migrating ERP/accounting systems. * Experience preparing investor, board, or PE-style reporting packages. * Familiarity with vendor rebates and OEM partner agreements. * Experience analyzing profitability for capital equipment sales. Remote Work Requirements * Previous experience working remotely with a U.S.-based team. * Ability to maintain meaningful working-hour overlap with the U.S. Eastern Time Zone. * Strong communication skills when working with executives, vendors, customers, OEM partners, and internal teams. * Highly organized, self-directed, and capable of managing deadlines independently. * Comfortable working with cloud-based accounting, communication, and business systems. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is more than a bookkeeper or financial reporting specialist. We are looking for a **hands-on Controller** who can understand the entire financial picture of the business and help leadership make better decisions. This person should be able to clearly answer: * How much cash do we have available? * What cash is expected to come in and when? * What payments and obligations are coming due? * Which products, projects, and customers are most profitable? * Where are margins being lost? * How much capital is tied up in inventory? * What is driving changes in COGS and gross margin? * How is the business performing against budget and forecast? * What financial risks should leadership be aware of? * What actions can the company take to improve cash flow and profitability? Key Success Measures Success in this role will be measured by: * Accurate and timely monthly financial close. * Reliable financial statements and management reporting. * Improved cash flow visibility and forecasting accuracy. * Strong inventory and COGS controls. * Accurate gross-margin and profitability reporting. * Timely identification of financial risks and opportunities. * Successful integration of accounting processes following the acquisition. * Effective reporting to executive leadership and new ownership. * Improved financial controls, processes, and operational efficiency. How to Apply: Please send the following to: ---------- Updated Resume/CV Cover Letter explaining why your accounting and finance experience, particularly in full-cycle accounting, inventory, COGS, financial reporting, and cash flow management, makes you a strong fit for this Controller role. Candidates who submit a short Loom video explaining their relevant accounting and finance experience, leadership background, experience working with U.S.-based companies, and why they believe they are a strong fit for the Controller position will receive additional consideration. title: Senior Typescript/Vue 3 Developer
description: We are a software development company seeking an additional team member for immediate assistance with client projects. This is a great opportunity for an ongoing relationship, with the potential for a full-time position if things go well. We are looking for a senior front-end developer to help with web development of a medium sized application. If you are a full-stack developer, please apply also, as we have back-end work (that is a different role we’ll be hiring for, but if you’re strong in Python, let us know). The initial scope is for 40 hours per week. The project will be to develop part of the front-end, using Vue3 (composition API, typescript) along with vite, pinia, vitest (jest experience is OK). We want a senior engineer, who can solve difficult problems, as well as manage other developers. The full dev stack is: typescript, Vue3 single file components (SFC, composition), Quasar Framework, Vite, Vitest, bash, github. We need a senior developer who is comfortable writing clean maintainable code, and has dealt with things like server-sent-events, SSE resumption, well designed class structures, and full test suites (unit, functional and integration). You will be maintaining a TS library, and the app itself. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE: Must Have Skills: - Experienced only: please *do not* apply if you are not an experienced developer. - Coding: a lot of experience with front-end development (clean, maintainable and (advanced) typescript, html, css, bootstrap). - Familiarity with either Cursor or Windsurf IDEs, and the agentic coding workflow. - Test driven development: all of our coding starts with writing tests first. Please outline your experience with automated testing, preferably vitest or jest (or cypress or similar) for end-to-end testing. - Typescript: typescript development experience (our core logic is in a typescript library that is compiled to JS using Vite and rollup). You must be very comfortable working in a strongly typed environment, writing types and classes, and following strong OOP patterns by default. - HTML/CSS: strong with HTML and SCSS. - Quasar: if you have experience with the Quasar framework, this is highly desired and you should highlight this in your application. - PrimeVue, Syncfusion: we are evaluating these libraries and if you have production experience with them please let us know. - End-to-end developer: Must have experience taking rich mockups (e.g. Canva or Figma) with sophisticated design and converting them into fully working front-end code. Note you will be working alongside a designer. “Done” would mean: 1) library/service classes built; 2) GUI built; 3) extensive test suite that covers all that code; 4) documentation written. If you are not used to working like that, this might not be a fit for you. - “Design thinking”: we want a senior developer who knows how to think through designing codebases that scale. i.e. using tests, writing clean code, documentation, etc. - CI/CD: must be familiar with using Github, bash scripts, etc. - Must have had experience managing/leading other devs. Even if its a small team. Desirable (but not required) skills: - Visual Design Sensibility: whilst we have a designer you can work with, it would be good if you have some design sensibility, and are able to implement “nice” looking pages without help from a designer. Please highlight your skill in this area. - Backend (python): whilst *not* a requirement, it would be a big plus if you have experience working on the backend as well (i.e. you’re a full-stack developer). Our backend is a python FastAPI set of webservices. - Backend (other): if you don’t have backend experience with python, but do have it in other languages (e.g. c# /, or node or next.js etc) then please include information about that. - Automation: comfortable writing scripts (e.g. build scripts for npm run build, etc) or deployment scripts in bash or powershell to help with CI/CD. - Uses AI: if you are using any AI coding tools we like that and we want to know about it! e.g. if you’re using Github co-pilot, or Windsurf or Cursor etc, please let us know. We love AI and use it a lot ourselves, so this is a plus not a negative. To be considered for this role, you need to also complete the details on this form: ----------

title: Full-Time Short-Form Video Editor
description: Volume: 4 finished videos per day / 20–28 per week Type: Long-term, full-time, ongoing — this is a career role, not a gig Start: ASAP About the role I'm a full-time short-form creator posting 5–7 videos a day across TikTok and Instagram on multiple accounts. My niche content creations, class action lawsuits, AI tools, and consumer/product content, and I've done 100M+ views in the last 12 months. I batch film, so you will never be waiting on footage. You'll have the bulk of my raw content well ahead of schedule and you'll work from a queue, staying at least one full day ahead of my posting calendar. The entire point of this role is that I never open my phone in the morning and find nothing ready to post. I'm hiring one editor to own this long term. If you're reliable, this is a stable full-time salary with room to grow. Your daily output Every working day you deliver four finished, post-ready vertical videos: 1 × Greenscreen video Me talking over a background of changing images. You source or build the background visuals, time each swap to what I'm saying, key the greenscreen cleanly, and make the cuts feel intentional. Clean keying and correctly timed image changes are the whole job here. 2 × Talking-head UGC edits Tight cuts, filler and silence removal, onscreen artifacts. No captions or titles will need to be added, as I do this in TikTok and Instagram's native editors. These are the volume workhorses and should get faster as you build out templates. 1 × High-level promo video Premium edit for a content-creation tool I promote. Motion graphics, screen recordings and app/UI overlays, animated text, mockups, zooms, sound design. This is the piece I'll judge your ceiling on — it needs to look like a real product ad, not a template. You'll need to keep the pipeline organized with clear file naming, folder structure, and a short daily status on what's finished and what's queued. We can do this in Google Drive. What I need from you (non-negotiables) Full-time availability. Four videos a day including one premium edit is a real workday. This should be your main job, not something squeezed between other clients. A one-day buffer, always. You have footage in advance, so there's no excuse for a same-day scramble. Finished videos sit in the folder a day before I need them. Reliability over raw talent. I'd rather have a solid editor who never misses than a brilliant one I have to chase. Volume without sloppiness. Captions timed correctly, no dead air, hook in the first frame, clean keying — every single time. Range. You need to be fast on talking-head work and genuinely capable on motion graphics. One without the other doesn't work for this role. Daily communication. A short end-of-day update on what shipped and what's next. Flag problems before they slip, not after. Self-direction. I'll give you scripts, references, and brand direction. I'm not art-directing every cut. Good enough English to follow scripts, catch context, and time captions accurately. Stable internet and a machine that can handle daily motion-graphics work. Tools Strong in CapCut Pro and/or Premiere Pro. After Effects or equivalent motion skills is required for the daily promo video. Bonus: Figma or Photoshop for overlays, mockups, and thumbnails, plus experience editing tech/software or app-demo content. Nice to have Experience with high-volume creator or agency workflows Prior work on SaaS or app promo creative Understanding of what performs differently on TikTok vs. Reels Google Drive / Dropbox / ---------- pipeline experience How to apply Send the following — applications missing any of these get skipped: Greenscreen example — one video where you keyed a subject over changing background visuals. Talking-head examples — 2–3 short-form vertical UGC edits you personally edited. Your best motion-graphics or product-promo edit — the one you'd show to win a job. Real capacity answer — confirm you can deliver 4 videos a day including one premium edit, and list your current clients and commitments. Process Paid trial from my raw footage: one greenscreen, one talking head, one high-level promo edit If it's a fit, we start a paid 30-day trial month at the full $1,500 salary, then move to long-term Consistent delivery means raises and expanded scope as the accounts grow I'm looking for someone to work with for years. If you show up every day and keep the queue full, this role is yours to keep. Include the word "post-ready" in your message so I know you read this.

title: Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist
description: Who We Are: At Escend Media, we help D2C brands implement retention strategies that increase profit and drive customer retention. We want to be the ‘who’ behind emails that people ask ‘dannngg, who designed that’. What We Do: We help 7 and 8 figure ecommerce businesses develop, optimize and scale their owned media marketing efforts. Whether they are just looking to start email marketing, they need to really refine what they are currently doing or they need someone to take email marketing off their shoulders, we’re here to help them so that they can focus on running the business. Our clients are leaders in their industry and have built strong relationships with the customers they serve. Our job is to ensure that their brand image stays consistent online and offline and, more importantly, that their business is growing. Summary of The Position: The Shopify Post Purchase CRO Specialist is responsible for the strategic implementation and optimization of post-purchase upsell funnels, primarily utilizing platforms like Aftersell. This role focuses on enhancing Average Order Value (AOV) and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) e-commerce brands by creating highly relevant and effective post-purchase offers. The specialist will manage the full lifecycle of implementation, from strategic planning and A/B testing to performance monitoring and continuous optimization, ensuring seamless integration and alignment with brand objectives. Responsibilities: • Implement and manage post-purchase upsell funnels using platforms such as Aftersell, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives to increase AOV and CLTV. • Conduct systematic A/B testing across various elements including product selection, offer and pricing structures, pricing angles, copywriting, psychological angles, user interface (UI) optimization, and customer segmentation. • Monitor and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Acceptance Rate, AOV Lift, Incremental Profit/Session, and Upsell Conversion Rate, optimizing for Revenue Per Visitor (RPV) and Profit Per Visitor (PPV). • Ensure technical and creative requirements are met for all implementations, including fulfillment safety (e.g., 'Order on Hold' feature), mobile responsiveness, brand consistency, and effective inventory management. • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to ensure brand consistency and compelling offer presentation. • Identify and avoid common pitfalls such as the 'Wall of Text' error and the 'Irrelevance' trap, focusing on clear value propositions and relevant offers. • Leverage customer data, loyalty programs, and other add-ons to enhance post-purchase strategies and maximize incremental revenue. • Continuously refine and improve post-purchase strategies based on performance data and evolving market trends. Our Culture: • No one is bigger than the team • We don’t make excuses, we take responsibility • Innovate everywhere • Communicate. Communicate. Communicate. We have a culture of open communication. Required Skills: • Proven experience in implementing and optimizing post-purchase upsell strategies, preferably with platforms like Aftersell. • Strong understanding of e-commerce metrics and their impact on business growth (AOV, CLTV, ROAS, RPV, PPV). • Demonstrated expertise in A/B testing methodologies and data-driven optimization. • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to quality assurance in all implementations. • Knowledge of mobile UI/UX best practices for e-commerce. • Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into actionable strategies. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly. • Experience with project management software (e.g., Clickup) is a plus. • Proactive approach with a sense of urgency and purpose in daily tasks. Perks: - Flexible working hours - Remote working - Room to grow - we're an early stage start up with a proven track record - Competitive compensation - Work with some amazing brands This Role Is Perfect for You If… - You love working as a team. - You are a self-starter. - You can work under pressure - You have exceptional communication skills - You are results/outcome driven. - You have a ‘can-do’ attitude. If “that’s not my job” isn’t in your vocabulary, you’ll fit in great! This Role is NOT the Right Fit For You If You Are… - A ‘me first’ type of person - Not a self-starter. - Not a ‘people person’ - Problem driven, not solution oriented. If you complain about problems/issues/bottlenecks, without proposing a solution, this is not for you. - Looking for a typical 9-5. If you hate Mondays, this is not for you. We’re a mission-driven company who are all about changing the lives and businesses that we work with. If we have something that needs to get done, we’ll have all hands on deck. Sometimes you might have to work late but sometimes you’ll get the afternoon off, it’s not all work no play, but we’re here to help business grow!
