title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
job_title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description: AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote The short version We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven email, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics. Who we are We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results. How we work (important) - We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms. - That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services. - You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country. What you will do (the core) - Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market: email at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits. - For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started. - For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way. - It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country. - Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign. - Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds. - Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on email and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought. - Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works. What you will do (the bonus, all-round) - Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting. How you build it (we like builders, not renters) - Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows. - Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense. - Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform. - For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box. If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want. Who you are - You think in systems and you build and own them. - You have grown something real and can show it, with a number. - You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration. - You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation. - You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market. - You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted). The deal - Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results. - We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person. - As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role. How to apply (please read) 1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this. 2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent? 3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number. Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
job_title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description: Role We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result. About us We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes. How we work We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review. This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code. What you will do - Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely. - Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable. - Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps. Requirements - Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely). - Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself. - Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase. - Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input). - Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow. - Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders. - Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday. Nice to have - AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features). - Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds. - Multi-tenant SaaS experience. Trial (before any production access) We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront. You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit. How to apply (English, no template letters) 1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep. 2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it? 3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code. 4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith? 5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records? 6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects. Do not apply if - You are not the person who will do the work. - You ship AI output without verification. - You cannot describe your workflow concretely. - You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase. - You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Digital Marketing Expert – Meta Ads
description: META ADS & DIGITAL MARKETING SPECIALIST – BJJ / MARTIAL ARTS We are an established Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu academy looking for an experienced Meta Ads & Digital Marketing Specialist to manage and grow our paid advertising. We offer BJJ programs for kids and adults and are looking to significantly improve our local marketing while expanding into the sale of BJJ instructional content, online courses and other digital products. This is a long-term role for someone who understands performance marketing, lead generation and conversions — not someone who simply knows how to boost posts. WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON 1. Local BJJ Academy Marketing You will develop and manage Meta campaigns designed to: - Generate leads and bookings for trial BJJ classes - Target parents for our kids' BJJ programs - Target adults interested in starting BJJ - Run local brand awareness campaigns - Retarget website visitors and engaged audiences - Improve trial bookings and ultimately convert prospects into members - Test different audiences, offers, hooks and creatives Our priority isn't simply generating cheap leads. We want quality prospects who actually book trials and have the potential to become paying members. 2. BJJ Instructional Content & Digital Products We are also expanding into selling BJJ instructional content and digital products online. You will help develop, launch and optimise campaigns for: - Paid BJJ instructional content - Online BJJ courses - Digital products - Lead magnets and free instructional content - Email list acquisition - Prospecting campaigns - Retargeting campaigns - Sales campaigns - Funnel optimisation - Scaling profitable campaigns Unlike our academy advertising, this side of the business will target a national and international BJJ audience. Experience successfully marketing online courses, instructionals or other digital products is therefore highly valued. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES - Create, manage and optimise Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns - Develop campaign structures and testing strategies - Research and build appropriate audiences - Set up prospecting and retargeting campaigns - Develop advertising angles and offers - Write compelling ad copy, headlines and hooks - Work with our existing video and photo content to develop ads - Advise us on what new creative content needs to be filmed - Test different creatives, copy, audiences and offers - Monitor CPL, CTR, CPM, CPA, ROAS and conversion rates - Optimise campaigns based on actual performance data - Track leads through to trial bookings and memberships - Help develop and optimise digital product funnels - Provide clear weekly reporting showing what is working, what isn't and what should be tested next WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR You MUST have proven experience managing Meta Ads for lead generation and/or digital product sales. Experience marketing any of the following is highly desirable: - Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu - Martial arts - Gyms and fitness businesses - Membership businesses - Local service businesses - Online courses - Digital products - Coaching or education businesses Knowledge of BJJ or martial arts would be a major advantage. WE WANT SOMEONE WHO UNDERSTANDS THE NUMBERS We are looking for someone who thinks strategically. We don't want someone who simply launches campaigns and leaves them running. You should be comfortable analysing the entire customer acquisition journey and identifying where a campaign or funnel is failing. For example: Low hook rate → Creative problem Good engagement but low CTR → Messaging/offer problem Good CTR but poor lead conversion → Landing page/funnel problem Lots of leads but few trial bookings → Lead quality or follow-up problem Trials but poor membership conversion → Offer/sales process problem For digital products, we also want someone who understands CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, retargeting and scaling profitable campaigns. HOURS Initially approximately 10–15 hours per week, with the opportunity for additional hours as our digital instructional business grows. We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position who can grow with the business. HOW TO APPLY IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word "BJJ". Applications that do not start with BJJ may not be considered. This is so we know you have actually read the entire job description. Then please tell us: 1. Your experience managing Meta Ads 2. Examples of campaigns you have personally managed 3. Your typical monthly ad spend managed 4. Results you've achieved — CPL, CPA, ROAS, etc. 5. Your experience generating leads for local businesses 6. Any experience with gyms, martial arts or membership businesses 7. Your experience selling online courses, instructionals or digital products 8. How you approach creative testing 9. How you determine when to scale, modify or stop a campaign 10. Your hourly rate and weekly availability We're looking for someone who can become an important part of our marketing team and help us grow both our physical BJJ academies and our digital BJJ instructional business.

We want someone who understands **mortgage customer acquisition.** --- # REQUIRED EXPERIENCE Please apply ONLY if you can check most of these boxes: ☐ Previous Facebook/Meta Ads experience ☐ Previous experience generating leads for a **U.S. mortgage company, lender, broker, or loan officer** ☐ Experience with U.S. residential mortgage campaigns ☐ Understanding of Meta's rules applicable to housing/mortgage advertising ☐ Experience with lead-generation campaigns ☐ Experience with Meta Instant Forms ☐ Experience with landing-page funnels ☐ Experience with Pixel/CAPI and conversion tracking ☐ Experience measuring cost per lead and cost per qualified lead ☐ Experience A/B testing creatives, hooks, copy, forms, and landing pages ☐ Strong analytical skills ☐ Strong written English ☐ Reliable internet and computer ☐ Able to work independently without constant supervision --- # STRONG BONUS SKILLS Experience with any of the following is valuable: * GoHighLevel * HubSpot * Zapier * Mortgage CRM systems * SMS/email automation * Google Analytics * Google Ads * Canva * Landing-page builders * Mortgage purchase campaigns * Jumbo mortgages * First-time homebuyer campaigns * Realtor lead-generation partnerships --- # HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS Your performance will ultimately be measured on: 1. **Cost per lead** 2. **Cost per qualified mortgage lead** 3. **Lead-to-appointment conversion** 4. **Appointment-to-application conversion** 5. **Cost per mortgage application** 6. **Closed/funded loan attribution** 7. **Return on advertising spend** A $20 lead that never qualifies is worth less to us than a $75 lead that becomes a serious mortgage applicant. **Lead quality matters more than lead volume.** --- # COMPENSATION **Starting Rate: $7–$12 USD/hour** We are willing to pay toward the higher end for someone who can demonstrate actual U.S. mortgage lead-generation results. We would prefer to start part-time while we establish performance. If you can consistently generate qualified mortgage opportunities at an acceptable acquisition cost, this can become a **long-term position with increased hours and compensation.** --- # HOW TO APPLY Start your application with: **"I HAVE GENERATED U.S. MORTGAGE LEADS"** Then answer ALL of the following: ### 1. Mortgage Experience Which U.S. mortgage companies, brokers, lenders, or loan officers have you run Facebook/Meta Ads for? You may keep client names confidential if necessary. ### 2. Results For your best U.S. mortgage campaign, tell us: * Monthly ad spend: * Number of leads: * Average cost per lead: * Number of qualified leads: * Cost per qualified lead: * Appointments generated: * Applications generated: * Closed loans, if tracked: ### 3. Proof Provide screenshots of Meta Ads Manager showing results from previous mortgage or closely related campaigns. **You may remove or hide confidential client information.** ### 4. Purchase Mortgage Experience Have you specifically generated leads from people looking to **purchase a home**, rather than refinance? Explain the campaign and results. ### 5. Campaign Strategy Assume we want to generate mortgage inquiries from: **New Jersey homebuyers with a signed purchase contract, closing within 1–90 days, seeking a $300,000–$2 million mortgage.** In 5–10 sentences, explain how you would approach the campaign. ### 6. Tracking How would you track: **Facebook Lead → Qualified Lead → Appointment → Application → Closed Loan?** ### 7. Compensation What is your requested hourly rate? ### 8. Availability How many hours per week can you dedicate to us? --- # IMPORTANT **Do not apply if your experience is limited to social media posting, graphic design, or boosting Facebook posts.** We are hiring a **performance marketer and mortgage lead-generation specialist.** We will prioritize candidates who can show documented results generating **U.S. mortgage leads through Meta advertising.** The **$7–$12/hour range is appropriate for screening**, but I would not automatically reject someone asking $12–$15/hour if they can prove they have built profitable U.S. mortgage campaigns. Current PH postings show experienced mortgage/real-estate marketing talent around $7–$9/hour, while specialized Meta performance marketers are being advertised substantially higher. ([OnlineJobs][1]) The most important screening question is the **New Jersey campaign strategy question**. It quickly separates someone who has genuinely worked with U.S. mortgage advertising from someone who has merely run Facebook lead forms.

Proven experience managing supply chain or supplier operations for a high-volume e-commerce or dropshipping business — this is not a role for beginners - You are used to working with large revenues, large order volumes, and large SKU catalogs (3,000+ SKUs) - Experience managing multiple suppliers / Chinese agents at the same time - A strong, direct communicator and hard negotiator — you are comfortable pushing back, questioning charges, and holding suppliers accountable - title: Email Designer – D2C E-Commerce Brand
description: Summary We’re looking for an Email Designer to join our retention marketing team and become the dedicated email designer for our men’s belt brand. You’ll work closely with our Head of Retention and the rest of the design team, creating campaigns and flows and helping us continuously improve the quality of our email marketing. We’re looking for someone who understands good design, is creative, communicates well, and most importantly, is proactive. You don’t necessarily need years of email design experience. Experience with email is a big plus, but if you’re a strong designer, the specifics of email design can be learned. What matters to us is that you can think for yourself, bring ideas, ask for feedback, and take initiative. The Role You’ll be the dedicated email designer for one of our brands. Our other brand already has its own designer, so you’ll be able to really dive into this brand, understand its customers and visual identity, and become very familiar with what works for it. You’ll work directly with our Head of Retention, who leads the email strategy and direction, as well as the other designers on the team. Your work goes further than simply receiving a finished wireframe and putting it together in Figma. You’ll be involved in: - Coming up with ideas and concepts for campaigns - Designing campaigns and flows in Figma - Writing and improving email copy together with AI - Building and setting up emails inside Klaviyo - Finding the right imagery and content for your designs - Thinking about layout, hierarchy, storytelling, and how to communicate an offer or message visually - Bringing your own ideas to campaigns and discussions - Asking for feedback and improving your work - Participating in concepting, feedback, and strategy calls with the team You’ll have freedom to be creative and bring your own input, while working within the strategy and direction set by the Head of Retention. If you’re looking for a role where every concept, wireframe, asset, and piece of copy is completely prepared for you before you start designing, this probably isn’t the right fit. We want a designer who enjoys being involved in the process. What We’re Looking For Must-have: - Strong Figma skills - A good understanding of design, including typography, hierarchy, spacing, composition, and layout - Creativity and the ability to develop ideas visually - Fluent spoken and written English - Good communication skills - Proactive attitude - Attention to detail - Comfortable asking questions and requesting feedback - Able to work independently when needed - Able to overlap with European / Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST) Big plus: - Previous email design experience - Experience with Klaviyo - Experience with Photoshop - Experience with AI image generation - Experience using AI for copywriting or creative workflows - Experience with e-commerce or DTC brands - Advanced Klaviyo knowledge such as dynamic blocks, personalization, or conditional content Being Proactive Is Important This is probably the most important part of the role besides being a good designer. We don’t want someone who finishes an assigned task and then simply waits until another task appears. If you have room in your schedule, look at what’s coming up. Ask what you can work on. Review previous designs. Bring an idea. Ask for feedback. Suggest something we could test or improve. You don’t need to lead the strategy, but we do want you to contribute to it. We want someone who becomes a genuine part of the team rather than someone we only communicate with when a design needs to be made. About the Brand You’ll be designing for our men’s belt brand. We’ve recently expanded the brand with a completely new Outdoor collection, alongside our existing Classic collection. This gives us a lot of new products, photography, use cases, stories, and creative directions to work with. We’re currently working on taking the overall email design to the next level and making our campaigns more varied, visual, and interesting. There’s plenty of room to experiment and bring new ideas into the brand. How We Work We use: - Figma for design - Klaviyo for email marketing - Slack for daily communication - Notion for planning and workflows - AI tools to help with copywriting, ideation, and creative work You’ll have regular communication with the team and participate in feedback, concepting, and strategy calls. Most communication happens around European / Amsterdam time (CET/CEST), so reasonable overlap with these hours is important. We’ll initially start with a smaller number of hours per week depending on your availability and fit. There are plenty of hours available within the department for the right person, and we’re looking for someone we can work with long-term. To Apply Please send: 1. Your portfolio – Email design examples are a big plus, but we’re also interested in other work that demonstrates that you’re a strong designer. 2. A short introduction – Tell us about your design experience, Figma experience, and any experience you have with email marketing, Klaviyo, Photoshop, or AI tools. 3. (IMPORTANT) A short introduction video – Tell us a little about yourself, what you’ve worked on, and why you’re interested in the role. We’re not looking for someone who checks every possible box. We’re looking for a good designer who communicates well, is eager to learn, brings ideas, and takes initiative.

title: Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager
job_title: Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager
description: I am looking for a creative, reliable, and highly organized Podcast & YouTube Producer / Content Repurposing Manager for an ongoing part-time role. I have an established library of podcast interviews and other content that I want to refresh, tighten, repackage, and repurpose for YouTube and podcast platforms. Some older episodes are still highly relevant but may need stronger editing for today’s audience. For example, a 20-minute interview may be much stronger at 10–12 minutes if the unnecessary sections are removed and the main story is brought forward. Some are audio only; some are video and audio. This role requires more than technical editing. I am looking for someone with strong editorial judgment and excellent copywriting skills. Responsibilities You may be responsible for: Editing podcast audio and video Tightening older episodes while preserving the speaker’s meaning and natural voice Removing repetition, long pauses and sections that do not add value Creating polished intros and outros Preparing episodes for YouTube and podcast platforms Writing strong episode titles Writing descriptions, summaries and show notes Writing promotional copy Identifying strong hooks and key moments Creating or coordinating thumbnails Creating YouTube Shorts and social media clips Adding captions and subtitles Organizing content into playlists and categories Optimizing content for search and discoverability Reviewing older content and recommending how it can be repurposed Helping create a consistent visual and editorial style Reviewing analytics and identifying which topics, titles and formats perform best Suggesting ways to improve reach, engagement and audience growth Copywriting Is a Major Part of This Role Strong written English is essential. I do not want generic descriptions or titles that sound AI-generated. You should be able to listen to an interview, understand what makes it interesting, and turn that into compelling copy that makes someone want to click, watch or listen. For example: Weak: “Interview with Jane Smith about her life journey” Stronger: “Starting Over After Everything Changed: A Story of Resilience and Purpose” You need to be able to find the real story inside the conversation. You May Be a Good Fit If You: Have excellent written and spoken English Have experience editing podcasts and/or YouTube videos Understand audience retention Understand YouTube titles, thumbnails and basic SEO Are a strong copywriter Have good storytelling instincts Can identify the strongest parts of a conversation Can work independently once you understand the style and expectations Are comfortable making recommendations Are highly organized Pay close attention to detail Prefer clean, professional editing over excessive effects Experience with interview-based podcasts, educational content, wellness, leadership, coaching or personal development is helpful but not required. This Is Not the Right Role If: You only provide basic technical editing You rely entirely on AI for titles and descriptions You need detailed instructions for every task You are uncomfortable making editorial decisions Your editing style focuses more on effects than improving the content itself Ongoing Work This is an ongoing part-time role. There is a substantial library of existing content to work through, along with new content being created. I am looking for someone who could potentially become a long-term member of my content team. How to Apply Please include: A short introduction and your relevant experience. Links to 2–3 podcasts or YouTube videos you have edited or produced. Examples of titles, descriptions, show notes or promotional copy you personally wrote. Tell me what makes a podcast episode interesting enough for someone to keep listening. Tell me what you would look for when d ---------- how to turn a 20-minute interview into a stronger 10–15 minute episode. Begin your application with the word "Motivation" so I know you read the full posting. Please do not send a generic application. I am much more interested in finding someone with strong judgment, communication skills and creative ability than receiving a long list of software programs you know how to use.

job_title: Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI
description: Sales & Estimating Coordinator – Landscaping | Aspire, GoHighLevel & AI IMPORTANT: LOOM VIDEO REQUIRED TO APPLY Please do not apply until you have completed the Loom video instructions below. We receive a high volume of applications and will only review candidates who submit the required Loom video with their application. Your Loom video should be no longer than 5 minutes. In your Loom video, please: 1. Introduce yourself and briefly explain your relevant work experience. 2. Tell us specifically about any experience you have with Aspire Landscape Software. If you have used Aspire, explain what you did inside the software. 3. Tell us about any experience you have with GoHighLevel and what you have built or managed within it. 4. Explain how you currently use AI tools such as ChatGPT to make your work faster or better. 5. Imagine a salesperson sends you customer meeting notes, a meeting transcript, voice recordings, photos, measurements, and project instructions. Explain how you would take that information and turn it into a polished customer proposal. 6. Please share your screen for at least a portion of the Loom and show us a software, workflow, system, or project you are comfortable using. Do not show confidential information belonging to a current or previous employer. 7. Tell us about any other skills you have that may be valuable to our company. We are not looking for a professionally produced video. We want to see how you communicate, think, organize information, and use technology. Please do not simply read an AI-generated script. Applications without the required Loom link will not be considered. IMPORTANT WORK SCHEDULE: This position requires you to be available and working during our normal business hours of 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. Please make sure you are comfortable consistently working these hours before applying. ABOUT THE POSITION Local Landscapers is a growing landscaping and outdoor construction company in Virginia, USA. We are looking for a highly organized, technology-focused Sales & Estimating Coordinator to support our sales team. This is not a traditional data-entry Virtual Assistant position. Our salespeople spend their time meeting customers, visiting properties, understanding projects, taking measurements, developing solutions, selecting materials, and making the technical decisions required to build a project. We need someone behind them who can take that information and quickly turn it into an organized, professional, customer-ready proposal. The goal is simple: Our salesperson provides the knowledge and technical decisions. You help build the finished product. Over time, we want the right person to become an important part of our sales operation and help us process more opportunities without sacrificing speed, accuracy, or proposal quality. WORK SCHEDULE This is a full-time remote position. You must be available and actively working from 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday. This schedule is important because you will work directly with our U.S.-based sales team throughout the day. Our salespeople will be completing appointments and sending information to you so proposals can begin being built as quickly as possible. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working this schedule consistently and long term. WHAT YOUR WORKFLOW MAY LOOK LIKE A salesperson completes an appointment with a customer. The meeting may be recorded and summarized using Otter.ai. The salesperson may also provide you with a Loom video, voice recording, photos, measurements, drawings, material selections, pricing information, and additional notes. You will take that information and: * Organize the customer's goals and project information * Identify the individual services or line items being proposed * Draft professional customer-facing scope descriptions * Build and organize the proposal in Aspire * Add appropriate photos, product information, drawings, and supporting materials * Make sure the proposal clearly explains what is included and excluded * Reference previous approved proposal templates and company standards * Identify missing information instead of guessing * Present the salesperson with a short, organized list of questions requiring their decision * Prepare approximately 90% of the proposal for final salesperson review * Make requested revisions quickly * Help keep opportunities and follow-ups organized Our goal is NOT for you to make technical landscaping or construction decisions that you are not qualified to make. Our goal is for you to become extremely good at taking the salesperson's knowledge and turning it into a finished, polished sales package. ASPIRE LANDSCAPE SOFTWARE Experience with Aspire Landscape Software is STRONGLY PREFERRED. If you have Aspire experience, we want to know specifically what you have done inside the platform, such as: * Opportunities * Estimating * Proposals * Catalog items * Work tickets * Customer information * Scheduling/workflows * Reporting * Other Aspire functions Aspire experience is a major advantage, but we will consider an exceptional candidate who demonstrates the ability to learn software quickly. GOHIGHLEVEL Experience with GoHighLevel is preferred. As you grow into the position, you may also help us with: * Sales pipelines * Lead organization * Automated email and SMS follow-up * Workflows and automations * Tags and opportunity stages * Unsold proposal follow-up * Lead nurturing * Old lead reactivation * Marketing attribution * Sales reporting * CRM organization You do not need to be an expert in every GoHighLevel feature on your first day. AI IS PART OF THIS JOB We actively use AI and want someone who is comfortable using it. You should be able to use tools such as ChatGPT to help: * Organize raw information * Summarize meeting transcripts * Draft proposal language * Improve customer-facing writing * Research products and materials * Create repeatable templates * Analyze information * Improve workflows * Work faster without sacrificing accuracy We are not looking for someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. We want someone who knows how to give AI good information, review its output, catch mistakes, and turn it into useful finished work. COMMUNICATION This is a remote position, so strong asynchronous communication is extremely important. Our company already uses Loom regularly. You should be comfortable receiving instructions through: * Loom videos * Otter.ai transcripts and summaries * Voice recordings * Written notes * Photos and videos * Drawings * Email and messaging You should also be comfortable recording short Loom videos when showing us your work, asking a complicated question, or explaining an issue. One of the most important skills for this position is knowing when you can figure something out yourself and when you need to ask the salesperson a question. We do not want someone who guesses when important information is missing. At the same time, we need someone who is resourceful and does not require constant supervision. IDEAL CANDIDATE You may be a great fit if you: * Have excellent written and spoken English * Are extremely comfortable working on a computer * Work quickly and accurately * Are highly organized * Have excellent attention to detail * Are comfortable learning new software * Use AI regularly and intelligently * Can take messy/raw information and organize it * Can follow established systems and templates * Can identify missing or conflicting information * Are comfortable asking concise, specific questions * Can work independently * Enjoy building systems and improving processes * Are interested in a long-term position where your responsibilities can grow * Are able to consistently work 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday Experience supporting a landscaping, construction, home-service, estimating, or sales organization is a major plus. SOFTWARE & SKILLS WE VALUE Experience with any of the following should be mentioned in your application: * Aspire Landscape Software – strongly preferred * GoHighLevel * ChatGPT / AI tools * Otter.ai * Loom * Google Workspace * Google Sheets / Excel * Canva * CRM systems * Estimating software * Proposal-building software * Construction or landscaping software You do NOT need experience with every program listed above. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A successful person in this role makes our salespeople more productive. Instead of a salesperson spending significant time sitting at a computer building a proposal, we want them to be able to send you their information, move on to the next sales opportunity, and return later to a proposal that is approximately 90% complete. A great handoff might look like: "Proposal is ready for review. I need you to confirm these three technical questions. Everything else is complete." We value: Speed. Accuracy. Organization. Initiative. Excellent communication. The ability to figure things out. GROWTH OPPORTUNITY We are looking for someone interested in becoming a long-term member of our company. This position may begin primarily focused on proposal and estimating support, but the right person could eventually take significant ownership of our sales operations, including Aspire, GoHighLevel, proposal systems, follow-up systems, reporting, AI workflows, and supporting additional salespeople as our company grows. There is room for increased responsibility and compensation as you demonstrate your value and take ownership of more of the sales process. PAID SKILLS TEST Candidates who perform well during the initial application process may be invited to complete a PAID skills test. The test will closely resemble the actual work you would perform in this position. You may receive items such as: * Customer meeting information * Salesperson notes * Photos * Measurements * Voice/video instructions * Project information You will then be asked to organize the information and build part of a customer proposal. We encourage the use of AI during the test. We are interested in seeing the quality, accuracy, organization, judgment, and speed of your finished work. HOW TO APPLY STEP 1 – REQUIRED: Record your Loom video using the instructions at the very top of this job posting. title: Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time)
description: Creator Partnerships Manager (Part-Time, Remote) Type: Part-time, 20 hours per week (4 hours/day, Monday to Friday) Salary: $450 – $600 USD/month, depending on experience. ABOUT US We are a European e-commerce brand selling personalised jewelry. Small team, direct communication, everything in English. We run a creator program where content creators receive free product, make short-form video, and earn commission on the sales their content generates. It works. It just needs someone who runs it properly, every day. THE ROLE You own our creator program end to end. Managing the creator pipeline. Every creator moves through a number of stages before their first video goes live. You keep track of exactly where each one is, follow up on a fixed rhythm, and chase our suppliers when a sample is delayed. You tell the creator what's happening before they have to ask. Finding new creators. You get a fixed number of invitations to send every working day, and you use all of them. Not on the biggest accounts, on the right ones: clean natural-light filming, strong close-up work, an audience that actually engages. Reviewing video. This is where the job gets interesting. Every video is checked against our written standard before it goes live. Clear yes or no, and when it's a no you tell the creator exactly what to change. The founder reviews alongside you for the first two weeks so you learn what we look for. After that it's yours. Seasonal campaigns. Christmas, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day. You set these up in advance and brief our best creators, so the content exists before the season starts instead of during it. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We can teach you our product. We can teach you our platform. We cannot teach you attention to detail. The person we want notices that the hook lands at four seconds instead of two. That the product goes out of focus in the third shot. That a creator's last three posts got half the engagement of the ones before. That the tracker says "shipped" but the tracking number never moved. Most people watch a video and say "nice, good lighting". We are looking for the person who says "no, and here is exactly why, and here is what to change". That is the whole job. Everything else is process. REQUIRED - 2+ years managing creators, influencers or affiliate partners for a brand or agency - Excellent written English. You write to creators in the US and Europe every day and it has to sound human - A genuine eye for video. You can watch ten seconds and name what works and what doesn't - Self-managing. You track things without being asked and follow up without being reminded - Comfortable in Google Sheets A plus: - Experience with a creator platform such as Trybe, Aspire, GRIN or similar - E-commerce or Shopify background - Jewelry, fashion or beauty Not needed: - You do not edit video yourself WHO THIS SUITS Nobody will hand you a daily task list. You get clear targets and freedom in how you hit them. Creators are busy and get approached by a lot of brands. If following up with someone for the third time makes you uncomfortable, this will frustrate you. If you enjoy turning a quiet list into an active one, you will like it here. HOW TO APPLY We get a lot of applications and most of them are clearly written by AI. We can tell, and it never works in your favour. We would rather read three honest sentences from you than three polished paragraphs from a chatbot. So skip the cover letter. Just tell us two things, in your own words: One brand where you managed creators. How many, over what period, and what you did about the ones who went quiet. Numbers help. Why you think you are the right person for this one. Not why you want a job. Why this one. Write it like you would explain it to someone over coffee. That is all we need to start a conversation.

title: E-Commerce Virtual Assistant + Automation Specialist — Long-Term Opportunity
job_title: E-Commerce Virtual Assistant + Automation Specialist — Long-Term Opportunity
description: We are a U.S.-based e-commerce company looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant who can also help us automate repetitive parts of the business. This is not a traditional VA role where the goal is only to complete assigned tasks. We are looking for someone who can handle day-to-day e-commerce and administrative work, assist with customer phone calls, and help us identify, build, test, document, and improve automations that make the company more efficient. ## Core Responsibilities * Assist with customer phone calls * Create and update product listings * Work with product titles, descriptions, specifications, and fitment data * Organize and clean product information * Work in Excel and Google Sheets * Perform online research * Assist with website and e-commerce administrative tasks * Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve productivity * Organize images and product files * Follow detailed written procedures accurately * Help identify repetitive work that can be automated * Build, test, and improve automations * Document completed automations * Monitor automated processes and troubleshoot problems * Suggest better or faster ways of completing repetitive work Experience with BigCommerce, Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Zapier, Make, n8n, ChatGPT, APIs, Google Apps Script, Python, or similar tools is a plus. Automotive knowledge is NOT required. We will provide training. ## Work Schedule — Important This position requires working during **New York, U.S. business hours — Eastern Time (ET).** This is required because part of the position includes helping answer customer phone calls and working with our team during normal U.S. business hours. Applicants must be comfortable working this schedule from the Philippines. Please do not apply if you are only available during normal Philippine daytime hours. ## Automation Projects In addition to regular VA responsibilities, you will be assigned specific automation projects. Each project will have: * A clearly defined goal * A target completion date * Expected results * Testing requirements * Documentation requirements * A defined period for verifying reliability Examples may include: * Automating repetitive spreadsheet work * Automating product-data organization * Creating workflows between systems * Using AI to reduce repetitive writing or data-processing work * Automating reports * Automating file and image organization * Reducing manual data entry * Building repeatable internal workflows * Automating recurring e-commerce administrative tasks You are not expected to know how to automate everything on day one. What matters is your ability to research, learn, troubleshoot, test, and successfully complete projects. ## Automation Bonus Program Automation projects are eligible for additional performance bonuses separate from regular salary. An automation will NOT be considered successfully completed simply because it works once. To qualify for the full automation bonus, the automation must: * Meet the agreed project requirements * Work correctly in real-world use * Be properly tested * Be documented clearly * Continue working reliably for at least **30 days** * Produce the expected result without creating additional unnecessary manual work ### Faster Completion = Higher Bonus Each automation project will have a target completion date. Completing a project earlier can result in a **higher bonus**, provided the automation still meets all requirements and successfully completes the 30-day reliability period. The goal is to reward both: **Speed + Reliability** Finishing quickly is valuable, but only if the automation continues working correctly. An automation completed early but requiring constant repairs will not qualify for the higher bonus. An automation completed quickly, documented properly, and running successfully for 30 days may qualify for the highest bonus available for that project. The exact bonus and target dates will be defined before each automation project begins. ## What We Are Looking For * Strong spoken and written English * Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers by phone * Excellent attention to detail * Professional and patient customer-service skills * Comfortable working with numbers, spreadsheets, and product data * Able to follow detailed instructions without guessing * Strong internet research skills * Comfortable learning new software * Comfortable using ChatGPT and AI tools * Interested in automation and process improvement * Able to troubleshoot problems independently * Willing to suggest better ways of doing things * Reliable internet connection * Backup internet strongly preferred * Backup power strongly preferred * Comfortable working New York / U.S. Eastern Time * Interested in a long-term position We value people who do not just ask: “What task should I do next?” We are looking for someone who also thinks: “Why are we doing this manually, and can we make it faster or automate it?” ## Compensation We are currently evaluating the market and are open to different experience levels. Please tell us the compensation you believe is appropriate based on your experience and skills. Do NOT simply write “negotiable.” Regular salary and automation-performance bonuses are separate. ## How to Apply Please answer ALL of the following questions: 1. What city in the Philippines do you live in? 2. Are you looking for: * Full-time * Part-time * Either 3. How many hours per week would you prefer to work? 4. Are you able and willing to work during **New York, U.S. Eastern Time business hours on a permanent basis?** 5. What hours in Eastern Time are you available to work? 6. What monthly salary in USD would you expect for: * 20 hours per week * 40 hours per week 7. What is your current or most recent monthly salary? 8. Have you handled customer phone calls for a U.S., Canadian, UK, or Australian company? If yes, briefly describe your experience. 9. How comfortable are you speaking English with customers over the phone? Rate yourself from 1–10. 10. What e-commerce platforms have you worked with? 11. What automation tools have you used? Examples: Zapier, Make, n8n, Google Apps Script, Python, APIs, ChatGPT, Claude, Power Automate, or other tools. 12. Rate your Excel / Google Sheets ability from 1–10. 13. Rate your written English from 1–10. 14. How frequently do you currently use ChatGPT or other AI tools? 15. Describe one repetitive business task you have automated or made significantly more efficient. Please explain: * What the task was * What tools you used * How the automation worked * How much time it saved * Whether it continued running after you completed it 16. If you were given a repetitive task that you did not know how to automate, what steps would you take to figure it out? 17. What type of work are you best at? 18. What type of work do you dislike doing? 19. What internet speed do you currently have? 20. Do you have a backup internet connection? 21. Do you have backup power in case of an outage? 22. How soon could you start? At the very top of your application, write: **E-Commerce Automation** Applications that do not include this phrase or do not answer all questions may not be considered. Candidates selected for the next stage may be given a short paid skills and automation test.

title: AI Automation & Implementation Specialist

STRONGLY PREFERRED Experience with: • AI voice agents and phone automation • AI agent development • RAG and AI knowledge bases • CRM integrations and automation • Shopify or e-commerce integrations • Customer service and lead automation • REST APIs and webhooks • Database integrations • Workflow monitoring and error handling • JavaScript, Python, or other programming languages • Platforms such as Vapi, Retell AI, ElevenLabs, Twilio, or similar tools IMPORTANT QUALIFICATION We are looking for someone with REAL-WORLD IMPLEMENTATION EXPERIENCE. You should be able to: • Understand a business problem. • Identify what can and should be automated. • Recommend the appropriate AI tools, platforms, and approach. • Build and implement the solution. • Test and troubleshoot the automation. • Monitor and improve the system over time. We do not expect you to know every AI platform available. However, you should have a strong understanding of AI automation and integrations and be able to research and implement the right solution when needed. APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS When applying, please provide: 1. Examples of AI automation projects you have personally built and implemented. 2. A brief explanation of the business problem each automation solved. 3. The tools, platforms, APIs, and technologies used. 4. Your specific role and responsibilities in the implementation. 5. Portfolio links, screenshots, videos, documentation, or other evidence of your work, if available. 6. A brief explanation of how you would approach automating customer and product inquiries for a business like ours. Applications without relevant hands-on AI automation experience may not be considered. We are particularly interested in candidates who can look at a business process, identify opportunities for improvement, and turn those opportunities into practical, reliable AI-powered systems. We want someone who can TAKE OWNERSHIP of AI automation projects and implement solutions with MINIMAL SUPERVISION.

Use local and CRE hashtags (Broward, Fort Lauderdale, Plantation, Miami-Dade, Palm Beach, #CRE). Include a clear CTA on lead-oriented posts (DM, link, “contact Gus”). Repurpose blog and newsletter content into multiple short social posts. Track which formats drive profile visits and inquiries; double down on what works. Content Calendar — Plan Well in Advance The content calendar must be built ahead of time, not week-to-week. Planning in advance is what lets us produce higher-effort content — if the VA suggests a video, a script, or a shoot, we need lead time to prepare it. A good rule of thumb is to have the calendar mapped at least 3–4 weeks out. Map themes, posts, and key dates 3–4 weeks in advance across all platforms. Flag any post that needs a script, video, or graphic so there’s time to produce it. Share the calendar with Lisa so scripts and video work can be scheduled together. Keep a backlog of evergreen ideas to fill gaps and respond to timely market news. Be Proactive & Forward-Thinking We want a VA who is constantly thinking about what should be done next to grow reach — not just executing the list. Watch what’s working, study what competitors and top CRE accounts are doing, and bring recommendations to Lisa. Proactively pitch new content ideas, formats, and platform strategies to grow followers and reach. Recommend when video, Reels, or short scripts would outperform static posts — and plan them into the calendar early. Spot emerging platform trends and test them quickly while they’re still fresh. Suggest landing pages for individual properties when a listing would benefit from one, and build them as needed. Definition of Done — Social All scheduled posts published on time, on-brand, error-free. Comments and DMs answered within one business day. Weekly metrics logged in the shared tracker. 3. Responsibility 2 — Blogs & Newsletters Cadence: 2 blog posts per month and 1 newsletter per month. All content must be relevant to commercial real estate and reviewed and approved by Gus before publishing. Blog Workflow (2x / Month) 1. Propose topics from a running content backlog — CRE trends, South Florida market updates, asset-class insights (industrial, office, retail, multifamily, land), and seller/landlord education. 2. Draft in a Claude Project tuned to the CMV brand voice; target SEO keywords identified for the site. CAN NOT COPY AND PASTE FROM CLAUDE or ANY OTHER AI Platform. 3. Self-edit for accuracy, voice, and brand guardrails; run a humanizing pass so copy doesn’t read as AI-generated. and never copy and paste content. 4. Send to Lisa for review; incorporate edits. (If Lisa cannot approve, she will route it to Gus.) 5. Publish only after Lisa approves; add internal links, meta description, and a featured image. 6. Repurpose into social posts and a newsletter segment. Newsletter Workflow (1x / Month) 5. Curate the month’s highlights: new listings, closings, market data, and the best blog content. 6. Draft with a clear subject line, a strong opening, and one primary CTA. 7. Send to Lisa for review and approval (Lisa escalates to Gus only if needed). 8. Schedule/send; log open rate, click rate, and any replies/leads. Approval Rule Nothing publishes without Lisa’s sign-off. Everything routes through Lisa first; if she is unable to approve, she will have Gus review it. Build review time into the calendar — submit drafts at least 2–3 business days before the intended publish date. 4. Responsibility 3 — Website Optimization (SEO + AI/AEO) Scope to be finalized with Lisa. The VA must be capable of both traditional SEO and AI/Answer-Engine Optimization (AEO) — structuring content so it surfaces in AI assistants and answer engines, not just search results. This builds on the existing city-page template work (JSON-LD schema, breadcrumb schema, AEO FAQ blocks). Expected Skill Areas On-page SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, image alt text, page speed basics. Keyword research: identify terms South Florida CRE sellers/landlords search; map to pages and blog topics. AEO / structured data: maintain and extend the locked city-page template with JSON-LD, breadcrumb schema, and FAQ blocks. Content optimization: FAQ sections, original research formats, and clear, citable answers for AI engines. Measurement: track rankings, organic traffic, and AI-surface visibility over time. Property landing pages: create dedicated landing pages for individual listings when one is needed, optimized for search and conversion (clear details, CTA, and lead capture). To Discuss & Finalize With Lisa Which pages and city pages are the current priority. Access to the CMS, analytics, and any SEO tooling. Two open verification items before publishing: whether “KW Commercial” can be named in marketing materials, and whether “Innovation District” is the official corridor name in Pompano Beach. Reporting cadence and target metrics. 5. Responsibility 4 — Buildout (Brochures & Flyers) The VA will learn Buildout to create brochures and flyers for any active listings. These materials must follow brand standards and Florida compliance rules. Ramp-Up Plan 8. Complete Buildout onboarding/training and get account access. 9. Learn how listing data flows into brochure and flyer templates. 10. Produce a first brochure and flyer for review against brand and compliance standards. 11. Build a repeatable checklist so each new listing gets marketing materials quickly. Standards for Every Piece Both the CMV Commercial and The Martinez Team logos at equal size (Florida requirement) — use the combined lockup. Brand colors and fonts applied Accurate listing details; no unverified claims. Consistent layout and quality across all asset classes. 6. Cross-Cutting — Claude Proficiency & Workflows Across all four responsibilities, the VA should work fluently in Claude and continuously build assets that make the team faster. The aim is for the VA’s skills to help optimize Claude for future tasks, not just complete one-off work. Expectations Build Claude Projects: a dedicated Project per workstream (social, blog/newsletter, SEO/AEO, listing marketing) loaded with brand context, voice, and ICP files. Maintain a prompt library: save and refine prompts that produce on-brand output reliably. Document workflows: write down repeatable processes so they can be handed off or scaled. Quality control: always review Claude output for accuracy, brand voice, and compliance before it ships; humanize AI copy. Improve over time: note what works, update Projects and prompts, and propose new efficiencies to Lisa. Foundational Files to Use brand-context.md, brand-voice.md, and ideal-customer-profile.md — load these into every relevant Claude Project. Social media posts: Ongoing / weekly Lisa (spot-check claims & listings) Engagement (comments/DMs) Each active day Blog posts: 2x per month Lisa approves Newsletter: 1x per month Lisa approves Website SEO/AEO: Ongoing (TBD w/ Lisa) Lisa Buildout brochures/flyers: Per new listing Brand & compliance check Metrics report: Weekly + monthly Lisa

title: Senior Social Media & Lead Generation Manager-Construction Company
job_title: Senior Social Media & Lead Generation Manager-Construction Company
description: ******IMPORTANT: Priority will be given to candidates with proven experience managing social media for construction, building, architecture, property development, real estate, engineering or trade-based businesses. About Rockwall Projects Rockwall Projects is an established Sydney construction company operating since 2007. We deliver architectural homes, alterations and additions, commercial construction, remedial projects and Class 2 building work across Sydney. As Rockwall enters its next stage of growth with new branding and an upcoming website launch, we are seeking an experienced Social Media and Lead Generation Manager to take ownership of our digital presence. This is not a basic posting or virtual assistant position. We need a professional who understands branding, construction content, audience growth and how social media can generate genuine business enquiries. Position Details Location: Remote – Philippines Engagement: Independent contractor Hours: 20 hours per week Initial period: Three-month trial Rate: A$10–A$12 per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability Schedule: Flexible, with agreed availability during Sydney business hours Performance incentives may be available for generating qualified project enquiries This position has a genuine opportunity to grow into a full-time, long-term role as Rockwall’s social media activity, lead generation and business requirements increase The successful candidate will have the opportunity to take on greater responsibility and grow with the company as measurable results are achieved Role Responsibilities Social Media Management Take ownership of Rockwall Projects’ social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok. Develop and manage a structured monthly content calendar. Ensure content is prepared, approved, scheduled and published consistently. Adapt content appropriately for each platform while maintaining a consistent brand voice and visual identity. Schedule and publish content using Meta Business Suite and other relevant platforms. Monitor comments, engagement and messages and respond professionally where authorised. Maintain accurate and up-to-date information across all social media profiles. Keep all content, drafts and completed materials organised within Google Drive. Content Creation Transform supplied construction photos, videos and project information into professional and engaging content. Create Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, stories, carousels, project updates, before-and-after content and educational posts. Edit short-form videos using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro or similar professional software. Produce clean, professional graphics using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or equivalent platforms. Write strong captions, headlines and calls to action in professional Australian English. Create content that explains construction processes in a way that is interesting and understandable to potential clients. Develop fresh content ideas that increase brand awareness, engagement, trust and visibility. Repurpose core content appropriately across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok. Ensure all content reflects Rockwall’s new branding, services, values and upcoming website. Confirm technical or construction information with the Director before publishing anything that may be unclear or inaccurate. Construction-Focused Marketing Understand construction stages, site progress, renovations, structural work, remedial building, commercial projects and Class 2 construction. Recognise which site activities, project milestones and construction details will make valuable social media content. Turn ordinary site footage into professional stories that demonstrate Rockwall’s experience, workmanship and project capability. Present Rockwall as an established, credible and professional Sydney builder. Develop content for different target audiences, including homeowners, architects, developers, strata managers, commercial clients and government organisations. Never present AI-generated, stock or third-party imagery as completed Rockwall Projects work. Lead Generation Develop a social media strategy focused on generating genuine construction enquiries—not only followers and likes. Create organic campaigns that encourage prospective clients to visit the website, request a consultation or contact Rockwall. Support and manage Meta lead-generation campaigns when approved. Assist with Facebook and Instagram lead forms, campaign targeting, copy, creative material and calls to action. Develop LinkedIn content and outreach strategies targeting architects, developers, strata managers, consultants and commercial decision-makers. Recommend appropriate campaign audiences, objectives and advertising strategies. Monitor incoming enquiries and ensure leads are recorded and passed to the Director promptly. Help establish a clear process for converting social media engagement into consultations and project opportunities. Monitor campaign performance, cost per lead and lead quality. No paid campaign or advertising expenditure may be launched without written approval. Strategy and Performance Review Rockwall’s existing social media presence and recommend improvements. Assist with developing a practical 90-day social media and lead-generation strategy. Monitor platform trends and identify relevant opportunities for the construction industry. Analyse content performance and explain what is working, what is not working and what should change. Provide a concise monthly performance report covering: Qualified project enquiries Consultation bookings generated Cost per lead Website visits Audience location Reach and engagement Reel views and watch time Follower growth Best-performing content Recommendations for the following month Focus on attracting relevant Sydney audiences rather than meaningless international followers or artificial engagement. Communication and Collaboration Work closely with the Director through WhatsApp, email and scheduled online meetings. Provide clear updates on upcoming content, campaign priorities, required footage and outstanding approvals. Supply a weekly shot list explaining what photographs and vertical videos are required from construction sites. Bring ideas and recommendations forward without waiting for instructions for every task. Ask questions when technical construction information or project details are unclear. Meet agreed deadlines and maintain consistent availability throughout the week. Expected Content Output The successful candidate will plan and produce an agreed weekly content schedule, generally including: Three to five core content pieces each week, adapted across the relevant platforms Reels and short-form project videos Project progress and before-and-after content Educational construction posts Company, team and behind-the-scenes content LinkedIn business and industry content Instagram and Facebook stories Lead-generation calls to action Quality, consistency and relevance are more important than publishing large quantities of weak content. Essential Skills and Experience At least four years of professional social media management experience. Proven experience managing social media for a business or professional brand. Previous experience with construction, building, property, architecture, real estate, engineering, trades or a related industry. Strong knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and TikTok. Proven ability to create, schedule and publish professional organic content. Strong short-form video editing skills. Experience creating Instagram Reels and TikTok content. Experience using Meta Business Suite. Experience developing and managing content calendars. Strong written and spoken English. Ability to write professional captions and calls to action. Strong understanding of brand presentation and visual consistency. Experience generating business enquiries through social media. Understanding of Meta advertising and lead-generation campaigns. Ability to analyse social media insights and campaign performance. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. Ability to work independently and take ownership of the role. Reliable internet connection and suitable remote working environment. Professional, proactive and dependable communication style. A portfolio demonstrating high-quality social media work and measurable results. Highly Regarded Skills Experience working with Australian construction or property businesses. Understanding of the Sydney construction and property market. Experience marketing architectural homes, renovations, commercial construction or Class 2 projects. Experience with Meta Ads Manager and Facebook lead forms. Experience with LinkedIn B2B lead generation. Experience supporting a business through a rebrand or website launch. Experience with Canva, CapCut and Adobe Creative Suite. Basic website, SEO, CRM or email-marketing knowledge. Experience managing Google Drive content libraries. Experience working directly with business owners or company directors. Experience creating social media systems and processes from the ground up. Systems and Platforms The successful candidate should be comfortable using: Instagram Facebook LinkedIn TikTok Meta Business Suite Meta Ads Manager Canva CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar editing software Google Drive Google Sheets WhatsApp Email Zoom or Google Meet What Success Looks Like Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should have: Established a consistent and professional presence across all relevant platforms. Created and implemented a structured content calendar. Organised Rockwall’s social media content library. Improved the quality and consistency of posts and videos. Increased engagement from relevant Sydney audiences. Established a system for capturing and tracking social media enquiries. Developed an organic and paid lead-generation strategy. Identified the content and campaigns most likely to generate qualified project opportunities. Reduced the Director’s day-to-day involvement in social media management. The Person We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who can genuinely take ownership of Rockwall Projects’ social media presence. The ideal candidate will be professional, creative, organised, proactive and commercially minded. They will have the confidence to bring their own ideas forward while working closely with the Director to ensure all content remains accurate and aligned with the company’s brand. They must understand that successful social media management involves more than posting attractive content. It requires consistency, strategy, audience understanding, professional communication, performance analysis and a clear focus on generating business opportunities. We want someone interested in a long-term working relationship who will take pride in helping an established Australian construction company grow. How to Apply Please begin your application with the words: ROCKWALL 2007 Applications that do not include these words will not be considered. Please provide: A brief introduction explaining your relevant experience. Your CV or résumé. A link to your portfolio. Links to business accounts you currently manage or previously managed. Examples of construction, property, architecture or real-estate content you have created. Evidence of campaigns that generated genuine enquiries, appointments or sales. Any available campaign results, including advertising spend, cost per lead and lead quality. Details of the software and platforms you use. Your requested hourly rate. Your weekly availability and ability to communicate during Sydney business hours. A two-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you are suitable for this role. Contact details for at least one previous professional reference.
