title: Amazon Listing & Creative Optimization Lead - Part-Time
job_title: Amazon Listing & Creative Optimization Lead - Part-Time
description: Own Amazon listing creative end to end for Senwosa, our pizza-making accessories brand: the research, the direction, the production and the tests. Part-time, remote worldwide, working directly with a founder with 10+ years in e-commerce. You own the direction and the call on what to test. This role does not manage PPC campaigns. Compensation: Up to USD 25/hour, depending on experience, demonstrated results, and level of ownership. We are looking for the best fit, not the lowest bidder. Initial commitment: 10-15 hours per week; exact monthly capacity agreed before the start. Engagement: Part-time independent contractor. The first 90 days are the initial engagement. Location: Remote. Worldwide. Collaboration: Mostly asynchronous, with 1 weekly decision call. Time zones: You choose your hours. We agree on a recurring window you can keep, plus a slot for the weekly call. We plan in Europe/Warsaw time. Works directly with: Founder. ________________ The opportunity Most Amazon listings lose the customer for a single reason. The main image says the wrong thing, the gallery answers the wrong question, or the copy repeats what every competitor writes. Your job is to find that reason and remove it, with evidence. Atlanti Brands has built and sold e-commerce brands, mostly on Amazon. You work on the brands we are building now: Senwosa, which makes pizza-making accessories for customers in the US, UK, EU and Canada, plus 2 smaller brands. Senwosa is the focus and takes most of your time. You own this loop: evidence → purchase barrier → creative direction → brief → production → QA → publish → test → decision The founder owns the product, the positioning and the budget. You focus on one main priority and one smaller task at a time. You also help choose what we sell next. For product ideas on the founder's shortlist, you review customer and market evidence and recommend what to test. What you own * Turn evidence into priorities. Use reviews, search and performance data, competitor research, and customer tests such as PickFu to identify the biggest opportunities across current listings, ad creative, and upcoming launches. Build a clear, capacity-ordered backlog. * Own the creative direction. D ---------- the listing SEO approach, message order, and direction for main images, galleries, A+ Content, product videos, video ads, and static ads. * Make small edits yourself using our tools and AI. Create wireframes and mock-ups, revise copy and layouts, localize existing assets, and generate or refine AI images. Brief specialists when the work requires advanced retouching, photography, 3D, or video production. * Lead production through publication. Find, brief, and manage freelancers, specialists, and UGC creators. Accept or reject their work against our product facts, claims, and usage rules. Upload approved assets in Seller Central and verify that they appear correctly in each marketplace and placement. You remain accountable for the final result. * Test, d ---------- , and record. Run A/B tests of listing and ad creative, supported by creative-level ad reporting. Distinguish decision-ready results from early signals, and keep a light, AI-assisted record of what changed, what happened, and what we learned. What success looks like by Day 90 * Deliver creative packages for 3 new product launches. Lead each package from customer and market research through SEO copy, main image, gallery, A+ Content, product video, ad creative, and final QA. If the third product is not ready, complete the agreed backup project instead. * Improve our priority listings and ad creative. Use an AI-assisted portfolio audit and focused customer research to identify the biggest conversion gaps and complete the highest-priority improvements. * Build a scalable video and ad creative library. Develop strong master concepts, reusable footage, and efficient variants, then localize the agreed listing videos and ad creative for priority European marketplaces with a video editor. * Create a repeatable testing and decision system. Start useful A/B tests when traffic and eligibility allow. Turn completed tests into clear decisions to keep, improve, or stop, and record early signals and blockers when a final result is not yet available. By Day 90 you should manage day-to-day creative priorities, briefs, specialist feedback, publication and follow-up without daily direction. How the engagement works * Capacity. We reserve and pay for about 10-15 hours per week during the first 90 days. We agree on the exact time allocation before the start, together with a recurring working window that fits your time zone. Extra hours are agreed in advance. * If a blocker is on our side. If something we owe you stops the main task, we still pay the agreed hours. You stay available and complete other ready work. Tell us early when something on our side is holding you up. * After Day 90. Our goal is a long-term working relationship. After the first 90 days, we review the results and how we work together, then agree on the next scope and capacity in writing. * Contract and payment. This is an independent contractor engagement. You invoice us monthly in USD. Why work with us * Real ownership. Work directly with the founder, learn from 10 years of building e-commerce brands and see your impact across multiple marketplaces. * Support, not bureaucracy. We give you product facts, templates and AI workflows. We fund approved research and specialists. You get direct feedback and fast decisions. * Paid reserved capacity. We pay for the capacity we reserve, not only for completed deliverables. * Room to improve how we work. We expect direct communication. If a part of our process is wrong, say so, propose a better way, and help us implement it. What you need * You have owned Amazon listing creative outcomes. You have led Amazon listing creative work from direction through production. You can brief and manage freelancers, give clear feedback, and accept or reject their work against defined standards. SEO-only experience, support work, or producing assets from someone else's brief is not enough. * You know the Amazon creative craft. You understand listing SEO, conversion copy, main images, galleries, A+ Content, product video, and ad creative. * You can defend and execute a creative direction. You have strong visual judgment and can explain the evidence behind your decisions. Using Canva, Photoshop, AI image tools, or equivalent software, you can create wireframes and mock-ups and make simple asset edits yourself - such as a new main image variant, copy or layout changes, localized versions, and AI-generated or refined images. * You use data and AI responsibly. You understand basic commercial math and attribution, and use AI for research, audits, and creative work. You check sources, apply your own judgment, say what the data cannot prove, and record decisions for future use. * You can work in English. You can write a clear brief and discuss decisions live. Accent and occasional grammar mistakes do not matter. Useful but not required: experience with PickFu, Intellivy, ProductPinion, or Amazon Manage Your Experiments. Pizza-making experience or a genuine interest in the category is also a plus. How to apply and what to expect 1. Application. Tell us about your relevant experience and describe 1 relevant project. 2. Shortlist screen. Selected candidates complete a short, unpaid simulated task. Some candidates are invited to a brief follow-up discussion. 3. Paid finalist case. Finalists complete a 4-hour case for USD 100. We pay the fee regardless of whether an offer is made. Selected candidates then have a 30-minute discussion. We hold a final mutual-fit conversation with the preferred finalist and may, with permission, contact 1 reference if a specific question remains.

title: Marketing Operations & Content Coordinator
description: About the Role InvestNJoy Capital is a Texas-based real estate investment company focused primarily on multifamily investments. We are building a more sophisticated investor marketing, communications and capital formation platform. We already have support for advanced CRM architecture, GoHighLevel automation and systems development. This role is different. We are looking for an exceptionally organized, resourceful person with excellent written and spoken English who can help us execute the marketing, content, research and day-to-day work required to keep the system moving. You may receive: 1 A five-minute voice note from one of the principals. 2 A meeting transcript. 3 Rough bullet points. 4 An existing investor report. 5 A list of contacts that needs to be researched. 6 A marketing campaign that needs to be loaded into GoHighLevel. 7 A newsletter that needs to be drafted and scheduled. 8 A long video that needs to become several shorter pieces of content. Your job is to take incomplete inputs and turn them into organized, finished work. We are not looking for someone who needs every task explained step by step. We want someone who can understand the objective, use AI and other tools intelligently, ask good questions when necessary, and get things done. Exceptional English Is Required This is one of the most important qualifications for the position. 1 Communicate comfortably in spoken English with U.S.-based executives. 2 Understand nuanced business conversations and instructions. 3 Write professional emails and newsletters. 4 Turn rough thoughts into clear written communication. 5 Edit AI-generated writing so it sounds natural and credible. 6 Recognize when content sounds generic, overly promotional or obviously AI-generated. Much of our audience consists of successful business owners, executives, professionals and sophisticated real estate investors. Our communication needs to reflect that. Primary Responsibilities Content & Executive Communication 1 Turn voice notes, meeting transcripts, rough notes and ideas from company leadership into polished content. 2 Draft investor emails and newsletters. 3 Draft LinkedIn posts and other social content. 4 Repurpose longer content into multiple shorter pieces. 5 Assist with investor updates and educational content. 6 Edit AI-generated writing extensively before it is used. 7 Maintain a content calendar. 8 Help develop a consistent voice for the company and its principals. Marketing Operations 1 Build and schedule email campaigns. 2 Load content into GoHighLevel and other marketing systems. 3 Maintain marketing calendars and campaign schedules. 4 Coordinate landing pages, forms, emails, graphics and other campaign assets. 5 Test links, forms, emails and workflows before launch. 6 Track whether campaigns and projects were actually completed. 7 Follow up on unfinished items without needing to be reminded. CRM & Database Operations You do not need to be an advanced GoHighLevel developer. We will have technical support for advanced CRM architecture and automation. You should, however, be comfortable learning and operating a CRM. 1 Update and maintain contact information. 2 Apply appropriate fields, tags and segmentation. 3 Manage lists. 4 Upload and clean contact data. 5 Identify duplicates and incomplete records. 6 Maintain follow-up information. 7 Support investor and prospect pipelines. 8 Load email and nurture content into existing workflows. 9 Test automations after they are built. GoHighLevel experience is helpful, but advanced GHL experience is NOT required. We would rather hire an exceptional communicator and operator who can learn GoHighLevel than an advanced GHL technician who cannot write or communicate well. Research & Data Enrichment 1 Research prospective investors, family offices, RIAs, capital partners and referral relationships. 2 Find and verify company and contact information. 3 Research organizations and investment criteria. 4 Enrich CRM records. 5 Build prospect and research lists. 6 Organize information in spreadsheets. 7 Use AI and research tools intelligently to accelerate this work. Social Media & Basic Creative Work 1 Schedule and publish approved content. 2 Create professional basic graphics in Canva. 3 Repurpose existing content for different platforms. 4 Assist with simple video editing or clipping when needed. 5 Maintain organized folders of content and marketing assets. You do not need to be a professional graphic designer or video editor. AI Is Part of the Job We expect you to use tools such as ChatGPT and Claude every day. 1 Research. 2 Brainstorm. 3 Draft. 4 Summarize. 5 Analyze transcripts. 6 Repurpose content. 7 Improve processes. 8 Create SOPs. 9 Organize information. 10 Work faster. Copying and pasting the first answer from ChatGPT is not acceptable. You must review the output, recognize problems, improve it and take responsibility for the final product. The Type of Person We Want 1 Exceptional written English. 2 Strong spoken English and listening comprehension. 3 Extremely organized and detail-oriented. 4 Finishes what they start. 5 Comfortable receiving imperfect instructions. 6 Can figure things out independently. 7 Asks intelligent questions rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions. 8 Uses AI extensively and intelligently. 9 Has good business judgment. 10 Enjoys learning new software. 11 Comfortable doing both creative work and repetitive execution work. 12 Can work with executives without requiring constant supervision. 13 Wants a long-term role where responsibilities can grow. Real estate or investment experience is helpful but not required. Helpful Experience ChatGPT Claude GoHighLevel Canva Google Workspace Google Sheets / Excel LinkedIn Email marketing platforms Social media scheduling CRM systems Basic video editing Online research Content repurposing Newsletter creation You do not need to know every tool. The ability to learn quickly matters more. Please Do Not Apply If You 1 Struggle to communicate fluently in English. 2 Primarily consider yourself a GoHighLevel developer or automation engineer. 3 Only want technical work. 4 Only want social-media work. 5 Need detailed instructions for every task. 6 Regularly submit unedited AI-generated writing. 7 Are uncomfortable with repetitive administrative execution. 8 Routinely miss deadlines. 9 Need someone to repeatedly follow up with you to complete work. 10 Are looking for a short freelance project rather than a long-term position. Schedule Full-time preferred: approximately 35-40 hours per week. We are based in Texas on U.S. Central Time. We need approximately 3-4 hours of daily overlap during the U.S. morning, with the remaining work able to be completed during Philippine working hours. This is intended to be a long-term position. Compensation Approximately $900-$1,200 USD per month, depending on experience, English communication, demonstrated skill and schedule. Exceptional candidates may command more. We are willing to pay more for someone whose work genuinely saves executive time and consistently produces high-quality output. How to Apply Begin your application with: BUILD THE MACHINE 1. Tell us briefly about your background, focusing especially on content, marketing operations, research, executive support, CRM work or similar responsibilities. 2. Tell us how you currently use AI in your work. Which tools do you use and what do you actually use them for? 3. Give us one example of a situation where you received incomplete instructions and had to figure out how to complete the assignment yourself. 4. What software and marketing tools are you comfortable using? 5. What is your desired monthly compensation? 6. What hours can you work, and how much overlap can you provide with U.S. Central Time? Required Writing Test Please complete this as part of your application. You may use ChatGPT, Claude or another AI tool. We encourage you to use AI if that is how you normally work. The final work, however, should represent your judgment. Raw Notes From the Company Principal We have not purchased another apartment property recently, and that’s intentional. There have certainly been properties available to buy, but owning more real estate isn’t automatically the same thing as creating value. Over the last couple of years, financing costs increased, insurance and property taxes became more expensive, and in a lot of markets seller expectations took longer to adjust than property-level performance. We’ve continued looking at opportunities, but we’d rather miss a deal than force one that doesn’t compensate investors appropriately for the risk. At the same time, we are investing significantly in our own infrastructure around investor relationships, technology, CRM and capital formation so that when the right opportunity does appear, we’re better prepared to move quickly and execute. We think the next phase of the market will create opportunities for disciplined buyers, but patience matters. Please Submit A LinkedIn post of no more than 200 words based on the notes above. The audience is prospective and existing real estate investors. 1 Sound like it was written by a real business principal. 2 Be confident but not promotional. 3 Do not invent facts. 4 Do not sound like generic AI marketing copy. 5 Have a clear central message. There is no single correct answer. We care much more about your judgment and finished writing than about which AI tool you used. Long-Term Opportunity We are looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term member of a growing company. If you are exceptionally organized, communicate extremely well and enjoy turning ideas into finished work, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing.
description: Performance Marketing Specialist Paid Media, Strategy & Growth — Remote, Philippines We are a growing performance marketing agency looking for an experienced marketer who can help us create better results for our clients and become an important part of the company as we grow. Most of our current clients are B2B companies, primarily in Europe, but the role is not limited to B2B. As the company grows, you may also work with B2C clients and different industries. Our approach to marketing is simple: We don't sell arbitrary packages. We focus on the client's goal and build the strategy required to achieve it. We don't believe that “5 ads per month” or “10 creatives per month” automatically creates value. Sometimes the right solution may require one strong campaign. Sometimes it may require 30 new creatives, a new landing page, different positioning, new targeting or an entirely different strategy. The question is always: What is the client trying to achieve, and what do we need to do to get there? This is not a junior position You should already know what you're doing. We're looking for someone with at least 3 years of relevant digital/performance marketing experience who can contribute knowledge and ideas from the beginning. You should not need to be taught the fundamentals of paid advertising. In your area of expertise, we actually want you to know more than we do. We want to be able to say: “Here is the client. Here is their goal. Here is the budget and the situation. What do you think we should do?” We will discuss strategy together, challenge ideas and make decisions together. But over time, you should be able to take increasing ownership without needing someone involved in every audience, headline, campaign structure or optimisation decision. Your input matters. Your main responsibility: performance marketing Paid media and performance marketing will be the core of your role. You should have practical experience with: LinkedIn Ads Meta Ads Google Ads Lead generation Campaign strategy Audience research and targeting Retargeting Testing and optimisation Offer and messaging development Ad copy and headlines Basic creative production Landing-page optimisation Tracking and performance analysis You should be particularly strong with LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads. You should also understand Google Ads and be able to work with the platform, although we are not specifically looking for a Google Ads specialist. Knowing where to click inside an advertising platform is not enough. We care much more about whether you understand: Why an offer should work How it should be positioned Which audiences should see it What should be tested What the data is telling us Why performance is changing What to do when something isn't working How to turn advertising spend into the result the client actually wants Landing pages and broader marketing work Because we are still a growing company, this will naturally be a broader role than working inside Ads Manager all day. You should be comfortable helping with landing pages and occasional website work. Most landing-page work will currently be done in Webflow. WordPress experience is useful, but it is not currently a requirement. You may also occasionally help with: Canva creatives Ad copy Headlines Simple graphic content AI-assisted content Minor website changes Occasional simple video content You are not expected to be a professional graphic designer, video editor and web developer at the same time. Your primary job is still marketing and performance. Tracking and analytics You should understand the fundamentals of proper tracking. Experience with areas such as the following is expected: GA4 Google Tag Manager LinkedIn Insight Tag Meta Pixel Conversion events UTM tracking Basic attribution Performance reporting You don't need to be an analytics engineer. But if you're responsible for performance, you need to understand whether the data you're making decisions from can actually be trusted. Who we're looking for You should have: 3+ years of relevant experience Strong hands-on paid advertising experience Demonstrated experience generating measurable results Experience working with Western companies Preferably experience with European companies or European markets Strong written and spoken English Strong strategic thinking The ability to work independently Good judgement Ownership of your work Reliable communication The ability to explain why you made a decision A reliable computer A reliable internet connection We will pay for the software, systems and tools required to perform your work. You are not expected to personally pay for company software. We want to see what you've actually done Years of experience alone don't tell us very much. If possible, we would like to see examples of previous campaigns, strategies or client work. You don't need to disclose confidential client information. We are interested in questions such as: What was the client's objective? What was the approximate advertising budget? Which platforms did you use? What strategy did you choose? Why did you choose it? What wasn't working? What did you change? What happened afterwards? What results did you achieve? What would you do differently today? We care more about understanding how you think than seeing an impressive screenshot without context. How we work Results over performative busyness We care about: Outcomes, ownership and deadlines rather than activity for activity's sake. We are not interested in monitoring whether someone appears online every minute of the working day. We are interested in whether: The work is completed properly Deadlines are respected Client budgets are respected Performance is moving in the right direction Problems are communicated early You take responsibility for your work Freedom comes with responsibility. As trust and results increase, so will your autonomy. Mistakes are allowed People make mistakes. That is part of working. A mistake itself is not necessarily the problem. What matters is what happens afterwards. When something goes wrong, we want to understand: What happened? Why did it happen? How do we fix it? How do we make sure the same mistake doesn't keep happening? What we do not want is a problem being hidden until the last possible moment. If you are stuck, need something, can't complete something, don't understand something or believe something is going wrong: Say it early. Most problems are much easier to solve before they become emergencies. Honest communication We value honesty and respectful disagreement. If you believe an idea is bad, say so. Explain why. We do not want someone who simply agrees with everything. At the same time, we follow a simple principle: Disagree and commit. We can disagree openly while discussing a decision. But once a decision has been made, we both commit to it and do our best to make it succeed — even if one of us originally preferred another option. Respect goes both ways. AI is welcome You are welcome to use AI. We actively believe AI can help with: Research Copywriting Brainstorming Analysis Creative ideas Production Improving workflows Use it when it makes your work better or faster. But you still own the final output. “AI generated it” is not an excuse for poor-quality work. Client portfolio We believe in quality over account volume. The goal is not to give one marketer 40–50 clients and ask them to keep everything alive. The number of clients you manage will depend on factors such as: Complexity Advertising spend Required workload Strategy Creative requirements Landing-page work Reporting requirements A large account may require significantly more attention than several smaller accounts. We will therefore manage workload based on what is realistically required to do good work. Working arrangement First 3 months The role starts as a freelance engagement. Expected workload: Approximately 25–30 hours per week. Monthly compensation: DKK 4,000 per month Currently approximately ₱38,900 per month, depending on exchange rates. The initial period allows both sides to determine whether the collaboration works well. If it clearly isn't working, neither side is expected to continue simply to reach the end of the three months. Availability during the initial period During the first months, while we learn how to work together, we expect you to normally be reachable when needed between: 09:00–12:00 Danish time We understand the time difference and there can be reasonable flexibility. As we become comfortable working together, the arrangement can become increasingly asynchronous. Longer term, communication may primarily consist of messages and a regular weekly meeting. The general expectation will be that messages requiring a response are normally answered no later than the next working day. Full-time opportunity If the initial collaboration works well for both sides, the intention is to transition the role into full-time employment through an Employer of Record (EOR) in the Philippines. This would normally happen after approximately three months. Expected full-time workload will normally be around: 40 hours per week. We care more about quality, responsibility and results than unnecessarily tracking every individual hour. Once transitioned to full-time employment, this will be an exclusive position. You should therefore only apply if you would genuinely be willing and able to stop other ongoing client work and work full-time with us if the permanent position is offered. Compensation progression Initial freelance period First approximately 3 months: DKK 4,000/month Approximately ₱38,900/month at current exchange rates. Approximately 25–30 hours per week. Full-time employment After a successful initial period and transition to EOR employment: DKK 4,500 gross/month Currently approximately ₱43,800 gross/month, depending on exchange rates. Performance bonus After approximately 6 months, you will become eligible for a performance-based bonus, paid quarterly. Your bonus will be directly connected to the results generated across the client portfolio you are responsible for. The purpose is simple: Better measurable performance should create better compensation. The bonus will be based on the measurable results of the client accounts you are responsible for, rather than simply on the number of campaigns launched or tasks completed. This may include factors such as lead quality, cost efficiency, conversion performance, account growth and the overall value created for the client. The exact calculation will depend on the type of accounts you manage, because not every client has the same goals, budget or sales process. The bonus is intended to reward sustained performance, not one unusually good week or a result caused by factors outside your control. We will therefore look at performance over time and take the relevant context into account. If you consistently produce strong results, improve account performance and take on greater responsibility, the bonus can become a meaningful part of your total compensation. In other words, the role is not limited to a fixed salary where exceptional performance makes no financial difference. The specific targets, measurement period, eligibility requirements and payment process will be explained during the hiring process before any full-time employment agreement is entered into. Longer-term salary progression For someone who continues performing at the expected level, takes ownership and successfully grows with the company, the planned base salary progression is: DKK 8,000 gross/month + performance bonus Currently approximately ₱77,800 gross/month + bonus, depending on exchange rates. This progression is expected after approximately 12–18 months, depending on performance, responsibility and development in the role. Growth and responsibility We are still a growing company. That means we cannot promise you a specific corporate job title five years from now. What we can say is that strong performance, trust and ability can lead to significantly more responsibility. As the company grows, there may be opportunities to: Take ownership of larger accounts Take responsibility for more strategy Help shape how we approach performance marketing Build internal processes Potentially help guide future team members We prefer giving capable people more freedom rather than creating unnecessary layers of bureaucracy. Hiring process The process will generally include: Application Initial interview Discussion of your previous work and marketing approach Selected candidates may complete a paid assessment Final discussion and decision The assessment will take approximately one hour and focuses on work style, personality and how you approach decisions and collaboration. Only selected candidates who progress through the interview process will be asked to complete it. The assessment is paid. Don't match every requirement? Apply anyway. If this role sounds like you but you don't tick every single box, we'd still encourage you to apply. Strong judgement, ownership and demonstrated ability matter more to us than matching a checklist perfectly. We are looking for someone who: Thinks Challenges ideas Takes responsibility Communicates honestly Wants to produce genuinely good work Wants increasing freedom as trust develops Wants their compensation to grow alongside their contribution If that sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you. Important notice Any currency conversions shown in this job posting are approximate and may change due to exchange-rate movements. We reserve the right to correct any errors, inaccuracies or unintended omissions in this job posting.

description: DO NOT APPLY ON THIS PAGE. Open the link at the bottom and record. A resume sent here will not be read. We are a travel office in Israel. We book flights, hotels, cars, and apartments. Ticketing already has a desk. This seat is the money: cards, banks, Amadeus commissions, customer collections, and Amex points rebates. If you have only done payroll, expenses, or "I enter receipts in QuickBooks," do not apply. You must have already worked the money side of a travel agency (or airline / OTA / GDS desk). The work week follows our office: Sunday to Thursday, about 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM Philippine time. You work Sundays. Your weekend is Friday and Saturday. WHAT YOU WILL MANAGE 1. CREDIT CARDS Look through every card charge. Confirm it is accurate and that there is a customer payment (or a known open balance) against it. A charge with no matching file is an open item the same day, not "we'll see." 2. AMADEUS — AMERICAN AND ISRAELI We run two Amadeus worlds. You check both: - Did we receive the commission from the company? - Did the customer actually pay us? A ticket that flew with no commission, or a commission with no customer money, is your catch. 3. BANK ACCOUNTS Look through the bank accounts and make sure it all adds up. Weekly rec. A stranger can follow the trail. Differences are not rounded away. 4. AMEX TRAVEL + POINTS TICKETS When we buy a ticket with points through Amex Travel, you track the whole loop: - The points seller got paid - The ticket was issued - The rebate came back How it works here: a $1,000 ticket is 100,000 points. Then 35 percent is supposed to be refunded. That rebate can take up to 2 weeks. When nobody is watching it, it eats hours and we lose money. You watch it. You chase it. You do not let a rebate sit. 5. COLLECTIONS Customers who owe us. You follow up until the balance is paid, promised with a date, or flagged to the owner with a reason. 6. POINTS COLLECTION Same energy as collections, for points: rebates, missing deposits, sellers not paid, 35 percent that did not post. You run after it. 7. OPEN BALANCES You send the open-balance list. Who owes what, on which file, since when. The sales desk should not have to ask you for this. 8. COST DATA Pull cost data out of the system. What we paid the airline, the hotel, the car company, the points seller, the card. 9. COST ANALYSIS Not just pull the number. Say what things actually cost us after rebate, after commission, after fees. So we know which bookings made money. 10. CHEAPER SERVICES Look at the services we use (car rentals and the rest) and find ways to get them cheaper. Bring a better rate or a better vendor, with the math. YOU DO NOT OWN - Setting guest prices or giving discounts - Issuing tickets (we already have an Amadeus issuer) - Moving money without a written owner approval - Hoping the 35 percent rebate "shows up" REQUIREMENTS - You have done travel-agency money work as your actual job: cards vs bookings, customer balances, supplier costs. Name the agency. - You have opened Amadeus (or another GDS) to check a file, a commission, or a sales report. You do not need to issue tickets. You do need to read the money. - You have personally finished bank recs. Every week. Without being chased. - You have chased money: collections, missing rebates, or "the vendor said they paid us." You follow up. - Fluent English, spoken and written. You will email open balances. We will hear you before we meet you. - Reliable computer, fast internet, backup internet, backup power - Two references from travel-finance, agency back-office, or collections work A PLUS - Amex Travel, pay-with-points, or any points desk where a rebate posted days later and you were the one who noticed - Both ARC (US) and BSP (Israel / international) commission reports - QuickBooks Online or Xero - You have cut a car-rental or hotel cost by shopping it, not by guessing HOW WE HIRE You will record your voice on a real money scenario and send a redacted sample of your own work. We do not interview people we have not heard. HOW TO APPLY Open this link and complete the recording form (about 20 minutes): ---------- /philippines/travel-bookkeeper If you already recorded, send a message here with your full name and the word RECORDED so we can match you. That is the only message that gets a reply.

title: Short-Form Content Creator - TikTok / Reels / Shorts | Plix.GG
job_title: Short-Form Content Creator - TikTok / Reels / Shorts | Plix.GG
description: Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors. We're looking for a creator who genuinely understands TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, what people are watching, what formats are trending, what sounds are being used and how to turn an idea into a video people actually want to finish. This is NOT an editing-only role. You will research trends, find ideas, choose games, record gameplay or real-world footage and edit finished short-form videos. We handle uploading and posting. You do not need to manage our social accounts. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We want someone who actively uses TikTok, Reels and Shorts and pays attention to: • Current content trends and formats • Trending music and sounds • Hooks that stop people scrolling • Editing styles that are working right now • Gaming and internet culture • What other gaming creators are doing • Why some videos perform and others don't You should actively research what is currently working and develop concepts independently. Most importantly, you need good creative judgment. Not every browser game is interesting enough to carry a video by itself. Sometimes gameplay is enough. Sometimes the stronger video is built around a gaming setup, laptop, phone, IRL situation, meme, challenge, POV, trend or relatable idea. → Your job is to know the difference. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ CONTENT CAN INCLUDE • Single-game videos • Multi-game videos and lists • Gameplay • Challenges • Memes • POVs • Gaming setup / desk setup videos • Laptop, monitor and phone footage • Gaming room / RGB setup footage • IRL videos filmed at home, schools, cafés, malls, outdoors, etc. • Voiceover or no voiceover • Trend-based concepts • Videos built around a joke, situation or trend instead of only gameplay If you have a good-looking gaming setup, desk, room, laptop or another visually interesting environment, we want you to use it. For example: → Open with a good-looking gaming setup → Hook: "3 browser games I play when I'm bored" → Transition into the games We want variety. We do NOT want the same template repeated every day. But we can try good templates that did not work more times. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ WHAT YOU DO • Research TikTok, Reels and Shorts for trends, formats, sounds and ideas • Follow gaming creators and relevant competitors • Find games on Plix.gg worth making content about • Develop your own concepts and hooks • D ---------- whether a video should be gameplay, IRL, setup-based, meme, POV, challenge, list, trend or another format • Record clean gameplay • Film attractive real-world or gaming-setup footage when needed • Edit 10–40 second short-form videos • Choose suitable music, trending sounds and SFX • Add captions and on-screen text • Test different opening hooks • Use performance feedback from previous videos to improve future concepts You do not need to show your face or use your own voice. You can if you want to, but it is not required. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ OUTPUT 5–7 finished videos per week. Videos can vary significantly in format and production effort. Some can be simple gameplay videos. Others may use several games, IRL footage, gaming setups, multiple locations or more complicated concepts. We care about retention, creativity and views, not forcing every video into the same structure. We handle publishing. Your responsibility is delivering finished videos ready to post. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ YOU SHOULD HAVE • Strong understanding of TikTok, Reels and Shorts • Strong short-form editing skills • Good instinct for hooks and first 1–3 second retention • Awareness of current trends, sounds, formats and editing styles • Genuine interest in games and internet culture • Ability to develop ideas independently • Ability to research what is currently performing • Ability to film good-looking real-world or gaming-setup footage • Good sense of pacing, music, captions, SFX and visual composition ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ EQUIPMENT You need: • PC or laptop capable of smoothly recording browser games • Smartphone with a good camera • Reliable internet • CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut or similar ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ HOURS • No fixed schedule • No required timezone overlap • No time tracking Work whenever you want as long as the content is delivered on time. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ PAY ₱65,000 / month Paid monthly via Wise. Reasonable pre-approved expenses for outside shoots are reimbursed separately. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ HOW TO APPLY Send the following: ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ 1 — YOUR WORK Send 1–3 short-form videos you worked on. For each video, tell us what you were responsible for: • Concept • Filming • Hook / script • Editing ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ 2 — YOUR SETUP Send: • Editing software • PC / laptop specs • Phone model If you have a gaming setup, desk, room or another environment that could be used in videos, send a photo or short clip as well. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ 3 — TWO VIDEO IDEAS FOR PLIX.GG IDEA 1 — GAMEPLAY One gameplay-focused concept. Name the specific game and paste its plix.gg URL. IDEA 2 — IRL / GAMING SETUP Concept using IRL footage, a gaming setup, laptop, phone, desk, room or another visually interesting environment. For both ideas, explain: • What happens in the first few seconds • The main concept • Why you think someone would keep watching Do not just write: "Show gameplay with text." We want to understand how you think about hooks and short-form content. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ 4 — SHOW US THAT YOU UNDERSTAND CURRENT TIKTOK Send us ONE current: • TikTok / Reels / Shorts trend • Format • Sound • Editing style • Hook style Send the link to it, not just a description. Then explain how you would adapt it for Plix.gg. We specifically want someone who actively researches what is working NOW rather than using the same editing style repeatedly. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ EXAMPLES These are simple examples of content and formats that can work: → ---------- → ---------- → ---------- games&t= ---------- More browser-game examples: → ---------- /search?q=browser games&t= ---------- → ---------- games&t= ---------- → ---------- games&t= ---------- These are REFERENCES, not templates. We want you to research TikTok yourself and find new formats, trends, hooks and ideas that could work better. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ PAID TRIAL Shortlisted applicants receive a paid ₱2000 trial. The trial is paid whether or not we hire you. The trial includes: ◆ PART 1 — IRL / GAMING SETUP VIDEO Create one short-form concept using IRL footage, your gaming setup, laptop, phone, desk, room or another visually interesting environment. ◆ PART 2 — PLIX.GG GAMEPLAY VIDEO Create one short-form video using gameplay from Plix.gg. We are not judging editing quality alone. We also want to see: • Your ideas • Your hooks • Your understanding of current trends • Your filming ability • Your creative judgment • Whether you understand what type of content has the best chance of performing

description: Company: Rezie Project type: Fixed-price, milestone-based project Total project budget: $1,000 USD Project timeline: Six weeks Location: Remote Future opportunity: Potential full-time position after successful completion About the Project Rezie is developing a specialized AI platform for the contractor and restoration industry. We have an existing application, interface, database, and codebase. Some functionality is already working, but the platform still requires development, debugging, integration, testing, and deployment. We are looking for an experienced full-stack AI developer who can take ownership of the existing codebase and complete the full production-ready platform within six weeks, according to our private requirements and acceptance criteria. This is not an MVP or prototype project. The completed application must be reliable, secure, tested, and ready for real-world use. Additional product details will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process and after signing a confidentiality agreement. Responsibilities Audit and understand the existing codebase. Complete unfinished frontend and backend functionality. Improve database reliability and data synchronization. Complete AI, document-processing, and structured-output integrations. Diagnose and fix existing application defects. Connect all platform components into one reliable workflow. Add validation, error handling, and automated testing. Ensure updates do not break previously working functionality. Deploy the completed application. Provide technical documentation and a final code handoff. Commit all completed work to the company-owned repository. Timeline and Work Expectations The complete project must be delivered within six weeks of the agreed start date. Before development begins, we will establish a written milestone schedule with specific deliverables and acceptance criteria. The selected developer must: Begin work promptly after receiving access and project documentation. Meet the agreed weekly milestones. Provide regular progress updates and working demonstrations. Commit completed work to the company repository throughout the project. Communicate technical risks or blockers immediately. Reserve sufficient time for final testing, deployment, documentation, and handoff. The six-week timeline will begin after the agreement is signed, access is provided, and the milestone requirements are confirmed. Any approved change to the project scope or timeline must be documented in writing. Payment and Deliverables The total project budget is $1,000 USD. Payment will be divided across clearly defined deliverables. Each payment will be released after the corresponding functionality has been demonstrated, tested, committed to the company repository, and accepted. Payment is based on completed and accepted deliverables rather than hours worked. Hard-coded demonstrations, temporary fixes, incomplete functionality, or solutions that only work for one test case will not be accepted. The complete milestone structure, technical requirements, payment amounts, and acceptance criteria will be provided to the selected developer before work begins. Full-Time Opportunity A developer who successfully completes the project, produces reliable work, communicates consistently, meets the agreed timeline, and demonstrates strong technical ownership may be offered an ongoing full-time position with Rezie. The project will allow both sides to evaluate long-term fit. A full-time offer is not guaranteed and will depend on project performance and company needs. Required Experience Full-stack web application development. React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or comparable technologies. AI and LLM integrations. Structured AI outputs and validation. PDF, OCR, or document-processing systems. Backend APIs, databases, and asynchronous workflows. Automated testing and application debugging. Experience taking over and completing an existing codebase. Strong communication and independent problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to deliver projects on an agreed schedule. Experience limited to basic websites, prompt writing, or simple chatbots is not sufficient.

title: Customer Service and Scheduling Coordinator
description: Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator Just Right Electric — Greater Phoenix, AZ It's just right, every time. title: Brand Designer
description: **About Manukora** Manukora is a global wellness brand, leading the fast-growing US Mānuka honey category. We're on a mission to preserve the power of Mānuka and deliver it to the world in pure, functional formats at uncompromising quality, purity and potency. Born in the wilds of New Zealand, we harvest one of the planet's rarest natural resources: raw Mānuka honey. This creamy caramel super honey contains unique antioxidants, prebiotics, and a special antibacterial compound called "MGO."Established in 2015, we are a founder-led, family-owned business headquartered in New Zealand with operations globally in the United States and Europe. Manukora is a certified B Corporation, working with locally-based master beekeeping partners to produce the highest quality Mānuka, leading through ethical beekeeping practices and investing in our bees, their environment and the communities that surround them. We are a team of beekeepers, herbalists, food scientists, and wellness professionals working to deliver this one-of-a-kind honey and reimagine the immune and digestive wellness categories. **The Role** You'll work directly with our Senior Design Lead, turning ideas into scroll-stopping digital and marketing work: campaigns, paid social, email, web, and everything in between. If you love continuing to evolve legacy brands (not just decorating them), this role is for you. What you'll do - **Brand identity & visual language** - evolve and protect our premium identity across every digital touchpoint, keeping the brand distinctive and consistent as we scale - **Social media creative** - concept and design scroll-stopping paid and organic social that performs - **Digital campaign production** - bring campaigns to life across email, web, landing pages, and digital ads, from concept through final assets - **Art direction** — support on art direction across photography and video shoots for digital channels: produce mood boards, shot lists, and on-the-day creative direction (remote or on-site) - **Creative production** - produce high-quality brand content end to end, moving fast without sacrificing craft - **Brand guideline stewardship** - support and maintain our brand guidelines, ensuring internal teams and external partners apply them correctly - **Creative briefing** - write and shape creative briefs, and bring strong ideation to the table; you'll help form concepts, not just execute them - **Create distinctive brand assets** - continue to evolve the brand in the right direction by creating distinctive brand assets that can be used cross-channel. - **Collaborate** - Work closely with Senior Design lead on design development and research, help manage creative workflow and asset distribution across the team. **What you'll bring** - 3–4 years of brand/digital design experience, with at least 2 years in **CPG, DTC, or consumer brand** environments (in-house or agency) - The energy to lead projects from first brief to final delivery, with the people skills to delegate and potential to grow a direct report over time. - **A very strong brand eye and just damn good taste**, if your friends don’t tell you that you have great taste, you're not the right person for the job. - A portfolio that shows strong **brand and strategic design thinking** - not just polished executions. - Excellent typography, layout, and visual storytelling instincts - Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; motion skills (After Effects) a plus - Experience designing for performance channels (paid social, email, landing pages) and understanding what converts - Experience art-directing shoots and working with photographers/videographers; comfortable writing and responding to creative briefs - An interest in AI design tools and how they can support creative workflows - curious, experimental, and open to new ways of working, never at the expense of craft - Self-direction and clear communication - you'll be working remotely with a distributed team **What this role is not*** - Packaging design - this role won't own packaging, but experience with it is a plus - Junior/entry-level - you should be able to run with a brief independently - Generic graphic design - we need someone who lives and breathes consumer brands **Why you'll love it** - **Real creative ownership** - small team, direct access to brand leadership, your work ships fast and gets seen by millions - **A brand worth designing for** - premium product, distinctive identity, and an audience that genuinely loves what we make - **A mission behind the work** B Corp certified, founder-led, and genuinely invested in honey, beekeepers, and the environment - **Flexibility** - work from anywhere in the Philippines or Malaysia, with flexible hours to collaborate across time zones **How to apply** Send an email directly to ---------- Subject Line: Brand Designer - [Your Full Name] Please include the following in your email: Send us your portfolio (URL, PDF), CV and cover letter Your current location (City & Country). title: Real Estate Acquisitions (VA)
description: Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist (Remote) About Us Price Real Estate Investments is a multi-market U.S. based real estate investment company focused on acquiring off-market properties directly from homeowners. We specialize in building strong relationships with sellers, negotiating with them, and closing deals virtually. Our team is fully remote, but our impact is nationwide — and we’re growing quickly. We’re looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisitions Specialist to join our acquisitions team. This role is critical to our business: you’ll be speaking directly with homeowners, negotiating terms, and guiding sellers through the contract signing process. If you’ve personally made offers to sellers and closed contracts over the phone, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work in a high-energy, professional environment. Compensation $10/hour USD base pay Plus Monthly Contract Bonuses for getting offers accepted: • Bronze: 2 signed contracts = $500 bonus • Silver: 3 signed contracts = $1,000 bonus • Gold: 4 signed contracts = $1,500 bonus • Platinum: 5+ signed contracts = $2,000 bonus On-target earnings can range from $2,500–$3,500+ per month depending on performance. Pay dates are on the 1st and 15th of each month. We believe in rewarding results. Our top performers earn meaningful bonuses based on closed contracts and consistent production. Schedule Full-time, Monday to Friday 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CST Remote position, work from your own secure setup What You’ll Be Doing - Engage with homeowners (seller leads), build authentic rapport, and manage conversations with professionalism - Follow a proven acquisitions script while sounding natural and confident - Ask strong follow-up questions to uncover seller motivation and property condition - Make verbal offers, negotiate price and terms, and walk sellers through agreements using DocuSign - Handle objections effectively and push deals forward toward signed contracts - Maintain organized notes, offers, and seller updates in our CRM - Collaborate closely with the acquisitions team and leadership What It Takes to Succeed Here - Relentless Follow-Up: Sellers don’t always respond the first time — or the second. You know how to stay persistent with calls, texts, and follow-ups until you get an answer. Nothing slips through the cracks on your watch. - Extreme Attention to Detail: Every call, every note, every update gets logged correctly in the CRM. You don’t miss details, and you take pride in keeping your pipeline organized. If you’ve ever been called meticulous or “on top of everything,” this is where you’ll shine. - Closer’s Mentality: You’re not just reading a script — you know how to listen, build rapport, and guide sellers toward a decision. You thrive on negotiation, handle objections with confidence, and create win-win agreements that get signed. - Driven by Results: You measure success by contracts closed. You hold yourself to high standards and push to hit — and exceed — your targets consistently. You’re motivated by performance and driven by the satisfaction of closing successful deals. - Resilient Problem-Solver: Whether it’s a tough seller, a pricing objection, or a complicated situation, you don’t freeze — you find solutions and move the deal forward. Challenges are part of the role, and you thrive in solving them under pressure. Requirements - Minimum 2+ years of experience in real estate acquisitions or seller negotiations - Proven track record of closing real estate deals and securing signed contracts - Excellent English communication skills (spoken and written) - Confidence and professionalism on the phone; ability to build trust and rapport quickly - Familiarity with real estate terms like ARV, repairs, inspection, contingencies, etc. - Strong work ethic, coachability, and ability to follow scripts while sounding natural - Proficiency with CRMs and outbound dialers - Reliable high-speed internet, updated computer, and a quiet workspace What We’re Looking For - A confident, friendly, and persuasive communicator who thrives on results - Someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and relentless in follow-up - A professional with the drive to close contracts and grow with a fast-moving team Why Join Us? - Competitive pay with structured bonuses - Real opportunities for growth in a professional investment company - Work remotely with a team that supports your success - A chance to close real deals, make a real impact, and develop long-term career skills in acquisitions At Price Real Estate Investments, acquisitions is the heartbeat of our business. You’ll be in the front seat, driving growth and learning the strategies that power real deals across multiple U.S. markets. How to Apply: (Read Carefully – Incomplete Applications Will Be Ignored) - Email us at: ---------- - Subject line: Real Estate Acquisitions Application – OJPH - Attach your resume with relevant real estate or sales experience - Include a 1–2 minute audio or video introduction about yourself and experience. Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered.

This is not a basic virtual assistant role. We need someone who understands that in real estate, vacancy costs money, slow follow-up kills opportunities, and poor data creates bad decisions. You must be able to think and operate like a marketer, salesperson, researcher, and real estate professional—without needing constant supervision. Your Primary Responsibilities 1. Market & Rent Vacant Properties Quickly You will actively market furnished, mid-term, short-term, and traditional rental properties using platforms such as: • Airbnb • VRBO • ---------- • Furnished Finder • Zillow • ---------- • Facebook Marketplace & Groups • Corporate housing channels • Social media • Direct outreach to hospitals, staffing agencies, corporations, relocation companies, insurance housing providers, and prospective tenants You must understand: • Listing optimization • Rental pricing and positioning • Lead generation • Prospect follow-up • Sales conversion • Social media marketing • Tenant outreach • Vacancy-reduction strategies We are not looking for someone who simply posts listings. We want someone who knows how to generate attention, create demand, follow up aggressively, and convert inquiries into qualified tenants or bookings. 2. Real Estate Research & Lead Generation You will also help identify and research potential real estate opportunities, including: • Commercial real estate • Residential investment properties • Off-market opportunities • Wholesaling leads • Distressed properties • Property ownership research • Owner/contact identification • Comparable sales and rental research • Market research • Due diligence • Broker and agent outreach • Investor lead generation • Preliminary deal analysis Your job is to help us uncover what others may overlook. 3. CRM & Property Database Management You must be highly organized and experienced with: • CRM systems • Google Sheets • Excel • Property databases • Lead pipelines • Follow-up tracking • Broker/agent databases • Tenant prospect tracking • Investment opportunity tracking • Research documentation Our expectation is simple: Every lead has a status. Every opportunity has a next step. Every property has accurate information. Every important follow-up gets completed. You Are a Strong Candidate If You Have Experience In: • Real estate investing • Rental property marketing • Airbnb / VRBO / ---------- • Furnished or corporate housing • Mid-term rentals • Commercial real estate • Wholesaling • Property research • Skip tracing • Lead generation • Digital marketing • Sales • CRM management • Investor or broker outreach We Are Looking for Someone Who Is: • Proactive • Highly organized • Persistent • Resourceful • Analytical • Sales-oriented • Marketing-minded • Detail-oriented • Comfortable working independently • Focused on measurable results You should be able to receive an objective and determine the best way to accomplish it. We do not want to micromanage you. What Success Looks Like Your performance will be judged by results such as: • Faster property rentals • Reduced vacancy • More qualified inquiries • Better listing visibility • Stronger prospect follow-up • More investment opportunities identified • Accurate property and ownership research • Organized CRM pipelines • Clean, actionable data • Fewer opportunities falling through the cracks Experienced Applicants Only Please do not apply if your experience is primarily general virtual assistance. We are specifically looking for candidates with demonstrable real estate, marketing, lead generation, property research, sales, or rental-platform experience. HOW TO APPLY Start your proposal with: REAL ESTATE RESULTS Then answer: 1. How many years of real estate experience do you have? 2. Which rental platforms have you personally managed? 3. Give one example of a property you successfully helped rent or market. 4. What real estate lead-generation strategies have worked best for you? 5. What experience do you have with investing, wholesaling, or commercial real estate? 6. Which CRM systems have you used? 7. Which tools do you use for property research, ownership research, skip tracing, and due diligence? 8. Give one example of a measurable result you produced for a previous real estate client. Generic or copy-and-paste proposals will not be considered seriously. We are looking for someone who can help turn: Vacancies into income. Data into intelligence. Leads into conversations. Conversations into tenants. Research into opportunities. And opportunities into deals. If that describes how you work, we want to hear from you.

title: Head of Sales Development (SDR/LDR)
description: The Company: This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. Position Overview: The PH Head of Sales Development will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This leader will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization. The ideal leader has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue. Key Responsibilities: Build the Program • Design and stand up the Company's outbound sales motion from zero — including ICP, targeting, messaging, cadences, qualification, objection handling, technology, QA, reporting, and operating rhythm. • Recommend the right team structure and pilot size, backed by data, and define the conditions for scaling to 10+ reps. • Build a repeatable full-cycle motion where reps prospect, qualify, handle objections, and close, with clear escalation for larger or more complex deals. • Partner with Technical/Data and Marketing on list quality, vertical targeting, lead generation, and sales enablement. • Design the SDR incentive and commission structure with HR and Finance and align it to qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and company economics. Build the Team — Hire, Train, Retain • Own hiring for the team — define the rep profile, run the interview loop, and maintain a high bar for experienced sellers. • Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics. • Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process. • Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota. • Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing. • Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable. Own Revenue & Outbound Production • Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment. • Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices. • Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections. • Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down. Pipeline, Process & Enablement • Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks. • Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions. • Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability. • Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes. • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting. Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics • Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment. • Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics. • Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback. • Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling. • Provide concise, actionable reporting to US executive leadership and participate in strategic reviews. Required Qualifications: • 5+ years in B2B outbound and consultative sales with a documented record of quota attainment, including hands-on prospecting and closing. • 3+ years leading SDR, inside sales, or comparable outbound teams. • Required: demonstrated experience building and scaling an outbound sales function from zero — not simply managing an established team. • Documented track record with specific, quotable results from a team built and scaled to consistent quota attainment. • Personally recruited and ramped sales talent; able to explain the rep profile, sourcing strategy, hiring bar, and time-to-productivity. • Existing network or bench of proven sales talent that can be activated for the initial team is strongly preferred. • Strong command of CRM, sales engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-recording/coaching, and reporting tools; able to independently build cadences, scripts, QA, and performance reporting. Salesforce experience preferred. • Data-driven operator who can diagnose where conversion breaks down and adapt the playbook accordingly. • Consultative selling philosophy — leads with discovery, listens before recommending, and can coach this approach rather than simply enforce scripts. • Exceptional spoken and written English with a warm, credible phone presence for a US audience. • Executive presence, high energy, entrepreneurial mindset, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment. • Reliable remote work setup with stable high-speed internet, headset, and backup power/internet; full overlap with US business hours (CST). Nice-To-Have: • Experience selling into US non-acute healthcare practices. • Experience selling compliance, waste, insurance, SaaS, BPO, or other recurring B2B services. • Experience designing tiered SDR incentive and commission plans. • GoHighLevel or Salesforce experience building campaigns, pipelines, automations, and reporting. • Existing network in US healthcare compliance, practice management, or adjacent vendor ecosystems. • Experience representing a company at conferences, roundtables, or industry events. Compensation & Benefits: • Base pay: $1,800–$2,000 USD/month, based on experience. •Plus, potential performance incentives. Incentives are discretionary and may be provided, adjusted, or removed by the Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract. • Full-time independent contractor engagement, permanent work-from-home. • Monday–Friday, full overlap with US business hours (CST) to align with US provider-office calling windows. • Work Anniversary Bonus • No work with pay on US Holidays Basic Technical Requirements: • Reliable remote work setup with a stable, high-speed internet connection. • Noise-canceling headset for a professional, US-facing phone presence. • Backup power and backup internet connection. • A quiet and dedicated workspace at home. • Ability to maintain full overlap with US business hours (CST). Application Process: Submit your resume to all of the following emails: • ---------- • ---------- Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Accordant Capital and its portfolio companies, including MedPro Disposal and MP1 Solutions, are equal opportunity employers. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
description: The Company: This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Chicago-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies. Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide. In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development. Position Overview: The SDR is a full-cycle sales role responsible for opening new doors for MPHQ — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and converting outbound conversations into qualified opportunities and closed business. You will prospect into US provider offices, navigate to decision-makers, understand their compliance needs, position the Company's value, handle objections, and close business. Success means consistent activity, strong conversion, disciplined pipeline management, and month-over-month quota attainment. You are a seller, not a script reader — comfortable creating conversations from cold outreach, asking strong discovery questions, listening before recommending, handling rejection, and asking for the close. Key Responsibilities: Outbound Prospecting • Make high-volume outbound calls into assigned US provider-office lists using targeted data and approved calling cadences. • Navigate gatekeepers and reach office managers, practice administrators, owners, and other decision-makers professionally. • Execute multi-touch outreach across calls and approved sales-engagement channels so viable accounts are not abandoned after a single attempt. • Prioritize accounts and activities based on ICP, likelihood to engage, and pipeline potential. Consultative Selling • Open calls as conversations, not pitches, and earn the prospect's attention through relevant questions. • Understand how the practice manages compliance today, who they use, what it costs, and where the pain points are. • Translate compliance and waste requirements into clear, practical language for busy healthcare decision-makers. • Recommend solutions based on the prospect's needs and be transparent when Accordant is not the right fit. • Build relationships that create future opportunities even when the initial answer is no. description: # REAL ESTATE COLD CALLER / LEAD REACTIVATION SPECIALIST — PROJECT/GIG I am looking for an **experienced Cold Caller / Lead Reactivation Specialist** for a short-term project working through an existing database of older and cold real estate leads. **This is initially a project/gig and not a permanent position.
