RESPONSIBILITIES * Make outbound calls to existing cold and older leads * Send follow-up text messages when appropriate * Re-engage previous buyer and seller leads * Determine whether they are still interested in real estate * Determine whether they are looking to buy or sell * Identify their current timeframe and motivation * Schedule qualified appointments on my calendar * Follow up with leads who are not ready immediately * Update every contact attempt and conversation in the CRM * Add clear and accurate notes * Update lead status/stage and contact information * Identify wrong numbers, disconnected numbers, duplicates, and outdated contacts * Create appropriate follow-up tasks * Keep the CRM/database organized as leads are worked * Provide reporting on calls, conversations, follow-ups, qualified leads, and appointments scheduled ## EXPERIENCE REQUIRED **Previous cold-calling experience is required.** Real estate cold-calling experience is a plus but is not required. **No cold-calling or sales training will be provided.** You should already know how to: * Make outbound calls confidently * Speak naturally and professionally * Get past the initial resistance of a cold lead * Follow a script without sounding like you are reading * Ask appropriate qualifying questions * Handle common objections * Identify motivation and timeframe * Know when a lead needs additional follow-up * Transition naturally into scheduling an appointment * Document conversations accurately in a CRM You must have **clear, easily understood spoken English and strong conversational skills**, as you will be speaking directly with U.S.-based consumers. ## EQUIPMENT & CALLING SYSTEM You must have: * Reliable high-speed internet * Reliable computer * Quality headset/microphone * Quiet and professional calling environment * Stable internet connection suitable for outbound calls **The CRM and calling/dialer system will be provided.** You will be added to my existing CRM/calling system as needed for this project. Previous experience using a CRM and/or call dialer is expected. ## PERFORMANCE This project will be evaluated based on the quality of the work and results, including: * Leads attempted * Contact/conversation rate * Follow-ups generated * Qualified buyer or seller opportunities identified * Appointments scheduled * Accuracy of CRM notes and contact updates * Proper lead-status management * Quality of conversations and follow-up **If the work is beneficial and produces results, this gig may turn into an ongoing part-time position.** ## HOW TO APPLY Please use **REAL ESTATE COLD CALLER** as the subject line. Please answer ALL of the following questions: **1. What is your desired hourly rate?** **2. How many years of cold-calling experience do you have?** **3. Have you previously cold-called real estate leads?** If yes, explain what type of leads you contacted and what you were responsible for. **4. Tell me about your current or most recent cold-calling position.** What type of business did you work for, and what were your responsibilities? **5. Approximately how many outbound calls did you make per day or per hour?** **6. What results did you personally achieve?** If available, provide actual numbers such as conversations, qualified leads, appointments scheduled, or conversion rates. **7. What CRM systems have you personally used?** Please explain what you actually did inside the CRM. **8. What call dialers, VoIP systems, or CRM calling systems have you previously used?** **9. After speaking with a lead, what information do you normally document in the CRM?** **10. How would you handle an older lead who answers the phone and immediately says, “I'm not interested”?** **11. How do you determine whether a lead should be scheduled for an appointment, followed up with later, or no longer actively pursued?** **12. Are you comfortable making both outbound calls and follow-up text messages?** **13. What are your normal working hours and time zone? What hours are you available during U.S. Eastern Time?** **14. Are you currently working with any other clients?** If yes, approximately how many hours per week? **15. How do you track your working hours?** Please include the program or method you use and how you document time spent calling, texting, following up, and updating the CRM. ## REQUIRED CALL SAMPLE **16. Please submit a 1–2 minute video recording so I can hear your natural speaking voice, communication style, and how you would communicate with one of my leads.** For this exercise, imagine you are contacting an older lead in my real estate database who previously expressed interest in buying or selling a home. Use the following as a starting point: > **“Hi, Mr./Ms. [Last Name], this is [Your Name]. I'm working with Alicia Brown, and we're reaching out to some of her previous contacts to update her records. I wanted to check in and see if you're still considering buying or selling real estate.”** From there, **continue the conversation naturally.** If the person says yes, demonstrate how you would determine: * Whether they are buying or selling * Their current timeframe * Whether anything has changed since they previously spoke with Alicia * Whether they would like to schedule a time to speak with Alicia If they are not ready yet, demonstrate how you would determine an appropriate time for future follow-up. **You do not have to repeat the script word-for-word. I prefer that you sound natural and conversational rather than simply reading a script.** **Do not use an AI-generated, AI-enhanced, or altered voice.** Your recording will be evaluated based on: * Clarity of spoken English * How easily you can be understood * Natural conversational ability * Confidence * Tone and pacing * Professionalism * Ability to ask appropriate follow-up questions * Ability to transition naturally toward scheduling an appointment Please provide an accessible Google Drive, Loom, unlisted YouTube, or similar link. **Applications without the required call sample may not be considered.** ## IMPORTANT This is **not an entry-level cold-calling position**. I will provide the leads, CRM/calling system, business-specific information, and script/talking points. However, **I will not provide training on how to cold call, overcome basic objections, qualify prospects, or conduct a sales conversation.** You should already have these skills and be prepared to begin working with minimal direction. **This is initially a short-term gig/project. If your work is beneficial and produces results, there is potential for the opportunity to continue as a part-time position.**

description: About us MedCode Pro is a medical-coding and revenue-integrity company. We audit operative notes against what was billed and paid, find coding errors in both directions (undercoded revenue and compliance risk), and help specialty practices bill cleanly and defend their claims. We're expanding into interventional radiology — specifically lower-extremity peripheral vascular intervention (angioplasty, stent, atherectomy, IVL) — and we need an experienced IR coder/auditor to be our subject-matter expert for this specialty. Please note this will be Part-time contract to start (10–20 hrs/week), with room to grow into full-time What you'll do • Review de-identified IR operative/procedure notes and determine the correct CPT code set — this is the "answer key" our whole quality process is built on. • Audit claims for both missed revenue and compliance exposure (over-coding, unbundling, medical-necessity gaps). • Apply the current lower-extremity endovascular revascularization coding rules correctly — territory-based coding (iliac, femoral/popliteal, tibial/peroneal, inframalleolar), the highest-service-wins bundling within a vessel, initial + additional-vessel add-ons, IVL add-ons, and NCCI edits. • Check interventions against Medicare LCD / medical-necessity criteria for PAD/critical limb ischemia (rest pain, tissue loss, ABI, failed conservative therapy). • Review codes proposed by our software (we use an AI-assisted coding engine — you are the human expert who accepts, rejects, or corrects each suggestion) and give feedback that improves the system. You must have • Active certification: CIRCC strongly preferred (Certified Interventional Radiology Cardiovascular Coder). CPC, CCS, or RCC also considered if paired with real IR/vascular experience. • Hands-on experience coding or auditing lower-extremity endovascular revascularization — you can explain, without looking it up, why angioplasty + stent in the same vessel is one code, not two. • Working knowledge of NCCI edits, RS&I/catheterization bundling, and modifier use (RT/LT, -59/-XU). • Familiarity with peripheral-vascular medical-necessity / LCD requirements. • Comfort reading full operative notes and handling de-identified data professionally (HIPAA awareness). • Reliable internet, clear written English, and attention to detail. Nice to have • Experience in an office-based lab (OBL) or ASC setting, and with the technical-component / device (HCPCS C-code) side. • Prior work as an auditor (not just a production coder). • Experience with the newer restructured LE revascularization code family. How to apply — please follow these steps or we won't review your application: 1. Start your message with the word "VASCULAR" so we know you read the full post. 2. List your certifications (with numbers/expiry) and briefly, your IR/peripheral-vascular coding experience. 3. Answer this short coding test (2–4 sentences, show your reasoning): Right lower extremity. In the right external iliac artery, balloon angioplasty was performed and then a stent was placed (straightforward lesion). In the right common femoral artery, balloon angioplasty alone was performed (straightforward). Access was via a right common femoral puncture; no tibial or below-ankle work was done. Which CPT codes would you report for the professional claim, and briefly why? We read the reasoning more than the exact numbers. Strong applicants will hear back within a few days.

title: Publishing & Book Marketing Manager — Long-Term Fiction Series
job_title: Publishing & Book Marketing Manager — Long-Term Fiction Series
description: I'm looking for someone experienced with indie publishing and book marketing who can take over as much of that side of my business as possible so I can concentrate on writing. The Perfection Cycle is a planned 10-book speculative-fiction series published under the pen name K.C. Finehope. Books 1–3 are completely finished and ready to publish, and Book 4 is well underway. Book 1 is already set up on StoryOrigin with current review copies. The author website and MailerLite account are also set up, and I've previously published through Amazon KDP. I don't need someone to teach me how to self-publish. I could learn the marketing side myself, but I don't want to spend my time doing that when I could be writing the next book. I'm looking for someone who already understands this business and can eventually run most of the publishing and marketing operation with minimal direction from me. What I need The immediate priority is getting Book 1 moving: StoryOrigin promotions, ARC/reviewer recruitment and follow-up, newsletter swaps, mailing-list growth, promotional opportunities, social media, and preparation for the KDP launch. Books 2 and 3 are already finished, so this will quickly become series marketing rather than a one-book project. Depending on your experience, I'd eventually like you to handle as much as possible of the following: StoryOrigin and BookFunnel ARC/review-team recruitment and management MailerLite and email marketing Newsletter swaps and group promotions KDP management Metadata, categories and keywords Launch and release strategy Kindle Unlimited strategy Pricing and promotions Series read-through Social media management and audience growth Amazon Ads and Meta Ads Promotional opportunities and outreach Tracking results and adjusting the strategy based on what is actually working You don't need to be an expert in every item on that list. I'd rather have someone be honest about what they know well and where they might eventually recommend bringing in outside expertise. What matters most is that you understand indie publishing and book marketing, can work independently, and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting for me to provide a task list every day. Why I want to move quickly The series deals heavily with AI, synthetic companions, human/AI integration, labor displacement, relationships, and the social consequences of technological change. Some things I originally wrote as speculative fiction are already beginning to happen in the real world. Reality is starting to catch up with the books, and I don't want them sitting on my hard drive while that happens. That's one reason I already have three books finished before launching the series properly, and why I'm looking for someone who can start moving the marketing side forward while I continue writing. Long-term opportunity This isn't a one-book gig. There are ten books planned, and I'm looking for someone who could potentially stay with the series for years. This will remain a part-time position, with the workload naturally increasing around launches and decreasing between releases. Ideally, I want to reach the point where you run this side of the business and I write the books. The posted hourly range is intentionally broad. For the right person, I'm open to discussing a compensation structure that includes meaningful long-term upside in addition to hourly pay. I'm interested in finding someone who wants to help build the series over time and benefit from its success, not simply complete a short-term assignment. When you apply Please tell me: How much of the publishing and marketing operation described above you would be comfortable handling yourself. With Books 1–3 ready and StoryOrigin already set up, what would you focus on first? What experience you've had working with indie fiction authors, book launches, or ongoing author marketing. You don't need to claim you can do everything. I'm much more interested in finding someone experienced, capable, reliable, and interested in building something long term than someone who checks every box.

This role is designed for a sales professional who can run that motion independently, keep pipeline and reporting current, and escalate offer, pricing, targeting strategy, and close decisions to Leadership. After a year, this person has the model and existing sales assets organized, with CRM, outreach cadence, follow-up, proposal workflow, playbook, and weekly reporting in active use, and with qualified prospects contacted, conversations booked, proposals sent, signed clients, and visible progress toward break-even. Engagement Model This is a remote role with an expected workload of up to 40 hours per week, working with Leadership on daily direction, review, and feedback. The Business Development & Revenue Systems Lead must be available from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for outreach, calls, and same-day follow-up. Strategy, offers, and priorities stay with Leadership at the start. Scope may expand only when business need, role capacity, performance, and leadership approval all support the change. Responsibilities - Research target niches, cities, service areas, and local businesses, then build targeted prospect lists. - Run outbound campaigns by email, phone, and LinkedIn, personalizing each touch from the prospect, niche, market, and available proof. - Follow up until each prospect is closed, paused, or disqualified, and log activity, responses, objections, next steps, and outcomes in the CRM. - Book discovery and demo calls, and prepare Leadership with prospect context, materials, and open questions before each conversation. - Draft proposals, one-page summaries, follow-up emails, and sales materials tailored to the prospect's business, niche, location, and needs. - Move qualified prospects from first contact toward a signed client, including post-call notes, action items, and client handoff after a win. - Rebuild CRM workflows, pipeline stages, lead statuses, follow-up reminders, and sales reporting from existing assets and Leadership direction. - Turn existing scripts, proposal templates, FAQs, agreements, and outreach materials into a practical sales playbook. - Document workflows for lead sourcing, research, outreach, qualification, demo preparation, proposal follow-up, client handoff, and reporting. - Record which niches, cities, and customer profiles respond, track objections and buying signals, and recommend messaging, proof, offer, and material changes to Leadership. - Use AI for research, drafting, personalization, and summaries, then review the output before it reaches a prospect or the CRM. Offer, pricing, and close decisions stay with Leadership. - Protect prospect and client information in CRM records and sales files, and escalate data, access, or commitment issues to Leadership promptly. - Execute assigned pipeline, outbound, follow-up, proposal, and CRM work only after the primary sales motion is functioning and Leadership assigns it. Required Qualifications - Experience owning outbound sales execution: prospecting, outreach, follow-up, and the rebuild of CRM and playbook from existing assets, running that motion independently, keeping pipeline and reporting current, and escalating offer, pricing, targeting strategy, and close decisions to Leadership. - Ability to research local businesses by niche and city, read response and objection patterns, and turn those into targeting and messaging recommendations Leadership can act on. - Judgment to d ---------- which prospects to pursue, when to pause or disqualify, and when an AI draft is accurate and specific enough to send. - Familiarity with a CRM, spreadsheets, email, phone, and LinkedIn for outreach, pipeline tracking, and reporting; comfort using AI for research, list-building, drafting, personalization, and summaries; and willingness to learn the stack Leadership selects. - Ability to operate with incomplete systems, dormant assets, and changing targeting, turning Leadership direction into daily execution and improving the process as results come in. - Clear written and spoken English for outbound email, phone, LinkedIn, call prep with Leadership, proposals, and weekly reporting. Preferred Qualifications - Experience running outbound sales or appointment setting. - Experience with local service businesses, local SEO, Google Business Profile, or lead-generation offers. - Experience setting up CRM pipelines, stages, reminders, and sales reporting. - Experience writing or improving sales scripts, outreach sequences, or proposal templates. - Experience working with U.S.-based companies or buyers. - Experience in a remote seat with limited day-to-day supervision. Why This Role Remote work on a required 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time schedule, up to 40 hours a week, for a sales professional who owns prospecting, outreach, follow-up, and the rebuild of CRM and playbook from existing assets. Opportunity for continued work and expanded responsibilities when business need, role capacity, performance, and leadership approval all support the change. Work with Leadership on daily direction, review, and feedback, with strategy, offers, and priorities set by Leadership at the start. Hours Expected workload is up to 40 hours per week, with required availability from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time for outreach, calls, and same-day follow-up. Pay Compensation will be based on experience, role fit, and agreed weekly scope. title: LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement
description: About Founders & Funders Founders & Funders is a growing community that brings together high-potential founders, venture capital firms, and strategic partners through curated events, meaningful introductions, and relationship-driven experiences. We are looking for an experienced **LinkedIn Outreach & Founder Engagement** who can help us identify, engage, and invite the right founders to our events. This is not simply a high-volume outreach role. We need someone who understands how to find qualified founders, create communications that feel personal and relevant, and build outreach systems that consistently generate strong responses and event registrations. What You’ll Own Founder Research and Targeting - Identify founders who match the specific criteria, audience, and goals of each event. - Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, databases, AI tools, and other research platforms. - Evaluate founder quality based on factors such as company stage, revenue, funding, industry, location, and overall event fit. - Continuously improve targeting strategies based on registration quality and campaign performance. LinkedIn Outreach and Engagement - Create personalized LinkedIn outreach campaigns that capture founders’ attention and encourage meaningful responses. - Write creative invitations, follow-ups, and engagement sequences that feel warm, relevant, and human. - Adapt messaging for different founder segments, industries, funding stages, and event formats. - Engage prospects through both automated and manual outreach while maintaining a high level of personalization. - Build genuine relationships with founders—not simply send connection requests or generic messages. Automation, AI, and Campaign Systems - Use LinkedIn outreach and automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools to build and manage campaigns. - Use AI strategically for research, personalization, message development, segmentation, and campaign optimization. - Create repeatable outreach workflows that allow the team to scale without sacrificing message quality. - Monitor platform limitations and LinkedIn best practices to maintain account safety and campaign effectiveness. - Test new tools, systems, and approaches that can improve founder acquisition. Lead Generation and Performance - Own outreach performance from prospect identification through registration. - Track key metrics such as connection acceptance, response rate, qualified conversations, registrations, approvals, and attendance. - Run regular message and campaign tests to improve results. - Identify why campaigns are performing well or underperforming and recommend solutions. - Provide clear updates on results, challenges, learnings, and next steps. Leadership and Team Development - Help establish outreach standards, processes, templates, and best practices. - Coach and support other team members involved in founder research and outreach. - Review outreach quality and help the team improve targeting, messaging, and follow-up. - Take increasing ownership of the overall founder outreach strategy as the organization grows. - Develop into a future leader who can eventually manage and strengthen the Founder Outreach team. What We’re Looking For - Proven experience in LinkedIn outreach, lead generation, founder acquisition, business development, or a related role. - Advanced knowledge of LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator. - Experience using LinkedIn automation platforms such as Ulinc or similar tools. - Strong understanding of outreach automation, AI-assisted workflows, CRM systems, and lead-generation platforms. - Excellent writing skills, with the ability to create communications that are engaging, personalized, and not overly sales-driven. - Experience building and optimizing multi-step outreach campaigns. - Strong research skills and the ability to distinguish qualified prospects from high-volume lists. - Comfortable working with performance metrics and making decisions based on campaign data. - Highly organized, resourceful, proactive, and able to manage multiple campaigns at once. - Strong judgment when balancing automation with thoughtful, human engagement. - Leadership potential and a genuine interest in coaching others and improving team performance. What Success Looks Like - We consistently attract the right founders for each event—not simply more registrations. - Outreach messages generate strong connection, response, and conversion rates. - Founder communications feel personal, thoughtful, and aligned with the F&F brand. - Campaigns are organized, measurable, and continuously improving. - The team has clear outreach processes, templates, reporting, and quality standards. - You grow from a hands-on outreach expert into a strategic leader who can help build and manage the function. Ideal Candidate - You are both creative and analytical. You know how to write a message that gets a founder’s attention, but you also understand targeting, automation, conversion metrics, and campaign strategy. - You are not looking for a role where you simply execute a list of daily tasks. You want to take ownership, improve systems, contribute ideas, coach others, and grow into a leadership position as Founders & Funders continues to expand. How to Apply 1. Send your resume 2. This is not a typical website or CRUD project. We are building a precise loan servicing system for a real portfolio of owner financed real estate notes, along with a secure borrower portal. The business rules, calculations, workflows, and numeric examples are already documented. Your job is to turn those specifications into reliable software and prove through testing that the numbers are correct. The first milestone will focus on the allocation engine itself: no UI, just correct financial logic backed by automated tests. What You’ll Be Doing You will be responsible for building and maintaining functionality that: • Generates amortization schedules and maintains loan balances • Records and allocates borrower payments according to defined business rules • Tracks principal, interest arrears, escrow, fees, and suspense separately • Maintains an append only transaction ledger and complete audit history • Allows operators to review and override proposed payment allocations • Explains the ledger entries behind calculated balances • Generates statements and notices • Provides borrowers with a secure portal to view balances, payment history, and documents • Runs reliably in a cloud environment • Includes automated testing to verify financial calculations and business rules What We’re Looking For You should be genuinely strong in: • Python or Node.js • PostgreSQL and database schema design • Cloud deployment such as Render, Railway, ---------- , or AWS • Automated testing • Building functional web interfaces • Financial calculations and safe handling of currency • Reading detailed technical specifications and implementing them precisely • Debugging and validating your own work AI proficiency is required. AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or equivalent should already be part of your normal development workflow. We expect you to know how to use AI to plan against a specification, generate code, write and run tests, investigate failures, and accelerate development. However, you are responsible for everything AI produces. You must be able to recognize when AI generated code looks correct but violates the specification or produces incorrect financial results. Our Philosophy Financial accuracy comes before speed. A wrong number that successfully saves to the database is more dangerous than code that crashes. We value developers who test their assumptions, prove their calculations, take ownership of their work, communicate clearly, and use AI as a tool without outsourcing their judgment to it. You will work from detailed specifications, but we expect you to think independently, ask precise questions when necessary, and continue making productive progress without needing daily step by step instructions. What Would Make You Stand Out You will stand out if you have experience with: • Financial software, loan servicing, accounting, or ledger systems • Payment allocation and amortization logic • Transaction ledgers and audit trails • Production systems where numerical accuracy is critical • Designing database architecture from the ground up • Strong automated testing practices • Using multiple AI coding tools effectively while independently verifying their output This Job Probably Isn’t For You If... • Most of your experience is WordPress, Shopify, or landing pages • You need someone to break your work into daily step by step instructions • You have never designed a database schema yourself • You have never written automated tests • You use AI to generate code you cannot personally understand or debug • You want to learn a new framework while working on this project • You dislike repetitive validation and testing • You are juggling multiple clients and cannot give this role real focus About the Team You will work directly with the owner rather than inside a large development team. You will receive clear written specifications, agree on priorities, and take ownership of execution. We value direct communication, accountability, independent thinking, and the ability to adapt when new information requires a change in direction. We are looking for someone interested in a full time, long term role, not simply completing a short development project. Compensation: $1,200 to $2,000 USD/month, based on experience Hours: 40 hours/week Schedule: Flexible, with some overlap with US Central Time Start: As soon as we find the right person AI Tools: Paid AI tooling, including Claude Code or equivalent How to Apply Use the subject line: LEDGER | [Your Name] Please answer all five screening questions below. Applications that do not answer all questions will not be considered. Strong applicants will be invited to complete a small paid trial project using a real piece of the allocation engine. The project will take a few hours and will be paid at your normal rate. Screening Questions 1. Currency Why should currency never be stored as a floating point number, and what should be used instead? Please answer in one or two sentences. 2. Solve This Problem A loan has a principal balance of $100,000 at 10% annual interest. The scheduled monthly payment is: $877.57 principal and interest + $200 escrow = $1,077.57 total For this month: Scheduled interest: $833.33 Scheduled principal: $44.24 The borrower sends $700. The system applies money in this order: Principal first, capped at scheduled principal → Interest → Escrow → Fees Show: • How the $700 is allocated • New principal balance • Unpaid interest • Escrow shortage • Your reasoning 3. Production Bug Tell us about one bug you shipped to production that had real consequences. What happened, how did you find it, and what did you change afterward? 4. Technical Experience In two or three sentences, describe the most technically difficult system you have built. Include links if available. 5. AI Development Workflow How do you use Claude Code or similar AI coding tools during a normal working day? Be specific about what you give AI, what you handle yourself, and how you verify its work. Then give us one example of AI generated code that looked correct but was actually wrong. How did you catch it?

description: We are a U.S.-based luxury architectural metalwork company looking for a full-time Senior AI Video Editor & Motion Designer. This is not a basic VA, posting, Canva, or slideshow-editing role. We need an exceptional editor who can take raw construction footage, installation clips, fabrication footage, finished-project photography, product imagery, drawings, and a clear creative theme—and turn them into cinematic films that make people stop and think, “Damn, this company is the real deal.” THE CORE MISSION Create premium project films and social content that: • make the finished architecture look extraordinary • show builders, developers, architects, and luxury clients that we can fabricate and install major projects • turn imperfect raw footage into intentional, high-energy visual stories • preserve the real building, product geometry, and architectural details • sell craftsmanship, scale, lifestyle, credibility, and emotion—not just features YOU MUST BE EXCELLENT AT VIDEO EDITING We care more about editing judgment than simply knowing an AI tool. You should be highly capable with: • Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or an equivalent professional workflow • pacing, music selection, sound design, color, stabilization, speed changes, match cuts, visual rhythm, and payoff • masking, tracking, rotoscoping, compositing, cleanup, motion graphics, typography, and visual effects • selecting powerful 0.5–3 second moments from long, imperfect raw clips • combining real footage, still photography, drawings, and generated material into one coherent film • producing clean, premium work without blurry footage, generic templates, random effects, basic crossfades, or slideshow pacing AI VIDEO AND IMAGE GENERATION You should also be comfortable with several of these tools: • Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, or similar • image-to-video animation, controlled camera movement, cinematic B-roll, product visualization, and scene extension • prompting and iteration that preserve believable architecture, steel profiles, doors, windows, hardware, glass, reflections, and perspective AI should expand what is possible. It should not replace excellent editing or invent incorrect architecture in a real project. WHAT YOU WILL CREATE • 30–60 second flagship project films for our website and commercial credibility • 15–30 second Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, and promotional edits • cinematic AI-generated or AI-composited product and lifestyle videos • finished-project reveals, before/after transformations, installation and fabrication hype clips • clean and text-on-screen versions, thumbnails, covers, cutdowns, alternate hooks, crops, and platform variants • supporting image, carousel, Story, Pinterest, Houzz, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and email assets when needed This is a high-output content-engine role. After onboarding, the operating target is 100+ platform-ready content units per week through intelligent repurposing—not 100 unrelated original videos. title: WordPress Migration Specialist
description: Title: WordPress Migration Specialist — 10-Month Project, US Company (WordPress / 301 Redirects / SEO-Safe Migrations) Rate: $8 – $10 USD/hour, based on demonstrated skill Type: Long-term contract, ~10 months, About the project A US healthcare company with treatment centers in several states is rebranding. We're moving ten websites onto ten new domains over the next ten months — roughly one site per month. Every page has to move without losing its search rankings, which means content moves, metadata gets rewritten, and every old URL gets pointed at its new home. This is careful, methodical work. It is not glamorous. Done right, nobody notices — traffic stays flat through the move and then grows. Done wrong, a company loses a decade of search visibility in a weekend. We're hiring someone who understands which one of those they're preventing. The problem I'm hiring to solve We can direct ten site migrations but we can't personally execute three thousand URL moves, metadata rewrites, and redirect mappings. What you'll actually own - Moving pages and posts from existing WordPress sites to new ones, preserving formatting and images - Rewriting titles, meta descriptions, and headings for the new brand - Building and implementing the 301 redirect map — old URL to new URL, every single one - Publishing content on a schedule we set — not all at once, because every batch has to be reviewed and verified before the next one goes out - QA: broken links, missing images, redirect chains, orphaned pages - A weekly written status on what moved, what broke, and what you're unsure about - Additionally, Build Programmatic SEO into new migrated sites using dedicated sitesmaps and mega menu - Familiar with WP Engine You'll work directly with me and our content lead. We'll show you the process on the first site. After that we review, we don't hover. Who this is for You've done WordPress content migration before and you know what a 301 redirect is for, not just how to create one. You're comfortable in Yoast or Rank Math and you've used a redirect manager. You're careful with spreadsheets — a redirect map is a spreadsheet, and one wrong row is a dead page. You write clear English; we work asynchronously and almost everything is written. When you apply, please use the exact subject line "Lanzones — Migration" so I know you read the whole post. Most importantly: you ask before you guess. On a migration, a confident wrong assumption is worse than a question. Who this is not for If you've never touched a redirect, this isn't an entry point — the stakes are too high across ten sites. If you'd find ten months of methodical, repetitive, detail-critical work miserable, please don't apply; you'll be unhappy and so will we. What we offer - Steady, predictable work for roughly ten months, paid semi-monthly - A US client who pays on time and knows what they're asking for - Paid skills assessment — $30 for about 90 minutes. No free work - Paid probation week at full rate before either of us commits - Real chance of ongoing contract work after we run multiple sites and always need reliable hands How to apply 1. Your resume, plus two live sites you've worked on that I can look at 2. Answers to the three questions below, in your own words 3. A 90-second Loom video ( ---------- , free) sharing your screen walk me through a migration or a redirect setup you've done. Any site, any size. Also answer the 3 questions below in Loom video The three questions: The three questions: 1. You're moving a blog post from ---------- /blog/what-is-detox/ to ---------- /resources/what-is-detox/. Walk me through every step you'd take, in order, from start to finished. Assume the new site already exists. 2. You've been given a list of 400 URLs to migrate and 30 of them have no obvious match on the new site. What do you do? 3. What's one mistake you've seen people make during a website migration — or made yourself — and what did it cost? Applications missing the video or any answer won't be reviewed. Every complete application gets a reply.

title: Construction Project Manager
description: PropZap is building a next-generation real estate company designed to expand across North America. We are pioneers in how modern real estate companies should be built — powered by strong systems, smart processes, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency. We're building with intention. With structure. With the right people at the core. With performance that compounds over time. Our goal is to create a brand that sets the standard. A company that leads. A business built to scale intelligently and sustainably across markets. And for the right person, this isn't just a job inside that company. It's a front-row seat to its growth. -------------------------------------------------------------- Role: Construction Project Manager Location: Remote Shift: Aligned with Canada MST Role Type: Full-time Compensation: Competitive salary based on experience and qualifications, plus performance-based bonuses -------------------------------------------------------------- Why This Role Is a Big Opportunity for You PropZap works closely with active real estate investors in Alberta, Canada who are constantly buying, renovating, building, and reselling properties, and this side of the business is a real, growing pipeline of work, not a one-off project. Whether it's a full renovation or a new build from the ground up, every property that gets delivered well builds the confidence to take on the next one, and the next one after that. Right now, this entire process runs through one person juggling it alongside everything else, from securing the property and drafting the scope of work, all the way through contractor management, budget tracking, and final sign-off. That's the gap this role exists to close, and it's built to be run remotely from day one. This isn't a role where you manage one project and disappear. This is an ongoing seat managing a real, recurring pipeline of construction and renovation projects for investors who are actively scaling their own buying and building volume. As they grow, this role grows with them, and there's a genuine path to more ownership, more projects, and more responsibility over time. -------------------------------------------------------------- What You'll Be Doing - Draft the construction scope of work and budget for each project, whether it's a renovation or a new build - Source and evaluate contractor bids, and award and write construction contracts - Assign work to the selected contractor and get the project underway - Meet regularly with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to align on timelines, budgets, and progress - Review photos, video, and contractor updates to confirm safety and quality standards are being met on-site - Review and approve project plans, drawings, and specifications, keeping them accurate and up to date - Monitor progress across all active projects to keep work on schedule and within budget, addressing issues as they come up - Review and approve change orders, RFIs, invoices, and other project documentation - Coordinate with other functions (architecture, engineering, procurement) to make sure resources are available when needed - Keep project records and databases current and accurate - Provide regular updates to clients and stakeholders on project status and any concerns - Confirm final completion remotely through documentation and contractor sign-off, before the property moves to resale - Analyze costs across the active pipeline and identify opportunities for savings - Review overall project and department performance periodically, and help shape plans, budgets, and priorities going forward -------------------------------------------------------------- Who This Is Perfect For - Someone who's actually run construction, renovation, or new-build projects before, not just studied it - Someone comfortable managing multiple properties and contractors at once without losing track of details - Someone who communicates clearly and directly with tradespeople, and knows how to keep a contractor accountable without micromanaging every hour, even without being physically on-site - Someone trustworthy with budgets, payments, and vendor relationships - Someone genuinely comfortable running construction projects remotely, coordinating job sites without ever needing to be there in person - Proven track record managing construction, renovation, or new-build projects, ideally within real estate or property investment - Strong understanding of construction processes, materials, and industry best practices, ideally familiar with Canadian/Alberta building codes and permitting - Comfortable creating and managing budgets, schedules, and contractor relationships - Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making skills - Able to work independently while keeping stakeholders regularly updated Highly Ideal: - Experience with both renovation projects and ground-up new construction - Experience working with property investors or real estate-focused clients - Experience managing construction projects remotely, without being on-site - Familiarity with construction management or documentation tools -------------------------------------------------------------- What You'll Gain - Competitive, performance-based compensation tied to how well the pipeline runs - Ownership of a real, growing pipeline of construction and renovation projects, not a single isolated job - Room to grow as our investor clients scale their own buying and building volume, meaning more projects, more responsibility, and more opportunity over time - Direct collaboration with PropZap's leadership on how this function should run and scale - The chance to build and shape this role as it grows, rather than stepping into something rigid and already fixed in place -------------------------------------------------------------- How to Apply Send the following to: ---------- - Resume (required) - A short summary of construction, renovation, or new-build projects you've personally managed, including budget size and project type (required) - Portfolio or examples of past projects, if available (preferred) - Expected monthly compensation in CAD (required) - Any DISC test result (if available) Subject Line: Construction Project Manager – Your Name -------------------------------------------------------------- If you know how to take a property from empty scope of work to a finished, sellable result, whether it's a renovation or a build from scratch, and want to build a real pipeline of projects rather than chase one-off jobs, this might be the role you've been waiting for.

We care about: * Qualified leads * Email/newsletter subscribers * Free-trial registrations * Paid conversions * Mortgage inquiries/applications * Cost per lead * Cost per acquisition * Conversion rates **If a post gets 50,000 views and produces zero qualified leads, we don't consider that a successful post.** Your job is to use social media to produce measurable business results. # Platforms You Must Know You should have **hands-on professional experience** creating and managing content across most or all of: * LinkedIn * Facebook * Instagram * YouTube / YouTube Shorts * TikTok * X / Twitter Experience with Meta Business Suite, Facebook Ads Manager and ---------- is particularly valuable. # What You Will Actually Do ### 1. description: We're a US e-commerce group doing $3-5M per month across multiple DTC brands. Our goal is written on the wall: $10M per month by 2027. Our growth comes from one thing: creative. We ship a high volume of video ads, we test relentlessly, and the winners scale fast. Not a freelancer we hand a shot list to: someone who becomes part of how we think about creative. This is not a "cut the clips and add captions" job. If you're looking for a ticket-taker role where someone else does the thinking, this isn't it, and we'll both waste our time. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO - Produce a high volume of AI video ads every week — new concepts, hook variations, iterations on winners — without quality dropping as volume goes up. - Study what's winning right now across the market. Not what worked last year. You should already have a research habit: you watch what top DTC brands are running, you spot the concepts breaking out, and you understand why they work. - Rebuild and adapt those winning concepts for our brands — fully with AI. - Bring us ideas we didn't ask for. Angles, hooks, formats, concepts. If your only contribution is executing our briefs, you're not the person for this. - Hit deadlines. Consistently. Volume means nothing if it lands late. THE AI PART — READ THIS TWICE This is the single most important requirement, and we're not being casual about it. Everything can be made with AI now. We need someone who has already internalized that and works accordingly not someone who "has played with a few AI tools" or is "open to learning." You should be able to take a winning video ad you've seen in the wild and rebuild it end to end with AI characters, voiceovers, b-rolls, the full video at a quality level that's ready to run. We are deliberately not listing the tools we expect you to know. Tell us what you use and why. Your stack, and how precisely you can explain your choices, tells us more than any certification could. If you're genuinely at the front of this, that answer will be easy for you to write. WHO THIS IS FOR - Excellent English. Our market is the US. You'll write hooks, headlines and scripts that need to land with an American audience. Non-negotiable. - You've done this for a real brand. You have worked with brands doing at least 7 figures per month in the US or another English-speaking market. We'll ask for proof. - Full-time, and exclusive. This is a full-time position — 5 days a week, our brands only. We are not looking for someone juggling three other clients and fitting us in between gaps. While you work with us, you don't take on other brands. If you're not in a position to commit to that, don't apply. - Motivated for the long run. We're building a group, not flipping a store. If you're looking for a 3-month gig, don't apply. - Autonomous and proactive. You manage your own output, flag problems before they become problems, and come with proposals rather than questions. WHAT WE OFFER - $2,000 USD per month, paid by Wise or bank transfer, plus a performance-based variable: bonuses tied to how your creatives actually perform. The better your ads do, the more you earn. - A long-term seat in a growing group. We're at $3-5M/month today across several brands, aiming for $10M/month by 2027 — and the people who help us get there take the biggest seats on the way. We're not hiring for a project: we're hiring someone we expect to still be working with in two years. - We ask for exclusivity, so we treat this as a real job and not a gig: a steady full-time workload every week, Monday to Friday, weekends always off, commitment on our side, and pay that reflects both. You stop chasing the next contract and start building something. - For the right person, this role grows into Creative Strategist for a brand of the group: owning the creative direction, d ---------- what we test and why, not just producing it. Compensation grows with it. The best editors we work with stop being editors. That's the path here. TO APPLY Send us: 1. Your portfolio — real AI video ads you personally made. Not a showreel of pretty shots: ads that ran, ideally ads that performed. 2. Proof of the brands you've worked with. We want to see the 7-figure US / English-market experience, not just read about it. 3. Your AI workflow. What you use, at which stage, and why you chose it over the alternatives. Be specific — vague answers get filtered out immediately. 4. Three concepts winning right now that you've spotted in the last 30 days, and your read on why each one works. We read every application properly, and we expect the same in return — so start your application with the word banana before anything else, otherwise we'll know it wasn't read and we won't go further. Tell us what you'd change about our creative if we brought you in tomorrow. That answer matters more to us than your years of experience.

title: SOCIAL MEDIA / INFLUENCER ASSISTANT
description: I’m looking for a reliable, organized, and social-media-savvy assistant to help me manage 4 Instagram accounts. This is a part-time, primarily remote position — approximately 15 hours per week at $5/hour. You don’t need advanced experience. I’m looking for someone who understands social media, is comfortable with basic editing, learns quickly, and is interested in discovering the real behind-the-scenes of the influencer/content creator industry. MAIN RESPONSIBILITY — SHORT TREND REELS The primary task will be creating approximately 4 short trend Reels per day, Monday–Friday, for each of 4 accounts. That equals approximately 80 Reels per week. These are NOT complicated or heavily edited Reels. They follow a very simple system that I will teach you: • Usually 7–10 seconds maximum • Generally one existing video clip + text/trending format • Sometimes a few clips depending on the trend/niche • Approximately 3 minutes to create each Reel once you understand the system • 80 Reels × 3 minutes = approximately 4 hours of editing per week The accounts cover different niches, including travel, NYC content, lifestyle/travel, and creator/social media content, so each account will have its own strategy. FINDING TRENDS I will regularly send you trends through WhatsApp or organize them in dedicated folders so you know exactly what I want recreated. However, I also want you to gradually learn how to find trends yourself based on each account’s niche. I’ll teach you my method for finding trends and how to train your Instagram algorithm so your feed starts showing you more relevant content and ideas. CONTENT ANALYSIS & STRATEGY A very important part of the position will be analyzing what is actually working. Instead of constantly trying random content, I want you to look at the performance of each account and identify: • Which subjects perform best • Which hooks get attention • Which Reel formats work • Which trends perform well • Which concepts should be repeated When we find something that works, the goal is to repeat the strategy, create variations of it, and adapt it to each account and audience. I’ll teach you my method for analyzing content, so advanced analytics experience is NOT required. ORGANIZATION I’ll create organized Google Drive folders for each account. Every completed/edited Reel will need to be uploaded to the correct folder so everything stays organized and easy to access. Being organized and consistent with this system is extremely important. POSTING I’ll personally handle posting for some of the accounts. For two accounts, I may give you direct login access so you can post through the Edits app using my specific posting and Trial Reels strategy. I’ll provide training on exactly how I want this done. INFLUENCER / BRAND OUTREACH Part of your weekly hours will also be dedicated to finding potential influencer opportunities and reaching out to brands, businesses, hotels, restaurants, and other potential collaborations through Instagram DMs. You won’t need to write the pitches yourself. I’ll provide the messages/templates and explain who to contact. This will mostly be a straightforward and repetitive outreach process. APPROXIMATE WEEKLY SCHEDULE The position is approximately 15 hours per week. Those hours will be divided between: • Creating approximately 80 short Reels • Finding relevant trends • Analyzing what content is performing • Repeating/adapting successful strategies • Organizing and uploading content • Posting on selected accounts • Sending influencer/brand outreach DMs • Occasional additional social media/admin tasks WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR You do NOT need to be a social media expert. Basic knowledge of Instagram, Reels, CapCut and/or Edits is enough. More importantly, I’m looking for someone who is: • Reliable and consistent • Very organized • Fast and efficient • Comfortable with repetitive tasks • Naturally interested in social media and trends • Able to follow instructions and a specific system • Able to notice patterns in what performs well • Comfortable eventually working independently • Willing and excited to learn WHAT YOU’LL LEARN This is also an opportunity to get hands-on experience in the real influencer and content creation industry. I’ll personally train you on my systems for finding trends, creating content efficiently, analyzing performance, growing accounts, developing content strategies, and reaching out to brands for collaborations. You’ll get to see how multiple creator accounts are managed behind the scenes and learn strategies you can eventually apply to your own work or career in social media. COMPENSATION & WORK SETUP ???? $5/hour ⏰ Approximately 15 hours/week ???? Primarily remote ???? Flexible schedule You can work from home, your desk, a coffee shop, etc. I don’t currently have a permanent office, so most of the work will be done independently. We can have Zoom calls for training and check-ins, and occasional in-person meetings may also be possible. If you’re interested, please send me a short introduction including: • Where you’re based • Your current availability • Any social media experience you have (basic experience is completely fine) • Whether you’re familiar with CapCut and/or Edits • Why you’re interested in the position I’m looking for someone who can grow into the role, understand my system, and eventually become very independent with the day-to-day workflow.

title: **Temporary Housing Specialist / Cold Caller / Lead Generation Representative**
job_title: **Temporary Housing Specialist / Cold Caller / Lead Generation Representative**
description: About Akita Management Services Akita Management Services is a US-based property management company that works with short-term, mid-term, and temporary housing opportunities. We help connect housing needs with suitable properties and work with homeowners, policyholders, temporary housing specialists, relocation contacts, and other housing-related partners. We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and confident **Temporary Housing Specialist / Cold Caller / Lead Generation Representative** to help us find suitable properties, build relationships, make calls, follow up consistently, and support our lead generation process. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable speaking on the phone, enjoys searching for opportunities, can negotiate professionally, and understands the importance of accurate documentation and strong follow-through. Position Overview The Temporary Housing Specialist will be responsible for aggressively searching for suitable housing opportunities, contacting homeowners and related parties, communicating with temporary housing specialists, and helping move leads through our internal process. This position requires someone who is proactive, organized, persistent, and comfortable making calls throughout the day. The right candidate must be able to hold professional conversations, ask good questions, document information accurately, and follow up without needing constant reminders. This is not just a basic cold-calling role. We are looking for someone who can think, communicate, negotiate, and help create real housing opportunities for the company. Key Responsibilities Lead Generation & Property Searching * Search aggressively for suitable properties that may qualify for temporary housing, mid-term rental, or corporate housing opportunities. * Identify homeowners, landlords, property managers, hosts, and other potential housing contacts. * Research property details, location, availability, pricing, and suitability. * Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential housing leads. * Follow up consistently with leads until there is a clear outcome. * Track all lead activity, contact attempts, responses, and next steps. Cold Calling & Phone Communication * Make outbound calls to homeowners, property owners, policyholders, temporary housing specialists, and related contacts. * Hold professional conversations to gather information and identify opportunities. * Clearly explain the company’s housing needs and potential opportunities. * Ask detailed questions about property availability, pricing, terms, location, and suitability. * Handle objections professionally and continue conversations with confidence. * Maintain a respectful but persistent follow-up approach. Negotiation & Relationship Building * Negotiate pricing, availability, terms, and potential housing arrangements when appropriate. * Build professional relationships with homeowners, hosts, and housing contacts. * Communicate clearly and confidently with temporary housing specialists and other partners. * Identify where there may be room for better pricing, better terms, or stronger opportunities. * Escalate strong leads and important conversations to leadership when needed. Administrative & Documentation Duties * Maintain accurate notes for every call, lead, and follow-up. * Update internal spreadsheets, CRMs, task boards, and tracking systems. * Organize property details, contact information, pricing, availability, and communication history. * Prepare lead summaries for leadership review. * Follow company systems, checklists, and documentation standards. * Make sure no important details are missed or left incomplete. Required Skills & Qualifications * Strong spoken and written English communication skills. * Experience with cold calling, lead generation, sales support, appointment setting, real estate, property management, or customer service. * Comfortable making outbound calls and speaking with different types of people. * Strong negotiation and follow-up skills. * Excellent attention to detail. * Ability to research properties and organize information clearly. * Comfortable working remotely with a U.S.-based company. * Able to work during California / Pacific Time business hours. * Reliable, professional, and self-motivated. * Able to handle rejection and continue working with a positive attitude. * Strong computer skills, including email, spreadsheets, online research, and communication tools. Preferred Experience * Experience working with U.S.-based clients or companies. * Experience in real estate, property management, short-term rentals, mid-term rentals, temporary housing, corporate housing, insurance housing, or relocation housing. * Experience using CRMs, lead trackers, Google Sheets, Airtable, ClickUp, ---------- , or similar systems. * Prior experience calling homeowners, landlords, property managers, or business contacts. * Experience with negotiation or sales conversations. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is confident, organized, persistent, and professional. They are not afraid to make calls, ask questions, follow up multiple times, and search hard for the right opportunities. They should be able to communicate warmly while still being assertive. They should understand that success in this role comes from consistency, strong documentation, good judgment, and the ability to move conversations forward. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, pays attention to details, and does not wait to be told what to do next. The right person will be able to help create opportunities, maintain organized records, and communicate clearly with both the team and outside contacts. Apply to the position using this link, ---------- Work Schedule This is a full-time remote position. Candidate must be available to work during Pacific Standard Time business hours. Exact schedule will be discussed during the interview process. ## Compensation Compensation will be based on experience, skill level, communication ability, and availability. How to Apply Please submit the following: -Resume or CV. -A short introduction about yourself. -Summary of your experience with cold calling, lead generation, real estate, property management, sales, or customer service. -Expected monthly compensation in USD. -Confirmation that you are available to work California / Pacific Time business hours. -A short explanation of why you believe you would be a good fit for this role. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, sounds confident on the phone, and can represent the company professionally.

title: Remote Patient Care Coordinators (RNs)/ MA
description: Registered Nurse / Medical Assistant Responsible for facilitating efficient patient intake, medical processing, and discharge procedures. Provides compassionate, timely, and accurate patient support while ensuring compliance with clinical and organizational protocols. Key Responsibilities: *Facilitate patient intake, including registration, documentation, vital signs, medical history, and initial assessment. *Prepare patients for examinations, procedures, and treatments. *Assist healthcare providers with clinical and medical processing activities. *Accurately document patient information, services provided, medications, and clinical findings. *Coordinate laboratory tests, diagnostic procedures, referrals, and follow-up care as directed. *Monitor patients and promptly communicate changes in condition or concerns to the appropriate healthcare provider. *Provide patients and families with clear instructions regarding medications, treatment plans, follow-up appointments, and post-care needs. *Facilitate safe and efficient patient discharge, ensuring all required documentation and instructions are completed. *Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to applicable healthcare regulations, safety standards, and infection-control practices. *Support a professional, organized, and patient-centered clinical environment. *Perform other duties as assigned within the scope of licensure, certification, and organizational policies.

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description: # Real Estate Operations Manager | $4–$7/hr + Performance Incentives We are a growing U.S. real estate company looking for a highly organized, experienced **Real Estate Operations Manager** to help oversee the day-to-day operations of our sales, lead generation, transaction, and administrative systems. This is **not a basic administrative or virtual assistant position.** We are looking for someone who understands how a real estate operation works, is comfortable managing people, numbers, systems, and processes, and can become the person management relies on to know **what is happening, what needs attention, and what needs to happen next.** You will work across multiple parts of the business, including: * Seller lead management * ISA operations * CRM organization * Dialer campaigns * SMS marketing * Property underwriting * MLS research * Payroll tracking * Transaction coordination * Team accountability * Reporting * Process improvement The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership, solves problems proactively, and does not need to be reminded about every task. ## Compensation **$4.00–$7.00/hour**, depending on experience, skill level, real estate knowledge, and familiarity with our systems. There may also be opportunities for: * Performance bonuses * Commissions * Increased compensation based on results * Expanded responsibilities as the company grows Candidates with strong experience in several of the following may qualify toward the higher end of the range: * ReadyMode * Smarter Contact * Follow Up Boss * Dotloop * MLS * Real estate underwriting * Comparable sales analysis * ISA management * Real estate operations * Wholesaling or investment real estate Compensation and responsibilities may grow based on demonstrated performance and ownership of the role. # Core Responsibilities ## Property Underwriting & Deal Review You will help management and acquisitions quickly understand whether seller opportunities are worth pursuing. Responsibilities may include: * Reviewing incoming seller leads and property opportunities * Researching property values and comparable sales * Pulling and analyzing MLS comps * Reviewing property history and prior sales * Evaluating active, pending, and sold listings * Assisting with ARV calculations * Reviewing estimated repair information * Helping determine potential offer ranges * Reviewing equity and deal viability * Organizing seller and property information for acquisitions * Prioritizing opportunities based on motivation, equity, property condition, timeline, and potential value You should be comfortable looking at property data and turning it into useful information for a sales or acquisitions team. ## Lead Management & CRM Operations You will help ensure our seller leads are properly organized, assigned, worked, and followed up with. Responsibilities include: * Managing and organizing leads inside our CRM * Monitoring lead stages and dispositions * Ensuring follow-up tasks are being completed * Identifying neglected or improperly managed leads * Maintaining organized lead lists * Creating follow-up categories * Helping maintain nurture campaigns * Monitoring lead flow through the sales pipeline * Ensuring qualified opportunities reach the appropriate team member * Identifying leads that need additional attention * Improving lead organization and follow-up processes A major part of this role is making sure **good opportunities do not fall through the cracks.** ## ReadyMode Management Experience with **ReadyMode** is strongly preferred. You may be responsible for: * Uploading lead lists * Organizing campaigns * Creating dialing campaigns * Managing campaign settings * Managing lead distribution * Maintaining dispositions * Maintaining follow-up lists * Monitoring ISA activity * Reviewing campaign performance * Helping troubleshoot basic dialer or campaign issues * Ensuring leads are being distributed and worked correctly * Helping management identify productivity or performance issues Candidates with experience managing another high-volume outbound dialer may also be considered. ## SMS Marketing & Smarter Contact You will also help manage our outbound SMS lead generation. Responsibilities may include: * Creating SMS campaigns in Smarter Contact * Uploading and organizing prospect lists * Segmenting leads correctly * Writing and scheduling campaigns * Monitoring replies * Routing opportunities to the appropriate team member * Tracking campaign results * Maintaining clean contact databases * Creating nurture and follow-up campaigns * Helping test messaging and campaign strategies * Preventing duplicate or improperly segmented contacts Experience with **Smarter Contact** is a major advantage. ## ISA Team Operations You will help support the day-to-day management of our Inside Sales Agent team. Responsibilities may include: * Monitoring attendance * Monitoring schedules and hours * Reviewing productivity * Reviewing call activity * Tracking KPIs * Helping coordinate training * Assisting with onboarding and offboarding * Maintaining employee and contractor records * Communicating procedures and expectations * Helping identify performance issues * Following up on accountability items * Assisting management with performance reporting You should be comfortable holding team members accountable in a professional and respectful way. This does not mean micromanaging the team. It means ensuring expectations are clear, numbers are visible, problems are identified early, and commitments are followed through. ## Payroll & Administrative Operations You may also assist with operational payroll preparation. Responsibilities may include: * Tracking employee and contractor hours * Reviewing time records * Preparing payroll information * Maintaining payroll records * Tracking commissions * Tracking bonuses * Identifying inconsistencies before payroll is submitted * Maintaining accurate internal compensation records Accuracy and attention to detail are extremely important. ## Dotloop & Transaction Support You will help ensure our real estate transaction files stay organized from contract through closing. Responsibilities may include: * Creating transaction files in Dotloop * Uploading contracts * Uploading disclosures * Organizing amendments and addenda * Monitoring documents for missing information * Checking signature completion * Helping maintain accurate transaction records * Assisting agents and management with transaction organization * Tracking important documents and deadlines * Helping keep files complete and audit-ready Direct transaction coordination experience is a strong advantage. ## MLS & Property Research You should be comfortable working with MLS data or be experienced enough in real estate research to learn our process quickly. Responsibilities may include: * Pulling comparable properties * Reviewing sold properties * Reviewing active and pending listings * Researching property history * Reviewing prior listing activity * Analyzing market activity * Helping determine pricing ranges * Assisting with underwriting * Preparing property information for management, agents, and acquisitions staff Strong attention to detail is essential when reviewing comparable properties. ## Seller Lead Nurturing Some seller opportunities require weeks or months of follow-up before they are ready to move forward. You may help ensure those opportunities stay active. Responsibilities may include: * Following up with seller leads * Checking for changes in motivation * Checking timeline changes * Discussing updated pricing expectations * Maintaining long-term relationships * Documenting conversations * Updating CRM information * Identifying newly motivated sellers * Returning qualified opportunities to acquisitions or sales You should be persistent and organized without being unnecessarily aggressive. # Systems Experience Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred: * **ReadyMode** * **Smarter Contact** * **Follow Up Boss** * **Dotloop** * **MLS** * Google Workspace * Google Sheets * Real estate CRM systems * SMS marketing platforms * Lead databases * Outbound dialers * Property research tools * Comparable sales analysis * Real estate investor systems * Wholesaling systems * Transaction management platforms You do not need experience with every system listed. However, candidates with direct experience using multiple systems in an actual real estate operation will receive stronger consideration. # Who We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is: * Extremely organized * Detail-oriented * Reliable * Comfortable managing several moving pieces at once * Able to prioritize effectively * Comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets * Strong with technology * Fast at learning new software * Experienced with real estate terminology * Comfortable researching properties * Comfortable reviewing comparable sales * Comfortable communicating with team members * Comfortable holding people accountable * Able to work independently * Proactive about identifying problems * Strong at documenting processes * Comfortable improving existing systems * Able to recognize inefficiencies * Calm when multiple priorities compete for attention * Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment * Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions We especially value someone who thinks: **“I saw the problem, figured out what caused it, fixed it, documented it, and made sure it does not keep happening.”** # Preferred Background We would especially like to hear from candidates who have previously worked as a: * Real Estate Operations Manager * Real Estate Office Manager * Real Estate Operations Coordinator * Real Estate Virtual Assistant Manager * Transaction Coordinator * Lead Manager * ISA Manager * Acquisitions Assistant * Acquisitions Coordinator * Real Estate Executive Assistant * Real Estate Investor Operations Manager * Wholesaling Operations Manager Experience working with a: * Real estate brokerage * Real estate investment company * Wholesaling company * Acquisition team * High-volume ISA organization * Seller lead generation company is highly preferred. # What Success Looks Like The successful person in this role becomes the person who can answer: **Where do our leads stand?** **Are our campaigns running correctly?** **Are the ISAs working the right opportunities?** **Which sellers need immediate attention?** **What leads are falling behind?** **What deals need underwriting?** **Are our payroll numbers correct?** **Are transaction files complete?** **Are follow-ups happening?** **What operational problems need management's attention?** When this role is working well: * Leads are organized. * Campaigns are active. * ISAs know what they should be doing. * Follow-up is consistent. * Seller opportunities are properly nurtured. * Payroll information is accurate. * Property numbers are reviewed. * MLS research is completed correctly. * Transactions are organized. * CRM information is current. * Management has visibility into performance. * Problems are identified before they become emergencies. Our goal is for management to be able to focus on higher-level decisions instead of personally chasing every operational detail. # This Role Is NOT For You If Please do not apply if: * You need constant supervision * You wait to be told about obvious problems * You regularly forget follow-ups * You struggle managing multiple systems * You dislike working with spreadsheets or numbers * You are uncomfortable learning new technology * You have no interest in understanding real estate * You avoid holding team members accountable * You struggle with detailed administrative work * You are looking for a simple task-based VA role * You are uncomfortable taking ownership of results This position requires someone who can manage both **details and the bigger operational picture.** # How to Apply Send your application to: ---------- Use the subject line: **Application – Real Estate Operations Manager** Please answer the following questions: 1. Describe your previous real estate experience. 2. Have you previously managed operations for a real estate team, brokerage, investor, or wholesaling company? Please explain. 3. Which of the following systems have you personally used? * ReadyMode * Smarter Contact * Follow Up Boss * Dotloop * MLS * Other real estate CRMs or dialers 4. Describe your experience managing leads and CRM pipelines. 5. Have you managed an ISA or sales team? If yes, how many people and what KPIs did you track? 6. Describe your experience with MLS research and comparable sales. 7. Are you comfortable calculating or reviewing ARV and evaluating investment opportunities? 8. Describe your experience with transaction coordination or Dotloop. 9. Have you handled payroll, time tracking, commissions, or contractor payments? 10. Describe one operational problem you identified and solved without being specifically instructed to fix it. 11. What reports or KPIs have you been responsible for maintaining? 12. How do you make sure important tasks and leads do not fall through the cracks? 13. What is your current availability and preferred working schedule? Please also include a **short voice or video introduction**. Tell us briefly: * Who you are * Your real estate background * Your strongest operations skill * The systems you know best * Why you believe you would succeed in this role Applications with **specific examples, measurable results, screenshots, reports, process improvements, or descriptions of systems you personally managed** will receive stronger consideration. We are looking for someone who wants to **take ownership of the position, become an important part of the team, and grow with the company.** **Compensation: $4–$7/hour + potential commissions/performance incentives** **Apply at: ----------
