I am building a real estate acquisition operation and want to develop a **long-term team**. If you perform well, there may be opportunities for: * Increased responsibility * Performance bonuses * Lead-management responsibilities * Training new callers * Team-lead responsibilities * Additional hours/responsibilities * Future advancement within the company --- # WHO I AM LOOKING FOR The ideal person is: * Experienced * Reliable * Extremely coachable * Competitive * Persistent * Organized * Confident * Conversational * Good at listening * Comfortable with rejection * Detail-oriented * Honest * Self-motivated * Results-oriented * Comfortable working independently You should genuinely enjoy talking to people. --- # WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY Please do NOT apply if: * You have never cold called before * You have never called U.S. homeowners * You have no real estate experience * You dislike making a high volume of calls * You are uncomfortable speaking English * You cannot work U.S. hours * You need constant supervision * You frequently miss work * You have unreliable internet * You do not have a quiet workspace * You are uncomfortable with rejection * You are looking for a temporary job * You are going to use someone else's identity on calls * You are unwilling to follow Do-Not-Call procedures --- # APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS ## IMPORTANT: At the very beginning of your application, write: # "I READ THE ENTIRE POST." Applications that do not begin with those exact words will NOT be considered. Then answer ALL questions below. ### 1. How many years of experience do you have cold calling U.S. homeowners? ### 2. Are you comfortable working 40 hours per week on U.S. Eastern Time? ### 22. Do you have: * Reliable computer? * Reliable internet? * USB headset? * Quiet workspace? * Backup internet? * Backup power? description: Position: Part-Time / Freelance with Opportunity for Long-Term Work Content: Instagram Reels, TikTok & Short-Form Social Media Location: Remote Niche: Beauty, Esthetics, Education, Entrepreneurship & Lifestyle About the Role I’m looking for a creative, reliable short-form video editor who can help me turn raw footage into engaging, polished and scroll-stopping social media content. I am a beauty business owner, esthetician, educator and content creator. My content ranges from educational beauty and waxing videos to behind-the-scenes business content, lifestyle videos, voiceovers and personal-brand content. I already have an established style and brand. I’m looking for someone who can learn that style and eventually edit content with minimal direction. This is NOT just about cutting clips together. I want an editor who understands: • Storytelling • Strong hooks • Viewer retention • Short-form pacing • Instagram & TikTok trends • Clean text and captions • Music and sound effects • B-roll placement • Beauty/lifestyle aesthetics • When an edit should be simple vs. fast-paced What You’ll Do You will receive raw video footage, and depending on the project, I may also provide a script, voiceover, inspiration video or general direction. Your job will be to turn that footage into finished short-form content ready to post. Typical videos will include: • Instagram Reels • TikToks • Educational talking-head videos • Beauty/waxing tutorials • Behind-the-scenes content • Day-in-the-life videos • Voiceover Reels • Product/brand collaborations • Lifestyle content • Promotional videos Most videos will be approximately 15–90 seconds. Editing Style My style is feminine, clean, modern and polished while still feeling natural and relatable. I don’t want every video overly edited. Some videos may need trendy, fast-paced editing while others should feel simple, luxurious and effortless. You must be comfortable studying reference videos and recreating the overall editing style WITHOUT copying someone else’s work exactly. Requirements You should have: • Experience editing Reels/TikToks/Shorts • Strong English comprehension • Excellent attention to detail • Understanding of social-media retention • Experience with captions/text animation • Good music selection • Good storytelling instincts • Ability to follow creative direction • Reliable communication • Ability to meet deadlines • Willingness to receive feedback and make revisions Experience editing beauty, wellness, fashion, lifestyle, personal-brand or creator content is a BIG plus. CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve are all acceptable. Potential Workload We will begin with a smaller number of videos while we learn how we work together. If we’re a good fit, I would like this to develop into an ongoing relationship with approximately: 12–30+ short-form videos per month. There is potential for the role and compensation to grow over time. How to Apply Please send: 1. A short introduction about yourself. 2. Your location/time zone. 3. Your portfolio. 4. 3 examples of short-form videos YOU edited. 5. Your preferred editing software. 6. Your rate per short-form video OR preferred monthly rate for approximately 20 videos. 7. Typical turnaround time for one Reel. 8. Tell me about any experience you have editing beauty, lifestyle, educational or personal-brand content. IMPORTANT: At the very end of your application, write the word PINK. Applications that don’t include PINK will not be considered. This helps me know that you actually read the entire job description. Paid Editing Test Selected finalists will be invited to complete a PAID test edit using the same raw footage. You’ll receive reference videos showing the style I’m looking for. I’m not looking for someone who can simply follow instructions—I want to find someone who understands the brand, has creative instincts and can eventually become a long-term part of my content team.

title: E-Commerce Reconciliation & Vendor Support Specialist
description: We are looking for a highly detail-oriented E-Commerce Reconciliation & Vendor Support Specialist to help resolve discrepancies involving our suppliers, Amazon, and Walmart. Phone calls are a required part of this position We will provide reports identifying transactions, shipments, invoices, credits, shortages, or other items requiring investigation. Your responsibility will be to review each item carefully, determine what needs to be resolved, contact the appropriate supplier or Amazon/Walmart support team, and follow up consistently until the issue is closed. This position requires excellent attention to detail and strong English communication skills. You must be comfortable communicating professionally by both email and phone, including calling suppliers and contacting Amazon or Walmart customer service/support. You will also be responsible for keeping accurate notes on every case, recording communications and outcomes, updating the reconciliation report, and making sure unresolved items do not get forgotten. We are looking for someone who: Has exceptional attention to detail Speaks and writes English confidently Is comfortable making outbound phone calls Can communicate professionally with U.S. suppliers Can communicate with Amazon and Walmart support Is persistent with daily follow-ups Is organized and capable of managing many open issues simultaneously Has strong Excel/Google Sheets skills Can identify discrepancies and investigate their cause Documents every action accurately Takes ownership of an issue until it is resolved Please begin your application with the words “RECON READY.” Tell us about your experience with reconciliation, Amazon/Walmart, Excel or Google Sheets, and communicating with suppliers. Also include a short voice recording introducing yourself and describing a situation where you had to repeatedly follow up with someone to resolve an issue. Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Seller Center, vendor reconciliation, accounting, bookkeeping, inventory reconciliation, or e-commerce operations is preferred.

title: Transaction Coordinator - Residential Real Estate
description: Dannecker & Associates Closing Assistant The Closing Assistant role at Dannecker & Associates involves overseeing all administrative and compliance details of real estate transactions, working to ensure a smooth closing process for our team and their clients. This position requires acute attention to detail, organizational and administrative skills, as well as the ability to be resourceful and solution-driven. Our mission is to improve the lives of others by ensuring the very best experience when buying, selling homes and investments. We strive to achieve this experience by incorporating Dannecker & Associates’ Core Values into each interaction: Do the Right Thing, Thirst for Learning, Quality and Focus, Spirit of Winning, Collaborate without Ego, Fun & Laughter, Resourcefulness. Core Responsibilities: Transaction Management: Oversee the entire contract to close process, ensuring all deadlines, contingencies and CAR/Compass requirements are met. Document Handling: Handle the preparation, review, execution and tracking of a large volume of real estate documents (contracts, disclosures, addenda, reports, escrow documents, etc.), ensuring accuracy and brokerage compliance. Brokerage Compliance: Navigate Compass Business Tracker platform to validate the accuracy of all transaction documents, working with the Compass Compliance team to ensure each file adheres to all local, state, and company regulations, overseeing the lifecycle of the Business Tracker file from open to close. File Maintenance: Maintain meticulously organized files, keeping the Google Drive and Business Tracker up-to-date. Perform file audits. Follow all closing procedures upon the conclusion of each escrow to ensure proper database management. Special Projects: Embody a growth mindset to expand your skillset and navigate new projects as team needs expand. Crosstrain with various departments as needed. Continuing Education: Stay informed and educated on all form updates and evolving brokerage requirements. Oversee the Full Transaction Lifecycle: Utilize Glide for the preparation/completion of seller disclosures upon the receipt of an executed Listing Agreement. Manage all administrative and procedural steps from the ---------- nt a contract is executed until the final closing date. Deadline Tracking: Meticulously track and manage all contractual deadlines and contingencies. Problem-Solving: Proactively monitor transaction progress, identify potential issues or delays, and work with relevant parties to resolve them efficiently before they impact closing. Zillow: Actively manage the Zillow system; Prepare Invoices, and close out all Zillow Preferred transactions by each deadline. Communication: Serve as the central point of contact, providing timely communication for agents, clients, lenders, title/escrow companies and teammates. Much of the communication is via email so proper English writing skills are a must. Real Estate Agents (our team): Provide file audits, answer process/compliance questions, and ensure all necessary documentation is completed and conveyed in a timely manner. Clients (Buyers/Sellers): Collaborate with Buyer/Sellers to ensure all broker documentation is received, reviewed, and fully executed in a timely manner. Assist with any non-sales-related communication, redirecting/providing a warm handoff to any party within the transaction, as deemed applicable. Provide deposit and contingency removal updates. Order Home Warranties (buyer-side escrows) and provide Utility reminders. Cooperating Agent/Transaction Coordinator: Create a collaborative environment to ensure the needs of each broker file are met, and communication is properly documented. Request contingency removals for seller-side transactions. Title/Escrow: Deliver necessary documents, coordinate signed commission instructions and escrow amendments, and verify settlement statements. Lenders: Monitor loan progress, provide required documentation, and track loan commitment milestones. Finance: Provide the finance manager with prompt updates on accelerated close of escrow dates, agent credits, purchase price changes, sales manager approvals, Modifications (MT-BR or MT-LA) and updated Zillow invoices as applicable. Follow Up Boss: Update stage, make sure transaction is input as sold, update new address, remove old address, update close date. Update notes on client.

title: SR TALENT ACQUISITION COORDINATOR, CONTRACT
description: senior Search Associate Contract · Remote (Philippines-based) · MissFit Coaching in Chicago USA Engagement: Independent contractor, full-time hours Reports to: David Sho, Head Customer Success Location: Remote, based in the Philippines ABOUT MISSFIT MissFit Coaching is a boutique reverse-recruiting and executive career strategy firm. We work with mid-career and senior white-collar professionals — many in active job transitions — to run their job search the way a search firm runs a client mandate: proactive targeting, hidden-market outreach, and disciplined pipeline management, not just resume tweaks and job board applications. Our founder is an ICF-pcc certified coach with 30 years of corporate HR and executive search experience. THE ROLE We're hiring a senior Search Associate to support reverse-recruiting operations for our clients — director, VP, and C-suite candidates navigating their own search. This is an execution and support role: you'll follow MissFit's documented playbooks to build target lists, maintain trackers, and support candidate positioning, working closely with and under the direction of our Customer Success team. You'll work inside our proprietary Momentum Maximizer tracking system, our Fit Finder scoring standard, and our daily team rhythm (Slack standups, commit cards, go-live QA gates) — with clear process, complete training, and a lead reviewing your work as you grow into the role. WHAT YOU'LL DO — Build target company and contact lists for clients who are seeking new jobs at the director-to-C-suite level, using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo, following provided targeting criteria — Support hiring-signal research (leadership changes, funding events, org shifts) under a lead's direction — Draft outreach messaging and positioning that our senior clients will send under their name — Maintain client search trackers (our proprietary Momentum Maximizer system) with complete, accurate, and current data — Score job opportunities against client fit criteria using our Fit Finder standard — Flag stalled searches, missed follow-ups, and networking gaps to your lead — Communicate search updates clearly, in writing, to the internal team WHAT YOU BRING — 4+ years of experience in HR, talent acquisition, or recruiting — corporate or agency setting, MINIMUM - Quick learner, experienced with AI, Claude, and Perplexity — Highly organized, with strong attention to detail and follow-through on multi-step processes — A strong work ethic — dependable, timely, and able to keep pace with a full caseload — Clear, professional written English — you'll draft messaging that is highly polished and grammatically perfect grammar — Comfort learning sourcing and tracking tools (LinkedIn, Apollo, Momentum Maximizer) — training provided — Comfort with confidential, high-stakes work — you're often handling someone's livelihood and reputation — Based in the Philippines, able to work hours with meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time — Comfort operating inside a defined system (trackers, scoring standards, daily standups) with regular feedback and oversight HOW YOU'RE MEASURED Once onboarded, your performance is tracked on accuracy and consistency — tracker quality, on-time follow-through, and adherence to process — alongside the client satisfaction and renewal outcomes the broader team is judged on. Strong performers have a clear path to the Executive Search Operator role. HOW WE EVALUATE CANDIDATES Our hiring process is deliberately rigorous because the work is high-trust. Expect: — Three short written screening answers (under 200 words each, no AI tools), If you write to us with AI, you will be disqualified. I don't want to read an AI-written letter. I want a letter written by a human. I like humans. — A one-minute unscripted video introduction. We want you to just talk to us. No script. — A short interview — A paid 30 trial engagement before any ongoing contract is confirmed WHY THIS ROLE This is a chance to build real HR and recruiting experience into an executive search discipline — inside a fully remote contract role with a U.S.-based firm, working alongside a 30-year executive search and HR veteran. Strong performers have a defined growth path to Executive Search Operator over time. You will work with other people from the Philippines, Nigeria, Pakistan, and the USA. We are a global, nimble, fast-paced, remote-first team. Fixed salary plus opportunity for commission. Salary depends on your skills. TO APPLY Email your resume and a brief intro video (unscripted, one minute) to ---------- with the subject line: "Search Associate."

THE ROLE Your job is to call property owners and landlords in Australia, introduce our platform, work out whether their property is a good fit, and guide the right owners through getting their property listed with us. Importantly, this is not about signing up as many properties as possible — it's about signing up the RIGHT properties: ones that will actually get booked. You will: - Make outbound calls to a list of property owners we provide - Follow a script (which we'll give you and refine together), but sound natural and human, not robotic - Qualify each property early in the call against three key things: 1. PRICE — the owner has realistic rent expectations (well-priced properties book; overpriced ones sit empty). Ask what rent they're hoping for and gauge whether it's realistic. 2. AVAILABILITY — the property is genuinely available to rent soon, not months away or currently tenanted. 3. VIEWINGS — the owner is willing and able to promptly show the property to interested tenants (an owner who can't do viewings means no bookings). - Politely move on from owners who aren't a fit — don't waste effort onboarding properties that won't book - Explain simply what we do and why it benefits the owner: we market their property and handle all the incoming enquiries — the owner only handles viewings and d ---------- who to accept - Handle basic objections and keep the conversation going - Guide suitable, interested owners through creating an account and listing their property on our platform, and help them complete it - Follow up with warm leads by phone and email until their property is live - Route detailed questions (pricing specifics, terms) to our team - Log every call, lead, and outcome in a simple spreadsheet or CRM WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on the phone (this is the most important requirement) - Previous cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or phone sales experience - Good judgement — able to qualify a lead and tell the difference between a property that will book and one that won't, rather than just signing up everyone - Comfortable making outbound calls and hearing 'no' — resilience matters - Friendly, persuasive, and genuinely good at building quick rapport - Organised and thorough at following up — you chase warm leads until they're across the line, and log everything accurately - Comfortable guiding a non-technical owner through an online signup process patiently - Reliable internet and a quiet space to call from with a good headset - Bonus: experience in real estate, property, or the Australian market WHAT WE OFFER - A clear script and full training on what to say, how to qualify owners, and how to onboard them - Warm-ish lists (real property owners, not random numbers) - Base pay PLUS a bonus for every property that gets signed, listed, and booked — sourcing quality properties directly earns you more - Flexible hours and a long-term role that can grow into more hours and responsibility as we scale HOW TO APPLY When you apply, please include: 1. A short voice recording (30-60 seconds) introducing yourself in English — this helps us hear your phone voice. You can record on your phone and share a link (Google Drive, Vocaroo, etc.) 2. A brief note on your cold calling / phone sales experience 3. Your available hours in ACST (Australian Central Standard Time) Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. description: Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator The Beacon Center | Remote | Full-Time or Part-Time About The Beacon Center The Beacon Center is a community-based nonprofit organization in Montgomery, Alabama, focused on expanding access to services that help individuals and families thrive. As The Beacon Center continues to grow, we are seeking a highly organized and skilled Grant Writer & Grants Coordinator to help identify funding opportunities, develop competitive proposals, manage grant deadlines, and strengthen our overall grants pipeline. Position Overview This is not simply a writing position. We are looking for someone who can help build and manage a strong grant development system for The Beacon Center. The ideal candidate will be able to research funding opportunities, understand complex grant requirements, develop compelling proposals, organize supporting documents, maintain deadlines, communicate what information is needed from leadership and program staff, and assist with post-award reporting. You should be comfortable working with U.S.-based foundations, corporations, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and philanthropic funders. Primary Responsibilities Grant Research Research foundation, corporate, local, state, federal, healthcare, and community funding opportunities. Identify grants that align with The Beacon Center’s programs and strategic priorities. Review eligibility requirements before recommending opportunities. Maintain a pipeline of upcoming grant opportunities. Provide brief summaries of recommended grants, including funding amount, deadline, eligibility, program alignment, required documents, match requirements if applicable, and a recommendation on whether we should pursue the opportunity. Grant Writing Draft letters of inquiry and full grant proposals. Develop compelling organizational narratives. Write needs statements, program descriptions, goals, objectives, outcomes, sustainability plans, evaluation sections, and organizational capacity statements. Adapt existing organizational information for different funders rather than starting from scratch each time. Ensure proposals clearly respond to the funder’s questions and scoring criteria. Assist with grant budgets and budget narratives in coordination with leadership and finance staff. Proofread and edit proposals before submission. Grant Management Maintain a centralized grant calendar. Track application deadlines, reporting deadlines, award notifications, renewals, and follow-up dates. Maintain organized grant folders and supporting documentation. Create checklists for each application. Notify leadership early when documents, signatures, budgets, data, or partner information are needed. Maintain updated versions of commonly requested organizational documents. Grant Reporting Help prepare interim and final grant reports. Track required outcomes and reporting requirements. Work with program staff to collect program data and success stories. Assist in maintaining documentation required by funders. Help ensure grant commitments and reporting deadlines are not missed. Funding Areas The Beacon Center pursues funding related to: Behavioral health and counseling Mental health access HIV prevention and healthcare access Social determinants of health Community health workers Health literacy Food insecurity Homelessness Housing stability Workforce development Adult education and GED programs Violence prevention and intervention Hospital-based violence intervention Reentry and justice-involved populations Youth and family services Faith and community partnerships Community development Capital improvements and facility development Technology and program infrastructure Required Qualifications We are looking for someone with demonstrated experience, not someone learning grant writing for the first time. Applicants should have: At least 2 to 3 years of professional grant writing, nonprofit development, proposal writing, or related experience Excellent written English Strong research skills Experience writing professional proposals, reports, or funding requests Ability to understand detailed Requests for Proposals Strong attention to detail Excellent organization and deadline management Ability to manage several grants simultaneously Strong Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Drive skills Ability to work independently Ability to communicate clearly when information is missing Ability to accept feedback and revise drafts quickly Strongly Preferred Preference will be given to applicants with experience in one or more of the following: U.S. nonprofit organizations U.S. foundation grants Federal or state grants Healthcare grants Behavioral health or mental health grants Community development grants Public health grants Homelessness or housing programs Workforce development Human services organizations Grant reporting and compliance Developing grant budgets ---------- or similar U.S. funding systems Important Expectations Our organization moves quickly and manages several programs and partnerships simultaneously. We need someone who: Does not wait until the day before a deadline to request information. Can identify missing information early. Can turn an RFP into an organized application checklist. Understands the difference between simply writing well and writing specifically to a funder’s requirements. Can manage details without requiring constant supervision. Can research before asking questions. Can distinguish between a strong funding opportunity and one that is not a good fit. Maintains confidentiality regarding organizational and client information. Is comfortable working directly with an Executive Director. All final grant submissions will initially be reviewed and approved by the Executive Director before submission. What Success Looks Like Within the first several months, the successful candidate should help us establish: A comprehensive grant opportunity pipeline A master grant calendar Organized grant files A library of reusable organizational narratives A funding prospect list A reporting calendar Strong systems for gathering grant data and documentation Consistent submission of high-quality, strategically aligned grant applications Schedule This position is remote. Candidates must have some availability that overlaps with U.S. Central Time for communication, meetings, and deadline coordination. The position may begin part-time with the opportunity to expand based on performance, grant workload, and organizational needs. Compensation Compensation will be based on demonstrated experience, writing ability, U.S. nonprofit grant experience, and results. Expected range: $6.50 to $9.00 per hour depending on experience. We are looking for a long-term team member rather than someone interested only in completing individual grant applications. How to Apply Please submit the following: 1. A brief introduction explaining your grant writing experience. 2. How many years you have worked in grant writing, nonprofit development, or proposal writing. 3. Whether you have written grants for U.S.-based nonprofit organizations. 4. The types of grants you have written. 5. The approximate number of grant proposals you have completed. 6. Examples of grants you helped secure, including approximate award amounts when you are permitted to share them. 7. A writing sample or redacted grant proposal. 8. Your experience with grant research. 9. Your experience managing grant calendars and reporting deadlines. 10. Your desired hourly rate. 11. Your current availability. 12. Put the words “Beacon Grant Writer” at the beginning of your application so we know you carefully reviewed the posting. Application Question The Beacon Center provides counseling, healthcare access, food assistance, workforce development, homelessness services, and community programs. If you were hired today, explain how you would identify and prioritize the first 10 potential funders for our organization. We are looking for someone who can become an important part of The Beacon Center’s long-term growth and funding strategy.

What I Will Provide I want to make the position as simple as possible for the person I hire. I will provide: - Assignment instructions - Due dates - Class materials - Course notes - Textbooks or required readings - Rubrics - Examples - Reference materials - Teacher feedback - Any additional information needed to understand an assignment You will not be expected to randomly figure out what I am studying without context. I will give you the information and resources necessary to assist with the work. For security reasons, I will provide assignment materials directly rather than requiring you to use my private school passwords or impersonate me in school systems. What I’m Looking For The ideal person is: - Reliable - Responsive - Organized - Good at following detailed instructions - Comfortable researching unfamiliar topics - A strong reader and writer - Able to learn quickly - Detail-oriented - Good at meeting deadlines - Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear - Consistent enough to work with me on an ongoing basis You do not necessarily need to already know every subject. Being resourceful and capable of understanding instructions and researching information is more important. I especially value someone who takes responsibility for the work they agree to help with. If an assignment has a deadline, I need to know that you will communicate with me and help me get it handled rather than disappearing at the last minute. Workload This is intended to be an ongoing monthly position rather than a one-time project. The workload may change from week to week depending on what assignments I have. Performance will be evaluated using a balanced combination of: Documented call attempts per hour. Total documented activity during the 20-hour workweek. Quality and accuracy of contact research. Meaningful conversations with qualified contacts. Proper handling of objections and follow-up commitments. Accurate and complete records. Qualified consultation meetings scheduled. Reliability in completing the full 20-hour weekly commitment. Compliance with appropriate calling hours for each prospect's local time zone. Qualifications Fluent English with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong understanding of U.S. business culture. Professional and confident telephone presence. Comfortable conducting online research. Able to document conversations accurately. CRM experience is a plus. Automotive dealership or hiring experience is preferred. Able to work independently and reliably complete 20 hours per week. Able to schedule and conduct calls during normal business hours for U.S. operations while accounting for each prospect's local time zone. Able to maintain consistent hourly productivity while prioritizing professionalism, accuracy, and relationship quality. What Success Looks Like Success means consistently identifying the right hiring contact, creating qualified opportunities, documenting conversations accurately, following up as promised, and scheduling consultation meetings while completing the agreed-upon 20 hours each week. The objective is simple: use each working hour productively, find the right person, create the opportunity, document the conversation, follow through, and secure qualified meetings within a reliable 20-hour-per-week schedule while making calls during appropriate business hours for each prospect's local time zone.

description: Department: Finance / Operations / Information Systems Reports To: VP of Finance Position Type: Full-Time Preferred Certification: Acumatica MVP and/or Acumatica Certified Developer Position Summary Alpine Corporation is seeking a highly experienced Senior Acumatica Developer & ERP Project Lead to take a leadership role in our Acumatica implementation and become the long-term technical owner of the platform. We are looking for someone who has personally participated in and successfully completed Acumatica implementations and understands how an ERP should function across finance, accounting, order management, inventory, purchasing, supply chain, warehouse operations, and integrations. The ideal candidate will initially work alongside our external Acumatica implementation partner, serving as Alpine’s internal Acumatica expert and project lead. This person will help translate business requirements into system design, evaluate proposed solutions, identify gaps, challenge unnecessary customizations, coordinate testing and implementation priorities, and ensure that the system being built will support Alpine’s actual business processes. At the same time, this individual must be a strong hands-on Acumatica developer capable of taking ownership of development work where appropriate rather than relying exclusively on the implementation partner. Following implementation, this position will transition into the primary internal owner of Acumatica, responsible for ongoing development, optimization, integrations, automation, support, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Acumatica Implementation Leadership • Serve as Alpine’s internal Acumatica subject matter expert throughout the implementation. • Partner directly with Finance, Operations, Purchasing, Inventory, Warehouse, Sales, Customer Service, and other business teams to understand requirements. • Work directly with Biz-Tech and Alpine leadership to manage implementation priorities, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and timelines. • Participate actively in discovery and rediscovery sessions rather than relying solely on meeting recordings, transcripts, or requirements passed down after the fact. • Review proposed configurations, workflows, customizations, integrations, and development solutions before implementation. • Challenge proposed customizations when standard Acumatica functionality can accomplish the business objective. • Identify requirements or process dependencies that may have been overlooked during discovery. • Help establish clear ownership and accountability for implementation tasks. • Maintain visibility into what has been completed, what remains outstanding, and what is required for go-live. Business Process & ERP Design Evaluate business requirements and help design scalable Acumatica processes across areas including: • General Ledger • Accounts Receivable • Accounts Payable • Cash Management • Financial Reporting • Order Management • Customer Management • Purchasing • Inventory Management • Warehouse Management • Demand Planning / MRP • Vendor Management • Sales Orders • Purchase Orders • Deposits and Prepayments • Returns and Credits • EDI and Marketplace Transactions • Freight and Logistics • Reporting and Business Intelligence The successful candidate should understand not simply how to configure Acumatica, but how transactions move through an organization and ultimately affect inventory, receivables, payables, cash, and the general ledger. Hands-On Acumatica Development • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Acumatica customizations. • Develop Acumatica customization projects using C#, .NET, BQL/FBQL, DACs, graph extensions, event handlers, workflows, and APIs. • Build and maintain integrations between Acumatica and external systems. • Develop automation to eliminate unnecessary manual processes. • Create custom screens, fields, workflows, reports, inquiries, and business logic when required. • Develop and maintain Generic Inquiries, dashboards, notifications, import/export scenarios, and reporting. • Troubleshoot application, customization, integration, and performance issues. • Review development performed by third-party partners and ensure it meets Alpine’s technical standards. • Take development work internally when doing so is faster, more cost-effective, or strategically preferable to outsourcing it. • Maintain documentation and source control for custom development. Integrations & Systems Architecture Help design and maintain integrations between Acumatica and Alpine’s broader technology ecosystem, which may include: • EDI platforms • Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces • Retailer portals • Warehouse and 3PL systems • Freight and logistics platforms • Banking and payment systems • Reporting and analytics platforms • Customer and vendor systems • APIs and other third-party applications Ensure integrations are reliable, documented, scalable, and designed with appropriate monitoring and error handling. Testing, UAT & Go-Live • Establish structured testing and User Acceptance Testing procedures. • Translate business requirements into test scenarios. • Coordinate testing with department owners and end users. • Validate that transactions flow correctly from operational activity through financial reporting. • Identify defects, configuration gaps, and process issues before go-live. • Maintain and prioritize implementation issues and development backlogs. • Support data validation, migration, cutover planning, and go-live readiness. • Provide hands-on support during go-live and stabilization. Post-Implementation Ownership After implementation, become the primary internal technical owner of Acumatica. Responsibilities will include: • Ongoing Acumatica development and administration. • Continuous improvement of workflows and business processes. • New integrations and automation. • System upgrades and release management. • Troubleshooting and root-cause analysis. • User support and training. • Security and role management. • Performance optimization. • Technical documentation. • Development standards and change management. • Evaluation of new Acumatica functionality. • Reduction of unnecessary dependence on outside consultants. The objective is to continuously improve Acumatica as Alpine’s business evolves rather than treating ERP implementation as a one-time project. Required Qualifications • 5+ years of hands-on Acumatica experience, preferably in senior development, technical consulting, solution architecture, or implementation leadership roles. • Must have participated in at least one full Acumatica implementation from discovery/design through go-live and post-implementation support; multiple implementations strongly preferred. • Advanced hands-on Acumatica development experience. • Strong C# ---------- development experience. • Strong knowledge of Acumatica customization architecture and development framework. • Experience with BQL/FBQL, DACs, graph extensions, Generic Inquiries, workflows, APIs, import/export scenarios, reports, and automation. • Experience developing and troubleshooting integrations with third-party systems. • Strong understanding of relational databases and SQL. • Experience with source control and structured software development practices. • Ability to independently troubleshoot complex ERP and business-process issues. • Ability to manage technical projects, priorities, dependencies, and external consultants. Finance & Operations Knowledge This position requires more than technical Acumatica knowledge. Candidates must demonstrate a working understanding of how ERP transactions affect the business, including: • General ledger and financial statements • Accounts receivable and collections • Accounts payable • Cash management • Inventory costing and valuation • Purchasing and vendor management • Sales orders and fulfillment • Inventory availability and allocation • Warehouse operations • Demand and supply planning • Returns, credits, deductions, and adjustments • Month-end close and financial reporting The candidate does not need to be a CPA, but must be comfortable working directly with senior Finance and Operations leadership and understanding the financial consequences of system design decisions. Strongly Preferred Qualifications • Acumatica MVP designation • Acumatica Certified Developer credentials • Prior experience as an Acumatica Solution Architect, Senior Consultant, Lead Developer, or Technical Lead • Experience leading or rescuing complex Acumatica implementations • Experience transitioning an organization from a legacy ERP/OMS environment into Acumatica • Distribution, wholesale, consumer products, e-commerce, or retail experience • High-volume order and inventory environments • EDI experience • Marketplace integrations, including Amazon • 3PL/WMS integrations

description: Job Title: Senior Full Stack Developer / Software Engineer (Web Apps & API Integrations) – Long-Term Freelance £15 per hour, capped at 37 hours per week Job Description: We are an established UK based marketing agency who specialise in the Automotive sector. We are moving quickly to streamline our operations, automate internal workflows, and launch new digital products for our clients. We have a clear pipeline of major projects mapped out for the next 12 to 24 months. We are seeking a talented, independent Remote Senior Full Stack Developer from the Philippines to join us as a long-term freelance partner. This role requires a true generalist. You will have technical ownership of our software pipeline, building highly secure internal management systems as well as polished, intuitive, customer-facing web applications. Our tech stack is already established. Our current development is built on a modern TypeScript stack: Next.js/React applications hosted on Vercel, back-end services hosted on Railway, a PostgreSQL database managed through Neon, and all code version-controlled in GitHub. You will be joining projects mid-development, so you must be comfortable picking up an existing codebase on this stack, and any recommendations for new tools or services should fit alongside it. This is an ongoing, flexible freelance arrangement focused entirely on deliverables and outcomes. Key Projects & Deliverables for Year 1: You will design, build, and launch a mix of external customer portals and internal operations systems: • OEM Test Drive Platform (Consumer and client-facing): Development has already begun on this project using the stack above; we need you to complete the project into a polished, user-friendly external application optimised for customers to be invited to, book, manage, and track vehicle test drives. • Sales Event Reporting App (Client-facing): Build a secure client portal that extracts data from our proprietary internal systems and translates it into clean, real-time visual reports and dashboards for our customers. • HR & Office Operations System (Internal): Create a centralised internal portal to manage employee absences, holiday requests, sickness tracking, a shared office diary, meeting room bookings, and attendance registers. Plus an automated reporting suite. • Bespoke Task Management System (Internal): Build a robust internal workflow tool that allows managers to allocate tasks, filter by client, track deadlines, and seamlessly toggle between list, calendar, and Kanban views. • Third-Party API Integrations (Automotive Stack): Build secure, reliable API bridges connecting our marketing infrastructure into automotive dealership systems, specifically Dealerweb and Tekion initially. • CRM & Automation Pipelines (Internal/External): Integrate data flows between core systems to automatically trigger real-time, transactional email and SMS notifications to customers based on workflow changes. What We Are Looking For: • Core Stack Experience (Essential): Strong, proven experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, React and Next.js, and PostgreSQL databases. You should be able to demonstrate real projects built with these technologies. • Our Platforms (Desirable): Direct experience with Vercel, Railway, Neon, and GitHub is a strong plus. Experience with close equivalents (e.g. other cloud hosting platforms or managed Postgres providers) is acceptable, as these tools are straightforward to pick up for an experienced developer. • Full-Stack Versatility: Proven experience building both complex, data-heavy internal company tools and simple to use, responsive, customer-facing web applications. • API & Integration Expertise: Strong experience connecting different software platforms via APIs and webhooks (especially experience with restricted or complex third-party systems). • Security-First Approach: Sound understanding of web application security fundamentals — secure authentication, safe handling of secrets and credentials, and protecting customer data in line with UK GDPR requirements. • User-First Mindset: An understanding of good user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) principles so that our customer-facing platforms look professional and are easy to use. • Independence & English Fluency: Ability to take a business concept described in plain English, translate it into a working technical solution without micro-management, and communicate clearly throughout the process. • Your Own Setup: You must use your own development equipment and have a reliable, high-speed internet connection. Contract Structure & Compensation: • Type: Indefinite, ongoing freelance contract • Flexibility: Includes a standard, simple 14-day or 30-day "at-will" termination clause for both parties. • Target Budget: Fully open to a competitive monthly retainer or hourly structure equivalent to £15+/hour depending on depth of experience. • Tax/Compliance: As an independent freelancer, you will manage your own local Philippine tax and government benefit filings. • Account Access: All platform accounts (GitHub, Vercel, Railway, Neon) are owned and administered by the company; you will be granted team member access for the duration of the engagement.

title: Klaviyo Campaign Manager
description: We're looking for one email copywriter to take full ownership of our Klaviyo account: daily campaigns, the entire flow architecture, segmentation, testing, reporting. Not "help with email." Own it. Who we are We're a DTC health and beauty brand selling to women and men aged 45–75. Cold traffic from Meta into direct response funnels — advertorials, VSLs, long-form sales pages. Running since 2023, multiple products live across several markets. We're a direct response shop. Everything is measured. Nothing is decorative. Our copy has a job and the job is revenue. The list is there. The traffic is there. The products convert. Email is the most underworked asset we own — which is exactly why we want one person on it full-time instead of squeezing it in between everything else. What you'll actually do Daily campaigns. You write and send to the list every day. Not "a few times a week when there's a promo." Daily. Story emails, offer emails, curiosity emails, urgency emails, re-engagement emails, plain-text emails that read like a message from a friend. You own the calendar. Flows. You own and continuously improve the full Klaviyo flow architecture — welcome series, abandoned cart, abandoned checkout, browse abandonment, post-purchase, subscription retention, winback. Not "set it and forget it." Tested, iterated, rewritten. Segmentation and list health. Engagement tiers, sunsetting, deliverability. You keep the list clean and the sends landing. Testing. Subject lines, offers, angles, send times. You bring the hypotheses, you run the tests, you report what won. Reporting. A short weekly number: revenue generated, open and click rates, what you tested, what you're shipping next week. The copy standard I'm a direct response copywriter myself. I will read your emails closely and I will tell you exactly what's wrong with them. What I want: Subject lines built on curiosity, specificity, or self-interest — not clever wordplay Emails written to one person, not to a list Story and mechanism-driven copy, not "Shop our bestsellers 🔥" One idea per email, one clear CTA Copy that respects that our customer is 45–75, not a 24-year-old on TikTok Voice-of-customer language pulled from reviews and support tickets, not invented in your head What I don't want: Template emails with a product grid and a discount code ChatGPT output pasted in with a hero image on top "Hi [First Name], hope you're having a great week!" Emails that could be sent by any brand in any category If you know Schwartz's awareness levels and can tell me which stage a given email is written for, we'll get along fine. Requirements Proven Klaviyo experience. You've owned an account end to end — campaigns, flows, segments, deliverability — not just written copy someone else scheduled. Native or near-native English writing. Your emails go out unedited. If I have to rewrite them, the arrangement doesn't work for either of us. Direct response background. Health, beauty, supplements, or info products preferred. If your experience is fashion drops and B2B newsletters, this will be a hard adjustment. You can write fast. Daily sending means daily writing. If a single email takes you four hours, the math doesn't work for you. Reliable internet and daily availability. Emails don't skip days. What it pays This is a revenue share, not a retainer: 5% of every euro Klaviyo attributes to the emails you write and send. Uncapped, for as long as you're the one running the account. At €50,000 in a month that's €2,500. At €150,000 it's €7,500. Nobody caps you, nobody renegotiates you down, and nobody takes the account away from you because you got too expensive. It suits someone who backs their own copy and would rather own the upside than trade it for a fixed fee. How to apply Send your application with all two of these. Applications missing any of them get archived without a reply. 1. Klaviyo attribution screenshots. Screenshots from inside Klaviyo showing revenue you generated — campaign performance, flow performance, or the account overview. Blur the client name if you need to; I don't need to know who they are, I need to see the numbers are real. Include the date range. 2. Three emails you wrote. Actual sent emails, not spec work. One campaign, one flow email, and one of your choice. Tell me in one line what each one was supposed to do and whether it did it. The process I review applications and reply to the ones that clear the bar. Short call to talk through the account, the products, and the numbers. You write two campaign emails on a real product. Paid at the revenue share rate if we send them. If they perform, you take the account. No unpaid test that runs for three weeks. Two emails, we send them, you get paid on what they earn.

title: Multimedia AI Specialist
description: We’re looking for a Multimedia AI Specialist to support Jumper Media’s social media and marketing content for our client accounts. You’ll help bring ideas to life through strong editing, pacing, and storytelling—creating polished videos that are on-brand, on-strategy, and ready for fast-paced publishing. If you’re passionate about content, editing, and using AI-assisted workflows to make high-performing videos—and you want to make a visible impact inside a fast-growing digital agency—we’d love to meet you. What You’ll Do - Edit a high volume of short-form social videos each week, keeping pace with a busy multi-platform posting schedule - Create content for multiple formats and channels, including: - TikTok / IG Reels - Video cutdowns and repurposed clips for Instagram - YouTube videos (when needed) + thumbnails - Simple motion/animated elements (text, overlays, transitions) when required - Turn raw footage into engaging edits with strong hooks, pacing, and retention-focused structure - Add and style captions/subtitles, on-screen text, and basic graphics as needed - Use AI tools to speed up and improve production quality (e.g., captioning, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, ideation, workflow automation) while keeping edits natural and on-brand - Follow brand guidelines and maintain consistent visual/audio quality (fonts, colors, templates, music/SFX levels) - Deliver work quickly and consistently—balancing daily turnaround edits with occasional longer-form projects - Quality-check everything before delivery: clean cuts, no typos in captions, correct framing, synced audio, crisp exports - Manage overlapping deadlines while collaborating with the team via Slack/Trello/Drive Who You Are - 2+ years of video editing experience (social media/marketing/content editing preferred) - A portfolio that proves you can deliver volume + speed + polish and demonstrates AI expertise - Proficient with at least one editing tool (any is fine): Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro - Comfortable using AI-assisted editing tools/workflows (or a strong willingness to learn and adopt them fast) - Strong sense of timing, storytelling, trends, and what performs on short-form platforms - Detail-obsessed—you don’t let mistakes slip through - Able to work under tight deadlines while meeting high-quality standards - Available during PST business hours (night shift in the Philippines) - Reliable, self-motivated, and takes direction well Bonus Points - Basic motion graphics skills (After Effects or similar) - Experience working with U.S.-based remote teams - Familiarity with Slack, Trello, and Google Drive - Experience using AI tools for editing (captions, transcript-based editing, audio cleanup, cutdowns, etc.) Compensation & Schedule - Starts at $5/hr (with opportunities for rate increases over time based on performance) - ~30 hours/week - Must be available during PST hours - Independent contractor role (long-term) How to Apply Email ---------- with: - A link to your portfolio (required) — must include AI-related examples, such as at least one video that used AI tools/workflows, plus a quick note on what AI tool(s) were used and what you used them for (e.g., captions, transcript-based editing, cleanup, cutdowns, background removal, generative elements, etc.) - A short intro and summary of your experience Note: Applications without a portfolio that shows AI expertise (AI-assisted video example required) will not be considered.

title: Influencer Outreach & Affiliate Partnerships Specialist
description: About the Role Welcome! We’re a UK women's fashion brand and are looking for an experienced influencer outreach specialist to build and manage a strong pipeline of UK creators, influencers and affiliates in order to generate UGC content. This is primarily an outreach, follow-up and relationship management role. We want someone who has done this before and is comfortable spending a significant part of every working day finding the right creators, contacting them, following up and moving partnerships through to gifting, content and results. Previous hands-on creator/influencer outreach experience is essential. Your Main Responsibility - Build a strong network of UK creators and affiliates who can help us generate great content, genuine engagement and measurable sales. What You’ll Own - Research and identify relevant UK-based creators, influencers and affiliates across Instagram, TikTok and other appropriate channels. - Assess creator fit based on UK audience, customer fit, engagement quality, content style, authenticity and commercial potential. - Find the best contact route and carry out personalised outreach by DM, email or appropriate outreach tools. - Follow up consistently with creators who do not initially respond and keep every active conversation moving. - Manage gifting from agreement through product selection, sizing, dispatch information, delivery follow-up and content due. - Follow up after products are received and make sure agreed content is actually delivered and posted. - Recruit and manage affiliates, including links, codes and basic results tracking where relevant. - Obtain and record usage permissions and support Meta Partnership Ads / whitelisting and TikTok Spark Ads where appropriate. - Build longer-term relationships with strong creators and identify people worth repeating, scaling or moving into paid partnerships. - Maintain an accurate creator pipeline covering every contact, response, follow-up date, product sent, content due, rights status and result. - Maintain communication with active creators and affiliates after onboarding, ensuring strong partners remain engaged and identifying opportunities for additional content, promotions and campaigns - Provide a concise weekly update showing pipeline movement, wins, blockers and next actions. Daily Outreach Expectations This is a proactive role. We do not want someone waiting for creators to come to us or waiting to be told who to chase. You should be comfortable maintaining a consistent pipeline of new creator research, personalised outreach, follow-ups, gifting in progress, content due, affiliate/whitelisting opportunities and longer-term creator relationships. Quality matters. We are not interested in just random high-volume messaging. Creators should be assessed for brand fit, UK audience, engagement quality, customer fit, content quality and commercial potential. What Success Looks Like We will look at the quality of creators sourced, outreach response rates, partnerships secured, gifting converted into content, affiliate/whitelisting activity and the commercial results generated. The goal is not simply to send out free products. The goal is to turn creator relationships into useful content, stronger reach, long-term partnerships and sales. Essential Experience - Proven hands-on experience with influencer, creator or affiliate outreach for a brand or ecommerce business. - Experience personally researching, sourcing, contacting and following up with creators on Instagram and/or TikTok. - Experience managing gifting, creator deliverables and multiple creator relationships at different stages. - Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating directly as the brand. - Strong organisation and follow-through, with proven use of trackers, deadlines and follow-up systems. - Ability to work independently, take initiative and keep stakeholders updated without constant chasing. Strongly Preferred - Previous creator/influencer experience for fashion, apparel, activewear, beauty or another consumer ecommerce brand. - Previous outreach to UK creators or experience representing UK, US or Australian brands. - Affiliate programme experience. - Meta Partnership Ads / whitelisting, creator licensing / usage-rights or TikTok Spark Ads experience. - Experience with micro-influencers and creator gifting programmes. How to Apply - Send your CV. - Share examples of creator/influencer campaigns, partnerships or outreach you have managed. Anonymised evidence is - welcome where confidentiality applies. - Tell us your current availability, desired hourly rate and any other regular work commitments. - Please also answer the following questions (**WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND A LOOM VIDEO TO STAND OUT IN THE APPLICATION PROCESS**): 1) Your influencer/creator outreach experience, the brands and creator types you have worked with, tools used and what parts of the process you personally owned. 2) Tell us about an outreach programme you personally managed. Approximately how many creators were involved, what did you own and how did you make sure nothing was missed? Please include the word “alpaca” somewhere in your application so we know you have read the full job description. Hiring Process Stage 1: CV, Loom and relevant-experience review. Stage 2: Shortlisted candidates complete a short practical creator-outreach exercise. Stage 3: Video interview. Final stage: Initial paid trial before continuing if we’re all happy

description: Begin your application with the word STELLA so I know you read this post to the end. I run an independent non-fiction publishing house with a growing catalogue on Amazon (paperback + ebook, multiple series and pen names). I'm hiring an experienced Publishing Manager to run the operational side of the business with me: hands-on book production, pipeline management, and direct support to me as the owner. What you will do - Format paperback interiors and ebooks to Amazon KDP spec (trim, bleed, margins, spine; EPUB), from manuscript to print-ready file; with your own hands, in a professional tool - Build and adapt full print cover files (front, spine, back) to KDP templates - Run the production pipeline across multiple simultaneous titles: statuses, deadlines, checklists, KDP uploads - Be my right hand: clear written communication, proactive updates, own tasks end-to-end without waiting to be asked Requirements: read carefully, these are strict. Applications missing any of the following will not be considered: 1. Real formatting/design tool experience. You work in at least one of: Adobe InDesign, Affinity, Vellum, or Atticus. If your only tools are Word and Canva, this role is not for you. Affinity experience is a strong plus; mention it. 2. Two work samples, made by you. One book interior (PDF) and one cover. For each, name the tool you used and state in one line exactly what you did yourself vs. what others did. Samples you only project-managed do not count. 3. Excellent written English (C2 level). Your application letter is the first test. 4. Full-time and exclusive. No other jobs or clients. Name your number - there is no posted rate; I will judge asks against experience. 8. A completed OnlineJobs.ph profile with ID verification and test results (IQ, English, DISC where available). One question; answer it in your own words (do not skip it; applications that ignore it are rejected unread): Tell me about a book - real or hypothetical - that you would have refused to publish, and why. What would you have looked at to make that call? What I offer: a stable long-term full-time role at a professional, systemised publishing operation; paid, structured onboarding; and real growth as the catalogue scales. The hiring process is: application → video interview → a paid test assignment (interior + cover file, done in your own tools) → offer.

This is not a passive data-entry role, you will be the heartbeat of our scheduling and sales follow-up process. Your primary focus will be outbound phone calls following up on outstanding lawn care/landscaping quotes, talking to property owners, booking jobs, and helping manage our crew schedules. We’re also looking to grow this role into helping prepare small mowing and snow removal quotes — we’ll provide full training, so we’re really looking for serious applicants who are ready and willing to be trained on estimating. Prior quoting/estimating experience is a big plus, but not required. Key Responsibilities: Quote Callbacks (Warm Sales): Call back a backlog of property owners who requested landscaping/mowing quotes. Answer their questions, handle objections warmly, and secure the booking. Scheduling & Crew Routing: Manage and coordinate schedules for our field crews, optimize their daily routes, and book incoming jobs efficiently. Lead & Request Management: Monitor and process new property service requests coming through our system (Jobber). Proactive Outreach: Perform outbound cold calling and follow-ups during slower periods to keep the crews busy. Quotes & Estimates (Training Provided): Help prepare small mowing and snow removal quotes for customers using our pricing tools and templates. We will fully train you on this — we’re just looking for serious applicants who are ready and willing to learn estimating. Required Qualifications & Skills: Excellent Spoken English: Exceptional spoken English with a warm, clear, and professional phone voice. You must be deeply comfortable being on the phone most of the day, specifically talking to older/senior homeowners who appreciate a polite, friendly cadence. Sharp Math & Spatial Awareness: You must be fast and accurate with fundamental mental math. You will constantly be looking at property dimensions, square footage, and pricing structures. (Real estate VA experience or construction/home services background is a huge plus!) Estimating/Quoting Experience: Prior experience preparing quotes for mowing, snow removal, landscaping, or similar home services is a big plus — though we’re happy to train the right person who is serious and eager to learn. Sales Background: At least 1–2 years of experience in outbound sales, real estate, appointment setting, or premium BPO customer service accounts. Tech-Savvy & Organized: Experience with CRM tools, Google Workspace, and scheduling software (experience with Jobber is a plus, but not required). Reliable Setup: A quiet home office workspace, a reliable high-speed internet connection, a backup power/internet solution, and a premium noise-canceling headset. A supportive, friendly team environment where your initiatives are valued. How to Apply: To apply, please reply with the following: A link to your updated resume/CV. A brief paragraph explaining your experience with phone sales, real estate, or scheduling home services, or estimating/quoting for mowing and snow removal jobs. title: AI 3D Animation Creator — Gaming Shorts
description: Plix.gg is a browser gaming platform with 72,000+ games and 300K+ monthly visitors. We want to apply this to original gaming topics, not copy existing videos. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ WHAT YOU'LL CREATE Videos will usually be 15–50 seconds, vertical 9:16. Topics can cover gaming broadly, including: • What actually happens when you have high ping • How a game server knows if your bullet hit • What happens inside a mouse when you click • How hitboxes work • What happens when your FPS drops • How controllers send inputs to a game • How a game runs directly inside your browser • Why browser games don't need to be installed • Plix.gg-specific concepts when there is a genuinely interesting idea Not every video needs to be about Plix.gg or browser games. Te videos do not have to be technical. They can also be more entertaining or relatable: • What happens to your body after playing games for 12 hours straight • What happens to your eyes when you stare at a screen all night • Why your hands get sweaty during an intense game • What happens inside your brain when you finally beat a difficult boss • What happens when you rage at a game • Why losing at the last second feels so frustrating • What happens when your mom walks in after you've been gaming all night • When your mom tells you to delete Roblox • What happens when Roblox is blocked but you still want to play something • When your parents think you're studying but you're playing browser games • What happens when the Wi-Fi dies in the middle of a ranked match • What happens when you play “one more game” at 2 AM • Why gamers lean their entire body when turning in a racing game • Why everyone presses buttons harder when they're losing • What happens when you keep clicking even though the game is frozen • What happens when 20 browser tabs are open while you're gaming • Why an old laptop starts sounding like a jet engine when you launch a game • How a browser game can start in seconds without a huge download • What happens when you open Plix.gg on a school or low-end laptop • Plix.gg-specific concepts whenever there is a genuinely entertaining idea We would rather make an interesting gaming video with broad appeal than force Plix into a topic where it doesn't belong. The goal is to make interesting gaming animations people would watch even if they had never heard of Plix.gg, with Plix integrated naturally when relevant. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ WHAT YOU DO • Turn scripts into visual scenes • Generate consistent 3D-style images/assets • Animate them using Seedance, Kling, Veo, Higgsfield or similar tools • Create good camera movement and transitions • Regenerate bad or inconsistent AI shots • Add ElevenLabs (or similiar) voiceover when required • Edit the complete video • Add captions, sound effects and music • Deliver the finished video ready to post You should still be able to develop the visual execution independently. Blender is NOT required. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ TOOLS Experience with several of these is preferred: • Seedance • Kling • Veo / Flow • Higgsfield • Sora • GPT Image / Midjourney • ElevenLabs • CapCut / Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve We care more about your output than which exact tools you use. We can provide to higgsfield team access. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You should understand: • AI image-to-video workflows • Character and object consistency • 3D-style compositions • Camera movement • Cutaway / cross-section scenes • Short-form pacing • Visual storytelling • Sound design • How to recognize and fix bad AI generations The finished video should feel like one coherent animation, not random AI clips stitched together. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ OUTPUT 2 finished videos per week Usually 15–50 seconds each. We handle uploading and social accounts. No fixed schedule or timezone requirements. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ PAY ₱65,000 / month Paid monthly via Wise. Pre-approved AI generation costs can be covered separately. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ HOW TO APPLY Send: 1. Portfolio Send 2–5 AI-generated videos you created. Tell us which parts you were responsible for and which tools you used. 2. Your workflow Tell us what you use for: Images: Animation: Voice: Editing: 3. Short visual test Explain how you would animate this: “When you click your mouse in an online game, the signal travels from your computer to the game server before the server d ---------- what happened.” Describe approximately 3–5 shots. We want to see how you think visually. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ ◆ PAID TRIAL Shortlisted applicants receive a ₱5,000 paid trial. We provide a short gaming script and reference style. You create one 20–30 second vertical 3D AI animation. The trial is paid whether or not we hire you. We evaluate: • Animation quality • Scene consistency • Camera movement • Visual storytelling • Editing • Sound design • Attention to detail

description: IMPORTANT: AN INTRO VIDEO IS REQUIRED. APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO WILL NOT BE REVIEWED. We’re looking for an AI Image Generation & Photoshop Specialist to join our creative team and help us create AI-generated brand imagery that is indistinguishable from real photography. We’ve built an advanced AI image-generation system using node-based workflows in Magnific. It allows us to create highly realistic imagery while maintaining consistency across models, products, environments, and overall brand aesthetic. The system works, but achieving the level of accuracy we expect still requires significant iteration, attention to detail, and Photoshop expertise. Every month, we create dedicated AI content batches for both of our brands (Bella Belts and Buckley Belts). These images become part of our central content library and are used across the business, from social media and email to paid advertising and campaigns. Because these assets are used at scale and across many different channels, product and visual accuracy are extremely important. What You’ll Do You’ll work alongside our current AI Image Generator, who will introduce you to the systems and workflows we’ve developed. Our process includes: Creating and working from detailed character and product reference sheets Developing shot ideas and references Generating consistent models, environments, styling, and compositions Running additional AI passes to accurately integrate our products into generated imagery Using Photoshop and compositing to fix anything AI cannot reproduce accurately Applying final post-processing to make images feel genuinely photographic Product accuracy is extremely important to us. We have extensive reference imagery for our products, and small inaccuracies in things like buckles, materials, proportions, or how a belt sits on the body can make an otherwise great image unusable. Photoshop & Compositing AI often gets us 90% of the way there. Your job is also to help solve the final 10%. You should be comfortable with Photoshop, retouching, and compositing, correcting product details, rebuilding problematic areas, removing AI artifacts, and making everything sit naturally within the image. We also use photographic post-processing such as grain, bloom, chromatic aberration, and other subtle imperfections using Dehancer to further solidify the realism of the final composite. Improving the System We don’t just want someone who can operate our current workflow. AI is moving incredibly quickly, so part of your role will be staying on top of new models, tools, techniques, and node-based workflows that could improve our results or make the process more efficient. If there’s a better way to achieve product consistency, compositing, character consistency, or photorealism, we want you to find it, test it, and help us implement it. Longer term, we also want to expand these systems into AI video generation as the technology becomes capable of maintaining the product accuracy we require. What We’re Looking For Strong experience with AI image generation Experience with node-based AI workflows Strong Photoshop, retouching, and compositing skills Excellent eye for photorealism, lighting, texture, perspective, and detail Extremely detail-oriented, particularly around product accuracy Comfortable with trial and error and troubleshooting difficult generations Naturally interested in testing new AI models, tools, and techniques Experience with e-commerce, fashion, product photography, or commercial imagery is a plus Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who combines AI expertise with strong Photoshop and compositing skills and can consistently produce a high volume of usable, on-brand assets for our wider creative team. Our standard is simple: the final image shouldn’t look AI-generated.
