title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist — E-commerce
description: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist — E-commerce Remote · Full-time · Long-term A little about us We’re looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Media Buyer / Creative Strategist to join our e-commerce business. We’ve been running our business successfully for more than 2 years, mainly in the health, wellness and beauty space. We use direct-response funnels and sell our products by understanding the customer behind them, their problems, desires, fears and emotions, and translating that into ads and funnels that convert. We’re a small, ambitious team and like to keep things personal. We have high standards, but we also want people to be themselves, bring their own ideas and genuinely grow together with the business. And right now, there’s one important person missing from our team: a strong Media Buyer / Creative Strategist. The role This role combines media buying and creative strategy. We already have our own strategies, systems and SOPs in place. We’re looking for someone who can first learn and take ownership of the way we currently work, execute it at a high level, and then use their own experience to bring that extra 10%. Someone who doesn’t just execute, but over time also thinks with us, spots opportunities and helps us improve our strategies and systems. Media Buying You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day media buying of our business. You will: - Manage and monitor our Meta campaigns. - Make decisions around scaling, descaling and relaunching. - Recognize performance drops and ad fatigue. - Identify when campaigns need fresh creatives or new briefs. - Read performance across different timeframes instead of overreacting to one good or bad day. - Follow and take ownership of our existing systems and SOPs. - Use your own experience to help us improve the way we work over time. For us, good media buying isn't just looking at ROAS and making a decision. We want someone who enjoys looking at data and understanding why something is happening and what a campaign actually needs. Creative Strategy Once we have a winning product, your job is to help us keep that winner alive and continue scaling it. You’ll: - Dive deeper into the customer, their fears, desires, objections and buying motivations. - Analyze winning ads and understand why they worked. - Research competitors using Meta Ads Library, Anstrex and other tools. - Develop new angles, hooks and creative concepts. - Create clear briefs and work closely with our creative team. - Use performance data like CTR, CPA and ROAS to determine what we should create next. We don't care about making ads just because they look nice. We care about creatives that sell an emotion and generate results. Who we're looking for Ideally, you already have solid experience in direct-response e-commerce and Meta advertising. Health, wellness or beauty experience is a big plus, but not a requirement. Strong e-commerce experience combined with the right mindset and willingness to learn is just as important to us. But experience alone isn't enough. The person behind the experience matters just as much to us. We’re looking for someone who: - Has proven Meta media buying experience. - Understands direct response, consumer psychology and copywriting. - Is comfortable reading and interpreting data. - Can explain why an ad or campaign worked. - Is very detail-oriented and genuinely cares about delivering high-quality work. - Takes ownership and doesn't need to be told everything. - Can follow our systems, but also has the experience and confidence to help improve them. - Is proactive and brings their own ideas to the table. - Is curious, open to feedback and always looking to improve. - Has a positive mindset and sees losing tests as opportunities to learn and grow. - Communicates clearly and is fluent in English. - Is looking for something long-term and genuinely wants to grow with the team. Ultimately, we’re not looking for someone who simply completes the tasks we give them. We want someone who does, thinks and builds with us. Working hours This is a full-time role, and availability at specific moments throughout the day is important. A typical day looks roughly like: Around 10:00 AM UK time — Morning media buying, followed by creative strategy, research and briefs. Around 2:00 PM UK time — Second campaign check. Around 11:00 PM UK time — Final media buying. This does not mean sitting behind your laptop from 10 AM until 11 PM. There is flexibility between these moments, but we need someone who is comfortable structuring their day around the campaign checks. Some of the tools we use Meta Business Manager · Meta Ads Library · Anstrex · Google Sheets · ---------- · AI tools What you can expect from us - A small, ambitious team with open communication. - Weekly calls and close collaboration. - Clear KPIs, expectations and honest feedback. - Freedom to bring your own ideas and opinions. - A culture where we see mistakes and losing tests as opportunities to learn and improve. - A culture focused on both personal and business growth. - A long-term opportunity to grow your responsibilities and impact together with the business. We have high standards, but we’re also human. We want to build a team where people can work hard, be themselves, communicate openly and actually enjoy what they're building. Compensation We believe good work should always be rewarded fairly. For this role, we offer $7–$12 USD per hour, depending on your experience, previous results and the value you can bring to the business. The exact rate will always be discussed together with you. Our goal is to agree on a fair compensation that reflects your experience and feels right for both sides. For the right person, this is a long-term opportunity to become an important part of our team, take on more responsibility and grow together with the business. Interested? Then we'd genuinely like to hear from you! Please send your application. And please, don't just send us your CV. Tell us a little about yourself, your experience, what you enjoy about media buying and creative strategy, and why you think you could be a great fit for our team. If you have previous results, campaigns or creatives you can share, even better. We'd love to see the numbers and hear why you think they worked. Just be yourself and tell us who you are, what you've done, and what you're looking for. Looking forward to hearing from you!

Campaigns & Cross-Team Alignment Social should never operate in isolation. Your content calendar should take into account product launches, Black Friday, Christmas, Valentine’s Day, seasonal moments, promotions, and other important events throughout the year. You’ll coordinate with our Brand, Creative, and Retention teams so that what we’re communicating on social aligns with what customers are seeing elsewhere. For example, if Retention is preparing a Black Friday email campaign, social should complement the campaign rather than feel completely disconnected from it. Messaging, timing, creative direction, and content should make sense together. Likewise, if you believe a campaign or social idea needs content that doesn’t currently exist, we want you to proactively communicate with the Creative/Brand team and request what you need rather than simply working around it. Trends & Opportunities We want someone who naturally keeps an eye on what is happening across Instagram, TikTok, and the wider social landscape. That could be a new content format, an interesting way another brand uses Stories, a trend we can adapt, a clever community interaction, or simply noticing that part of our profile could be positioned better. The goal isn’t to blindly follow trends. It’s to recognize what makes sense for Bella or Buckley and translate those opportunities into ideas that still feel like our brands. What We’re Looking For Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, and social culture Strong visual taste and understanding of what makes content feel on-brand Light photo, graphic, and video editing skills Ability to turn existing raw assets into engaging social content Strong organization and the ability to plan several weeks ahead Understanding of brand voice and community management Ability to think strategically rather than waiting to be told what to post Strong communication and ability to coordinate across different teams Proactive approach to trends, opportunities, and new ideas Experience with DTC/e-commerce, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brands is a strong plus Ultimately, we’re looking for someone who can own social rather than simply manage it, someone who makes sure the right content is going out at the right moments, and ensures that whenever someone visits one of our accounts, the brand feels alive.

What makes this different from a standard DTC seat: a large share of the sales you drive will land on Amazon, where Meta can't see them and will report you as unprofitable while you're actually making money. You're expected to know that trap, build the attribution around it, and argue for budget on total revenue over total spend. RESPONSIBILITIES - Build Meta and Instagram advertising for several brands from near zero. A few have a page or an old ad account, none have real traction — you're starting the channel, not inheriting it. - D ---------- which brand gets the next dollar. Move budget between the brands every week and say why. - Build the testing system: test angles, audiences, offers and landing pages. Write the hypothesis and the kill number before the campaign goes live. - Take what wins on one brand and test it on the others the same week. - Brief the creative team on paid social assets — hook, format, angle — inside the brand framework the Creative Strategist sets, and approve the asset before money goes behind it. - Set up tracking that catches sales landing on Amazon, where Meta can't see them and will report you as unprofitable. - Report weekly on blended MER — total revenue divided by total ad spend — and what you changed because of it. RESULTS - One brand reaches its target blended MER inside 90 days, with the winning angle, audience and creative format documented well enough for someone else to run it again. - Testing is continuous and documented — at least 4 new angles per live brand per month, each with a hypothesis and a kill number written before launch, and the result recorded whether it wins or dies. - Blended MER is tracked from day one — and improves month over month. - Spend is always accounted for. Zero budget overruns, and no campaign left running past its stated kill number unreviewed. - The creative queue never runs dry — the creative team always knows what's next and why. - Reporting is automated, weekly, and decision-ready. - Paid social becomes a measurable, growing revenue driver for the portfolio — on Shopify and in the Amazon halo it creates. REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years buying Meta and Instagram ads for physical consumer products, including at least one brand you took from zero to consistently profitable spend above $10,000 per month. - Can explain why platform-reported ROAS and blended MER disagree, and which one you act on. - Able to write a creative brief a creative team can execute without a call — hook, format, angle, and the objection the ad has to beat. - Advanced Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager — campaign structure, bidding, audiences, and attribution setup. - Self-directed and async. BONUS POINTS - Have driven off-Amazon traffic to an Amazon listing and measured the halo — Amazon Attribution, Levanta, or Brand Referral Bonus. - Experience working closely with creative strategists, designers, video editors, and copywriters. - Knowledge of landing-page optimization and conversion-rate optimization. - TikTok ads experience. LOCATION & HOURS - Remote. - Async by default. 40-hour week across five 8-hour days. At least 6 hours of each day overlap Dubai time (GST, UTC+4). - We track hours. That log is how your pay is calculated. - Your rate, your scope and your promotion are d ---------- on outcomes — what you shipped, what it moved in MER and acquisition cost, and what that movement was worth in revenue to the brand. WHAT WE OFFER - Competitive pay, performance bonuses, and career growth opportunities - Fully remote, permanently. No return-to-office plans, because there is no office to return to. - Ownership of your projects with zero micromanagement. title: Amazon Creative Strategist
description: APPLY -> ---------- ABOUT FLAPEN Flapen is an Amazon growth company. We launch and scale brands end to end — product research, positioning, creative, listings, and ads — for sellers who want to compete with operators far larger than they are. Every launch starts with our own research platform: proprietary market data that d ---------- which niches are worth entering before a dollar goes into inventory. Most Amazon brands lose on the shelf before anyone reads a word of their listing. Our work is to make sure that doesn't happen: sharper positioning, main images that earn the click, listings that convert the traffic they get. 300+ Amazon product launches run end to end Founded by an operator with 8+ years building and scaling Amazon brands ROLE We're hiring a Creative Strategist to own creative for a portfolio of client brands on Amazon. It starts before the listing: you define the brand from its target audience up — who it's for, what it stands against, how it looks and how it sounds — and every asset after that inherits it. You don't design and you don't edit. You d ---------- what the creative says, to whom and why, and the angle, the test roadmap and the call on what we kill are yours. What makes this different from a standard Amazon creative seat: you're building identity and conversion in the same job. Packaging and positioning are yours, and so is the main image that has to win a click against nine competitors in a grid. Then you have to prove it — CTR, CVR and ROAS, measured against the asset you replaced rather than argued from taste. This is for someone who has already carried a portfolio, not someone who wants to learn portfolio work on ours. RESPONSIBILITIES - Own creative strategy for a portfolio of client brands on Amazon — main image, secondary set, A+ content, packaging and video. - Define each brand from its target audience up: who actually buys, what they're d ---------- between, and the objection that kills the sale. A working document, not a persona deck. - Set the identity that follows from it — logo direction, packaging, palette, tone of voice, and the claims we lead with. - Write the briefs the creative team builds from — angle, hook, proof, objection, reference — specific enough that nobody has to ask a follow-up question. - Run the A/B testing roadmap: hypothesis and kill number written before launch, winner called from the data, and a readout that says what we keep and what we kill. - Direct the organic Instagram creative for the brands you run — the same identity, cut for a feed instead of a listing. Paid social is a separate seat and inherits the brand rules you set. - Mine the inputs nobody else has time for — reviews, competitor gaps, category conventions — and turn them into angles worth testing. RESULTS - First briefs shipped and live accounts owned inside 30 days. - Every brand in the portfolio has a current identity and messaging framework the whole creative team works from. - No brand goes a full month without a live test. Every test carries a hypothesis and a kill number written before launch, and a recorded result whether it wins or dies. - CTR and CVR improve on the accounts you own, measured against the control the asset replaced — and ad ROAS improves with them. - Nothing runs quietly. Losing creative is replaced on the schedule it was given, and no finished test sits unread. - Briefs stand on their own — the creative team starts building without a clarification call, and revision rounds drop over time. - Creative decisions trace back to a stated hypothesis and a measured result, not to opinion. The brief queue runs without founder review; readouts and real escalations are the only things that come up. REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years owning Amazon creative strategy for multiple brands at once, at an agency or independently, with the listings and the results they produced available to show. - Has built a brand identity from nothing, not just executed inside someone else's — positioning, packaging and visual system for a product that had none. - Diagnoses from metrics, not taste. Given CTR, CVR and ROAS you can say whether it's an image problem, an offer problem or a traffic problem — and you know a winner called from two weeks of thin traffic is noise. - Writes clearly under pressure, with briefs you can send us. Most of this job is writing, and a brief that needs a call to explain is a failed brief. - Self-directed and async. You commit to positioning without waiting for a sign-off. BONUS POINTS - Hands-on with Amazon split testing — Manage Your Experiments, Splitly or PickFu. - Have directed organic social creative for a consumer brand, not only listing assets. - Packaging design direction: dielines, print-ready handoff, 3D mockups in Pacdora. - Have worked alongside a media buyer and know where creative accountability ends and media accountability starts. LOCATION & HOURS - Remote. - Async by default. 40-hour week across five 8-hour days. At least 6 hours of each day overlap Dubai time (GST, UTC+4). - We track hours. That log is how your pay is calculated. - Your rate, your scope and your promotion are d ---------- on outcomes — what you shipped, what it moved in CTR and conversion, and what that movement was worth in revenue to the brand. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully remote, permanently. No return-to-office plans, because there is no office to return to. - Ownership of your projects with zero micromanagement. You are briefed on the outcome, not the steps. - A fixed annual paid time off allowance. - Budget for tools, courses and AI subscriptions you can make a case for. HOW TO APPLY Apply through the link below. You'll be asked to record a short introduction video — it takes about five minutes and it's the fastest way for us to see how you think. Applications sent as messages on the job board are not reviewed. ----------

description: # BOOKKEEPER & FINANCE ADMINISTRATOR – FULL TIME VA **Location:** Philippines – Home-based (outside Metro Manila preferred) **Work Type:** Full-Time VA Role – Independent Service Provider, Not Employment **Hours:** 45 hours/week, Monday–Friday **Shift:** Brisbane, Australia business hours ## About the Role We are looking for an experienced **Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator** to take ownership of the day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our growing Australian business group. We operate a couple of different businesses, including cleaning services and property management. There are a lot of transactions, invoices, contractor payments and moving parts, so this is not a basic data-entry bookkeeping role. We need someone who understands **Xero**, knows how to keep financial records accurate and organised, and takes ownership of making sure things are actually completed — not simply entered into a system. You’ll work closely with someone currently managing these processes, who will train you on our systems and gradually hand over responsibility. ## What You’ll Be Doing - Managing bookkeeping in Xero - Creating, reviewing and sending client invoices - Preparing weekly contractor payments and ABA files - Reconciling bank accounts and transactions - Following up overdue invoices and sending statements - Recording and investigating overpayments, credits and payment discrepancies - Assisting with payroll - Supporting BAS preparation and working with our accountant - Maintaining accurate financial records across our internal systems and Google Sheets - Following up internally when information is missing or something doesn’t reconcile - Helping manage trust accounting processes for our property management operations - Keeping clear records of what has been completed, what is pending and what requires attention - Identifying errors or inconsistencies rather than simply processing what is in front of you - Helping improve finance and bookkeeping processes as the businesses grow ## Trust Accounting An important part of our future property management operations involves **managing money belonging to property owners**, so trust accounting knowledge is particularly valuable to us. If you have direct trust accounting experience — especially Australian property management trust accounting — we definitely want to hear about it. **If you don’t, please still apply if the rest of your bookkeeping experience is strong. Just tell us honestly what experience you do or don’t have.** We value honesty much more than an applicant trying to tick every box. ## You’ll Be a Great Fit If You - Have strong practical experience using **Xero** - Have solid bookkeeping knowledge and understand the reasoning behind what you are doing - Have experience with reconciliations, invoicing, accounts receivable and accounts payable - Have excellent attention to detail - Are confident investigating something when the numbers don’t make sense - Are highly organised and systematic - Follow tasks through until they are actually finished - Communicate clearly in written English - Are comfortable chasing information from other team members when needed - Can work independently without constant supervision - Are trustworthy and understand the responsibility involved in handling financial information - Are comfortable with Google Sheets and learning internal systems - Ideally have experience working with Australian businesses - Ideally have trust accounting experience ## Availability This is intended to be your **primary and exclusive full-time professional commitment**. Because you will be handling important financial processes and working Brisbane business hours, this role is not suitable for someone planning to manage another full-time job, regular VA role or ongoing client work alongside this position. ## Your Setup You need: - Your own desktop or laptop - Reliable high-speed internet - Backup internet - Backup power, or reliable access to another working location during outages - A quiet and professional home working environment ## What We Offer - Long-term, stable full-time work - Weekly payments - 13th-month pay (pro-rata) - 4 weeks paid leave (accumulative or payable) - Training and handover from the person currently managing the processes - Opportunity to take genuine ownership of the finance function as our businesses grow - A warm, supportive and growing team # HOW TO APPLY – PLEASE READ CAREFULLY Send your application to: ---------- Your email subject **MUST include the word:** # BALANCE If **BALANCE** is not included in your email subject, your application will not be reviewed. Please put your **cover letter in the body of the email** — not as an attachment or external link — and attach your CV as a PDF. **Important**: Applications submitted through this platform will not be reviewed. To be considered for this role, you must apply by email following the instructions below. Keep your answers short and direct: 1. Where in the Philippines are you currently based? 2. How many years of bookkeeping experience do you have? 3. How many years have you used Xero professionally? 4. Have you worked for an Australian business before? If yes, doing what? 5. job_title: AI-Native Executive VA for a Multi-Business Founder (Night Shift)
description: Please read this whole post before applying. The last section tells you exactly how to apply, and I do check for it. I don't run one business. I run several at once — a brand launch and operations company that has put out 50+ direct-to-consumer brands, a manufacturing and logistics business serving consumer brands, a media company I operate alongside its founder, and a handful of smaller ventures and acquisitions in progress. They all need attention on the same day. That is the actual job. I need one person who can hold context across all of it — not a specialist in one lane, but someone who can go from a product launch for a consumer brand in the morning, to a deck for the media business in the afternoon, to chasing a supplier for the logistics company, and keep every thread straight. In one week you might build a Canva carousel for a brand launch, answer twenty customer emails in one company's voice, clean a messy order export and tell me what it means, chase a supplier who has gone quiet, put together a tracker for an entirely different business, and then rebuild the system we use to run all of it. If that variety sounds exhausting, this isn't the job for you. If it sounds like the best part, keep reading. THE HOURS — let's be honest about them up front. This role works US Pacific business hours: 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT, which is 10:00 PM – 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. It is a night shift. That is exactly why the pay is well above the market rate for this kind of role. This is the most important item on this list. - You can hold several unrelated things in your head at once without dropping any of them. If you need a single project at a time to do good work, you will be miserable here. - Excellent written English. You will be writing to US customers and partners on behalf of these companies. - You can make something look good in Canva without being told exactly what to make. - Comfortable in Google Sheets — formulas, pivots, cleaning up messy data. - You've worked with a US client or on a US schedule before, and it went well. - Reliable internet plus a backup connection. A night shift with no power or internet contingency doesn't work. - You solve first and ask second. When something breaks at 3 AM your time, I'm asleep. I need someone who makes a sensible call and tells me about it in the morning. NICE TO HAVE Shopify, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, Zapier or Make, basic video editing, prior e-commerce or agency experience. WHAT I OFFER - $1,200 – $1,500 USD per month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise. - Full time, long term, working directly with me — no agency in between. - Paid Philippine holidays, 10 days paid leave after 3 months, and a 13th month bonus. - A paid AI tool budget, because I want you using the best tools available. - A rare vantage point. You'll see the inside of several businesses at once — how they're launched, run and grown — which is not something most assistant roles offer. - Real growth. The first person I hire here becomes the person who helps me hire the next one. HOW THE HIRING WORKS A short written application, then a 90-second screen recording of you building two things at once with AI, then a video call, then a paid two-week trial. To be clear about the recording: it takes two minutes, it is not meant to be perfect, and I'm watching how you move rather than what you produce. Messy and fast beats polished and slow. HOW TO APPLY Reply with the subject line "Night Owl — [your first name]" and answer these three things in your message: 1. Describe one specific task you do with an AI tool, and paste the actual prompt you use for it. 2. Tell me your real experience with a night schedule. Have you worked one? For how long? title: Facebook Community Engagement & Compliance Specialist
description: Job Type Full-time / Part-time (Flexible) Remote 20–40 hours/week (negotiable) About the Role We are looking for a Community Engagement & Compliance Specialist to manage our Facebook presence. This is not a traditional social media marketing role focused on aggressive growth or paid advertising. Instead, your primary focus will be: Community management – building and nurturing a legitimate, engaged community around educational content and harm-reduction topics. Content moderation – ensuring all posts and comments comply with platform policies and internal guidelines. Compliance – navigating Facebook's strict content policies to keep our page and group safe from bans or flags. This role requires someone who understands the regulatory and legal landscape of health-adjacent products and can operate within tight compliance boundaries. Key Responsibilities 1. Content Creation & Reels Production Short-form video production – create, edit, and publish Facebook Reels (15–60 seconds) and other short-form video content . Graphic creation – design engaging graphics, carousels, and static posts using Canva or similar tools . Content calendar – develop and maintain a content calendar aligned with educational and research-focused goals . Content formats – produce a mix of: Educational Reels (highest priority – Meta's algorithm favors video content) Carousel posts for educational comparisons Story ads and static posts Post-production – basic video editing (CapCut, Canva, or similar tools) . 2. Community Management & Moderation Review and approve/deny incoming member requests for private Facebook groups. Review all pending posts daily. Approve positive, educational, and on-topic content . Remove spam, self-promotion, rule violations, and content that makes unsubstantiated health claims . Ensure negative posts, complaints, or discussions about illegal use are never approved publicly. Respond to all comments, direct messages, and mentions within 24 hours on weekdays. Respond to urgent inquiries within 24 hours on weekends . Flag and escalate crisis situations (FDA announcements, legal changes, negative press) to leadership immediately. 3. Content Strategy & Scheduling Create and maintain a social media content calendar aligned with educational and research-focused goals . Schedule posts using Meta Business Suite . Maintain a consistent posting cadence with: Educational/value posts Community engagement prompts Regular community activities Stay current with social media trends, platform updates, and best practices . 4. Compliance & Policy Navigation Operate strictly within Facebook's advertising and content policies . Avoid any "black hat" techniques or content that could trigger health/fraud filters. Ensure all published content is scientifically accurate and does not make unsubstantiated claims . Adhere strictly to "research purposes only" framing. Document moderation actions and compliance checks as required. 5. Reporting & Escalation Assist in regular content performance reporting . Track engagement, growth, and compliance metrics . Report any compliance flags, platform warnings, or crisis situations to leadership immediately. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Weekly Reels published – at least 2–3 Reels per week 100% of member requests reviewed within 24 hours Daily moderation of all pending posts with zero spam or unresolved negative posts going live All comments and DMs responded to within 24 hours Zero compliance flags or policy violations from published content Engagement metrics – reach, views, shares, saves, and comment engagement What We're Looking For Essential Skills Strong written English communication skills. Content creation skills – experience creating short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, etc.) using CapCut or similar tools . Graphic design skills – proficiency with Canva or similar tools . Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow templates and community rules precisely. Organized, reliable, and able to work independently . Comfortable enforcing guidelines respectfully and professionally. Crisis communication skills – able to handle high-stress situations calmly. Preferred Experience (Nice-to-Have) Experience as a Social Media Manager or Community Manager for a regulated or controversial industry (CBD, medical cannabis, harm-reduction organizations, etc.). Familiarity with Facebook's content policies and community standards . Experience with Meta Ads Manager is a plus but not required. Knowledge of harm-reduction content on social media platforms . What This Role Is NOT ❌ Not a general "growth hacker" pushing boundaries or risking account bans. ❌ Not a content creator making unsubstantiated health claims . ❌ Not a salesperson promoting the product as a "miracle cure" or "legal high." ❌ Not responsible for paid advertising unless explicitly instructed and approved. ❌ Not responsible for creating before/after transformation content . Why This Role Matters This is not just a "social media job." You are the frontline defender of the brand's reputation and compliance. Your work ensures that we can continue to operate safely on Facebook while building a genuine community around research and harm reduction . If you understand the importance of compliance and enjoy creating educational content that builds trust and community, we want to hear from you.

title: YouTube Video Editor — Software & Marketing (Long-Term)
description: Hi, my name is Stepan and I run faceless YouTube channels reviewing online marketing and software tools. I am hiring a second long-term editor to work alongside my current one. WHAT YOU DO You get raw screen recordings, the voiceover audio, and the script. You turn them into a finished, high-quality video: captions, zooms, text callouts, effects, transitions, music, and our offer cards. You do not record anything. You do not narrate. Someone else does that. Your job is purely the edit. Most videos are 5-15 minute software tutorials and comparisons. Some are shorter 1-3 minute deal videos where I want heavier effects. Around 4 finished videos per week. THESE ARE MY VIDEOS — this is the standard Best VPN 2026 (9:07) — ---------- Lovable Pricing (7:05) — ---------- UpPromote Tutorial (5:43) — ---------- Surfshark Coupon Code (1:33) — ---------- The first three are the level I want for tutorials. The last one is a short deal video — that is where I want maximum effects. Look at how the screen recordings are cropped and placed on a coloured background, how the captions highlight keywords, and how the discount card appears several times. That is what I am buying. PAY $ ---------- /month for 20 hours a week, depending on your experience and how the test video goes. Paid every 2 weeks by Wise. Reviewed at 3 months and 6 months. There is room to grow into full-time and higher pay if the work is strong — I already have one editor on those terms. WHAT ELSE Work your own daytime hours. No graveyard shift — I am in Europe. Weekends off. Philippine holidays off. 13th month pay. I pay for your tools, including CapCut Pro. Performance bonuses when videos do well. WHO I WANT Strong editing in CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Comfortable with captions, text animation, zooms and motion graphics Good eye for pacing — you know when a shot has been on screen too long You follow a spec sheet exactly. This is not a creative-freedom role. Reliable internet and a plan for brownouts Thumbnail design is a plus, not required WHO I DO NOT WANT Wedding, cinematic or vlog editors. Different skill. Anyone who needs a lot of revision rounds to get there. HOW TO APPLY I read every application that does all three. I skip the rest. 1. Start your message with the word STARLIGHT 2. Send 2-3 videos you personally edited that are closest to my examples above. Software, tech, marketing or educational content. Not a general showreel — I will not open one. 3. In 2-3 sentences: pick any ONE of my four videos above and tell me one specific thing you would edit differently, and why. There is a paid test video ($30) before anything else. I never ask for unpaid work.

title: Sales Outreach Lead Generator
description: # Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist **Location:** Manila, Philippines **Company:** BBSpro Services Inc. **Reports To:** Sales Director / Management Team **Employment Type:** Full-Time ## About BBSpro Services Inc. BBSpro Services Inc. is a Western Canadian provider of commercial chemical, warewashing, draught beverage, and related service solutions. We work with restaurants, hospitality groups, hotels, food-service operators, and other commercial businesses. We are looking for a **Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist** based in Manila to support our Canadian sales team by identifying qualified prospective customers and arranging meetings for our local sales representatives. This is primarily a **business development support role**. The successful candidate will be responsible for researching potential customers, building high-quality lead lists, obtaining internal approval before outreach, and then contacting approved prospects to secure qualified in-person sales meetings. ## Key Responsibilities ### 1. Lead Research & List Building Research and identify prospective customers that fit BBSpro's target customer profile. Target prospects may include: * Restaurants and restaurant groups * Hotels and hospitality operators * Bars, pubs and breweries * Commercial kitchens * Food-service operators * Senior living and institutional facilities * Other businesses that may require commercial chemical, warewashing, sanitation, or draught services For each prospect, collect and verify relevant information including: * Company/business name * Location * Type of business * Number of locations, where applicable * Website * Decision-maker name and title * Phone number * Email address * LinkedIn profile, where available * Existing supplier or relevant information, where reasonably identifiable * Reason the prospect may be a good fit for BBSpro **All lead lists must be submitted to the BBSpro team for review and approval before any prospect is contacted.** ### 2. Lead Approval Process The specialist will maintain an organized pipeline of potential leads and submit new lead lists to BBSpro management or the sales team for approval. The process will be: **Step 1 – Research:** Identify and research potential customers. **Step 2 – Submit:** Send the proposed lead list to BBSpro for review. **Step 3 – Approval:** BBSpro will approve, reject, or provide feedback on the leads. **Step 4 – Outreach:** Only approved leads may be contacted. **Step 5 – Qualification:** Determine whether the prospect has a legitimate potential need for BBSpro's products or services. **Step 6 – Meeting:** Schedule a qualified in-person meeting for the appropriate BBSpro sales representative. The specialist must **not contact unapproved prospects**. ## Appointment Setting & Outreach Once a lead has been approved, the specialist will contact the prospect through appropriate channels, including: * Phone calls * Email * LinkedIn or other approved business channels * Follow-up communications The objective is **not simply to generate calls or send emails**. The objective is to create genuine sales opportunities and secure meetings with qualified decision-makers. The specialist should be able to clearly and professionally introduce BBSpro, identify the appropriate decision-maker, understand the prospect's basic needs, and explain why a conversation with BBSpro may be valuable. ## What Is a Qualified Meeting? A meeting should generally meet the following criteria: * The company fits BBSpro's target customer profile. * The meeting is with a decision-maker or meaningful influencer. * The prospect has a potential need for one or more BBSpro products or services. * The prospect understands the general purpose of the meeting. * The prospect has agreed to meet with a BBSpro representative. * The meeting has a confirmed date, time, location and contact person. The goal is **quality over quantity**. Meetings should represent legitimate potential business opportunities rather than appointments booked simply to meet activity targets. ## CRM & Reporting The specialist will be expected to maintain accurate records of: * Leads researched * Leads submitted for approval * Approved/rejected leads * Outreach attempts * Conversations * Follow-up dates * Prospect feedback * Meetings scheduled * Meeting outcomes provided by the Canadian sales team A weekly activity report should summarize the lead-generation and appointment-setting pipeline. ## Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance may be measured based on: * Number of qualified leads researched * Accuracy and completeness of lead information * Percentage of submitted leads approved by BBSpro * Contact rate on approved leads * Qualified conversations generated * Qualified meetings booked * Meeting attendance/show rate * Conversion of meetings into sales opportunities * Quality and accuracy of CRM records **Meeting quality and eventual sales pipeline generated will be more important than simply maximizing the number of meetings booked.** ## Qualifications The ideal candidate will have: * Previous experience in B2B lead generation, business development, appointment setting, inside sales, or sales development * Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal * Confidence speaking with business owners, managers, executives and other decision-makers * Strong internet research and prospecting skills * Experience using LinkedIn and other lead-generation tools * Experience with CRM systems * Strong attention to detail * Ability to follow a structured approval and sales process * Strong organizational and follow-up skills * Ability to work independently while coordinating with a Canadian-based sales team Experience prospecting into the **restaurant, hospitality, food-service, commercial cleaning, chemical, equipment, or facilities-management industries** would be considered an asset. ## Working Hours Because the position supports customers and sales representatives in Western Canada, the successful candidate must be comfortable working hours that provide reasonable overlap with **Pacific Time (Vancouver)**. Some prospecting and appointment-setting activities may need to occur during Canadian business hours. ## What Success Looks Like A successful Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Specialist will consistently provide BBSpro with a pipeline of well-researched prospects, follow the company's lead-approval process, professionally represent BBSpro during outreach, and generate qualified meetings that give our Canadian sales team a genuine opportunity to win new business. The role is not measured simply by how many names are added to a spreadsheet or how many calls are made. **Success means creating qualified sales opportunities that can turn into long-term BBSpro customers.**

description: SENIOR CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER Full time | Remote, Philippines | US and UK client accounts ABOUT ALBA TALENT Alba Talent is a UK revenue architecture firm. We build the revenue systems that growing businesses in the US and the UK depend on, and we train and certify the people who run them. You would work one book of accounts inside a single client business, full time. The same accounts month after month, so you actually get to know them. We are hiring one Senior Customer Success Manager. THE ROLE You own a portfolio of client accounts from onboarding through to renewal. You are the primary relationship owner and the voice the client hears most often. Performance is measured on retention, account health and renewal outcomes. Not ticket volume. This is a senior seat and you will be left to run it. You take your own calls and you make your own calls. You pull someone else in when the situation actually needs it. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own a portfolio of client accounts across the full lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion and renewal - Lead client facing calls yourself: kickoffs, onboarding, scheduled check ins, quarterly business reviews, escalations and renewals - Watch account health and step in early when engagement drops - Take an at risk account and work the retention conversation through to an answer - Handle an unhappy client without flinching, and settle it at your level where you can - Open expansion conversations when an account is actually using what it already pays for - Keep CRM records and account notes to a standard a colleague could pick up without a briefing - Report on portfolio health honestly, including the accounts that are slipping REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - Five to ten years in Customer Success, Account Management or a client facing role where you owned the commercial outcome. Support experience on its own will not meet the bar here. - You have served US, UK or Australian clients, and you know how they talk and what they expect. - Retention, escalation and renewal conversations are things you have run, not things you have read about. - Credibility with founders, directors and VPs on a live call. You should be able to hold a position under pressure, and direct a difficult conversation rather than absorbing it. - Excellent spoken English. Clear, neutral, easy to follow. This is most of the job. - A major CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho or GoHighLevel, plus the usual video and chat tools. COMMUNICATION AND AUDIO STANDARDS You will be on client calls every day. We assess audio quality as part of selection, and we have previously declined otherwise strong candidates on this basis alone. Please read this part before you apply. - A dedicated USB or XLR headset or microphone. Not a laptop built in mic. Not wireless earbuds. - A private, quiet room for the whole shift. - Wired internet at 25 Mbps or better, plus a backup connection and a plan for when the power goes. - A webcam you are happy to keep on. ENGAGEMENT AND COMPENSATION - Full time, forty hours per week, long term - 1,000 to 1,200 USD per month, set by experience - Paid twice monthly - You need to cover US business hours, 9am to 6pm US Eastern. In practice this is a night shift in the Philippines, roughly 9pm to 6am. - Two week paid trial at the full rate. If it works, the seat is permanent, and we would rather keep someone for years than rehire every twelve months. SELECTION PROCESS Everyone who works a client account for us completes our internal Customer Success certification before going live. It ends in a live assessed call: a retention conversation, an escalation, and an upsell. Candidates do fail it. Passing is what puts you in front of a client, and the credential is yours to keep. HOW TO APPLY Please send all four. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. 1. Start your reply with the word ORBIT, so we know you got to the end of this. 2. The hardest client account you have personally saved. What was going wrong, what you did, and how it ended. We are reading for judgement here, so a short paragraph is fine. 3. Your CV. 4. A voice recording of two to three minutes, answering this out loud: "A client tells you they are cancelling at the end of the month because they are not seeing value. Talk me through how you would run that call." Speak as you would on a client call. Do not read from a script and do not use an AI voice. Every recording gets listened to, and this is the part that carries the most weight. When you send the link, write it with the dots spelled out, for example: loom (dot) com slash share slash yourrecording. This job board removes standard web links. Also tell us the monthly USD figure you are looking for within the range above, and your earliest available start date. Every candidate who submits a complete application will receive a response.

title: Short-Form Video Editor
description: WHO WE ARE We're a small creator-management agency (Cyprus HQ) that builds handmade brands for a tiny roster of creators. The founder works on every account. We're hiring our first dedicated editor for one flagship creator: a cozy homemaker lifestyle brand (warm home, garden, cooking, comfort) with a retro-gaming thread woven through it. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY EDIT Instagram Reels (15 to 30s) for a warm domestic-lifestyle brand. Think lamp-lit rooms, cooking and garden moments, soft-spoken voiceover, a retro game paused on the TV in the background. Warm and cozy, but never slow or boring. Our editing style: - 2-3s pacing rule - Something must happen every 2 to 3 seconds: a sound effect, a subtle zoom, a cut, a text pop, an on-screen detail. Micro-events keep retention high. The trick is doing this while the reel still FEELS calm and warm, not chaotic. Gentle movement, not zoom-punch spam. - Optimal trimming - Tight cuts, no dead air, no wasted frames. Every clip trimmed to its best moment. - Sound design as a core skill - Domestic texture (kettle, chopping, rain on the window, keyboard clicks) layered with retro game SFX accents and a whisper-register voice. title: Marketing Operations Manager
description: LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT. Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail. This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time. A NOTE FROM OUR CMO Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like: ---------- /share/9cd974e7c8a848de8b84a4a992df4e45 Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content. Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs. ABOUT VERITAS Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role. THE DETAILS • Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position • Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time • Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time • Fully remote and long-term • This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting • Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage • Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled WHAT YOU'LL OWN At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION • Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance. • Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables. • Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility. • Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output. • Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow. • Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly. • Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests. • Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage. • Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position. PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also: • Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members. • Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. • Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup. • Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling. • Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation. • Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows. • Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations. • Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems. HOW THE ROLE FITS You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you. You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership. HOW WE USE AI Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory. We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow. YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU • Have at least eight years of professional work experience. • Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports. • Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function. • Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience. • Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results. • Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story. • Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why. • Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck. • Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity. • Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers. • Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops. • Communicate clearly in conversational American English. • Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage. • Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings. • Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power. • Want one company to grow with for the long term. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR • Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting. • Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients. • A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable. • Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal. • Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results. • Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work. • Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it. HOW WE WORK Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves. Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear. HOW TO APPLY Use this subject line and at least 20 AP: [INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams Include the following: • Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work. • Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size. • Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage. • In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability. Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

Write the exact message you'd send them right now. --- **Task 2: Find Us 5 Affiliates** Go to TikTok Shop's creator marketplace and find 5 creators you would actually recruit for DracoSlides right now. ABOUT THE PROJECT Rezie’s frontend design, user interface, and intended workflow have already been completed. The primary work remaining is the backend development required to make the platform fully functional. The current backend, estimator, and claims workflow are not reliable or production-ready. This is not a basic code-maintenance assignment or a project involving only minor fixes to an existing application. Detailed workflows, product requirements, estimating rules, technical documentation, and acceptance criteria will be shared with qualified candidates during the interview process and after signing a confidentiality agreement. RESPONSIBILITIES The selected developer will be responsible for: * Auditing the existing codebase, backend, and database * Determining which existing components can be used and which must be rebuilt * Completing the backend architecture and application logic * Completing the estimator and remaining claims workflow * Integrating the required AI, OCR, document-processing, and image-analysis services * Building reliable structured outputs and validation * Developing the scope and estimate-generation functionality * Completing the claim-document, tracking, and follow-up functionality * Improving database reliability and data synchronization * Preventing outdated or incorrect project information from being used * Adding error handling and clear processing-status reporting * Connecting the completed backend to the existing frontend * Identifying and recommending any required APIs or third-party services * Testing the platform across multiple realistic projects * Correcting defects discovered during testing * Deploying the completed application * Providing technical documentation and a final code handoff * Committing all completed work to the company-owned repository DEVELOPER EXPECTATIONS The selected developer must be able to work independently and take technical ownership of the project. Rezie will provide the existing codebase, completed design, intended workflow, business requirements, and required outcome. The developer is responsible for performing their own quality-assurance testing before submitting work for final review. Rezie’s final acceptance testing is not a replacement for the developer’s own testing process. Technical risks, missing requirements, and blockers must be communicated immediately. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE * Full-stack web application development * React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or comparable technologies * AI and LLM integrations * Structured AI outputs and validation * PDF, OCR, image-analysis, or document-processing systems * Backend APIs, databases, and asynchronous workflows * Automated testing and application debugging * Experience completing or rebuilding an existing application * Strong communication and independent problem-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to complete projects on an agreed schedule Experience limited to basic websites, prompt writing, or simple chatbots is not sufficient. Experience with construction, restoration, insurance claims, property-damage estimating, or a related contractor industry is strongly preferred. Candidates must understand that an insurance estimate requires a detailed and accurate scope of work, not simply an AI-generated summary. TIMELINE AND WORK EXPECTATIONS The complete project must be delivered within six weeks of the agreed start date. Completing it earlier is fine. Before development begins, a written milestone schedule will be established with specific deliverables and acceptance criteria. The selected developer must: * Begin promptly after receiving access and documentation * Make the project a primary work focus * Meet the agreed weekly milestones * Provide regular progress updates * Demonstrate working functionality throughout development * Commit completed work to the company repository * Communicate risks or blockers immediately * Reserve sufficient time for final testing, deployment, documentation, and handoff * Be available for regular communication during U.S. business hours PAYMENT AND DELIVERABLES The total project budget is $1,000 USD. Hard-coded demonstrations, manually created outputs, temporary fixes, incomplete integrations, or functionality that only works for one test case will not be accepted. FULL-TIME OPPORTUNITY A developer who successfully completes the project, produces reliable work, communicates consistently, meets the agreed timeline, and demonstrates strong technical ownership may be offered an ongoing full-time position with Rezie. A full-time offer is not guaranteed and will depend on project performance and company needs. How you would approach a project where the accuracy of the generated scope is the most important requirement. 5. Your experience independently selecting APIs, testing your work, and resolving technical problems. 6. Confirmation that you can communicate during U.S. business hours. title: Marketing Agency Project Manager
description: We’re Hiring: Remote Creative Project Manager / Production Coordinator Company: La Vie Studios Media ---------- Instagram: ---------- /laviestudiosmedia Position: Creative Project Manager / Production Coordinator Location: 100% Remote Schedule: Part-Time | Full-Time Opportunities Once Proven Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor About La Vie Studios Media La Vie Studios Media is a South Florida-based creative production and marketing company helping businesses build their brands through strategic photography, video content, social media, and paid advertising. Responsibilities Pre-Production & Client Approval * Receive concepts, scripts, and creative direction from our Creative Director. * Review scripts and production documents for accuracy, completeness, feasibility, and quality. * Identify missing information or potential production issues before materials reach the client or production team. * Send scripts and concepts to clients for approval. * Collect, organize, and communicate client feedback. * Coordinate revisions with our creative team. * Confirm final approvals before production. * Ensure all necessary client assets, brand guidelines, creative references, scripts, shot lists, and expectations are organized before production. Production Coordination Although this position is fully remote, you’ll coordinate the planning and preparation behind our productions. * Coordinate production dates with clients and our creative teams. * Schedule and contract photographers, videographers, and other necessary production personnel. * Prepare production teams with scripts, shot lists, creative references, timelines, client information, and other necessary assets. * Make sure everyone understands the creative direction, priorities, deliverables, and expectations before production begins. * Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, missing information, or other potential blockers. File & Post-Production Management * Manage incoming photo, video, audio, and other digital assets. * Maintain clean and consistent folder structures and file-naming systems. * Ensure assets are properly backed up, organized, labeled, and easy to locate. * Organize footage and assets according to scripts, shot lists, projects, and deliverables. * Prepare and transfer organized assets, scripts, creative references, and editing instructions to our post-production team. * Assign and communicate editing priorities. * Track projects throughout the editing process. * Update project statuses and task-management systems. * Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with editors and team members. * Manage revision cycles through final approval. Responsibilities include: * Communicating project updates professionally and clearly. * Sending creative materials for client review and approval. * Delivering completed content for review. * Collecting and organizing client feedback. * Translating feedback into clear instructions for our creative team. * Managing revisions through final approval. * Communicating blockers or delays early. * Making sure clients understand where their projects stand without needing to chase us for updates. title: Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter
job_title: Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter
description: # Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter We’re a fast-moving eCommerce company operating primarily through **funnel-based dropshipping**, and we’re looking for an exceptional **Full-Stack Performance Video Editor + AI Graphic Designer / Prompter** to join our creative team. This is **not** a traditional video editing position. We are looking for someone who understands that in direct-response eCommerce, creative is the engine of growth. Your job is not to make videos that simply look good. Your job is to help us **reproduce, improve, iterate and scale winning advertising concepts**. ## What You’ll Be Doing A major part of our strategy is studying successful ads in the market and creating our own high-quality versions for our products and funnels. That means you must be extremely good at **creative replication**. We will often provide you with a winning reference ad and expect you to: * Recreate the structure as closely as possible * Match the hook style and opening sequence * Match the pacing and rhythm * Replicate caption timing and visual hierarchy * Preserve the original selling mechanism and storytelling flow * Replace all original product footage with our own product * Replace or improve the B-roll * Adapt voiceovers, scenes, graphics and proof elements * Make the final creative feel native, polished and performance-driven We are looking for **one of the highest-quality “copying” editors possible**. You need to be able to look at an advertisement and reverse-engineer exactly **why it works**, then rebuild the same mechanism for another product without producing a cheap-looking clone. ## Role 1 — Performance Video Editing You will create direct-response advertisements for platforms such as: * Meta / Facebook * Instagram * TikTok * YouTube Shorts You should understand: * Hooks * Retention editing * Pattern interrupts * Native social pacing * Direct-response storytelling * Offer presentation * CTAs * Product demonstrations * UGC * VSL-style creatives * Advertorial/funnel creatives * Before-and-after structures * Problem → agitation → solution frameworks * Testimonial and proof-driven creatives You should think like a **performance marketer who happens to be an elite editor**, not a cinematic editor trying to make ads. ## Role 2 — AI Graphic Designer You will also help us produce high-quality visual assets using AI. This can include: * Static Meta ads * Product images * Product-in-use scenes * Lifestyle visuals * Advertorial graphics * Before-and-after creatives * Landing-page imagery * Funnel graphics * Thumbnail concepts * AI-generated B-roll * Image variations for creative testing You should be able to take basic product assets and transform them into visuals that look premium and commercially usable. ## Role 3 — AI Prompter / Creative Generator We need someone who is genuinely strong at prompting. You should know how to get consistent, realistic and usable results from modern AI generation tools instead of simply typing one sentence and hoping for the best. You should understand concepts such as: * Prompt structure * Camera direction * Lighting * Composition * Product consistency * Character consistency * Image-to-image workflows * Image-to-video * Reference-image prompting * Scene continuation * Motion prompting * Negative prompting * Iterative prompt refinement Experience with tools such as the following is highly valuable: * Kling * Google Veo * Runway * Midjourney * Nano Banana / Gemini image tools * ChatGPT image generation * HeyGen * Arcads * Creatify * ElevenLabs * CapCut * Premiere Pro * After Effects * DaVinci Resolve * Photoshop * Topaz You do **not** need to use every tool. You do need to demonstrate that you have a real AI-powered creative workflow. ## What We Expect You should be able to receive: **1 winning reference ad + our product assets** …and independently turn that into a finished advertisement. We do not want someone who requires a 20-page brief for every creative. You need strong judgment. If the reference uses a specific B-roll sequence, you should understand what that shot is accomplishing and find, create or generate an equivalent. If footage is missing, your first instinct should be: **“How can I solve this?”** Not: **“Can you send me more footage?”** ## Creative Replication Is a Core Skill To be very clear: We actively use **winning ads as references**. Your ability to study those creatives and accurately reproduce their: * Hook * Structure * Pacing * Scenes * B-roll logic * Captions * Transitions * Emotional progression * Proof placement * CTA …is one of the most important parts of this position. We are not looking for random creativity. We are looking for someone who can identify what already works and execute it at an extremely high level for our brands. The strongest editor will be able to make our version feel **as good as or better than the reference**. ## Speed Matters We test a high volume of creatives. One winning concept may become: * 5 new hooks * 3 different opening scenes * Multiple B-roll versions * Different voiceovers * Different captions * Different CTAs * Different lengths * Different aspect ratios * Multiple static-image derivatives You therefore need to understand **creative iteration**, not just individual video production. A winning ad is not finished after version one. A winning ad becomes a creative tree. ## What We're Looking For You should have: * Proven experience editing performance advertisements * Strong experience with eCommerce / dropshipping / direct response * Excellent ability to copy and recreate reference ads * Extremely strong B-roll selection * Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok creative * Strong visual taste * Excellent pacing * Strong caption design * AI-generation experience * AI image-generation experience * AI video-generation experience * Advanced prompting ability * Ability to work quickly without destroying quality * Ability to accept direct feedback and iterate quickly * High attention to detail * Good English comprehension Bonus if you've worked with: * Dropshipping brands * One-product stores * Funnel-based eCommerce * Advertorial funnels * VSL funnels * Supplements * Beauty * Health * Problem-solving products * High-volume Meta advertisers ## What We DON'T Want Do not apply if: * Your background is mainly weddings, music videos or cinematic editing * You only know how to make “pretty” videos * You dislike copying winning references * You need detailed instructions for every edit * You cannot explain why an ad converts * You refuse to use AI * You use AI but produce obvious AI slop * You take several days to make basic creative variations * You care more about artistic originality than advertising performance We care about originality when originality improves performance. We care about replication when replication gives us a proven advantage. The metric d ---------- . ## Paid Test This position will begin with a **paid creative test**. You may receive: * One reference advertisement * Our product images/videos * Product information * Brand assets Your job will be to recreate the advertisement for our product. We will evaluate: **1. Accuracy of replication** Did you preserve what made the original work? **2. Editing quality** Does the final creative look premium? **3. B-roll selection** Did you choose or generate the right visual for every moment? **4. Performance thinking** Do you understand the hook, proof and CTA? **5. AI capability** Can you generate missing assets when necessary? **6. Prompting ability** Can you produce commercially usable AI visuals? **7. Speed** Can you execute quickly without constant supervision? **8. Attention to detail** Did you notice the small things? ## Long-Term Opportunity We are not looking for someone to edit three videos and disappear. We're building a serious creative operation. For the right person, this can develop into a long-term position where you become an essential part of our creative department and eventually help establish: * Editing standards * AI workflows * Prompt libraries * Winning-ad databases * Creative templates * B-roll libraries * Testing systems * Junior editor QA * Creative production processes The goal is to find someone who can ultimately operate as a **full-stack creative producer**, not simply someone moving clips around a timeline. ## How To Apply Start your application with the word: **PRINT** Then send us: 1. Your **3 strongest performance ads** 2. At least **1 example where you recreated or closely followed another advertisement/reference** 3. Your best **AI-generated product image or graphic** 4. Your best **AI-generated video/B-roll example** 5. The AI tools you currently use 6. Your editing software 7. Your current availability 8. Your expected monthly full-time rate Finally, answer this: **We give you a winning 60-second competitor ad and our product assets. Explain in 5-10 sentences exactly how you would recreate it for our product while keeping the elements that made the original successful.** Generic applications will be ignored. We are looking for someone **fast, technical, commercially minded and extremely good at execution**. If that sounds like you, apply.
