You will be expected to: • Listen closely to what I am saying and reiterate important product facts in the comments • Reinforce product benefits I mention • Answer questions you already know the answers to • Bring important information back into the conversation for viewers who just joined • Keep viewers engaged and talking • Welcome new viewers • Ask questions and encourage interaction • Watch for people adding products to their cart • Acknowledge and create excitement around cart activity • Recognize purchases and celebrate buyers by name • Use purchases to create social proof and encourage additional purchases • Remind viewers about products and offers • Help create urgency around promotions • Monitor the chat for bots and spam • Remove inappropriate comments • Block viewers who are vulgar, hateful, racist, threatening or intentionally disrupting the LIVE • Recognize the difference between a legitimate question/concern and someone intentionally trying to sabotage the LIVE I need someone who can THINK IN REAL TIME. I don’t want someone who waits for me to tell them what to type every few minutes. If I’m talking about a product benefit, I expect you to recognize that and reinforce it in the comments. If someone adds the product to their cart, I expect you to recognize it. If someone purchases, I expect you to celebrate it. Your job is to help create buying momentum while I focus on demonstrating the products and talking to my audience. TIKTOK SHOP EXPERIENCE TikTok Shop LIVE experience is REQUIRED. Please tell me specifically: • How many TikTok Shop LIVEs you have moderated • What your responsibilities were • Whether you’ve worked with product links • Whether you’ve worked with Flash Sales/Flash Deals • Whether you’ve used TikTok LIVE Manager • Whether you’ve helped a creator increase LIVE engagement or sales SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITING In addition to LIVE support, you will work as my short-form video editor. I need someone who can: • Edit TikTok/Reels/YouTube Shorts • Create strong hooks • Add captions and text overlays • Use B-roll, images and visual examples • Create problem/solution style videos • Understand current TikTok trends • Create engaging pacing that keeps people watching • Add appropriate calls-to-action • Repurpose my LIVE footage • Take the raw videos I provide and turn them into multiple pieces of content SCRIPT & CONTENT DEVELOPMENT I also need someone who can create scripts and content ideas for me. You will be able to review the products currently listed in my TikTok Shop and help develop content around them. I need: Strong HOOK → talking points/product benefits → natural conversation → CTA I want multiple hooks and creative angles rather than giving me the same generic script for every product. I also want you to suggest things for me to DO on camera, not just things for me to SAY. For example: • Visual demonstrations • Before/after concepts where appropriate • Trending formats • Problem/solution concepts • Props or visuals to use • Text/pop-up ideas • Ways to demonstrate a product MY PERSONAL STYLE This is VERY important. I am a real, relatable creator. I talk to my audience like I’m talking to one person or a friend. I am NOT a luxury lifestyle influencer. My content can be pretty and polished, but I don’t want everything to look overly luxurious, staged or artificial. I want my personality to remain authentic. I need an editor who can make my content look better while still making it sound and feel like me. WORK SCHEDULE This position is approximately 4 hours per day, Monday–Friday, split into two work periods. Philippines time: 7:30 PM–9:30 PM — TikTok Shop LIVE moderation 8:00 AM–10:00 AM — Editing, scripts & content development U.S. Eastern Time: 7:30 AM–9:30 AM — LIVE 8:00 PM–10:00 PM — Editing/scripts/content The schedule is split because I want the LIVE content from that morning to become part of the content and script planning for the following day. DAILY WORKFLOW After my LIVE, I will provide footage/products/content that I want worked on. During your editing/content hours, you will: 1. Edit videos I have already provided 2. Create additional short-form content from my footage 3. Review my TikTok Shop products 4. Develop new content ideas and scripts 5. Prepare hooks, talking points and CTAs for the following day’s content 6. Email/send me the scripts and ideas so I can film them after my next LIVE The goal is for me to wake up and already have the next day’s content ideas/scripts ready, while you’re also working on the videos from the previous day. IMPORTANT Please do not apply if you have never moderated a TikTok Shop LIVE. I am specifically looking for someone who can come into the LIVE and understand what needs to be done without requiring extensive training on basic moderation. Start your application by answering this question: You join my TikTok Shop LIVE while I’m demonstrating a product. Someone adds the product to their cart, another person purchases it, and several people are asking questions. Tell me exactly what you would do in the chat during those next few minutes. Please also include your hourly rate, LIVE experience, editing experience, and portfolio.

title: Google Ads Strategist - Home Services
description: If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY ROLE. Sustain Media is a local SEO and Google Ads agency built only for home service businesses. Roofers, plumbers, HVAC companies, electricians, landscapers, restoration companies, and auto shops. Most of our clients are owner-operated businesses doing $2M to $10M a year. Our job is simple: more calls and more booked jobs. Ultimately, every metric has to connect back to qualified leads, booked work, and profitable growth. We're hiring a Google Ads Strategist to join our paid media team. What makes this role different We use AI agents to handle a growing share of the repetitive work most agencies still do by hand, including search term mining, campaign audits, performance diagnostics, and reporting data pulls. The systems get better every month. Right now, this role includes real implementation work. You'll build campaigns, write ads, make bid changes, and manage accounts directly. We're moving quickly on AI systems, and over the next few quarters the role should become increasingly focused on strategy rather than implementation. That strategy includes understanding why a plumber in Portland needs a different structure than an HVAC company in Fort Wayne, when to push budget into a seasonal spike, when to pull back, and how to turn performance data into a growth plan for every account you run. If you want the strategy-only version of this job on day one, this is not it. If you want to grow into it as the systems mature, keep reading. What you'll own Your own book of clients. You'll own your accounts end to end, working alongside another PPC specialist who manages a separate portfolio. You'll manage Google Ads across home service accounts with different trades, markets, budgets, and growth goals. Each account needs its own strategy. Lead generation. These campaigns exist to drive phone calls, form fills, and booked jobs. You need to know how to build for that and measure it the way a business owner does: qualified lead volume, acquisition cost, booked work, and return on spend, not clicks and impressions alone. Tracking and attribution. A dashboard saying Google is working means nothing if the client's phone is not ringing. You'll own conversion tracking on every account and know how to verify which campaigns drive real calls, form fills, and booked jobs. New account builds. When a client signs, you architect the account from zero, including keyword research, campaign structure, ad copy, bidding, geo-targeting, conversion tracking, and launch. Judgment calls. Our AI agent Viktor provides audits and diagnostics. You d ---------- what to do with them: which bid strategy fits an account with 20 conversions a month versus 100, when PMax is supporting the account, when it is obscuring poor lead quality or wasting spend, and when to restructure instead of continuing to optimize around a flawed setup. Landing pages and offers. You work with our development and SEO teams so ad traffic lands on pages that convert. You guide the messaging and structure, but you do not build the pages. Monthly reporting. Viktor pulls the data. You write the story, explain what changed, and lay out the plan for the next month. What success looks like In your first 90 days, you'll take full ownership of a portfolio, confirm that tracking is trustworthy, identify the largest performance opportunities, and establish a clear strategy for each account. Longer term, success means improving qualified lead volume and booked-job economics while keeping clients confident in the direction of their campaigns. What we're looking for Must-haves: ? - Proven results running lead generation campaigns for local home service businesses ? - Hands-on experience with Search, Performance Max, and Local Service Ads ? - A strong understanding of conversion tracking. When a client says the leads are not coming in, 'the dashboard looks fine' is not an answer. You know how to verify what is real. ? - The ability to build an account from zero and defend every major choice you made ? - The ability to read data and make strategic recommendations, not just report what a dashboard says ? - Strong communication skills. You'll be in Slack daily. Strong pluses: ? - Strong attribution skills, including tracing ad spend through call tracking and offline conversions to booked jobs ? - Experience with CallRail or similar call-tracking platforms ? - An understanding of how Google Business Profile and local SEO work together with paid search ? - Agency experience managing multiple accounts at once ? - Comfort working with AI tools. You do not need to build automations, but you should want to use them. The environment ? - Remote, international team ? - Contractor position, paid biweekly ? - Base range: $1,500 to $2,000 USD per month depending on experience ? - Revenue share: after a certain amount of time with a client, you will begin earning an ongoing monthly share tied to how long that client stays with us. Realistically, this adds $200 to $500 per month within your first year and keeps growing as your book matures. It is paid every month, for as long as the client stays. ? Daily tools: Google Ads, CallRail, Slack, Airtable, Google Sheets, and Viktor ? You can work from anywhere in the world, but you work U.S. Eastern Time (EST) business hours. This is a firm rule, not a preference. There is no time tracking, and there never will be, but the EST schedule is non-negotiable. If you cannot commit to working EST hours, do not apply. ? Our clients are month to month with no long-term contracts. We earn the business every 30 days, which means the work has to be good. ? Small senior team. You work directly with the founder and the operations team

job_title: Facebook / Meta Asset Manager with Media Buying Experience
description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Facebook / Meta Asset Manager to manage and maintain the Meta infrastructure behind our growing dropshipping operation. This is not primarily a Media Buyer position. We already operate with clear SOPs and predefined rules for campaign testing, killing and scaling. Therefore, the more important part of this role is having an excellent technical and operational understanding of the Meta ecosystem and how different Facebook assets work together. Your main responsibility is to make sure our Meta infrastructure is properly organized, connected, maintained and ready for daily advertising operations. Your Main Responsibility: Meta Asset Management You will take operational responsibility for our Facebook / Meta assets. You should have strong hands-on experience working with: Meta Business Manager / Business Portfolio Facebook Ad Accounts Facebook Pages Pixels / Datasets Domains Users, Partners & Permissions Payment methods Instagram accounts Asset connections and assignments You need to understand how these assets connect to each other and how to troubleshoot them when something goes wrong. Asset Maintenance & Replacement We need someone who doesn't just react when an asset fails. You will be responsible for: Monitoring the health and availability of our Meta assets Maintaining an organized overview of all active assets Keeping sufficient backup assets available Replacing problematic assets when required Connecting replacement assets correctly Checking permissions and access Identifying missing or incorrectly connected assets Maintaining the required quantity of assets for our operations Keeping our asset documentation and internal sheets updated If an Ad Account, Page or another asset develops a problem, you should be able to diagnose the issue, understand what needs to be replaced or repaired and execute the required operational steps according to our SOPs. Important changes and replacements will initially be coordinated and approved with us, but we expect you to handle the operational execution independently. Backup & Infrastructure Management A major responsibility of this position is making sure our advertising operation has sufficient redundancy. You will: Keep track of active and backup assets Identify shortages before they become operational problems Maintain our required asset inventory Prepare replacement assets according to our internal processes Keep the overall Meta infrastructure organized Make sure required connections and permissions are correctly configured Report potential infrastructure risks early The goal is simple: Our advertising operation should never stop because nobody noticed that an asset was missing, incorrectly connected or unavailable. Campaign Operations & Media Buying Media buying experience is still required because you need to understand how the infrastructure is actually used. You will also: Set up campaigns according to our internal sheets and SOPs Upload campaigns into the correct Ad Accounts Check campaigns before scheduled launches Make sure ads are approved, active and spending correctly Monitor campaigns during product tests Follow predefined kill, continue and scale rules Execute budget and campaign changes according to our SOPs Maintain campaign statistics and reporting Identify unusual performance or delivery issues Our testing system follows predefined rules. We therefore don't need someone who constantly wants to reinvent the media buying strategy. We need someone who can execute the system reliably while recognizing when something falls outside the normal process. Required Experience This is not an entry-level position. You should have practical experience managing Facebook / Meta infrastructure and advertising operations. You should be confident with: Meta Business Manager / Business Portfolio Managing multiple Ad Accounts Facebook Pages Pixels / Datasets Domains and asset connections Users, permissions and partner access Troubleshooting Meta asset issues Maintaining backup infrastructure Meta Ads Manager Campaign creation and monitoring Basic campaign scaling and optimization Ecommerce / dropshipping advertising Google Sheets or similar tracking systems Previous experience managing multiple Meta assets simultaneously is especially important. What We're Looking For You are: Highly organized Reliable Detail-oriented Technically confident inside the Meta ecosystem Comfortable managing many assets simultaneously Able to follow SOPs precisely Able to work independently Proactive when infrastructure problems occur Comfortable troubleshooting before immediately asking for help Able to communicate clearly in English We want someone who thinks ahead. If we need a certain number of backup assets next week, we don't want to discover the shortage when we need them. We expect you to recognize the requirement beforehand and communicate or act accordingly. Long-Term Opportunity We are currently operating on a relatively small scale and building the infrastructure for further expansion. As we add more products, markets and advertising operations, the complexity and responsibility of this position will increase. For the right person, this can develop into a long-term Head of Meta Operations / Facebook Asset Management role. The goal is to eventually have someone who can take ownership of our Meta infrastructure and daily advertising operations while coordinating directly with the founder. How to Apply Please answer these questions: Describe your experience managing Meta Business Managers, Ad Accounts, Pages, Pixels/Datasets, Domains and permissions. How many assets have you managed simultaneously? Imagine one of our main Ad Accounts or Pages becomes unavailable shortly before a scheduled campaign launch. Walk us through how you would diagnose the situation, d ---------- what needs to be replaced, connect the required backup assets and make sure the campaign can still launch correctly. How would you organize and monitor a Meta setup with multiple active Ad Accounts, Pages and backup assets so that we always know what is active, what is available as backup and where additional assets are needed? Please also include your previous experience with Meta Ads, ecommerce or dropshipping campaigns. ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION Across both workstreams, you will: Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements. Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence. REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client. Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring. Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters. Meet deadlines without constant follow-up. Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish. Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents. Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone. Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas. Strong spoken and written English. Professional and confident phone presence. Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong organization and follow-through. Own the Complete Client Onboarding Experience - Assume ownership of each new client immediately following contract execution and formal transition from Business Development. - Develop and maintain a comprehensive onboarding plan for every new YLN partner. - Establish clear timelines, milestones, responsibilities, dependencies, and launch dates. - Coordinate all onboarding activity across YLN departments to ensure nothing falls through the cracks. - Maintain real-time visibility into the status of every active onboarding in DOCK. - Proactively identify delays, risks, dependencies, and potential roadblocks before they impact the client or launch date. - Ensure all required onboarding activities are completed before a client or program is approved to go live. - Conduct a formal handoff into ongoing Client & Agent Experience following successful launch. - Own the onboarding of new agents joining existing YLN client partnerships, including coordination of requirements, communication, completion, and readiness. 2. Serve as the face of YLN During Onboarding The Director of Client Onboarding will represent YLN throughout the onboarding process and help establish the client's first operational impression of the organization. Responsibilities include: - Own and coordinate onboarding communication with client stakeholders and participating agents, ensuring a consistent YLN voice and minimizing fragmented or duplicative outreach across departments. - Lead onboarding meetings alongside YLN Leadership, implementation calls, kickoff meetings, status meetings, and launch-readiness reviews. - Partner with the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience on key client meetings, strategic discussions, and escalations when appropriate. - Build confidence with brokerage leadership by demonstrating organization, responsiveness, preparation, and command of the onboarding process. - Gather required information from brokerage leadership and designated client points of contact. - Consolidate questions and requests so clients are not required to independently navigate multiple YLN departments. - Clearly communicate responsibilities, requirements, deadlines, outstanding items, and next steps. - Maintain consistency in YLN's messaging and onboarding standards across clients. The Director should create an onboarding experience in which the client always understands where they are in the process, what happens next, and what is required of them. 3. Manage Up & Drive Cross-Functional Accountability A defining responsibility of this position is the ability to manage up and across the organization. Although the Director reports directly to the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience, onboarding requires participation from numerous YLN departments. The Director is responsible for ensuring that each department delivers its portion of the onboarding process according to established deadlines. The Director will: - Maintain clear ownership and deadlines for every internal onboarding deliverable. - Proactively follow up with department leaders and team members regarding approaching and overdue deliverables. - Communicate risks and potential delays before they impact the client or launch. - Escalate unresolved issues to the Vice President of Client & Agent Experience and/or appropriate YLN leadership when necessary. - Conduct regular internal onboarding status reviews. - Hold participating departments accountable to agreed-upon timelines. - Ensure leadership has appropriate visibility into onboarding progress, risks, and resource constraints. - Create a culture in which onboarding deadlines are treated as organizational commitments rather than individual departmental targets. The Director must be comfortable professionally and respectfully holding individuals accountable regardless of title or department. The Director may not directly supervise every person involved in an onboarding, but the Director owns the timeline and the successful completion of the overall process. 4. Own DOCK as YLN's Onboarding Command Center DOCK will serve as the central platform for managing and communicating the YLN onboarding experience, both externally with clients and internally across YLN. The Director of Client Onboarding will be responsible for ensuring DOCK is consistently maintained, accurate, current, and actively used throughout every onboarding. Client-Facing DOCK Experience The Director will: - Establish and maintain the client-facing DOCK workspace for each new partner. - Ensure clients have a clear, professional, and easy-to-follow onboarding roadmap. - Maintain client-facing onboarding requirements, resources, documents, instructions, timelines, and next steps within DOCK. - Use DOCK to reduce unnecessary emails, repeated questions, and fragmented communication. - Ensure clients understand how to use DOCK and where to locate required onboarding information. - Keep client-facing information current as requirements or milestones change. - Continuously evaluate the DOCK experience from the client's perspective and recommend improvements. Internal DOCK Checklist & Accountability DOCK will also serve as YLN's internal onboarding checklist and accountability system. The Director will: - Maintain the complete internal onboarding checklist for every client. - Assign or document ownership of individual onboarding responsibilities. - Track completion of tasks and milestones across departments. - Ensure deadlines and dependencies are accurately reflected. - Follow up on incomplete or overdue items. - Maintain accurate status information so leadership can quickly understand where each onboarding stands. - Document exceptions, decisions, outstanding issues, and required follow-up. - Ensure internal completion requirements align with what has been communicated externally to the client. If an onboarding task, requirement, deadline, or dependency exists, it should be visible and trackable within DOCK. The Director will also continually improve YLN's master DOCK onboarding template as the organization learns from each implementation. 5. Coordinate Cross-Functional YLN Execution The Director of Client Onboarding will coordinate closely with YLN's: - Client & Agent Experience - Broker Partnerships - Corporate Partnerships - Technology - Marketing - Concierge - Transaction Management - Finance/Accounting - Executive Leadership Each department remains responsible for its respective area of expertise and deliverables. The Director's responsibility is to ensure the right person owns each deliverable, understands the requirement and deadline, and completes it successfully. 6. Manage Technology & Platform Readiness Coordinate with YLN's Technology Team to ensure all required systems, integrations, permissions, and configurations are completed prior to launch, including, as applicable: - Follow Up Boss - Ylopo - RealScout - eRelocation - SkySlope - Mapsly - Trainual - DOCK - YLN reporting and dashboards - Client brokerage systems - Third-party lead-source platforms and integrations The Director will track and manage technology readiness while partnering with Technology for technical configuration, integration, and troubleshooting. 7. Lead Launch Readiness Prior to every client launch, the Director will coordinate a formal readiness review to confirm: - Required client information has been received. - Participating agents have completed required onboarding. - Technology and integrations are operational. - Lead routing has been tested. - Referral agreements and fee structures are documented. - Training has been completed or scheduled. - Client-facing materials and communications are ready. - Reporting requirements have been established. - DOCK's external and internal onboarding requirements are complete and current. - Internal YLN teams understand their responsibilities following launch. - Outstanding risks or exceptions have been identified, documented, and communicated. The Director should be empowered to recommend delaying a launch when critical onboarding requirements have not been satisfied. Qualifications & Experience Required - Strong project management and organizational skills - Exceptional attention to detail - Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously - Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills - Ability to communicate confidently and professionally with brokerage owners, executives, managers, agents, vendors, and YLN leadership - Strong follow-through and personal accountability - Demonstrated ability to manage up and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority - Ability to professionally hold individuals and departments accountable to commitments and deadlines - Comfort working within technology and project-management platforms - Ability to identify potential problems before they affect a client launch - Strong documentation and process-management skills - Ability to work effectively in a fast-growing organization where processes continue to evolve Preferred - Experience in residential real estate, relocation, referral management, brokerage operations, lead management, or related industries - Experience onboarding enterprise or multi-location clients - Experience with CRM, project-management, and lead-management platforms - Experience developing SOPs, implementation plans, workflows, and project-management processes - Previous experience managing or developing team members

title: Full Stack Developer - Internal Tools
description: About us We make cosmetics for women over 45 and sell direct to consumer in the US and Germany. We're launching on Amazon in September. Scheduled jobs syncing Slack and ClickUp, plus MCP servers so our AI agents can query internal data directly. What you need 3+ years shipping full-stack web apps, with work we can look at TypeScript, React or Next.js Postgres, plus Supabase or Firebase including auth and row-level security REST APIs and webhooks, with real experience of rate limits, retries and integrations that fail overnight Deployment, DNS, environment and secret management AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) as part of how you actually work Written English strong enough to run async with a COO in another timezone Nice to have Slack API, ClickUp API, Python for data pipelines, Shopify Admin API, MCP servers, ecommerce or inventory experience. Also: taking over someone else's prototype and making it maintainable without making them feel bad about it. We don't care about degrees, certifications or agency logos. How we work Flexible hours with meaningful overlap with Manila. Written end-of-day updates, work tracked in ClickUp. You'll get requirements from a COO, not a product manager. We'd rather grow it into full-time than hand it to someone else in six months. Outline how you'd move it to a database without losing historical data and without our supply chain manager losing a day of work during the switch. Six sentences is plenty. Applications without the second item won't be read.

title: Bookkeeper
description: We are looking for a detail-oriented Bookkeeper to manage our daily financial records using Quick Books for a US based Construction Company. You will handle Accounts Payable and Receivable, Reconcile Bank statements, and prepare clean reports for our management team. Key Responsibilities Data Entry: Enter bills, invoices, receipts, and payments into Quick Books daily. Reconciliation: Match bank and credit card statements with our internal ledger every month. Accounts Payable (AP): Track vendor bills, schedule timely payments, and resolve billing questions. Accounts Receivable (AR): Send customer invoices, track aging reports, and follow up on late payments. Track employee expense reports. Financial Reporting: Generate monthly profit-and-loss statements, balance sheets, and custom reports. Tax Prep: Organize and share clean financial documents with our CPA at year-end. Required Qualifications Experience: Minimum of 2-4 years of proven bookkeeping experience. Software Skills: Strong, hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or QuickBooks Desktop (certification is a big plus). This is not an entry-level bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can independently manage the books, understand complex transactions, identify discrepancies, perform accurate reconciliations, and explain the financial records clearly without requiring extensive supervision. You will be responsible for managing 15+ financial accounts and processing/reviewing 100+ transactions per month. Core Skills: Solid understanding of general accounting principles, debits, credits, and ledger maintenance. Attention to Detail: High accuracy rate with data entry and a strong ability to spot discrepancies. Communication: Good written and verbal skills to talk with vendors and clients. Preferred Qualifications Associate’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. Experience in Construction accounting is a plus. What We Offer/ Pay Rate: SALARY * Schedule: Part-time / Remote * Hours: Flexible, set you own schedule * Benefits: Paid time off, Health Insurance after a certain time of employment This is a long-term position for someone who is organized, trustworthy, responsive, and comfortable working independently. During the interview process, candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their QuickBooks Online knowledge and explain how they approach reconciliations and bookkeeping problems.

title: Customer Support & Sales Representative - European Aesthetic Clinic (English-speaking clients)
job_title: Customer Support & Sales Representative - European Aesthetic Clinic (English-speaking clients)
description: ABOUT US We are DermLux Laser & Aesthetics - a group of five medical aesthetic clinics in Cyprus (European Union): Paphos, Limassol x2, Nicosia, Larnaca. 14 treatment rooms, around 40 staff. Laser hair removal, advanced facials, injectables. Website: ---------- A growing part of our clientele are English-speaking expats and tourists living in or visiting Cyprus. Our local team handles Greek-speaking clients. We are hiring one person to own the English-speaking side: answering them, advising them, and booking them in. You do NOT need to speak Greek. You will never be asked to. THE ROLE You are the voice and the writing of DermLux for every English-speaking client. - Answer inbound enquiries by phone, WhatsApp, Instagram/Facebook DM and email - Call back new enquiries fast (most of our clients enquire and expect a reply the same day) - Advise on treatments, explain what each one does, handle price questions - Book appointments directly into our system and confirm them - Follow up with clients who did not book yet, and with clients who missed their appointment - Work entirely inside our own software (Base44) - we train you on it This is a phone-and-typing job in equal measure. You will be on calls with British, Russian, Israeli and other English-speaking clients every shift. THIS IS A DEMANDING JOB - PLEASE BE HONEST WITH YOURSELF We are not going to pretend otherwise. The pace is real, the targets are measured, and your numbers are visible every single day. There IS genuine growth here - more hours, more responsibility, more money. But it goes to people who enjoy performing and want to be measured. It does not go to people waiting for the shift to end. If being held to numbers stresses you out, this is the wrong job and you will be unhappy in it. If it motivates you, you will do well here and we will make room for you. HOURS - READ THIS CAREFULLY Monday to Friday: 15:00-20:00 Cyprus time = 20:00-01:00 Manila time (summer) = 21:00-02:00 Manila time (winter, from late October) Weekends: selectively, 4 hours per day when we need cover. Not every weekend. That is 25 hours per week as a baseline, up to 33 hours in weeks with weekend cover. This is an evening/night shift in Manila time. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to it reliably, long-term. It is the single most common reason this kind of role fails. Once you know the job well, more hours are available if you want them. That is a real path, not a vague promise - but it is earned, not given at the start. HOLIDAYS: We work on the Cyprus calendar, not the Philippine calendar. Philippine national holidays are normal working days for us. Cyprus public holidays are your days off. You must be comfortable with this before you apply. PAY $6.00 USD per hour. At 25 hours/week that is approximately $650 USD/month (around PHP 37,000). At 33 hours/week that is approximately $860 USD/month (around PHP 49,000). Paid twice a month by direct bank transfer to your own Philippine bank account. WE pay all the transfer fees. The amount we quote is the amount that lands in your account. PERFORMANCE BONUS - real numbers, not a vague promise +$100 USD in any month where you produce 40 or more qualified booked appointments +$200 USD in any month where you produce 60 or more "Qualified" means the client is actually booked into a slot in our system. Our software counts this automatically and you can see your own running total at any time. It is not a manager's opinion and it is not d ---------- at the end of the month behind closed doors. CHRISTMAS BONUS (13th month) Yes - 8.33% of everything you have earned with us during that year, paid by 24 December. One condition, and we are stating it up front rather than letting you find out later: you must still be working with us at Christmas. If you leave before December, it is not paid. We think that is fair for a bonus that exists to reward the people who stay - but you deserve to know it on day one, not in November. WHAT WE REQUIRE - please be honest, we verify all of it 1. NEAR-PERFECT SPOKEN ENGLISH. This is not negotiable and it is the first thing we screen for. Our clients are native English speakers paying premium prices. A strong accent that makes them ask "sorry, can you repeat that?" costs us the sale. We judge this from your voice recording, not from your written application. 2. At least 3 years in customer support AND sales - not support alone. You must be comfortable asking someone to book and to pay. 3. Reliable fast internet, your own computer, your own headset, and a backup plan for power and internet outages. We do not provide equipment or an internet allowance. Please include a speedtest.net result. 4. A quiet place to take calls. Clients can hear background noise. 5. Reliability across the shift, week after week. This role only works if the phone is answered. NICE TO HAVE (not required, but tell us if you have it): - Experience in an aesthetic clinic, medspa, dermatology or beauty business - Experience selling treatments, packages or memberships - Experience with a CRM or booking system HOW TO APPLY Applications that skip any step below are not read. This is deliberate - it tells us who reads carefully, which is the whole job. STEP 1 - Put the word OLIVE in your subject line. STEP 2 - Answer these three questions, in your own words. Short and specific beats long and general. Q1. A client messages: "I saw your laser package but it's too expensive for me." Write, word for word, exactly what you would reply. Not a summary - the actual message you would send. Q2. From your last support/sales job, give us your real numbers: how many enquiries did you handle per month, how many did you convert, and what percentage of the appointments you booked actually showed up? If you do not know a number, write "I don't know" - that is a perfectly good answer. Making one up is not; we ask about these numbers in the interview and it becomes obvious very quickly. Q3. Open ---------- . Name one specific treatment we offer, and write the first two sentences you would say to a client on the phone who asks about it. STEP 3 - Record a voice or video introduction, 60-90 seconds. Loom, Google Drive, YouTube unlisted - whatever is easiest. In it: a) Say your name and where you are based. b) Read this sentence out loud, exactly as written: "Thank you for calling DermLux, this is [your name]. I can offer you a free consultation this Thursday at five, or Friday at seven. Which one works better for you?" c) Then answer in your own words: why should an English-speaking client in Cyprus trust you on the phone? We ask you to read that specific sentence so we know the recording is new. A recycled generic introduction is an automatic no. STEP 4 - Include your speedtest result, and confirm in one line that you can work 15:00-20:00 Cyprus time and that Philippine holidays are working days. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We read every complete application. Shortlisted candidates get a video interview with the owner. We tell you either way - you will not be left waiting in silence. We are not in a rush. We would rather wait for the right person than fill the seat quickly. If that person is you, this is a long-term position with a company that is growing and that pays on time, every time.

title: Business Automation Analyst
description: Business Automation Analyst | US-Based MSP | 100% Remote | Full-Time If your first instinct when doing something manually is “this shouldn’t be manual” — keep reading. To apply please fill out the application form here: ---------- /bepartofourteam. About the Company We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients. The Role You’re not here to maintain spreadsheets. You’re here to question why the spreadsheet exists — and build the system that makes it unnecessary. We’re looking for a Business Automation Analyst who sees manual work as a problem to be solved, not a process to be managed. You’ll analyze how work gets done across the business, identify what’s slow, repetitive, or error-prone, and build the systems that fix it permanently. Python, advanced Excel, AI-powered workflows, and smart automation tools are your toolkit. The outcome is a business that runs faster, reports more accurately, and depends less on manual effort over time. The Mindset We’re Looking For The best analysts we’ve worked with share a few traits: They see a manual process and immediately ask: “Why is someone doing this by hand — and what would it take to make sure no one ever has to again?” They take ownership. From the moment a process improvement is theirs, it’s theirs until it’s built, documented, and running without them. They think upstream. Instead of asking “how do I make this faster?” they ask “why does this exist, and should it?” They communicate clearly. Progress, blockers, and outcomes are shared openly — before being asked for. They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to. Who Thrives Here People who are operationally sharp, intellectually curious, and genuinely excited by the idea of making a business run better. You don’t need someone to hand you a list of things to automate — you find them yourself. You’re comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful with tools, and you care more about outcomes than staying in your lane. We’re a growing MSP, which means not every process is optimized and not every workflow is documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a gap — it’s the whole point. What You’ll Do You’ll walk into a business that has real operational inefficiencies — manual reports, repetitive data work, processes that exist because “that’s how we’ve always done it.” Your job is to find them, understand them, and systematically eliminate them. That looks like: Mapping workflows that rely on human hands and asking which ones shouldn’t — then building the automations that replace them Building Python scripts, data pipelines, and AI-powered workflows that turn hours of manual work into something that runs itself Creating Excel models and dashboards that give leadership accurate, real-time visibility — not end-of-week summaries compiled by hand Digging into messy, multi-source datasets and producing clean, reliable outputs that people actually trust Documenting everything you build so clearly that someone else could maintain it, improve it, or build on top of it — without asking you a single question Sitting with teams, understanding how they actually work, and translating that into automation solutions that fit the way they operate — not the other way around Continuously looking for the next thing to improve, because the work is never finished — it just gets better What We’re Looking For Strong Python programming skills — you don’t just write scripts that work, you write scripts that others can read, maintain, and build on Advanced Excel expertise (required) — Pivot Tables, Power Query, complex formulas, dashboards, data validation; This is a production role for a proven phone setter who can handle the complete process: respond immediately to fresh inbound leads, make high-volume outbound calls to warm, aged, cold, and reactivation lists, qualify homeowners, handle objections, keep the CRM clean, book accurate appointments, confirm attendance, and protect the sales team's calendar from weak or incomplete bookings. This is not a training-from-zero, chat-only, social-DM-only, data-entry, or general virtual-assistant position. You must already have measurable experience booking qualified appointments by phone. PAY, SCHEDULE, AND REQUIRED INTERVIEW • $6 USD per hour. • Paid monthly, not weekly or biweekly. • Full-time, 40 hours per week. • Monday-Friday, 10:00 AM-7:00 PM Eastern Time (New York time). • This listing does not promise a bonus, commission, automatic raise, or guaranteed promotion. • Qualified applicants must attend the live group interview on Friday, September 4, 2026 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time. • The interview will run for approximately one hour. • Enter through Prosper ---------- ---------- Prosper is building for long-term growth in solar, battery upgrades, home-energy savings, and home services. YOU MUST ALREADY HAVE • At least two years of recent phone appointment-setting, inside-sales, or high-volume call-center experience. • Proven experience with BOTH inbound lead response and outbound, cold, or reactivation calling. • Measurable prior production: daily call volume, qualified appointments per week or month, show rate, and industries served. • Experience using a dialer and CRM. GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Close, or similar systems are relevant. • Strong spoken and written English that U.S. homeowners can easily understand and trust. • Experience qualifying prospects, handling objections, scheduling appointments, confirming attendance, and maintaining clean CRM notes. • A reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, professional headset, quiet workspace, and dependable availability for the Eastern Time schedule. Solar, roofing, HVAC, insurance, real estate, home-improvement, telecommunications, or other U.S. home-services experience is strongly preferred. DO NOT APPLY IF • Your experience is limited to chat, social media, content, data entry, or general virtual-assistant work. • You have not personally worked both inbound and outbound phone leads. • You cannot provide real production numbers from a recent setting role. • You need basic phone-sales training before you can make calls independently. • You cannot work the stated Eastern Time schedule. • You do not accept $6 USD/hour paid monthly. HOW TO APPLY Start the first line of your application exactly: I understand the rate is $6 USD/hour paid monthly, and I can attend Friday, September 4 at 2:00 PM Eastern Time. Then answer all six questions: 1. How many years of inbound and outbound appointment-setting experience do you have? 2. In your most recent role, how many inbound leads did you work per day and how many outbound calls did you make per day? 3. How many qualified appointments did you average per week or month, and what was your show rate? 4. Which dialers and CRMs have you used? 5. Describe one difficult objection you regularly handled and how you moved the conversation forward. 6. Which U.S. industries have you called, and what homeowner or buyer qualification criteria did you use? Include a resume, proof of prior production, and a 90-120 second video audition. Applications without measurable phone-setting evidence or the requested video will not move forward. REQUIRED SETTER VIDEO AUDITION Record one continuous 90-120 second video. Start by stating your name, years of inbound and outbound phone-setting experience, and your most recent verified call and appointment numbers. Then complete this role-play: A U.S. homeowner completed an online form asking about solar. When you call, the homeowner says, “I was just looking, I am busy, and I do not want a sales pitch.” Demonstrate how you would open the call, ask two or three useful qualification questions, respond to the objection, and ask for a scheduled appointment with a closer. Do not read a generic script. We are evaluating tone, listening, control of the conversation, qualification, objection handling, and the clarity of the appointment ask. title: Instagram Carousel Copywriter
description: # Instagram carousel copywriter ---------- We're Digital Wealth Lab. We teach corporate people how to start AI marketing agencies for local businesses, and Bruno's Instagram is where most of that audience comes from. The account works because we skip the guru theater and just show the actual system. We need a writer who can keep it that way while we post more. **This role is carousels. That's it.** Not email sequences. Not landing pages. Not blogs. Not single-image posts with a clever caption. We're hiring someone who specializes in multi-slide Instagram carousels and has the receipts to prove it. Carousels are their own format with their own rules. Slide one has to earn slide two, slide two has to earn slide three, every break is a decision, and the last slide has to convert attention you spent nine slides building. Writing one good line is not the job. Holding a reader across ten of them is. ## The job Daily carousels for Bruno. You draft with our AI system to move fast, then rewrite it line by line until it's actually good. The AI gets you a draft. You write the post. - Daily carousels in Bruno's voice, hook slide through CTA slide - Structure that holds the swipe: one idea per slide, breaks that pull, no dead middle - Hooks that stop the scroll, closing slides that get DMs - QA every post against the voice, the format specs, and our guidelines - Brief the designers so slide copy and slide design aren't fighting each other - Track swipe-through, saves, shares, and DMs — what hits, what flops, what gets flagged — and fix the system off it - Own the lead and growth numbers from organic Reels may come later once you've got the voice down, but carousels are the job and carousels are what we'll judge the work on. ## Who we want Not entry level. This is for someone already good at social who wants a bigger seat: real numbers, daily output, a small team, and a say in how the whole thing runs. You should have: - **A carousel portfolio.** Actual multi-slide posts you wrote, ideally for influencers, coaches, or personal brands. Bonus if it's biz-op, finance, or self-improvement. Send slides, not tweets. - **Run an actual Instagram account day to day.** You've watched your own carousels save and die, and you can explain why. - **Copy you'd defend.** You can pull a reader from slide one to the CTA, and you know a good hook from a bad one without calling a meeting about it. - **A marketer's eye.** Look at a post and tell us whether it's built to grow, to capture leads, or to sell. - **AI already in your workflow.** You prompt Claude or GPT, you call out a weak draft, and you never ship the first thing it hands you. Nice if you've got: theme page or shoutout experience, an info-product or high-ticket background, work for a 100k+ creator, funnels that turn attention into calls or sales, or ghostwriting in someone else's voice. ## Who we're not looking for Being direct so nobody wastes a day on the task: - **Email marketers.** Sequences are a real craft. It isn't this one. - **Single-slide / static post writers.** One graphic and a caption is a different skill. - **Landing page, blog, SEO, or ad copywriters** looking to cross over into social. - **Generalists** whose portfolio is mostly the above with a couple of carousels at the bottom. If that's you, you're probably great at what you do. You're just not who we're after here. ## Two things we won't budge on The voice is Bruno's. If you'd rather write like yourself, you'll hate this. Hours are 4 AM to 12 PM Eastern, Monday to Friday. ## How to apply No test task, no consideration. Finish the whole thing and you'll hear back either way. **1. Five-minute video.** Loom or whatever you've got. Who you are, why this role, why you, how you use AI, and the carousels you've written for creators or brands. **2. The task.** Part 1: Go through Bruno's profile ( ---------- ), research the account, and pitch 5 carousel ideas (hook plus a short outline). No need to write the full posts. Example: > Hook: At 20 I was making $52k at a 9-5. I failed 6 businesses over the next 4 years. Everyone thought I was done. Then one boring AI tool changed everything. > > Outline: Bruno's story and the exact system he ran, with real numbers, named tools, and the math (what the tool costs vs. what the client pays). Part 2: Write out 2 of those 5 as full carousels, slide by slide, as many slides as the idea needs. Draft with AI if you want, but we're paying for your writing, so the final words are yours. If you used AI, send the transcript too. You get 24 to 48 hours once we send the task over. Send us the video, your 5 ideas, the 2 carousels, and the transcript if there is one.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM)
description: Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) Location: Remote (US hours) About OpenCall OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software. We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who can take ownership of our customer relationships and ensure our AI agents are delivering measurable, undeniable value to the medical and dental practices we serve. About the role As a Customer Success Manager at OpenCall, you are the bridge between our multi-location healthcare customers and our engineering/prompt teams. You aren't just doing check-in calls and sending NPS surveys; you are actively managing onboardings, understanding the complexities of medical scheduling, and driving product adoption. You will own the post-sales lifecycle. When a new clinic comes online, you will guide them through deployment, ensuring their intake forms, scheduling rules, and practice quirks are perfectly translated into our system. You will look for optimization and expansion opportunities, and work directly with our Agent Developers to push automation rates higher and drive up booking numbers. Responsibilities - Own the customer lifecycle: Manage the onboarding, adoption, and retention of our medical and dental group partners. You are their primary advocate and point of contact. - Workflow translation: Work with practice administrators to understand their specific operational rules, edge cases, and EHR/PMS integrations, ensuring our deployment team configures an optimal agent. - Data-driven optimization: Review real call data and metrics. If a specific objection-handling flow isn't working for a dental clinic in Ohio, you are the one who flags it, measures the drop-off in booking rates, and coordinates the fix. - Drive retention and expansion: Prove the ROI of OpenCall every single month, enabling the customer to roll out additional locations. You will run monthly and quarterly reviews grounded in hard data: calls handled, hours saved, and appointments booked. - Feedback loop: Act as the voice of the customer to our product and engineering teams. You will help prioritize feature requests and flag drift or friction in live deployments before the customer even notices. What we're looking for - You've managed complex customers and onboardings before. You have 6+ years of experience as a CSM in a B2B SaaS or HealthTech company - Analytical and empirical. You don't just ask customers how they feel; you look at the dashboard. You are comfortable diving into the data to justify your recommendations. - Deep empathy mixed with operational rigor. You stay organized when multiple projects are in flight. You understand that in healthcare workflows, a bad deployment costs real money for real practices, and you know how to manage expectations carefully. - Exceptional communication. You can seamlessly translate highly technical AI concepts to a non-technical front-office manager, and then turn around and translate front-office operational chaos into clear requirements for our engineering team. - Problem-solving mindset. You are proactive. When a customer is struggling, you don't just log a ticket—you dig in, listen to the failed call recordings, and come to the table with a proposed solution. Preferred Qualifications - 6+ years of direct customer success experience - 4+ years of experience in healthcare operations, SaaS, or contact center technology. - 3+ years of hands-on experience with Hubspot or a similar CRM - 4+ years of experience with medical/dental scheduling software and workflows, and you've seen how messy a front desk can get. - 4+ years of experience working alongside technical teams (engineers, product managers, or AI developers) to iterate on a highly technical product. - Prior demonstrated experience and success working with US companies during US business hours. If you are interested in this role, please create a short video (<5 minutes) describing your most challenging customer onboarding and most challenging customer renewal. Include the following details: - The company and customer you were working with - The key stakeholders at the customer and their roles - What was challenging about the onboarding and renewal - What you did to address those challenges

Your job is to help our team develop better awareness of their time — NOT anxiety about a timer. Different people work differently. A designer's day is different from a salesperson's. Experience managing, training or coordinating remote teams is also a PLUS. Previous Toggl experience is NOT required. We can teach software. We're much more interested in finding the RIGHT PERSON. 🌎 WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH We are an entrepreneurial U.S.-based company with a diverse international team. Your responsibility is to ensure that: - requirements are properly understood before work begins; - the correct technical approach has been identified; - work is assigned to the right people; - estimates and timelines are realistic; - blockers and risks are identified early; - developers and specialists remain accountable for delivery; - work is properly QA-tested before release; and - clients receive professional, high-quality work on time. The objective is to create a strong operational layer between clients, the technical team and the founder. 1. Technical Delivery Ownership You will take ownership of delivery across projects involving: - websites and landing pages; - CRM systems; - marketing automation; - forms and conversion funnels; - email and SMS workflows; - APIs and third-party integrations; - webhooks and data flows; - tracking and analytics; - WordPress and other CMS platforms; - paid advertising infrastructure; - internal web applications and tools; and - multi-channel digital campaigns. You will be responsible for taking an incoming requirement and ensuring it becomes a complete, actionable and technically sensible delivery brief. This includes identifying missing information before work is assigned. You should naturally ask questions such as: - What is the objective? - What problem are we solving? - Which website, environment or system is affected? - Is the work taking place in staging or production? - What URLs, assets and credentials are required? - What systems or workflows does this interact with? - What are the dependencies? - What are the acceptance criteria? - How will the work be tested? - What does "complete" actually mean? 2. Practical Technical Capability – Essential This is a technically hands-on delivery role. You do not need to be employed as a full-time software developer, but you must have strong, current practical experience working with web, CRM and automation systems. You should be comfortable personally: - working inside WordPress or comparable CMS platforms; - building or editing websites and landing pages; - building forms and multi-step conversion funnels; - configuring CRM fields, pipelines, stages and records; - building and reviewing workflows, triggers and automated journeys; - working with email and SMS automation; - understanding and troubleshooting webhooks and APIs; - understanding how data moves between systems; - working with staging and production environments; - understanding domains, DNS, hosting and deployment basics; - reviewing technical architecture and implementation diagrams; - diagnosing website, funnel and workflow problems; - testing technical solutions before release; - understanding tracking pixels, conversion events and analytics; - reviewing responsive behaviour across desktop and mobile; - identifying obvious accessibility and usability issues; and - challenging technical estimates where the proposed effort does not appear proportionate to the work. You are not expected to replace our software engineers. You are expected to understand their work sufficiently well to manage it intelligently, challenge it where necessary and make informed delivery decisions. If your recent technical experience consists primarily of managing developers who perform this work for you, rather than personally working with these types of systems, this role is unlikely to be suitable. 3. Agency Delivery Experience – Essential You must have significant experience working in a digital agency, web agency, marketing agency, technology agency or comparable multi-client delivery environment. We are not looking for someone whose experience has only been managing one internal product or one internal engineering team. Agency delivery requires a different discipline. You must be comfortable managing: - multiple clients simultaneously; - competing priorities; - frequent incoming requests; - scope changes; - short-turnaround work alongside larger projects; - different technical environments; - client deadlines; - resource conflicts; - retained client relationships; and - difficult conversations when a request cannot be delivered as originally expected. You should understand that clients often know what they want to achieve, but may not know what needs to be built technically. Part of your job is to establish the difference. 4. Client Leadership You will act as a senior delivery contact for clients. Responsibilities include: - understanding incoming client requirements; - identifying incomplete or technically problematic requests; - leading delivery discussions; - explaining technical issues in clear non-technical language; - providing confident progress updates; - managing expectations; - challenging poor-quality assets or unsuitable approaches; - controlling scope; - negotiating realistic delivery timescales; - handling difficult conversations professionally; and - escalating only when senior involvement is genuinely required. You must be comfortable saying no, not yet, or we recommend a different approach when the evidence supports it. 5. Team Leadership You will coordinate and manage work across a multidisciplinary remote team including: - software engineers; - automation specialists; - web specialists; - designers; - paid media specialists; - writers and editors; - client success personnel; and - external specialists where required. You will be expected to: - allocate work effectively; - establish clear ownership; - confirm that briefs are understood; - monitor delivery; - remove blockers; - challenge unreasonable estimates; - identify under-performance; - maintain delivery momentum; - enforce agreed deadlines; - prevent individuals from silently moving committed delivery dates; - escalate risks early; and - ensure team members remain accountable for their work. Being supportive and being accountable are not opposites. We expect both. 6. Quality Assurance A task is not complete simply because the person assigned to it says it is complete. You will help protect the quality of everything Mediatasks delivers. You should be comfortable personally reviewing work and asking: - Does it actually work? - Does it meet the brief? - Does it look professional? - Does it work on mobile? - Are the correct branding and assets being used? - Are forms and workflows behaving correctly? - Is data going to the correct place? - Are emails and SMS messages being triggered correctly? - Are links and URLs correct? - Are tracking and analytics functioning? - Are there obvious accessibility problems? - Is this genuinely ready to put in front of the client? We expect a high standard of judgement, not simply checklist completion. If something technically satisfies a brief but produces a poor client or user experience, we expect you to identify it and challenge it. 7. Delivery Systems & Operations You will oversee our project delivery system and production pipeline. Responsibilities include: - project intake and triage; - backlog prioritisation; - sprint and capacity planning; - resource allocation; - due-date management; - dependency management; - risk identification; - delivery forecasting; - QA and release controls; - delivery documentation; and - continuous process improvement. We use a combination of project management systems, Slack, Google Workspace and AI-assisted operational tools. Routine project administration is increasingly automated. We therefore want the Technical Delivery Manager spending their time on judgement, decisions, problem solving, prioritisation, quality and leadership rather than simply updating task statuses. 8. Capacity & Commercial Awareness You must understand the commercial consequences of delivery decisions. This includes: - estimating whether the team has capacity to accept new work; - understanding the impact of inserting urgent work; - identifying when one priority must move to accommodate another; - protecting project scope; - identifying unnecessary complexity; - preventing avoidable rework; - protecting delivery margin; and - identifying when a client's requested solution is disproportionate to the underlying problem. We want someone who can distinguish between a task requiring 30 minutes, three hours or three days — and who knows when to challenge an estimate. Required Experience You should have: - 6+ years' experience in technical project, delivery, product or digital operations roles; - strong experience in a digital, web, marketing or technology agency environment; - hands-on experience with websites, CMS platforms, CRM and automation systems; - experience managing multiple concurrent client projects; - experience leading remote multidisciplinary teams; - strong experience working directly with developers and technical specialists; - experience being a primary client-facing delivery lead; - experience with QA and release management; - strong commercial awareness; - experience managing capacity, priorities and scope; and - a proven ability to challenge clients and team members professionally when required. Previous software engineering, web development, automation, solutions architecture or similarly technical experience is highly desirable. Technologies & Platforms You do not need experience with every platform we use. However, relevant experience may include: - WordPress or comparable CMS platforms; - HubSpot, Salesforce, or GoHighLevel or comparable CRM/marketing automation platforms; - Zapier; - Make; - APIs and webhooks; - AWS or comparable cloud platforms; - HTML/CSS; - JavaScript; - analytics and tracking platforms; - Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Monday, Trello, Nifty or similar; - Slack; - Google Workspace; and - AI-assisted development and productivity tools. We care more about your understanding of how systems fit together than whether you happen to know one particular piece of software. Remote Leadership Requirements You must have: - excellent written and spoken English; - confidence communicating with UK-based clients and senior stakeholders; - excellent attention to detail; - strong written documentation skills; - the ability to work effectively with distributed teams; - the confidence to make decisions independently; and - the discipline required to manage multiple active projects remotely. Ideal Candidate You are: - technical expert; - hands-on; - highly accountable; - calm under pressure; - decisive; - commercially aware; - process-driven without being bureaucratic; - extremely attentive to detail; - comfortable challenging developers; - comfortable challenging clients; - capable of making sensible decisions with incomplete information; - interested in improving systems rather than merely operating them; and - someone who takes genuine ownership of delivery. You should naturally notice when something doesn't look right, doesn't work properly, is taking too long or doesn't make technical sense. And then do something about it. Why Join Us - Senior role with genuine ownership. - Work across web, CRM, automation, software and digital marketing. - Exposure to sophisticated professional-services projects. - Highly varied technical and commercial work. - AI-enabled operating environment. - Opportunity to improve and shape the delivery function. - Long-term opportunity for increased responsibility. Compensation $20–30 USD per hour depending on experience and technical capability. 30–40 hours per week. Long-term position. The upper end of the range is intended for candidates who can demonstrate strong current technical capability alongside senior delivery leadership. Recruitment Process Please send: - your CV in PDF format; - a short note explaining why your technical and agency delivery experience makes you suitable for this role; and - optionally, a short Loom video introducing yourself. Important Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical technical delivery assessment. This is not primarily a coding test. It may involve: - reviewing an incomplete technical brief; - identifying missing requirements; - reviewing a website or funnel; - explaining a CRM or automation workflow; - diagnosing a delivery problem; - reviewing a simple technical architecture; - assessing completed work against QA standards; or - challenging a technical estimate. If you are not comfortable being practically assessed on web, CRM and automation delivery, please do not apply. Applications that do not follow the application instructions will not progress. Required Skills & Qualifications -Prior experience in healthcare intake, referral coordination, medical office administration, or home health/rehab scheduling preferred. -Excellent written communication skills; comfortable managing a high volume of email correspondence professionally and efficiently. -Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask across many simultaneous, time-sensitive referrals. Experience with (or ability to quickly learn) EMR/EHR systems. -Comfortable using Slack and RingCentral (or similar messaging/VoIP platforms) for internal and clinician communication. -Familiarity with therapy disciplines (PT, OT, ST, PTA, COTA) and home health referral processes is a strong plus. -Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy in data entry. -Able to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and respond quickly during business hours. title: SEO Specialist
description: SEO Strategist, Long-Term Freelance Support (30 hrs/week, UK Hours) I'm a freelance SEO consultant with a portfolio of client accounts. There's more work than I can do alone, so I'm hiring an SEO specialist to assist long term. I own the client relationships and I'll be delegating work to you. You won't have direct client contact, but everything you produce goes out under my name. I need someone I can trust with that, and who's comfortable working across several accounts quietly in the background. You'd work with me, and one other freelancer. As trust builds, you'd take on more responsibility rather than more visibility. The role stays behind the scenes. You'd be doing most of this work yourself. Writers, off-page specialists and designers handle their own parts, and you'd brief and QA them, but the SEO thinking and the bulk of the execution sits with you. Once a plan is agreed I need you to run with it and come to me when something needs a decision. THE TERMS - $600/month to start, reviewed on performance (negotiable for the right candidate) - 30 hours/week, Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm UK time. The UK changes clocks and the Philippines doesn't, so: late March to late October is 4pm to 10pm Manila; late October to late March is 5pm to 11pm Manila - 10 to 20 paid days off per year, agreed in advance - Good chance of moving to 40 hours a week with a pay increase if it goes well - All tools provided. Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, Monday, AI subscriptions, everything you need. Some work runs through my own systems, which I'll set up and walk you through - Long term. I'm hiring one person to grow with, not covering a short-term gap Please read the hours carefully. This is an evening shift in the Philippines. If that doesn't suit your life, this isn't the right job. WHAT YOU'D BE DOING - Research and strategy. Keyword research and keyword clustering; search intent mapping; competitor and SERP analysis; topic and content gap analysis; building the roadmap for each account. - On-page and content. Detailed content briefs a writer can execute without coming back with questions; QAing and editing drafts; title tags, meta descriptions and heading structure; content calendars; diagnosing decayed pages and running the refresh. - Internal linking. Building internal linking maps; finding orphaned pages and wasted equity; anchor text planning; implementing the links. - Technical SEO. Screaming Frog crawls and audits; indexation, crawlability and site structure; redirect mapping; schema; turning findings into prioritised fix lists and implementing what you can yourself. - Off-page. Backlink analysis and competitor gap analysis; link prospecting; briefing off-page specialists on targets and anchors; Reddit seeding. - Conversion. Landing page and sales page audits; recommendations on structure, copy, forms and CTAs. - Reporting. Turning GA4, Search Console and Ahrefs data into monthly reporting and clear slide decks that explain what happened and why. Looker Studio or similar experience preferable. - Local SEO. Google Business Profile optimisation and posting. - AI search (AEO/GEO). Some work on visibility in ChatGPT, Perplexity and AI Overviews. - Managing the moving parts. Planning across several accounts in Monday or simialr PM tool, briefing writers, off-page specialists and designers, chasing delivery, and QAing everything before it reaches a client. You are the quality bar on anything that goes out. WHAT YOU NEED Non-negotiable - Communication skills. Great communication is essential. This is how we collaborate and work well together. - Hands-on SEO. You do the work yourself: research, audits, on-page, internal linking, reporting. This is not an oversight role. - Ahrefs. This is the tool we live in. - Search Console and GA4. Enough to find cause and effect, not just export a report. - Sheets or Excel, and Slides. Lookups, pivots, messy exports, and decks that read clearly. - Written English. You'll brief and edit content, and draft things that go to clients under my name. Excellent, not passable. - Organisation. Running several accounts at once without dropping things, and briefing and QAing the specialists who handle content, links and design. - Proactivity. You take an agreed plan and run with it. You raise problems early instead of letting them surface later. - Reliable, fast internet and a machine that can handle screen-sharing and remote sessions. Genuinely essential, not boilerplate. - Systems thinking. When doing your work, you think 'how could we improve this process, or make it better, faster and easier next time'. Preferred - Monday or a similar project management tool, Screaming Frog, a CMS (WordPress or similar), Claude or ChatGPT daily. Hands-on experience matters more to me than years on a CV. Agency experience across several accounts is a strong plus. HOW YOU WORK - You enjoy working with numbers and can explain what's driving a change, not just report that it happened. - You check figures before you use them. If a number looks off, you find out why. - You highlight when something's wrong rather than quietly working around it. - You're comfortable doing excellent work you don't get public credit for. - You handle client data and access carefully. - You build systems, not just output. We already have a lot of SOPs and templates, and I want someone who adds to them. The more we document, the easier your job gets. AI, LLMS AND AUTOMATION I want someone building with it, not just chatting to it. If you're doing the same task two or three times, I want you thinking about how to make the next time faster: prompt engineering, custom projects, reusable workflows, small automations. You don't need to be there already, but you should want to get there. There's genuine room to learn here, and I can provide a Udemy subscription or similar if you want to go deeper on AI. The other half of that: you own everything you send me. If you can't explain and defend the work, AI has slowed you down rather than sped you up. Using AI well means clear, detailed prompting up front, then careful QAing, checking and refining of what comes back. I support the use of AI, but we are responsible for what it produces. HIRING PROCESS - Apply. Send a CV plus a 2-minute Loom (details below). **APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO AND CV WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED - SO PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU SEND THESE IN YOUR INITIAL MESSAGE** - Paid task. If you progress to this stage, a realistic piece of work. $40, paid to everyone who completes and submits it, whether or not you're offered the role. Runs Thursday 10 September and takes 4 to 6 hours. If that date doesn't work, apply anyway and tell me which dates you're available. I can be flexible between 7 and 11 September. - Follow-up questions, answered by video. - Final stage interview. - Offer. Because of the access involved, I'll ask for two contactable references, a signed NDA (non-disclosure agreement) and a copy of your government ID at this stage. I'll do the same in reverse so you know exactly who you're working with. TO APPLY Send your CV and a 2-minute Loom video (any video recording is fine), camera on, covering: - Who you are and your SEO background. Detail and depth matter here. - Specific projects or examples you're proud of, and specifically what you did on them. - One question you'd want to ask me about this role. Send the Loom video link and CV via a Google Drive link, with sharing set to 'anyone with the link can view'. **APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A VIDEO AND CV WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED - SO PLEASE MAKE SURE YOU SEND THESE IN YOUR INITIAL MESSAGE** Applications without a Loom won't be reviewed.
