title: Product Development & Sourcing Manager
description: About AUGO Take life to go. That’s what AUGO is about. For the mom whose back door is always open with kids and dogs running through. For the off-roader strapping his ATV onto the truck. For families, adventurers, and everyone in between — AUGO is built to come with you. We’re a family-owned US e-commerce brand selling durable, practical products across home and outdoor categories — including our magnetic screen doors and retractable ratchet straps. We’ve built a strong Amazon business with thousands of 5-star reviews, selling across Amazon US and Europe, Walmart, and TikTok Shop. We grow by launching new products. To do that at the pace we want, we need someone who can build them. The Role We’re looking for a Product Development & Sourcing Specialist to own everything between a product idea and a product that’s ready to launch. The ideas are not the problem — we have more of them than we can execute. The problem is the middle: turning a direction into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification, finding the right factories, getting real quotes back, driving samples to a decision, and getting the product ready to go live on Amazon. Our target is ten new products live every quarter. You are the person who makes that possible. You’ll take a product idea and rough direction from our Head of R&D and carry it through specs, sourcing, quotes, negotiation, samples, and the product-side setup of the listing. You’ll direct our existing sourcing agent and deal with factories yourself. This is not an assistant role. You are not waiting for instructions — you are the person who makes sure nothing sits. Full-time. Reports directly to our Head of R&D. What You’ll Own Product Specs & Details Develop detailed, brand-aligned product specifications — materials, colours, comfort, construction, and the features that differentiate the product — while meeting target costs, competitive pricing, and product-appropriate shipping dimensions. The Amazon size tier gets confirmed before the design is frozen, because half an inch changes the fee. A complete spec pack within 1–2 days of approval, written so a factory can quote from it unchanged. Manufacturer Search Go wide, then narrow. Work Alibaba, 1688 and other channels to find and approach a large pool of factories, verify capability and capacity, and bring it down to a shortlist worth quoting. 5–8 strong, verified suppliers for each approved product within 3–5 business days. Pricing, Landed Cost & Negotiation Take the shortlist to real numbers. Negotiate, calculate landed cost per unit, and tell us whether the margin works. Not a quote-forwarder — the person who knows whether the number is good and pushes until it is. Best realistic price, MOQ, lead time, payment terms and packaging all confirmed before sample approval. Quotes collected within 2–3 days. Supplier Follow-Up Suppliers go quiet. The job is to not let that stop anything. No supplier question sits unanswered. Follow-ups happen daily until resolved. Samples Through to a Decision Order samples from the shortlist, track them, compare them against the spec, and run the revision rounds through to a final answer. Samples ordered within 1–2 days of a decision to sample. Every change documented, every sample driven to a written approval or rejection. Product Setup & Launch Readiness Create and manage UPC, SKU, FNSKU and QR codes. Own packaging, inserts, warnings and labelling to AUGO’s established standards. Confirm packaging and FBA dimensions directly with the factory. Direct product images, A+ content and video — the person who knows the product’s specs and materials briefs the creative. Organised Data & Reporting Every product has a clear supplier comparison showing company quality, quote, specs, risks, open questions and a recommendation. An end-of-day report every working day, a weekly scorecard and KPIs, and daily contact with the Head of R&D. Nobody should ever have to ask you where a product stands. What Success Looks Like • Spec packs complete in 1–2 days and good enough to quote from unchanged • 5–8 verified suppliers per product within 3–5 business days • Landed cost per unit calculated for every finalist and presented side by side • Every sample reaching a written decision against the spec — nothing sitting in a box • Products moving through the pipeline without being chased • The Head of R&D’s time spent on sourcing and specs measurably down 30 / 60 / 90 Day Plan First 30 Days — Learn the Products and the System • Learn AUGO’s catalogue, the two hero products, and the pipeline end to end • Meet the sourcing agent and our active factories • Learn our spec format and rebuild one existing product’s spec pack from scratch • Understand FBA size tiers as they apply to our actual SKUs • Shadow a live product through at least two stages • The end-of-day report starts on day one Days 31–60 — Take the Work • Own the specs outright. Take the product idea and direction from our Head of R&D and turn it into a complete, manufacturer-ready specification: materials and their grades, real-world dimensions and tolerances, construction and how each feature is actually built, colourways and finishes, packaging, inserts and labelling. • Do the work behind the spec. A direction is not a specification. You research what you don’t know, work out the parts nobody has worked out yet, and come back with something that can actually be built — and defend how you got there. • Catch the dimensional problems before the design is frozen, including the half inch that moves us into a worse FBA size tier. • Run a full search-to-shortlist cycle alone across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels — approaching factories, verifying capability and capacity, narrowing to a shortlist worth quoting. • Send RFQs, chase quotes to completion, and build the supplier comparison with landed cost per unit — without help • Reporting is running and nobody has to ask for it Days 61–90 — Own It • Carry products from approval to approved sample with no chasing • Five to six products launched or launch-ready against forecast • Clear supplier and cost documentation in place • A credible pipeline toward the ten-product quarterly goal Required Experience • Hands-on product sourcing experience — you’ve found factories yourself across Alibaba, 1688 or other channels, engaged suppliers directly, requested and compared meaningful quotes, and argued about MOQ and unit price. This is not a role for someone who has only “worked with suppliers.” • Experience taking a physical product from idea through to production • Managed a supplier relationship through at least one full production run • E-commerce experience — Amazon private label strongly preferred • Amazon Seller Central experience preferred, not required Requirements Required Skills • Sourcing. Sources efficiently across Alibaba, 1688 and other channels. Identifies and engages reliable suppliers. Requests and compares meaningful quotes. • Amazon listing literacy. You read a listing the way a seller does, not the way a shopper does — pulling dimensions, materials, construction and packaging detail off competitor listings and feeding it back into a spec. • Numeracy, genuinely. Margins, landed cost per unit, freight allocated per unit, CBM, percentages, FBA size tiers and dimensional weight. This job is arithmetic every day. • Clear written specifications — appropriately phased, without unnecessary complexity, and without simply transferring supplier listings into a spreadsheet. • Strong written English. You’ll report daily in writing and negotiate with factories in writing. • Reliable computer and internet connection, and daily overlap with our Head of R&D. Who You Are • You figure things out. The idea and the direction come from our Head of R&D. Turning that into a real product — every part nobody has worked out yet — is on you. You go and find out rather than assume, you’re resourceful about how you get there, and what you come back with holds up. • Follow-through is your identity. You chase without being told to. • You push back on a first price. A quote is an opening position, not an answer. • Detail-oriented where it costs money — you catch a spec error before it becomes 2,000 defective units. • You balance quality, differentiation, cost and shipping practicality rather than optimising one and breaking the others. • Comfortable owning a pipeline, not just completing tasks handed to you. • Direct communicator. You flag a delay before it becomes one. What We’ll Teach You Our brand standards, product point of view, customer preferences, target price architecture, and the specific qualities that make a product right for our brand. Also the Amazon fee schedules and calculators, our spec templates, our existing suppliers and sourcing agent, and our internal tools and reporting rhythm. We’re hiring for sourcing instinct and follow-through. The rest we can hand over. Benefits Benefits & Culture — Why You’ll Thrive at AUGO Real Ownership You run the product pipeline, not a task list. From spec to launch-ready, the product is yours. Direct Line to Decision-Makers You’ll work daily with our Head of R&D. No committees, no waiting weeks for an answer. Paid Onboarding We invest in training you properly rather than throwing you at the deep end on day one. Your Work Is Visible Every product you bring through shows up as a live listing with your fingerprints on it. A Brand with Proven Traction Thousands of 5-star reviews on Amazon. We’re not asking you to build from zero — we’re asking you to help us build faster. Room to Grow The product line and the team are both growing. So is this role. Performance-Based Raises Reviewed after 90 days, then annually. Fully Remote Work from wherever you’re most productive. We review applications within 48 hours and reach out to qualified candidates for next steps.

title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist – U.S. Bathroom Renovations
job_title: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist – U.S. Bathroom Renovations
description: Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist – U.S. Bathroom Renovations Gold Standard Bathrooms is a growing U.S.-based bathroom remodeling company looking for an experienced, motivated, and dependable Appointment Setter / Inside Sales Specialist to join our team remotely. This is NOT a general Virtual Assistant or administrative position. This is a sales and appointment-setting position. Your primary responsibility will be to contact new and existing homeowner leads, qualify their bathroom remodeling needs, handle initial objections, and book qualified in-home consultation appointments for our sales team. We generate leads through Facebook, Instagram, our website, advertising campaigns, referrals, and other marketing sources. Many of the people you will contact have already expressed interest in remodeling their bathroom. Your job is to turn that interest into a qualified appointment that actually takes place. WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING Your daily responsibilities will include: * Contacting new inbound leads quickly by phone and text * Calling homeowners who submit Facebook and Instagram lead forms * Calling website inquiries * Following up with leads who do not initially respond * Qualifying homeowners before scheduling appointments * Learning what the homeowner wants to accomplish with their bathroom * Determining whether they are interested in a shower replacement, bathtub replacement, tub-to-shower conversion, or larger bathroom renovation * Confirming the homeowner is within our service area * Determining the homeowner’s approximate project timeframe * Asking appropriate qualification questions while keeping the conversation friendly and natural * Explaining our free in-home consultation and what homeowners can expect * Building value and excitement around the consultation * Handling common objections professionally * Asking for the appointment and confidently moving the homeowner toward scheduling * Scheduling appointments directly into our calendar/CRM * Confirming all homeowners/decision-makers involved with the project can be present for the consultation * Sending appointment confirmations * Calling and texting customers before appointments to reduce cancellations and no-shows * Rescheduling canceled appointments * Following up consistently with leads until a clear disposition is reached * Re-engaging older leads that never scheduled * Maintaining accurate notes, statuses, and follow-up tasks in our CRM * Keeping our sales representatives’ calendars filled with qualified appointments THIS IS A SALES POSITION We want to be very clear about what we’re looking for. We do not want someone who simply answers the phone and schedules whichever time a customer requests. We want an inside-sales professional who knows how to convert leads into appointments. You must be comfortable: * Speaking with U.S. homeowners every day * Making a high volume of outbound calls * Responding quickly to new inbound leads * Asking qualification questions * Building rapport quickly * Controlling a phone conversation professionally * Handling objections * Following a proven script/process * Sounding natural instead of reading word-for-word from a script * Asking confidently for the appointment * Following up multiple times * Hearing “no” without becoming discouraged * Turning “maybe later” into an appointment when appropriate * Being held accountable for measurable results You should be friendly, professional, persistent, competitive, and results-driven. COMMON OBJECTIONS YOU WILL NEED TO HANDLE You should be comfortable responding naturally to homeowners who say things such as: * “I’m just looking for a price.” * “How much does it cost?” * “I’m getting several estimates.” * “I need to talk to my spouse.” * “Just send me some information.” * “I’m not ready yet.” * “I’ll call you back.” * “I’m just researching.” * “I don’t know when I want to do it.” Your goal is not to pressure homeowners. Your goal is to understand their needs, explain the value of the consultation, answer basic questions, and confidently ask for the appointment. EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR Previous experience with U.S. customers is strongly preferred. Ideal candidates will have experience in one or more of the following: * Appointment setting * Inside sales * Phone sales * Outbound calling * Inbound lead conversion * Lead qualification * Telemarketing * Home improvement * Bathroom remodeling * Roofing * Windows and doors * HVAC * Solar * Kitchen remodeling * Flooring * Construction * Other high-ticket U.S. home services Previous U.S. home-improvement or home-services appointment-setting experience is a major plus. We especially value candidates who have experience converting Facebook, Instagram, website, or other inbound internet leads into appointments. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS You should have: * Excellent spoken and written English * Clear, confident, easy-to-understand phone communication * Professional phone presence * Strong listening skills * Confidence speaking with U.S. homeowners * Previous appointment-setting, telemarketing, inside-sales, or phone-sales experience * Strong objection-handling skills * Ability to follow scripts, systems, and processes * Ability to sound conversational rather than robotic * Strong organizational skills * Accurate CRM/data-entry habits * Excellent follow-up skills * Reliable attendance * Strong work ethic * Ability to work independently * Ability to accept coaching and feedback * Stable high-speed internet * Reliable computer * Quality headset * Quiet and professional work environment * Backup internet and/or power solution strongly preferred WORKING HOURS This is a full-time position — minimum of 40 hours per week. You MUST be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) because you will be communicating directly with homeowners in the United States. Typical Schedule: Monday–Friday during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Some Saturday and Sunday availability WILL be REQUIRED depending on lead volume and appointment demand. Reliability is extremely important. We invest heavily in generating new homeowner leads, and speed-to-lead matters. When someone submits an inquiry, we want them contacted as quickly as possible. This is intended to be a long-term, dedicated position. We are looking for someone who wants to become part of our team and grow with the company. CRM & SOFTWARE Experience with any of the following is a plus: * GoHighLevel / HighLevel * LeadConnector * CRM systems * Online scheduling systems * Phone dialers * SMS/texting platforms * Facebook lead management If you have strong appointment-setting experience but haven’t used our exact software, we can train you on our systems. COMPENSATION Starting Base Pay: $6–$8 USD per hour depending on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability. In addition to your hourly pay, you will have the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses. PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES * $10 bonus for each properly qualified appointment that successfully sits/completes * Additional $25 bonus when your appointment results in a completed sale * Additional performance bonuses may be available for consistently exceeding company goals For example: A properly qualified appointment that takes place: +$10 bonus If that same appointment results in a sale: +$25 additional bonus That means an appointment that sits and sells can earn you $35 in bonuses, in addition to your regular hourly pay. We intentionally reward quality appointments, not simply the number of appointments placed on the calendar. HOW PERFORMANCE WILL BE MEASURED This is a performance-driven position. We will track metrics including: * Speed-to-lead * Number of outbound calls * Number of leads contacted * Contact rate * Appointments booked * Qualification rate * Appointment booking rate * Appointment confirmation rate * Appointment show/sit rate * Cancellation and no-show rate * Sales resulting from your appointments * Follow-up activity * CRM accuracy Quality matters just as much as quantity. Putting an unqualified homeowner on the calendar simply to increase your appointment count does not help you or the company. We want homeowners who understand why we are coming to their home, have a legitimate bathroom remodeling project, have been properly qualified, and are expecting our consultation. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE A successful person in this position does not call a new lead once and give up. If a new lead doesn’t answer, you follow our contact process. You call again. You send a text. You follow up. You try different appropriate times. You keep detailed notes. You work older leads when new leads are caught up. You confirm upcoming appointments. You work canceled appointments. You re-engage homeowners who previously said they weren’t ready. You consistently look for opportunities throughout our lead database. Your goal is simple: Keep our sales representatives in front of qualified homeowners who are genuinely interested in remodeling their bathrooms. GROWTH OPPORTUNITY We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity, not a temporary freelance project. Strong performance, reliability, and consistently producing quality appointments can lead to: * Increased hourly compensation * Additional performance bonuses * Increased responsibility * Leadership opportunities as our inside-sales team grows We want to build a strong appointment-setting operation and would like the right person to grow with us. HOW TO APPLY Please read this carefully. At the very beginning of your application, write: GOLD STANDARD If those words are not at the beginning of your application, we will assume you did not read the entire posting. Please answer ALL of the following: 1. Describe your previous appointment-setting and inside-sales experience. 2. Have you previously called U.S. customers? If yes, for what type of company? 3. Have you worked for a U.S. home-improvement or home-services company? If yes, tell us the industry and what your responsibilities were. 4. How many outbound calls are you comfortable making during a typical workday? 5. What CRM systems have you previously used? 6. Have you used GoHighLevel or LeadConnector before? 7. Tell us how you would respond to this homeowner: “I’m interested in remodeling my shower, but I’m really just looking for a price right now.” 8. A new Facebook lead comes in and you call them immediately, but they don’t answer. What would you do next? 9. Are you available to work approximately 40 hours per week during U.S. Eastern Time hours? 10. Are you comfortable with performance metrics and being held accountable for appointment quality and results? VOICE RECORDING REQUIRED Please provide a short voice recording introducing yourself. In your recording, tell us: * Your name * Your previous appointment-setting/sales experience * Your experience speaking with U.S. customers * Why you believe you would be successful in this position Applications without a voice recording will not be considered. We are specifically evaluating your English fluency, communication skills, confidence, professionalism, and ability to communicate naturally with U.S. homeowners. FINAL NOTE We are looking for someone who is: Confident. Persistent. Dependable. Organized. Coachable. Competitive. Results-driven. If you’re looking for a basic administrative VA position, this probably isn’t the right opportunity. If you enjoy speaking with customers, know how to handle objections, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone, understand that follow-up creates opportunities, and want your performance to directly increase your earnings, we want to hear from you. We are looking for the right person to become a long-term part of the Gold Standard Bathrooms team.

description: Compensation: $200–$250 USD per week to start Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours per week Location: Remote Position: Direct hire — individual applicants only About the Position We are looking for a talented full-time video editor to work directly with us and become a long-term part of our team. Our goal is simple: We provide the raw footage. You turn it into polished, engaging, ready-to-post content. We produce content for both a growing service business and a personal/business brand. Our videos cover entrepreneurship, leadership, business, education, behind-the-scenes content, our team, and the services our company provides. Most of our content will be short-form videos for: Instagram Reels Facebook Reels TikTok YouTube Shorts LinkedIn Other social platforms We also plan to increase our longer-form video content over time. DIRECT HIRE ONLY — PLEASE READ This is extremely important. We want to hire and work directly with the person who will actually be editing our videos. Please DO NOT apply if: You are an agency You represent a team of editors You intend to subcontract the work You intend to outsource any of our editing Someone else will actually be completing the editing You are looking to manage the account while another person performs the work The person who applies, interviews, and completes our editing test must be the same person who will be working with us and editing our content. We will be working very closely together. Over time, we expect our editor to learn our brands, personalities, editing preferences, content style, and what we like and don't like. Our goal is to develop a relationship where we can eventually provide raw footage and trust you to know how to turn it into a great finished video without needing detailed instructions every time. We are looking for a long-term team member, not a freelancer for a few projects. Your Primary Responsibility This is a VIDEO EDITING position. It is NOT primarily: Social media management Virtual assistance Graphic design Administrative work Content scheduling Those skills are fine to have, but they are not why we are hiring you. Your strongest skill should be video editing. If video editing is simply one of many different services you provide, this probably isn't the right position. What You'll Be Doing Your responsibilities will include: Taking raw footage and turning it into finished short-form videos Editing videos typically between 30–90 seconds Finding the strongest opening/hook Removing dead space, mistakes, repetition, and unnecessary content Improving pacing and viewer retention Creating clean, professional captions Adding punch-ins, zooms, movement, and transitions where appropriate Adding B-roll when it improves the story Adding music and sound effects when appropriate Cleaning up and balancing audio Performing basic color correction Formatting content correctly for vertical 9:16 social platforms Following established branding and editing standards Organizing project files and completed videos Making revisions when necessary Eventually reviewing longer recordings and identifying multiple strong short-form clips on your own We do NOT want every video filled with effects, animations, emojis, or unnecessary transitions. Our style should feel clean, modern, professional, natural, and engaging. Good editing should improve the content without making the editing itself the focus. What We're Looking For We want someone who: Has demonstrated short-form video editing ability Understands modern Reels, Shorts, and TikTok editing Understands hooks and viewer retention Has excellent pacing Can recognize the strongest parts of raw footage Has good creative judgment Can follow an established editing style Can eventually work without detailed instructions on every video Communicates clearly Is dependable Meets deadlines Is organized Responds well to feedback Wants to continuously improve You should be comfortable working with software such as: CapCut Adobe Premiere Pro DaVinci Resolve Or comparable professional editing software We care significantly more about the quality of your work than degrees, certifications, or how many years you've been editing. What Success Looks Like Initially, we expect to work closely together while you learn our preferred editing style. As you become familiar with our content, we expect the amount of direction required to decrease. Eventually, we want the workflow to be: We record → upload raw footage → you edit → finished content is ready for review. A successful editor in this position will consistently produce: High-quality videos Strong pacing Clean editing Fast turnaround Consistent branding Few unnecessary revisions Reliable communication Compensation Starting compensation will be $200–$250 USD per week, depending on demonstrated editing ability and experience. This is a full-time position. This is also intended to be a long-term relationship with room to grow. As your skills, responsibilities, speed, independence, and value to our team increase, there will be opportunities for increased compensation. We're willing to pay more as the relationship grows. What matters to us is finding the right person. How to Apply Please follow these instructions carefully. At the very beginning of your application, write: ORANGE VIDEO Applications that do not include this may not be reviewed. Then send us: A short introduction about yourself. Links to 3–5 of the best short-form videos YOU personally edited. Briefly explain exactly what you did on those videos. Tell us which editing software you primarily use. Tell us about your experience editing talking-head, business, educational, or personal-brand content. Tell us whether you currently work for other clients or employers. Confirm that you personally will perform all editing work and will not subcontract or outsource our videos. Confirm that you are interested in a full-time, long-term position. Tell us your expected weekly compensation in USD. Please do not send dozens of portfolio links. We would rather see your 3 best videos than 30 average ones. Paid Editing Test Candidates who appear to be a strong fit will be invited to complete a paid editing test using our actual raw footage. Multiple candidates may receive the same footage so that we can compare editing ability fairly. We will pay candidates who are selected to complete the test. We're not looking for the person who writes the best application or has the most impressive résumé. We're looking for the person who can take our raw footage and consistently turn it into excellent content. If you're an excellent editor looking for a stable, long-term position where you can work closely with a growing company and become an important part of our content operation, we'd like to hear from you.

title: People-Focused Virtual Assistant for Growing Online Coaching Business
job_title: People-Focused Virtual Assistant for Growing Online Coaching Business
description: Are you the person who's genuinely good with people? I'm a UK-based Career Coach running a growing online coaching business, community and programmes. I have a growing online audience and I'm looking for a switched-on VA to help turn that attention into real conversations and growth. You'll be messaging people from my LinkedIn profile, in my voice, as me. You won’t just be talking to anyone; you’ll be speaking with some senior and director-level professionals and leaders in their roles. That takes trust on my side and care on yours, so excellent written communication and judgement are essential. You don't need to have been an appointment setter in your previous role. I'll teach you my method. What I can't teach is being naturally curious about people. If you do have previous setting experience, that's a bonus, as long as you're open to learning a different approach. This is not a high-volume, copy-and-paste DM role. I want someone who takes the time to understand people, asks good questions and knows when to keep a conversation going rather than rushing to a pitch. Your core responsibilities will include: - Starting conversations with relevant new LinkedIn followers, connections and people engaging with my content - Building relationships through DMs and asking thoughtful questions to understand people's situations and goals - Learning my method for identifying opportunities, booking calls and directing people to agreed next steps - Following up with warm leads and re-engaging older leads and conversations - Keeping conversations, follow-ups and opportunities organised so nothing falls through the cracks - Researching and pitching relevant podcasts, YouTube channels, newsletters, communities and partnerships - Proactively identifying other opportunities to grow the business and reach more of the right people - Suggesting improvements when you spot a more effective way of doing something - Using AI for research and support while keeping conversations natural and human To do well in this role, you need to be: - Warm, friendly and genuinely interested in people - Curious and a good listener - Proactive and resourceful: you spot opportunities and take ownership rather than waiting to be told - Highly coachable and willing to learn, receive feedback and improve - Detail-oriented and organised - An excellent written English communicator - Able to spot an opportunity without being pushy - Persistent and resilient: rejection or silence doesn't discourage you or stop you from trying again - Comfortable using AI without relying on it to communicate for you - Open and reliable communicator: communicates clearly and proactively if they’re unavailable, unable to complete something, or need support. We're a small team with a kind, supportive culture. We care about each other, the business and the people we help, and I'm looking for someone who wants to contribute to that. Required skills and experience: - At least 1 year of experience as a Virtual Assistant OR in an online customer-facing, community, support, sales or growth role - Strong written English - Comfortable communicating with people online - Strong online research skills - Comfortable learning new tools and systems - Tech-savvy and resourceful, especially when it comes to finding another way to get something done when a tool or system doesn't work Bonus skills: - DM setting, appointment setting or lead generation - LinkedIn outreach or inbox management - Experience supporting a coach, consultant or personal brand - Podcast, YouTube or partnership outreach - CRM or pipeline management If you haven't done DM setting before but think you'd be brilliant at talking to people and are excited to learn, I still want to hear from you. Work schedule Part-time: 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week, Monday–Friday. You should be available to work from 1pm UK time onwards. Salary $400 USD/month to start, with the goal of moving to full-time for the right person. To apply: Start your application with “I'M YOUR PEOPLE-FIRST VA” and answer these four questions: 1. Imagine someone you've been chatting to sends you this message: “Honestly I'm exhausted. Work has been really frustrating lately and I feel like I'm putting in so much effort without getting anywhere.” Write the exact message you would send back. 2. Tell me about a time you were given responsibility for something without being told exactly how to do it. How did you approach it, and what was the outcome? 3. What are you looking for in your next role, and what would make you want to stay with a company long-term? 4. Why do you think you'd be a great fit for this role? Please answer in your own words. I'm interested in how you naturally think and communicate, not a perfectly polished or AI-written application.

title: Behavioral Health Insurance Verification Specialist
description: Verification of Benefits Specialist The Purpose of Your Role The Verification of Benefits (VOB) Specialist verifies insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements for prospective clients seeking behavioral health treatment services, including Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) and Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) levels of care. Working closely with the Admissions, Utilization Review, and Business Office teams, this role ensures benefit information is accurate, clearly communicated, and properly documented before admission. The VOB Specialist supports a smooth intake process by confirming coverage details, identifying payer-specific requirements, determining financial responsibility, and helping the team understand whether a client’s insurance benefits align with the recommended level of care. This role requires strong attention to detail, familiarity with behavioral health insurance benefits, and the ability to navigate complex payer requirements for IOP/PHP services in a timely, accurate, and compliant manner. Core Values Growth Proactivity Positivity Results Driven We set the bar that high for practical and aspirational reasons. Candidates with similar ethical standards, the ability to adapt in a fast-moving work culture, and a commitment to providing excellent client service are encouraged to apply. Key Performance Indicators * 100% accuracy in benefit verification and documentation. * 100% of verifications completed within one hour of request. * Maintain a variance of less than 2% between verified benefits and actual payer reimbursement outcomes. * Accurately identify IOP/PHP coverage, authorization requirements, exclusions, limitations, and payer-specific rules before admission. * Please note: When you achieve any of the above key indicators, your supervisor will counsel with you to set a new goal. Core Responsibilities * Insurance Verification and Eligibility * Contact insurance companies through outbound calls and payer portals to verify behavioral health benefits and eligibility for prospective clients. * Verify benefit details specific to IOP, PHP, outpatient behavioral health, and other applicable levels of care. * Accurately obtain and document deductibles, copays, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, remaining balances, authorization requirements, visit limits, exclusions, and coverage limitations. * Identify requirements for pre-authorizations, concurrent reviews, single case agreements, medical necessity criteria, or other payer-specific conditions prior to admission. * Confirm whether behavioral health benefits are carved in, carved out, managed by a third-party administrator, or subject to separate authorization rules. * Escalate unclear, conflicting, or complex benefit information to leadership, Admissions, Utilization Review, or the Business Office as appropriate. Behavioral Health and IOP/PHP Support * Understand the difference between common behavioral health levels of care, including outpatient, IOP, PHP, residential, and inpatient treatment. * Verify whether the prospective client’s benefits support the recommended level of care and communicate any concerns that may affect admission, authorization, or reimbursement. * Support Admissions by clearly explaining payer requirements, financial responsibility, and documentation needs related to behavioral health treatment. * Help identify potential reimbursement risks before admission, including non-covered services, authorization gaps, payer limitations, or inaccurate benefit information. Documentation and Systems * Document all benefit information, payer communications, reference numbers, authorization requirements, and financial responsibility details accurately and thoroughly in the EHR system. * Maintain an organized system for initial and ongoing benefit verifications. * Ensure benefit information remains current and reflects any changes prior to admission. * Support accurate handoff documentation for Admissions, Utilization Review, billing, and leadership. Client and Team Communication * Communicate clearly and professionally with Admissions, Utilization Review, and the Business Office regarding client insurance benefits and financial responsibility. * Provide timely updates when benefits are incomplete, unclear, or require additional payer follow-up. * Communicate effectively with insurance payers to obtain accurate information and resolve discrepancies. * Maintain a service-minded approach while supporting prospective clients and internal teams through the intake process. Compliance and Collaboration * Regularly audit verification of benefits activities to identify inaccuracies, trends, process gaps, and payer-specific issues. * Collaborate with leadership, Admissions, Utilization Review, and Business Office staff to improve accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. * Help reduce recurring verification errors by following best practices and documenting payer requirements consistently. * Adhere to all company policies, procedures, HIPAA requirements, and compliance standards. * Perform additional duties as assigned by leadership. Application Instruction If you’ve read the job description thoroughly, please include “Pineapple” in the subject line of your email and attach a link to your most updated resume in your message. Education and Experience * High school diploma or equivalent required. * Minimum of two years of experience in insurance verification of benefits, medical billing, utilization review, admissions, revenue cycle, or a related healthcare role. * Behavioral health experience strongly preferred. * Experience verifying benefits for IOP, PHP, outpatient behavioral health, residential, or inpatient treatment services preferred. * Experience working with admissions, utilization review, or behavioral health billing teams preferred. Technical Skills * Proficiency in medical billing software and EHR systems, such as Imagine, ADS, or similar systems. * Lightning Step experience preferred. * Demonstrated knowledge of insurance eligibility and benefits verification. * Strong understanding of behavioral health benefits, medical terminology, payer requirements, and medical billing practices. * Familiarity with IOP/PHP authorization requirements, payer portals, reference numbers, benefit documentation, and financial responsibility calculations. * Accurate and efficient electronic data entry skills. * Soft Skills * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Excellent organization, time management, and attention to detail. * Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced admissions environment. * Ability to communicate effectively with insurance payers and obtain accurate information. * Strong follow-through and ability to identify issues before they delay admission or create reimbursement concerns. * Comfortable working with sensitive behavioral health information in a professional, confidential, and compliant manner.

title: Executive Assistant
description: NOOR COMPANIES Real Estate Development · General Contracting POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT Executive Assistant to the CEO Full-Time | Remote | Direct Support to the Chief Executive Officer REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Development and construction operate on immovable deadlines. Permits, inspections, closings, draw schedules, and subcontractor commitments do not wait. The Executive Assistant to the CEO works at the center of that environment. POSITION SUMMARY This is a critical, high-trust position functioning as a mini chief of staff to the Chief Executive Officer. The Executive Assistant manages the CEO’s inbox, calendar, meetings, events, correspondence, and social media presence, fields inbound requests on the CEO’s behalf, and supports the analysis and reporting the CEO relies on to make decisions. The environment is fast-paced and the priorities change throughout the day. The successful candidate operates with a pronounced sense of urgency, responds quickly, communicates continuously, and takes full ownership of every item entrusted to them. Nothing is permitted to fall through the cracks. Prior experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a busy CEO, president, or owner is required. General administrative, customer service, and virtual assistant experience does not substitute for this requirement. Applications that do not demonstrate it will not be considered. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Calendar & Inbox Management • Own and protect the CEO’s calendar; schedule, reschedule, and resolve conflicts proactively and defend blocks of focused work • Manage the CEO’s email: triage daily, escalate what is urgent, draft responses for approval, and independently handle routine correspondence • Field inbound requests directed to the CEO, determine what requires their attention, and redirect or resolve the remainder • Set up meetings with internal staff, clients, consultants, subcontractors, lenders, and community partners, including agendas and prepared materials • Provide a written start-of-day plan and end-of-day summary, with status updates throughout the day Communications & Written Work • Draft, edit, and format professional correspondence, memoranda, letters, and internal communications • Assist in the preparation of proposals, qualifications packages, and responses to requests for proposal • Prepare and format presentations in PowerPoint for clients, partners, lenders, and board or community meetings • Maintain document organization and version control across active projects Events & Meeting Coordination • Coordinate company events, groundbreakings, ribbon cuttings, client functions, and community engagements end to end • Manage logistics, vendor coordination, invitations, RSVPs, run-of-show, and follow-up • Arrange business travel, itineraries, and accommodations; prepare and submit expense reports Marketing & Social Media • Manage the CEO’s and the company’s social media presence, including drafting, scheduling, and publishing content • Produce simple graphics and marketing collateral using Canva or comparable design tools • Support marketing initiatives, project announcements, award submissions, and website content updates Analysis, Reporting & Bookkeeping Support • Build and maintain spreadsheets, trackers, and reports supporting project timelines, budgets, vendors, and expenses • Compile and summarize data for the CEO, identifying discrepancies and drawing attention to items that require action • Provide bookkeeping support including invoice processing, expense coding, receipt reconciliation, and coordination with the accounting team Human Resources & Administrative Support • Support recruiting logistics, including scheduling interviews and coordinating candidate communications • Assist with onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and administration of company policies • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive personnel, financial, and business information without exception • Document standard operating procedures for recurring responsibilities REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Minimum three (3) years of experience as an Executive Assistant reporting directly to a CEO, president, or business owner in a fast-paced environment. This requirement is not waivable. • Demonstrated ability to manage a demanding executive calendar and inbox independently, exercising judgment about priority and urgency without direction. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel — formulas including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF and IF statements, pivot tables, filtering, and professional formatting. Must be able to build a tracker or report from a blank worksheet. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Word — able to produce polished, client-ready decks and professionally formatted documents. • Strong numerical literacy — comfort working with budgets, invoices, schedules of values, and financial summaries, and the ability to identify an error in a set of numbers. • Working knowledge of bookkeeping fundamentals — invoicing, expense coding, and reconciliation. Familiarity with QuickBooks preferred. • Exposure to human resources administration — interview scheduling, onboarding coordination, and personnel recordkeeping. • Marketing and social media experience — managing business accounts, drafting content, and maintaining a consistent professional voice. • Basic graphic design capability — Canva or comparable tools, sufficient to produce clean marketing materials and simple layouts. • Superior written English. Written work is issued under the CEO’s name and must be correct in grammar, tone, and punctuation without revision. • Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English, suitable for daily calls and direct contact with US clients, consultants, and subcontractors. • Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Experience supporting an executive in real estate development, construction, architecture, or a related industry • Familiarity with Procore, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or comparable construction and property management platforms • Experience with proposal and RFP response preparation • Working knowledge of QuickBooks, Asana, ClickUp, Notion, Slack, or the Adobe Creative Suite • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, communications, or a related field CORE COMPETENCIES • Sense of Urgency. Responds promptly and moves work forward without being prompted. Understands that in this industry a delayed response carries a cost. • Ownership and Accountability. Assumes full responsibility for assigned matters through completion. Raises problems early rather than concealing them. • Continuous Communication. Maintains frequent contact throughout the workday regarding completed work, obstacles, and changes in status. Silence is not acceptable in this role. • Attention to Detail. Catches errors in dates, figures, names, and documents before they are transmitted. • Adaptability. Adjusts to shifting priorities throughout the day without losing track of work already in progress. • Professionalism and Discretion. Represents the CEO and the firm appropriately in all communications and safeguards confidential information absolutely. • Sound Judgment. Determines what warrants the CEO’s attention and what does not, and knows when to ask rather than assume. • Aptitude for Learning. Absorbs new systems and procedures quickly, takes independent notes, and does not require repeated instruction. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Applicants must complete all four steps below. Describe a specific instance in which you identified a conflict, error, or missed deadline before your executive did, and the action you took. 4. Describe your experience with bookkeeping, human resources support, and marketing or social media. 5. Rate your proficiency in Excel and identify one report or tracker you have built from scratch. 6. Confirm your availability from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time, Monday through Friday, on a long-term basis. 7. Confirm that this position would be your sole employment and that you hold no other clients. 8. State your internet speed and your backup connection. 9. State your expected monthly compensation in USD. Step 3 — Video Introduction Record a video of two to three minutes and provide a link (Loom or Google Drive). Do not attach a video file. Describe a workday in which priorities changed substantially, and how you managed it. 3. Read the following aloud, exactly as written: “Good morning — the 10:15 walkthrough moved to 2:30, the permit inspector is confirmed for Thursday, and I have flagged three invoices requiring your approval today.” Step 4 — Work Samples Attach two samples of your work from the categories below. Remove or replace all confidential information. • An Excel report, tracker, or budget you constructed • A PowerPoint presentation you prepared • Professional correspondence, a proposal section, or a memorandum you drafted for an executive • A graphic, social media post, or marketing piece you designed SELECTION PROCESS 1. Interview with the Chief Executive Officer. Thirty minutes by video. 4. Reference verification. Contact with at least one prior employer. 5. Offer and introductory period. A thirty-day paid introductory period. Qualified applicants will be contacted within one week of submission. description: NOOR COMPANIES Real Estate Development · General Contracting POSITION ANNOUNCEMENT Real Estate Development Analyst Full-Time | Remote | Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer REPORTS TO Chief Executive Officer EMPLOYMENT Full-time, 40 hours per week. Our pipeline spans market-rate and affordable housing, public and civic solicitations, and mixed-use redevelopment, financed through conventional debt and equity as well as housing tax credits, tax increment financing, and public agency programs. POSITION SUMMARY The Real Estate Development Analyst supports the Chief Executive Officer across the full development lifecycle — from identifying and screening potential development sites, through underwriting and financing, entitlement, design coordination, and construction close-out. The Analyst is responsible for the financial models that determine whether a project proceeds, the budget tracking that governs every dollar spent once it does, and the coordination and follow-up that keeps architects, engineers, consultants, lenders, and municipalities moving on schedule. This is a research-, analysis-, and follow-through-intensive position requiring precision with numbers and persistence in pursuit of information. This position requires a technical foundation. Candidates must have education or working experience in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, and must be able to read and interpret architectural and civil drawings. Applications without this background will not be considered. ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES Site Identification & Market Research • Search brokerage and listing platforms — LoopNet, Crexi, CoStar, Catylist, brokerage websites, and auction platforms — daily for land and redevelopment opportunities matching the firm’s criteria • Screen candidate sites against acquisition criteria including zoning, parcel size, utility availability, access, topography, floodplain, and known environmental conditions • Research parcel ownership, assessed value, tax status, sale history, and legal description through county assessor, recorder, and GIS systems • Identify off-market opportunities including surplus public land, tax-forfeited parcels, obsolete or underutilized properties, and expiring-use affordable properties • Compile land sale comparables, rent comparables, sale comparables, absorption data, and demographic and employment data for each submarket under consideration • Prepare one-page site screening summaries with photographs, aerials, parcel maps, zoning summary, preliminary program, and order-of-magnitude economics • Maintain the acquisition pipeline tracker recording every site reviewed, its status, owner and broker contacts, pricing, and the reason for pursuit or rejection Financial Modeling & Proforma Analysis • Build and maintain development proformas from scratch in Excel, including sources and uses, hard and soft cost budgets, development schedule, absorption and lease-up assumptions, stabilized operating proforma, and monthly cash flow • Calculate and report the return metrics governing investment decisions — untrended and trended yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, cash-on-cash return, debt service coverage ratio, and loan sizing against loan-to-cost and loan-to-value constraints • Model the full capital stack including senior construction debt, permanent debt, tax credit equity, tax increment financing, deferred developer fee, soft and gap loans, grants, and sponsor equity • Run sensitivity and scenario analyses across construction cost, interest rate, rent, exit capitalization rate, absorption pace, and subsidy assumptions • Update proformas as design, cost estimates, financing terms, and program change; maintain disciplined version control and document every assumption and its source • Reconcile proforma assumptions against contractor estimates, consultant fee proposals, and lender term sheets • Prepare summary financial exhibits for the CEO, lenders, investors, and public agency partners Development Budget & Expenditure Tracking • Maintain the master development budget for every active project, tracking each line item from original budget through committed, invoiced, paid, and remaining balance • Track every dollar of spend across all projects and reconcile against the general ledger with the accounting team • Monitor consultant and contractor contract balances, invoice against contracted fee, and flag any invoice exceeding contracted scope • Prepare, assemble, and track predevelopment and construction draw requests to lenders and public funders, including supporting documentation, lien waivers, and inspector approvals • Track change orders, budget amendments, contingency usage, and cost-to-complete; report variances promptly and identify the cause • Produce monthly budget-versus-actual variance reports for each project and a consolidated report for the CEO • Maintain the funding draw calendar and monitor sources and uses balance throughout construction Architect, Engineer & Consultant Coordination • Maintain the consultant roster for each project — architect, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, landscape, geotechnical, environmental, survey, traffic, and specialty consultants — with scope, fee, contact, and contract status • Track consultant contracts, scopes of work, fee schedules, insurance certificates, and deliverable due dates • Maintain the design deliverables calendar across schematic design, design development, construction documents, and permit set milestones, and monitor progress against it • Follow up persistently with architects and engineers on outstanding deliverables, drawing revisions, and responses; escalate delays to the CEO before they affect the schedule • Log and track requests for information, submittals, design decisions, and outstanding items requiring resolution • Organize and version-control drawing sets, specifications, reports, and studies in the project document library • Prepare agendas for design and coordination meetings, record minutes, and distribute and track action items to closure Entitlements & Municipal Opportunity Development • Research zoning ordinances, comprehensive plans, overlay districts, density and height limits, parking requirements, and design standards for candidate sites • Identify municipalities, counties, housing authorities, and economic development agencies with active development priorities, surplus land, redevelopment districts, or announced solicitations • Set up meetings between the CEO and city planning, economic development, housing, and public works staff to identify development opportunities; prepare briefing materials in advance and track follow-up commitments after each meeting • Monitor city council, planning commission, HRA and EDA agendas and packets for relevant items, land dispositions, and emerging opportunities • Track entitlement milestones for each project — pre-application conference, site plan review, rezoning, variance, conditional use permit, plat approval, and public hearings • Maintain a master calendar of submission deadlines, hearing dates, and approval expiration dates • Research and summarize impact fees, utility connection charges, park dedication requirements, and other municipal exactions affecting project economics Public Financing & Funding Applications • Track application cycles and deadlines for Minnesota Housing programs including the Multifamily Consolidated Request for Proposals, 9% and 4% Housing Tax Credits, and the State Housing Tax Credit, as well as city and county funding sources • Assemble funding application materials, exhibits, narratives, and supporting documentation, and verify completeness against agency checklists • Analyze projects against Qualified Allocation Plan scoring criteria and identify actions that improve competitive position • Research and summarize available incentives including tax increment financing, tax abatement, brownfield and cleanup grants, historic tax credits, New Markets Tax Credits, and energy incentives • Maintain a consolidated funding calendar covering every source, cycle, and deadline relevant to the pipeline • Track awarded funding through commitment, closing, and compliance milestones Due Diligence, Reporting & Project Administration • Maintain due diligence checklists and trackers covering title commitment and exceptions, survey, Phase I and Phase II environmental assessments, geotechnical investigation, wetland delineation, utility availability letters, and zoning verification • Track all critical dates including purchase agreement contingency periods, option and extension deadlines, earnest money conditions, and closing dates, and provide advance notice of each • Prepare weekly and monthly pipeline reports and project status dashboards for the CEO • Assemble lender, investor, partner, and public agency reporting packages • Maintain organized project files, contact directories, and the central document library across all active projects • Document standard operating procedures and templates for recurring analytical and tracking work REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • Minimum two (2) years of professional experience in real estate development, architecture, civil or structural engineering, construction, property development, or commercial real estate analysis. • Educational background in architecture, engineering, real estate, construction management, finance, or a closely related discipline. • Ability to read and interpret architectural and engineering drawings — site plans, floor plans, elevations, and civil and utility drawings — and familiarity with the schematic design, design development, and construction document phases. • Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency. Must be able to construct a development proforma and cash flow model from a blank worksheet without templates or add-ins, using formulas, lookups, and logical functions accurately. • Working command of real estate finance fundamentals — net operating income, capitalization rate, yield on cost, internal rate of return, equity multiple, debt service coverage ratio, loan-to-cost and loan-to-value, amortization, and sources and uses. • Demonstrated research capability using brokerage and listing platforms, public property records, GIS systems, and municipal planning documents, with the ability to locate information that is not readily indexed. • Exceptional attention to detail with numerical information. Errors in a proforma or a budget carry direct financial consequence. • Persistent, professional follow-up. A substantial portion of this position consists of pursuing consultants, brokers, and agency staff until a response is obtained. • Superior written English sufficient to prepare summaries, memoranda, and application narratives issued to lenders, investors, and public agencies. • Fluent, clearly articulate spoken English for participation in calls with US architects, engineers, brokers, lenders, and municipal staff. • Reliable home office — computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM, internet service of 25 Mbps or greater, a secondary internet source, a headset, and a quiet, professional work environment. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Licensure or licensure eligibility as an architect or civil engineer • Experience with affordable housing finance, Low-Income Housing Tax Credits, or publicly subsidized development • Prior work supporting United States real estate projects or United States based clients • Familiarity with CoStar, LoopNet, Crexi, or comparable commercial listing platforms • Working knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Bluebeam Revu, ArcGIS or QGIS, Procore, or Argus • Experience preparing responses to requests for proposal or public solicitations • Competence in PowerPoint and Canva for the preparation of presentation and marketing materials CORE COMPETENCIES • Analytical Rigor. Pursues outstanding items to resolution. Does not accept silence from a consultant or agency as an outcome. • Sense of Urgency. Understands that entitlement calendars, funding deadlines, and closing dates do not move, and works accordingly. • Attention to Detail. Assumes responsibility for assigned projects through completion and raises problems early. • Sound Judgment. Distinguishes material issues from immaterial ones and knows when to escalate. • Discretion. Safeguards confidential financial, ownership, and transaction information absolutely. • Aptitude for Learning. Acquires unfamiliar markets, programs, regulations, and systems quickly and independently. APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS Applicants must complete all four steps below. Number your responses. 1. Describe your education and professional background in architecture, engineering, construction, or real estate, including your employer, your title, and your tenure. 2. title: LIVE WEBINAR PRESENTER & SALES PROFESSIONAL
description: **Remote | Gig / Part-Time | $50 USD Per Completed Webinar** Capital Fleet Rentals is looking for an exceptional **Live Webinar Presenter & Sales Professional** to conduct live online presentations for prospective business partners. **This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant position.** We are looking for someone with outstanding spoken English, strong executive presence, confidence, energy, professionalism, and the ability to engage and influence a live audience. If you can enter a virtual room, establish credibility quickly, keep people engaged, answer questions confidently, and guide an audience toward a clear next step, we would like to hear from you. ## THE ROLE You will conduct live Zoom webinars for Capital Fleet Rentals. We anticipate beginning with approximately **one webinar per week**, with the potential to increase to approximately **two webinars per week as registration volume grows**. Each webinar is expected to last approximately **30–60 minutes**, including audience questions. You will receive presentation materials, information about our business, training, and guidance before conducting webinars independently. Responsibilities include: * Conducting professional live Zoom presentations * Presenting information naturally rather than simply reading slides * Explaining business concepts clearly and conversationally * Maintaining audience attention and engagement * Communicating with confidence, energy, and credibility * Answering audience questions professionally * Responding effectively when conversations move beyond the presentation * Handling reasonable questions and objections with professionalism * Helping attendees understand the information being presented * Guiding interested attendees toward the appropriate next step * Professionally representing Capital Fleet Rentals ## WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR Relevant experience may include: * Live webinar presenting * Consultative sales * Business development * Public speaking * Training or facilitation * On-camera presenting * Professional hosting * Business presentations * Customer-facing sales presentations Previous vehicle-rental experience is **not required**. We can teach you our business. What is much harder to teach is **presence, confidence, communication, persuasion, judgment, and the ability to command a live audience.** Those qualities are extremely important to us. ## COMPENSATION & SCHEDULE **Compensation: $50 USD per completed webinar** This is a specialized gig position rather than a traditional hourly role. We expect to begin with approximately **one webinar per week** and may increase to approximately **two webinars per week depending on registration volume and business needs**. A specific number of weekly webinars is not guaranteed. Webinars will generally be scheduled during hours suitable for a U.S. Eastern Time audience. Anticipated start: **Late September / Early October 2026** ## SELECTION PROCESS We are intentionally taking our time to identify the right presenter rather than simply filling the position quickly. ### Step 1 — Application Video Please submit a **2–3 minute video presentation on a professional topic of your choice**. You may: * Explain a business concept * Present a product or service * Teach something * Tell a compelling professional story * Discuss another professional topic you know well We will **not provide a script for this first video**. Imagine that you have a live audience in front of you and your objective is to capture and maintain their attention. Professional video production is not required. Please do not heavily edit your submission. We want to evaluate your natural: * Spoken English * Communication ability * Confidence * Executive presence * Energy and personality * Persuasiveness * Professionalism * Camera presence * Ability to hold an audience's attention ### Step 2 — Live Presentation Audition Candidates who advance will receive information about Capital Fleet Rentals and a short presentation assignment before their interview. You will have time to prepare. During the interview, you will deliver a short live presentation as though we are attendees at one of your webinars. Expect questions. We want to see how well you prepare, understand unfamiliar information, communicate naturally, respond to questions, think on your feet, and engage a live audience. ## HOW TO APPLY Please include: 1. A brief introduction. 2. Your relevant experience in webinars, sales, public speaking, presentations, training, hosting, or business development. 3. Your **2–3 minute presentation video**. 4. Your current location and time zone. 5. Confirmation that you are comfortable conducting webinars during agreed-upon U.S. Eastern Time hours. 6. Confirmation that you understand compensation is **$50 USD per completed webinar**. 7. Your answer to this question: **“What separates an average presenter from someone who can truly command and influence a live audience?”** Please do not submit a generic application. This individual will represent Capital Fleet Rentals in front of prospective business partners, so communication ability, professionalism, credibility, and presence are very important to us. We are looking for someone who can walk into a virtual room with confidence, earn people's attention, establish trust, communicate clearly, and make the audience want to hear what comes next.

title: Product Manager (AI Native, Hands On)
description: Company: Fresh Fuel Marketing Type: Full time, 40 hours per week Hours: You set your own schedule. Written update in Slack every working day, plus 2 hours of overlap with Toronto time (EST) twice a week for calls Salary: $1,500 to $3,000 USD per month to start, up to $3,000 for someone who is clearly senior. 13th month pay included. Paid time off after 3 months Location: Remote, Philippines About the role I build things fast. I use AI to get from an idea to something that runs, and I have a stack of internal tools and web apps sitting at about 70 percent done. They work when I use them. They are not finished products. I need someone to take them the rest of the way. That means finding what is broken before a user does, d ---------- what actually has to be built before launch and what can wait, cleaning up the parts I rushed, and shipping. You will use AI to do this the same way I do. That is not a shortcut here, it is the job. This is not a role where you write tickets and wait for a developer. You are in the code. You use Cursor, Claude Code, or whatever you are fastest in, and you make the changes yourself. What you will do Take over projects that are partly built and get them to a state I can put in front of real users Go through what exists, find what is broken, half finished, or held together with tape, and write up what has to happen D ---------- what ships in v1 and what does not. Push back on me when I want to add things Write and fix code yourself using AI tools. Front end, back end, whatever the project needs Test properly before launch. Edge cases, error states, mobile, the things that break in front of a user Handle deployment and keep environments, keys, and repos in order Write the small amount of documentation needed so the thing can be maintained Keep everything visible in Slack so I always know status without asking What I am looking for You have shipped software to real users, not just built demos You are genuinely fast with AI coding tools. Cursor, Claude Code, Windsurf, Copilot, Replit, whatever. Tell me which and what you built with it You can read someone else's messy code and figure out what it is doing without asking twenty questions Comfortable in JavaScript or TypeScript. React, Next.js, Astro, Node, or similar. Familiar with a database like Supabase or Postgres You can deploy. Vercel, Netlify, Railway, or similar. Git and GitHub are second nature You have product judgment. You can look at a feature and tell me it is not worth building You catch bugs. You are the kind of person who tries to break things on purpose Strong written English. Most of our communication is written You tell me early when something will slip. I do not need perfect, I need honest Nice to have Experience with marketing or ads platforms, APIs, and webhooks Zapier, Make, or n8n Notion API Mobile or PWA experience You have done this before: inherited a half built thing and gotten it live Tools we use Slack, Notion, GitHub, Google Drive, and whatever AI coding tools you are best with. How to apply Read this carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted. 1. Send your resume. You can use AI to write or format it. I do not care. 2. Write your cover letter yourself. Please do not use AI for this one. I want to hear how you actually think. Tell me about one specific project you took from half finished to live. What was broken when you got it, what you cut, what you shipped. Short is fine. 3. Do this task. Imagine I hand you a working prototype on day one. It runs on my machine, real people have never used it, and I want it live in six weeks. Send me two things: The first 10 questions you would ask me before writing a single line of code A one page plan for those six weeks: what you would do in week 1, what you would cut, and what you would consider the minimum bar for launch I am judging this on the questions more than the plan. Good questions tell me you have done this before. 4. Include links. GitHub, a live product you built, anything I can actually click. If you cannot share code, describe what you built and what your part was. 5. Put this in your subject line: PM AI - [the last thing you shipped]
