title: Data anaylst
description: # Virtual Assistant – TikTok Live Set Builder & Scheduling **Remote Position** Our Tik Tok Shop is looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage the daily setup and scheduling of our TikTok Live shows. We operate a high-volume live-commerce business and can run up to 10 live shows per day. As we continue to grow, we are looking for someone who can take ownership of building our daily show sets and making sure every show is properly prepared and scheduled. This is primarily an **operations and scheduling position**. You will not be responsible for purchasing, accounting, company finances, or making financial decisions. ## What You'll Be Doing Your main responsibilities will include: * Building TikTok surprise sets inside our internal Tool House software * Following predefined set-building rules and templates * Using our points-based system to create balanced sets * Making sure sets contain the correct mix of base items, mid-tier items, bigger hits, and top/chase items * Reviewing inventory availability while building sets * Making sure each set passes our internal set requirements * Building approximately 5–10 sets per day depending on the schedule * Scheduling TikTok Live shows for our hosts * Making sure the correct set, host, show time, and listing are associated with each show * Keeping the daily show schedule organized * Checking that upcoming shows are completely ready before their scheduled start time * Communicating any inventory issues, scheduling conflicts, or set-building problems to management * Keeping track of which sets are built, finalized, uploaded, and scheduled ## What We're Looking For We want someone who is: * Extremely organized * Very detail-oriented * Comfortable working on a computer for most of the day * Able to follow detailed processes and rules accurately * Good with numbers and basic math * Comfortable learning new software * Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines * Reliable and consistent * Able to work independently once trained * Comfortable asking questions when something does not look right * Able to communicate clearly in English You do **not** need to be an expert on Milwaukee tools or TikTok Live before starting. We will provide training on our products, software, set-building system, and workflow. Experience with TikTok Shop, live selling, e-commerce, inventory management, scheduling, spreadsheets, or similar operations work is a plus. ## What a Typical Day Looks Like You will log into Tool House and review the upcoming live-show schedule. For each show, you will: 1. Select the appropriate set template. 2. Build the set using available inventory. 3. Follow the points and product-distribution requirements shown by our system. 4. Make adjustments until the set passes all required checks. 5. Finalize the set. 6. Prepare the TikTok listing/upload. 7. Schedule the show for the correct host and time. 8. Confirm that everything is ready. 9. Move on to the next scheduled show. Our goal is for this person to eventually own this entire process so our live-selling team can arrive each day with their shows already built and ready to run. ## This Role Is a Good Fit If... You enjoy repetitive but important operational work, like creating systems, checking details, keeping schedules organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. A strong person in this role should eventually be able to look at a schedule of 8–10 upcoming shows and independently make sure all 8–10 are properly built and ready to go. ## Growth Opportunity Tool House US is a rapidly growing live-commerce company. This position may expand into additional live-selling operations responsibilities as the business continues to grow. We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the team rather than someone looking for a short-term project. ## To Apply Please send: * A short introduction about yourself * Your previous VA, operations, e-commerce, or scheduling experience * Your normal working hours and time zone * Your computer/internet setup * Your expected hourly rate * Why you think you would be a good fit for a detail-oriented role like this Please also start your application with the words **"Tool House VA"** so we know you read the entire listing.

title: Video Project Manager (YouTube + Paid Ads)
description: Company: Fresh Fuel Marketing Type: Full time, 40 hours per week Hours: You set your own schedule. I need a written update in Slack every working day, plus 2 hours of overlap with Toronto time (EST) on Tuesdays and Thursdays for calls Salary: $1,200 to $1,500 USD per month to start, with room to $1,800 within a year for the right person. 13th month pay included. Paid time off after 3 months Location: Remote, Philippines About the role I run two things that need video. The first is my YouTube channel, Trevor Carlson, a travel storytelling channel with about 54,000 subscribers. The second is Fresh Fuel Marketing, a paid media agency where we make video ads for clients. I have a lot of footage. Old trips, b-roll, unused takes, half finished projects. What I do not have is someone who watches all of it, figures out what should be made from it, and then drives those videos to done. That is this job. You are not just an editor. You are the person who d ---------- what gets made, writes the outline or script, and either cuts it yourself or hands it to an editor and gives them notes until it is right. What you will do Watch and review existing footage, b-roll, and archive material, and keep track of what we have D ---------- what videos should be made from that footage and pitch those ideas to me with a clear reason why Write outlines and scripts for those videos Either edit the video yourself, or hand the script and outline to our video editing team Give the editing team specific, useful feedback until the cut is right Do the same work for Fresh Fuel client ad creative: review what footage a client has, plan the ads, brief the editors, review the cuts Keep every project moving and visible in Slack so I always know what stage things are at Communicate with me directly, clearly, and without needing to be chased What I am looking for You have managed video projects before, not just edited them. You have d ---------- what to make, not only how to cut it You can watch two hours of raw footage and come back with a short list of specific ideas, not vague ones You can edit. Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci, CapCut, whatever you are strongest in. Tell me which You can write a script or an outline that an editor can actually follow You can give an editor feedback that makes the next version better, with timestamps and specifics, not "make it more engaging" You know Slack and use it well. This is where we work. Threads, channels, updates, no silence Strong written English You are reliable about deadlines and you tell me early when something is going to slip Nice to have Experience with YouTube specifically: retention, hooks, packaging, thumbnails, titles Experience with paid social ad creative (Meta, TikTok, YouTube ads) and what makes a direct response video work Familiarity with ---------- , Notion, Google Drive, or similar project and review tools Travel, documentary, or story driven editing experience Tools we use Slack, Google Drive, Notion, and your editing software of choice. How to apply Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step get deleted. 1. Send your resume. You can use AI to write or format your resume. I do not care. 2. Write your cover letter yourself. Please do not use AI for this one. I want to hear how you actually think and write. Tell me why you are a good fit for this specific role. Short is fine. Honest is better than polished. 3. Do this task. Watch this video: ---------- "10 Day Motorbike Adventure: Exploring Northern Thailand's Hidden Gems on the Mae Hong Son Loop" Then send me three video ideas that come out of that footage or that story. They need to be highly specific. Not "a video about Hong Kong food." Something closer to "a 6 minute video built around the 3 minutes at the Wat Pa Tam Wua stop, opening on the road shot at 4:12, framed around what the loop costs you rather than what it gives you." Give me the angle, roughly how long it would be, what the hook is, and which moments from the video you would build it from. I will judge your application mostly on step 3. It tells me whether you can do the actual job. 4. Put this in your subject line: VIDEO PM - [your favorite documentary]

title: Executive Assistant/Operations Manager (Health Care)
description: About Maniya Health Maniya Health is a premier, 75-employee multispecialty medical practice in Central New Jersey that has served our community for over 50 years. We were named #920 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private companies. We are looking for a high-capacity EA / Operations Manager to serve as the strategic right hand to our CEO. Position Overview The primary purpose of this role is to make the CEO's life easier. Everything else follows from that. You will take work off the CEO's plate entirely — not by executing tasks he hands you, but by owning outcomes so completely that he stops thinking about them. Beyond direct executive support, you will manage the intersection of healthcare operations, HR, talent, IT, facilities, and project delivery. This is a senior role for someone who owns the result, not the checklist. This is a role with real scope and real autonomy, working directly with a physician-MBA CEO at a practice growing fast enough to make the Inc. 5000. You will learn every aspect of how an innovative medical practice runs, under close mentorship, with genuine room to grow as we expand. What you build here, you own. Structure Reports directly to the CEO. No direct reports to start — you influence and coordinate across departments through ownership and follow-through rather than formal authority. Scope may grow as the practice does. Schedule Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM US Eastern Time. Remote. Full-time and exclusive — no concurrent employment or client work during scheduled hours. May require additional hours for urgent issues such as a system outage or a same-day provider gap. Your First 30 Days Training on all Practice workflows. Inbox and calendar management, provider scheduling and PTO end to end, and closing the open vendor loops that currently sit with the CEO. Responsibilities 1. Executive Support — The Core of the Role Full Lifecycle Ownership: You are the final destination for anything assigned to you. When the CEO CCs you on an email or delegates a project, you own it until it's done. He should never have to follow up or wonder about status. Inbox Management: Oversee the general practice inboxes, routing information as appropriate. Once trust is established, you will manage the CEO's inbox — triaging, drafting responses, flagging what genuinely needs him, handling the rest. Calendar & Anticipation: Manage the CEO's calendar with foresight, including professional and personal logistics such as travel and events. Adjust for time zones, seasonal shifts like Daylight Savings, and personal commitments — holidays, celebrations, errands — without being prompted. Closing Open Loops: Many of our vendors and partners don't respond, or agree to something and go quiet. Today the CEO carries those loops in his head. Your job is to take them off his plate entirely — own the follow-up cadence, escalate when needed, close every loop. Representing the CEO: Attend vendor and partner meetings on his behalf. Take detailed notes, capture action items and owners, circulate the summary, drive follow-ups to closure. You are a polite but firm representative, ensuring team deadlines are met. 2. Project Management General Project Ownership: Projects come planned and unplanned. A provider gives notice and hundreds of patients need rescheduling. A new AI phone system has bugs to identify, report, and verify as fixed. A service line needs standing up. You take the goal, break it into steps, identify who does what, and drive it to completion — surfacing risks early and never letting it stall silently. Vendor Sourcing: Research and source vendors for software, hardware, and services. Run comparisons, gather quotes, check references, present options with a recommendation. Implementation & Closure: Own implementations end to end — configuration, testing, staff training, go-live. Identify bugs, log them with the vendor, and follow up until they are actually fixed. A ticket submitted is not a ticket resolved. Renewals & Contracts: Track renewal dates, licenses, and service agreements so nothing auto-renews unnoticed or lapses unexpectedly. 3. Provider Scheduling & Coordination End-to-End Ownership: Manage the full lifecycle of provider scheduling, vacations, PTO, and CME across approximately 40 providers. You are the final auditor — 100% accuracy across EHR and tracking systems before anything reaches the CEO's desk. Visiting Specialists: Several providers are specialists who come in one day a week from their own practices. You coordinate directly with their offices — confirming schedules, managing changes and cancellations, keeping templates accurate, making sure their day runs smoothly on site. 4. HR, Talent & Employee Lifecycle Recruiting & Hiring: Lead sourcing, job posting, resume screening, interview scheduling, and coordination with hiring managers. Build the pipeline before a seat opens. Onboarding & Offboarding: Own onboarding end to end — paperwork, system access, training coordination, day-one readiness. Same rigor on exit: final paperwork, access removal, equipment return. Talent & Compliance: Coordinate performance reviews, track training and credentialing, monitor license and certification expirations. You don't just send documents — you manage the completion rate, ensuring every signature is captured and filed. 5. Facilities, IT & Office Administration Account Management: Provision accounts for new hires across all systems; de-provision immediately on departure. Access sprawl is a compliance risk, and closing it is your responsibility. IT Support & Continuity: Handle everyday requests — password resets, access issues, device and printer problems, basic troubleshooting. Know the failover procedures and execute them; if the phone system goes down, route to the backup and notify the team. Know what you can fix and what needs a vendor — escalate fast, then own the follow-up. Facilities Issues: When a roof leaks or the HVAC fails, you own it from first report to final invoice. You won't be on site, so you coordinate with our on-the-ground team to get eyes on the problem and confirm the work was done properly. Your part is getting the vendor scheduled — following up daily if that's what it takes — and verifying the bill matches the quote. Supplies & Equipment: Keep every location stocked — clinical supplies, office supplies, everyday consumables. Nobody should ever tell the CEO we've run out of something. Purchase Orders, Reimbursements & Refunds: Review, approve, and track POs with a clear record of what was ordered, what arrived, and what it cost. Same for staff reimbursement requests and patient refunds — reviewed, approved, tracked to completion. 6. Operational Oversight Daily Review: Review checklists and Google Chat spaces daily to identify operational gaps and correct provider scheduling gaps. Monthly Operational Reviews: Prepare and run them — pull the data, build the deck, identify what moved and what didn't, come with recommendations rather than just numbers. Process Ownership: Own the recurring administrative and operational processes that keep the practice running. You know which exist, whether they were completed, and where they break down — and you fix them rather than reporting that they broke. Patient Discharges & RCM: Execute the patient discharge process end to end, with the rigor these documents require. We have a billing manager who owns billing operations; your role is coordination and oversight — confirming revenue cycle processes are running, surfacing issues, following up on anything that stalls. 7. Data & Analysis Reporting & Dashboards: Use Excel and Google Sheets to turn operational, financial, and clinical quality data into reports that drive decisions. Build, maintain, and present operational KPI dashboards. When something breaks, dig into why and lead the process improvement rather than patching symptoms. Analyst on New Initiatives: Serve as data analyst on new projects — researching potential service lines, expansion opportunities, and market questions. Gather the data, run the analysis, present findings with a recommendation rather than a data dump. Key Requirements Outcome Ownership: You own results, not tasks. You act as your own auditor and catch your own errors before anyone else does. You maintain 100% accuracy in high-stakes repetitive workflows — PTO approvals, provider scheduling, PO tracking. When a project stalls, you feel it personally. Persistence: Much of this job is making other people do what they said they would — vendors, contractors, partners, internal teams. You follow up five times without becoming apologetic or abrasive. Reliability: You are a steady, reachable anchor during business hours. If you can't make a commitment — a call, a deadline, a check-in — you say so in advance rather than going quiet. A missed commitment with notice is a scheduling problem; a missed commitment without notice is a trust problem. Anticipation & Context: You connect the dots without being told, looking ahead at the calendar and environmental factors to adjust proactively. You understand how one change in a physician's schedule ripples through five other systems. Risk-Based Judgment: In a medical practice, administrative work carries legal and clinical weight. You approach sensitive documentation — patient discharge letters, HR contracts — with extreme rigor and full compliance with US healthcare standards. 30,000 Feet and 2 Feet: You can move between strategic and tactical without losing quality on either — building a KPI dashboard in the morning and chasing a roofer in the afternoon. Both matter, and you stay calm and organized across both. Technical Fluency: Advanced Excel and Google Workspace — trackers, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs — plus the ability to quickly master new software including EHR and HRIS. On AI We use AI tools daily and expect you to. What we care about is whether you direct the tool and verify the output, or hand over your thinking. Be transparent about where you use it. On Monitoring Because this role has access to protected health information, all work is performed on monitored systems using Teramind. Every team member with PHI access operates under the same requirements. To be direct: any attempt to circumvent monitoring — mouse movers, jigglers, activity simulators, or anything similar — ends the engagement immediately. If the schedule or workload isn't working, tell us and we'll fix it. Qualifications US Health care provider experience mandatory Proven longevity at prior jobs 5–7+ years as a senior EA, Operations Manager, or Chief of Staff Direct CEO or C-suite support experience is mandatory. You must have supported a CEO or equivalent executive before. This is not a role where you learn executive support on the job. Mandatory: Deep experience in the US healthcare / medical practice ecosystem Job longevity is mandatory. We are looking for someone who has held prior roles for multiple years, not a pattern of short stints. If your resume shows several positions under a year, please explain why in your application. Advanced Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs) and Google Workspace Working proficiency with Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT Proven ability to master internal software (EHR, HRIS) and maintain complex checklists, prioritization, and follow-up with 100% accuracy Selection Process Advancing candidates complete a short practical exercise using real operational data. It assesses analytical accuracy, critical thinking, and — most importantly — how you verify your own work. Final candidates should expect reference checks with prior supervisors, including on attendance and follow-through.

title: Paid Advertising Specialist
description: ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION Our client, based in the United States, is looking for an experienced Paid Advertising Specialist to manage advertising campaigns across Meta and YouTube. This is a remote, part time or full time, client-facing position. The ideal candidate will have experience managing paid advertising for multiple clients and will be comfortable communicating directly with clients about campaign performance, recommendations, and next steps. ROLE OVERVIEW The Paid Advertising Specialist is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for building, managing, and optimizing paid campaigns across Meta and YouTube. title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description: We're looking for the person who opens our creative brief, reads what we wrote, and comes back with something better than what we asked for. If your instinct on getting a brief is to fill the order exactly as written, this role will frustrate both of us. We want the editor who asks why the hook isn't landing and proposes a stronger one, who remembers the b-roll we shot two projects ago and pulls it into this week's Reel, and who sends us a trend on Tuesday that we hadn't seen yet. We're hiring one person to do that across video and design. Who we are The Assist is a newsletter for professional women navigating the full complexity of career and life, reaching 300K+ engaged readers. We publish four editions a week (OG Tuesday, Wellness Wednesday, ThirstyThursday, and The Weekender), each built for a different moment in her week, and we're building out our Instagram presence to match what we've built in email. We're small, we move fast, and we care a lot about craft. We give readers the specific move, not just the concept. Tactical guidance, honest perspective, whole-person support: written by women, for women, never corporate. The role You'll work as an embedded member of our creative team on a contract basis. You'll sit inside our process, know our brand as well as we do, and have opinions about it. Two jobs in one seat: Video (roughly 70% of the work). Cutting Instagram Reels, and building the template system that lets us produce them at volume. Design (roughly 30%). Finishing our brand identity and building carousel templates our team can run without you. This is ideal but not required. What you'll deliver each month 8-10 Instagram Reels Ongoing additions to our Reel and carousel template library Proactive ideas: trends, formats, and hooks you think we should try How our process works Our campaigns live in a Notion database. Each campaign contains a creative brief for a Reel, and inside that brief you'll find b-roll, script ideas, and the preset templates we want used. Raw footage and brand assets currently live in Google Drive, but we're just getting started with video, so you'll help us shape the process as we go. You pull the brief, cut the Reel, and send it back. Along the way we expect you to talk to us: “Can you shoot b-roll of X? It would make this opening land.” “Have you seen the latest trend of X? You guys should try it.” “You used footage two campaigns ago that fits this. Want me to pull it in?” “This hook isn't strong enough. Here are two alternates.” The video work, specifically We want our video brand identity to feel like our newsletter has come to life: fun, witty, and full of big-sister energy. We're here to motivate, teach, share, and collaborate. We're all learning together, and the editing should feel that way too. We want videos that are in this kind of style: Talking-head editing that stays natural while feeling finished. One locked-off shot, soft natural light, mic visible on purpose. The energy comes entirely from the cutting. Invisible jump cuts. Tightening speech in-frame so the pace lifts without feeling choppy, fast and dense without ever feeling jarring. L-cuts and J-cuts. Audio leading or trailing the picture so transitions land smoothly. Headline typography as the scroll-stopper. Oversized, all-caps, stacked, centered, with color used intentionally to reinforce the point being made. This is the single most important skill for this role. Caption styling with real taste in type. Something like a light serif set phrase-by-phrase, not the default karaoke preset most editing apps default to. Screenshot and cutout overlays. Drop-shadowed, slightly rotated, clustered as visual evidence inside the frame. Restraint with stickers and emoji. Sparse accents that punctuate a moment and then get out of the way. Sound design that serves the edit. Little to no music bed, closer to wall-to-wall voiceover, with pace coming from the speech and the cutting rather than a track underneath it. The design work, specifically This role covers both finishing our brand identity and turning it into templates our team can run without you. That's two different skill sets, and we're looking for someone who can do both. Brand strategy Finish our brand identity. We're about 85% there. We have a couple of different brand guidelines in place that need to be merged into one cohesive document, with the judgment calls that requires (what stays, what goes, what's the actual system) rather than just formatting an existing decision. Production Build carousel templates. Reusable, on-brand, and simple enough that our interns and virtual assistants can produce from them without design training. Create visual assets we can rebuild ourselves. Everything you make should be handed over in a form our team can edit and extend. Tools Required: Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Notion. Also needed: After Effects, Descript, Canva, Illustrator, plus a willingness to bring in other tools we haven't discovered yet. You should be Fluent in short-form vertical video, with a portfolio of Reels or TikToks you cut yourself Genuinely good with type. Most of this job is typography moving in time Comfortable being told "here's the brief, make it better" A self-starter who can help us see what's possible with video, since we don't know everything about it ourselves A clear communicator in writing, since most of our back-and-forth will be async Organized enough to build systems other people can use, and to hand over files in a state they can pick up Active enough on social media that trends reach you before they reach us Available on Slack with hours that overlap the Pacific Standard Time team, and open to the occasional quick scheduled video call when async isn't enough You'll stand out if You've built a template system that a team actually adopted and kept using You've worked on a newsletter, media brand, or creator-led business You have a point of view about our current Instagram and tell us what you'd change You've helped shape a brand identity and can walk us through the thinking behind it You send us an idea we hadn't thought of before we've even hired you The arrangement Independent contractor, month to month. Monthly retainer depending on skillset and experience, tied to the deliverable goals above. Work made for hire, standard ownership terms. Either side can step away with 30 days' notice. How to apply Apply through this listing and reply with two or three Reels or TikToks you personally cut, ideally similar in style to what we're going for. If they're already visible on your profile or portfolio, feel free to just point us there instead of re-sending them.

title: Technical Artist — VFX, Shaders & Level Game Objects

description: About the game is a third-person roguelite dungeon crawler in Unity. Runs are built from DunGen tiles across themed worlds (fire, ice, castle/dungeon, tutorial). Combat is ability- and modifier-heavy, with elemental damage, bosses, traps, chests, portals, and secret rooms. We need someone who can make those spaces read clearly, feel dangerous, and stay performant — not a generalist who only drops store VFX into a scene. The role You will own the look of gameplay and the objects players interact with: VFX & shaders — combat, status, environment, and feedback Level design game objects — tile dressing, interactables, and world-specific props that survive procedural assembly You work in the Editor: Shader Graph, VFX Graph, particle systems, prefabs, and tile layouts. Light C# is useful for wiring effects to gameplay; this is not a systems-programmer seat. What you’ll do VFX & shaders Author Shader Graph (and HLSL when Graph is not enough) for combat and environment: slashes, trails, shockwaves, beams, lava/ice, scan/highlight, dissolve, portals, status indicators. Build VFX Graph and Particle System prefabs for abilities, enemy telegraphs, boss attacks, pickups (Ash), teleports, traps, and discovery feedback. Adapt and restyle third-party packs (Hovl, UNI VFX, KriptoFX, elemental blast/shield kits, dissolve/scan FX) so they match Ember’s look and URP stripping/perf rules. Work with volumetric fog/lights, URP features, and material variants so fire vs ice vs stone worlds stay distinct without blowing the GPU budget. Make effects readable in combat: silhouettes, timing, color coding for elements/status, and clear “this will hit you” vs flavor. Level design game objects Dress and maintain DunGen tiles: rooms, corridors, start/end tiles, boss rooms, unique/secret rooms, transition tiles. Build and polish interactable prefabs: chests, doors, secret doors, traps, heal/modifier pickups, teleports, journal pickups, spawn VFX, merchant/set dressing. Place collision, triggers, spawn points, NavMesh-friendly geometry, and static flags so tiles generate cleanly and pass level validation. Profile and fix overdraw, fill rate, lightmap scale, and batching on tiles and VFX. What we’re looking for Required Shipped (or late-production) work in Unity URP with Shader Graph and either VFX Graph or high-end Particle Systems. Strong prefab / scene craft: hierarchy, LODs, colliders, materials, lighting, and “this object works when a generator instances it.” Portfolio that shows gameplay VFX (hits, AOE, status, telegraphs) and authored 3D spaces (dungeons, interiors, or tile-based levels) — not only cinematic reels. Comfort with performance: overdraw, particle budgets, shader variants, URP stripping, mobile/PC-class constraints. Ability to take an existing art kit and make coherent, on-theme game objects, not one-off hero shots. Strong plus Custom HLSL, Shader Graph subgraphs, or URP Renderer Features. Elemental / dark-fantasy combat look (fire, ice, poison, arcane, dissolve, scan). Light C# for VFX hooks, material property blocks, or pooling. ProBuilder, Polybrush, or kitbashing dungeon modular kits. Not the focus Character modeling/animation as a primary duty Full gameplay systems / AI programming UI/UX as a primary duty

title: Sales No cold calling. No prospecting all day. We generate the leads—you focus on converting them.
job_title: Sales No cold calling. No prospecting all day. We generate the leads—you focus on converting them.
description: Position Overview No cold calling. No prospecting all day. We generate the leads—you focus on converting them. You’ll speak with U.S. homeowners who have already expressed interest in our services, understand what they’re looking for, prepare and present their proposals, follow up, and close the sale. We’re a growing U.S. home-service company looking for someone who wants more than just another VA position. You’ll own the sales pipeline, earn commission on the business you close, and have the opportunity to grow into a larger sales leadership role as we expand. Your core mission: Help improve our conversion rate from 10% to 15%+ while building relationships that drive customer retention and referrals. Key Responsibilities 1. Sales Execution & Closing Process and manage inbound leads from all marketing/operations channels (ads, website, referrals, yard signs, etc.). Conduct consultative phone and video sessions to assess customer needs, property details, preferences, budget, and timeline. Develop, present, and close customized quotes and high-ticket proposals professionally. Overcome customer objections and execute contracts seamlessly. Ensure smooth post-sale handoffs to the field crew for installation. Build trust and positive relationships with clients to generate recurring referral business. 2. Lead Management & Pipeline Follow-Up Prioritize rapid response to new inbound leads. We believe speed-to-lead matters—the sooner a prospect receives a helpful, professional response after requesting a quote, the greater the opportunity to start a conversation and earn their business. While circumstances will vary throughout the day, treat new inquiries as a priority and respond as quickly as reasonably possible. Maintain a 24-hour maximum response standard. No new quote request or qualified inbound lead should go more than 24 hours without receiving a response or acknowledgment. Create responsiveness without pressure. Our goal is for prospects to feel that their inquiry is important and that our team is attentive—not that they are being chased or pressured into making a decision. Consistently follow up with open opportunities. Maintain organized, professional follow-up with prospects who have received quotes, requested additional time, or have not yet made a decision. Qualify and prioritize opportunities. Identify customers who are ready to move forward, those who require additional information or follow-up, and those who may be better suited for future consideration. Maintain an organized sales pipeline. Use the CRM and established follow-up processes to ensure opportunities do not fall through the cracks and that each prospect receives the appropriate level of communication throughout the sales process. 3. Customer Retention & Revenue Growth Lead seasonal renewal outreach to re-engage past clients and secure renewal contracts. Target and pursue upsell opportunities (e.g., upgrading seasonal packages to permanent solutions, expanding to additional properties, adding premium services). Build relationships focused on high lifetime customer value to hit a 75%+ renewal/rebooking rate. 4. Sales Process Improvement & Documentation Map out the sales workflow to identify bottlenecks, friction points, and conversion barriers. A/B test proposal formats, pricing structures, and objection-handling strategies. Create and update standard proposal templates, scripts, and objection guides. Continually refine approaches based on real-time customer conversations. 5. Feedback & Strategic Recommendations Submit monthly written reports detailing key operational and sales findings: Top objections and recurring pushback ("customers always ask about X"). Pricing feedback and sensitivity trends (e.g., "$1,500 seasonal closes at 40%; $2,000+ closes at 15%"). Actionable ideas to boost overall conversion rates from 10% to 15%+. Patterns regarding messaging that sells vs. messaging that fails. Partner directly with the CEO and Operations to test new pricing structures and sales messaging. 6. Sales Pipeline & Performance Tracking Weekly Pipeline Tracking: Maintain and share weekly updates on active leads, pending proposals, expected close dates, and key follow-up items to keep the team aligned. Monthly Sales Performance Report: Track and review: Total leads received and lead sources. Close rates, revenue by category, and month-over-month trends. Average deal value, lead response time, and proposal-to-close conversion rate. Renewal and rebooking progress compared with monthly/seasonal targets. Team Review & Follow-Up: Use the tracking data to identify opportunities, gaps, and follow-up priorities, and coordinate with the sales team on next steps. Required Qualifications You do not need previous experience in the holiday lighting industry. We can teach you our products, services, pricing, and sales process. What we're looking for is someone who knows how to sell, communicates well, follows up consistently, and is willing to learn. Sales ability: Previous experience in direct sales, inside sales, or customer-facing sales with the ability to understand customer needs, present solutions, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale. Excellent English communication: Strong spoken and written English with the confidence to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners by phone, video, email, and SMS. Relationship building: Able to quickly establish rapport and create a comfortable, consultative customer experience. Follow-up discipline: Organized and persistent without being pushy; able to manage multiple opportunities at different stages of the sales process. Objection handling: Comfortable discussing pricing, answering questions, addressing concerns, and helping customers make confident purchasing decisions. Organization & CRM use: Comfortable learning and consistently using CRM systems to document conversations, proposals, follow-ups, and deal status. Self-directed & accountable: Able to prioritize opportunities, manage responsibilities independently, and take ownership of results. Team player & collaborative: Works well with others, communicates openly, shares information, and is willing to support the team to achieve shared goals. Coachable & willing to learn: Open to feedback and willing to learn our products, services, customers, and sales process. Reliable remote-work setup: Reliable computer, high-speed internet, professional work environment, and ability to consistently work U.S. Eastern Time. Preferred Qualifications The following experience can help you succeed in the role, but you do not need to check every box to apply: 3+ years of direct or high-ticket sales experience. Experience selling to U.S. customers. B2C or full-cycle sales experience. Home-service sales experience such as HVAC, solar, roofing, landscaping, lighting, or similar industries. Remote phone or video sales experience. Experience with recurring, seasonal, or renewal-based revenue. Experience with upselling, account growth, or customer retention. Experience providing feedback that helped improve a sales process. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can sell, communicate professionally, follow up consistently, take care of customers, and continue improving. If you have a strong sales background but haven't worked in holiday lighting before, we still want to hear from you. When applying, be prepared to share examples of your previous sales experience, results you're proud of, and situations where you successfully helped move a customer from initial interest to a completed sale. Competencies Results-driven: Motivated by closing deals and hitting targets Adaptive: Willing to test approaches, measure results, and pivot based on data Customer-focused: Builds genuine relationships; understands long-term value of customer retention Detail-oriented: Maintains accurate records; tracks what's working and what isn't Collaborative: Works well with small team; open to coaching and process feedback Proactive: Identifies opportunities and problems before being asked; offers solutions Role Expectations 1. Work Environment Location: 100% Remote (Must work from home or anywhere in the Philippines). Work Schedule Standard Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), following U.S. Eastern Time. This is a consistent U.S. daytime / Philippine overnight position. Optional Peak-Season Hours: During our busiest sales season, representatives who want additional earning opportunities may choose to extend their availability until approximately 7:30–8:00 PM ET. Extended hours are optional and are not part of the standard year-round schedule. Team members who prefer to maintain the regular 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET schedule may do so. For representatives who want to maximize their earnings during peak season, the extended window provides additional opportunities to respond to inbound leads, conduct customer consultations, follow up with active opportunities, close additional sales, and earn additional commission. 2. Employment Structure Status: 1099 Independent Contractor (either party must provide 2 weeks' notice to terminate). Equipment: Contractor must supply their own reliable computer, phone, high-speed internet, and necessary work environment. Why Join Us? Base Pay + Uncapped Commission: Earn a guaranteed hourly base plus commission on new sales, renewals, and upsells, with additional performance bonus opportunities. Work With a Great Team: Join a supportive, collaborative team with a hands-on and approachable CEO who values good ideas, initiative, and teamwork. Leadership Opportunity: Take a key role in helping lead and grow the sales team, with the opportunity to shape sales processes, improve performance, and contribute to the company’s growth. Room to Grow: As the company continues to grow, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and make a meaningful impact. 3. Reporting Structure Work closely with the CEO to stay aligned on sales priorities, pipeline progress, and growth goals. Partner with the Operations team to coordinate lead information, property details, and installation scheduling. Share feedback and ideas with Operations to make lead handoffs smoother and improve the overall customer experience. Compensation & Earning Potential This position combines a guaranteed hourly base with uncapped sales commission and performance-based bonus opportunities. Our compensation structure is designed to provide dependable base income while rewarding representatives who generate new business, grow existing accounts, retain customers, and deliver a strong customer experience. Base Pay: $5.00–$8.50 USD/hour Starting base pay is determined by experience, communication ability, demonstrated sales performance, and overall qualifications. There is also room for base compensation to grow as you demonstrate strong performance and take on additional responsibility. New Customer Sales: 5% of Gross Profit Earn 5% of gross profit on qualifying new customer sales you successfully close. Upsells & Account Growth: 5% of Gross Profit Earn 5% of gross profit on the additional sale when you successfully sell additional products, services, or upgrades to an existing customer. For example, if an existing customer adds additional lighting or another service to their original project, the 5% commission applies to the gross profit generated by that additional sale. Customer Renewals: 2% of Gross Profit Earn 2% of gross profit when a returning customer reaches a renewal decision and you successfully secure their business for another term. This includes: Returning one-year customers who renew for another season or term. Customers who have completed a multi-year agreement and choose to enter into a new agreement. Customers who are still within an active multi-year agreement are not considered renewals and do not generate renewal commission on their existing contracted service. However, any qualifying additional products or services sold to that customer are eligible for the 5% upsell commission. Additional Performance Bonuses Representatives may also qualify for additional performance-based bonuses tied to individual and company goals, including sales performance, close rates, customer retention, and customer satisfaction. Your Performance Drives Your Earning Potential Our compensation philosophy is simple: the more value you create, the greater your opportunity to earn. Your hourly base provides consistent compensation for managing customers, following up with leads, maintaining the sales pipeline, supporting existing accounts, and completing the day-to-day responsibilities of the position. Commission rewards you for producing measurable results: New revenue → 5% of gross profit Upsell/expanded revenue → 5% of gross profit Renewed revenue → 2% of gross profit Existing contracted revenue → Base compensation Sales commission is uncapped, allowing high-performing representatives to increase their earnings as they close more business and grow customer accounts. High-performing representatives may also have opportunities to advance into Senior Sales Representative, Sales Lead, or Sales Management positions with increased responsibility and compensation. Payment & Invoicing Invoices are submitted semi-monthly on the 1st and 15th of each month. Direct wire transfer or digital payment is processed within 2–3 business days of invoice submission. No expense reimbursement is provided. Please send your resume along with a 1–2 minute video introduction telling us a little about yourself and why you believe you're the best fit for the role. Submit your application to ---------- look forward to hearing from you!

Requirements You must have: At least two years of experience in e-commerce supply chain, logistics or order operations Experience working with Shopify stores generating at least $100,000 in monthly revenue or processing a high daily order volume Strong experience with Shopify and ParcelPanel Experience communicating directly with suppliers or fulfillment agents Good knowledge of tracking statuses, carrier delays and fulfillment problems Experience using Google Sheets or Excel Excellent written and spoken English Strong problem-solving, organization and follow-up skills Experience handling multiple stores, suppliers or workflows The confidence to hold suppliers accountable when agreements are not followed Experience with Gorgias, Slack, ---------- , 17Track, YunExpress or ParcelsApp is a strong advantage. Anyone can do that now. AI made good prose free, which means good prose is no longer the job. We're looking for someone who works the ticket before writing it. You should: — Read the real carrier events, not the tracking link the customer already saw — Check whether this person wrote before, and what was promised last time — Notice the payment method — PayPal and card have different dispute clocks — Tell a policy abuser apart from someone genuinely upset and about to leave one star — Chase the courier yourself instead of telling the customer to keep waiting — D ---------- within your limits instead of escalating everything and slowing the queue — Close the conversation, so the same person doesn't write three more times You should be able to take a Shopify order, a tracking page that hasn't moved in five days and an angry customer, and turn it into a resolved ticket and a customer who stays. --- LANGUAGES (NON-NEGOTIABLE) --- Our customers write from all over Europe, and every email is answered in the language it arrived in — never in English, and never in something that reads like it came out of a translator. A customer can tell within one sentence. — English at a top level, written and spoken. It's our working language and the one you translate through — You don't need to be native in every market. You do need replies a native reader wouldn't flag as translated — Which means catching what translation tools get wrong: formality in German, politeness register in French, warmth in Italian and Spanish — Any European language you genuinely have is a strong plus, not a requirement — Written level is what counts. You'll be judged on the emails you write, not on a certificate If your English isn't strong enough to move quickly and accurately in both directions, this role isn't the right fit. --- HOW WE USE AI (AND HOW WE DON'T) --- We assume you use AI. You should be confident in: — Drafting and translating with it, and holding one consistent tone across every language — Building your own prompts, macros and saved replies, so the same answer isn't rewritten fifty times — Checking every fact first: AI invents shipping dates and policies, and the customer holds us to them — Knowing which tickets it never touches alone: reactions, legal threats, disputes, anyone on their third email — Spotting the answer that is technically correct and still wrong, because it missed the problem underneath — Keeping the result human: a reply that reads as generated costs more trust than a slower one would have If your workflow is pasting the customer's email into ChatGPT and sending back whatever comes out, this role isn't the right fit. --- THE KIND OF PERSON WHO WILL THRIVE HERE --- You'll be a strong fit if you: — Have handled real volume for an e-commerce brand, and know your daily ticket count — Know your own numbers: response time, refund rate, chargeback rate, contact rate — Are comfortable inside Shopify: orders, fulfillments, refunds, customer history — Know what macros, tags and SLAs are actually for — Chase people internally when something is stuck, without being asked twice — Write short: six clear lines beat three paragraphs, in every language — Stay calm with someone being unfair to you, and calm again the third time — Have judgment about money: a partial refund today often beats a chargeback next week — Notice patterns: thirty emails about one thing means something upstream is broken — Care whether the customer comes back, not just whether the ticket is closed We care about support that protects revenue. That doesn't mean saying no to customers. It means every reply — and every refund decision — should support the relationship, the trust, and the next order. --- SKILLS & EXPERIENCE --- Ideally, you have experience with: — Customer service for an e-commerce or DTC brand running paid social — Shopify: orders, refunds, fulfillments, customer history — A helpdesk: Gorgias, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Front, Intercom, or similar — Email, WhatsApp, live withdrawal — PayPal and card disputes, resolved before they become chargebacks — ChatGPT, Claude, DeepL, or an AI agent inside the helpdesk Bonus if you've worked with beauty, skincare, or K-beauty brands targeting a female audience over 40. --- WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING DAY TO DAY --- — Answering emails in the language they arrived in, inside our response time targets — Working each ticket properly: order, tracking, history and payment checked before you reply — Chasing couriers on stuck parcels, and d ---------- when to reship — Handling refunds, returns and withdrawal requests within your limits — Catching disputes early, before they become chargebacks — Replying to comments and DMs under our ads, where a cold audience is watching — Improving macros, saved replies and prompts so the whole queue gets faster — Flagging patterns: the product page that causes tickets, the courier that keeps failing — Adapting tone and templates as each new European market opens --- WHAT'S IN IT FOR covered by us — Real autonomy: a spending limit you can d ---------- within, from early on — Owning the customer relationship for a brand growing across multiple European markets — Long-term growth title: Revenue Management
description: We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant with genuine, hands-on revenue management experience. Pricing is the heart of this role. You will own PriceLabs across our entire portfolio, and that is where your performance will be measured. The remaining hours are spent running the properties day to day, which is what makes the pricing work: you cannot price a portfolio well if you do not know what is actually happening in it. This is not an entry-level admin role. You will be setting base prices, tuning minimum stays, building comp sets and reading market data, then acting on what it tells you. Our target is 85 to 90% occupancy across the portfolio. Low occupancy means the price is too high. A calendar filling too fast means the price is too low. If reading that sentence made you want to open a dashboard, we want to hear from you. This is a long-term position with room to grow into a senior property manager or client success role. Responsibilities: Revenue Management (the core of the role, approx. 8 hrs/week): Own day-to-day dynamic pricing across the full portfolio in PriceLabs. Set and maintain base prices, minimum prices, seasonal profiles, dynamic minimum stays, orphan gap rules and last-minute discounts. Build and maintain competitor sets for each property and monitor Market Dashboards for pricing and occupancy trends. Monitor pace and pickup against the 85 to 90% occupancy target and adjust proactively rather than reactively. Manage PriceLabs syncing with our PMS (Hostfully) and troubleshoot listings not pushing rates correctly. Connect and configure new properties in PriceLabs as they are onboarded. Report on ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and revenue by property, and flag underperforming listings early with a recommended fix. Property Management (approx. 32 hrs/week): Manage guest communications through our PMS and AI messaging tools, maintaining our five-star communication standard and fast response times. Coordinate changeover cleaning teams across the portfolio, confirm turnovers are scheduled and completed, and review the post-clean video for every property, including under beds, all white goods, and under sofas and tables. Handle maintenance issues end to end: triage the report, dispatch the right contractor, chase to completion, confirm the fix. Manage guest issues and complaints using our established templates, and handle Airbnb Resolution Centre requests including damage and additional charge claims. Monitor reviews, respond appropriately, and escalate anything that may warrant a removal case. Keep listings, calendars, property information and compliance records accurate and up to date across all channels. Support onboarding of new properties: gather property details, populate guest manuals, set up listings and get them live. Write and maintain SOPs as processes are established. Client Support: Handle client inquiries and assist with invoicing, questions, and other support needs. Prepare owner-facing revenue and performance summaries. Business Support: Manage and update tracking sheets, databases, and other business-related data. Verify supplier invoices and prepare payments for approval. Assist with various administrative tasks to support business growth. Requirements: Substantial hands-on experience with PriceLabs. You should be able to talk us through settings you have changed, why, and what happened to revenue as a result. Proven short-term rental revenue management experience: ADR, RevPAR, occupancy, pace and pickup, booking windows, seasonality and comp sets. Comfortable with numbers and able to reason about supply and demand rather than just follow a checklist. A background in economics, finance, data or hotel/airline revenue management is a strong advantage. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. A proactive, responsible, and reliable attitude. Access to strong WIFI and a computer. Desired Qualities: Excited about working with a growing company on a long-term basis. Ability to work independently and take initiative. Nobody will be checking your calendar for you. Good judgement and commercial intuition. We would rather have someone who can spot that a price looks wrong than someone who can recite the jargon. A positive, can-do attitude.

title: Full-time Bookkeeper
description: Who We Are - Hello; my name is Casandra Armstrong, and I am the President of Resilient Pro Group LLC. We are an accounting and tax firm based out of Phoenix, AZ (United States). We are a small, but growing company and are experiencing quite a bit of growth. This has pushed the need for us to hire you, our newest team member. We help small businesses, just like ours, maintain, manage, and grow their businesses by ensuring accurate financials, processing payroll for their employees, tax preparation and strategy. We ensure we can take as much off the owner’s plate as possible while building trust within our working relationships. You’re probably wondering if you would be our first Filipino team member? Actually, no. We currently have 4 team members who are from the Philippines like yourself. We have 2 bookkeeping specialists, a tax specialist, and an administrative specialist that are based in the Philippines as well. In addition to them, our operations manager is US based. If you’re wondering what you would be doing? The job title is Bookkeeping Specialist. I am looking for someone who can perform detailed bookkeeping for several small business clients. Your primary duties as a bookkeeper would include document processing, data entry, account reconciliation, ledger management, and financial report processing while understanding the business structure and needs. We are QuickBooks based, so a QuickBooks background is required. However, we will also train on processes. So, why should you join us over anyone and everyone else? If you would like… 1) a steady pay check with the chance for bonuses based on performance, 2) the opportunity to work from home without a boss breathing down your neck, 3) a team environment where you work with others to share the work, and 4 ) if you want to work for a stable, growing U.S. firm, …then this is a job you will enjoy and excel at. How to know if you’re qualified for this opportunity? We are looking for someone who has bookkeeping experience, complete understanding of debits and credits, assets and liabilities, inter-company transfers, problem solving skills, fluent in English speaking and writing with the experience of speaking directly with US clients, and most importantly someone who can work with little to no direction and meet deadlines. We do not expect you to know it all as we will train you in your position with everything you need to know about our clients and our field for you to be able to excel at your job. I do need you to be a good leader- someone who can effectively manage him or herself at the job as well as manage others; someone who has extensive attention to detail, can manage and meet deadlines, follow processes and provide ideas for enhanced processes, problem solve and troubleshoot on their own with little to no direction, be able to effectively resolve issues with upset clients. Intermediate bookkeeping/accounting experience, and QuickBooks experience is required. I also cannot teach you to have a good attitude and to be self-motivated. These are things you must demonstrate in the interview process. A successful applicant must be able to demonstrate: * A can do attitude, and the ability to work without constant supervision * Be able to speak in conversational English and write in passable English as well * Knowledge of Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Dropbox, QuickBooks, and general ability to use windows based software * Have or be willing to obtain Internet fast enough to allow for virtual meeting such as zoom and VOIP phone calls without degradation * Working microphone and Internet video camera * Workstation with 2 monitors So, what are the working hours? As I stated before, our company is based in Phoenix, Arizona so we would require you to work during the US business hours, Monday to Friday 8:00am to 5:30pm Arizona Time What about pay? We are serious about hiring someone and are looking to fill this position ASAP. I also want this to be a real job that can meet your financial needs. Therefore, pay is negotiable but know I want you to be happy and satisfied working here, and a good pay scale is part of that. What about the 13th Month? Wondering if we pay the 13th month? Unfortunately, we do not. However, we do offer other benefits such as pay time off, holiday pay, and sick time for Full-Time positions. These benefits begin to accrue after your 90 days probation period of a full-time position. What happens next? Since our jobs are so popular we generally get deluged with applicants. So, I have designed a multi-part interview process to make the process as simple and efficient for all parties. The first part of the interview process is designed to examine your English-speaking & writing skills, personality type, internet speed and ability to follow directions. Please realize the initial application process will take a time commitment on your part of roughly 10-20 minutes. Since this job is intended to be well paying, I hope this time commitment is acceptable to you. Please be advised that those who submit incomplete applications will be passed over. If you make it through this first round, we will talk via video chat to answer any questions you may have as well as get to know you better. If this goes well, I will invite you to meet some other team members, as well as call your references to see if there is still a good fit. We will then ultimately hire someone. How to Apply Therefore, to submit your application for the job, please complete all of the following and email them to me at the reply to email address: ---------- Please send me all the following to applications at resilientpros dot com a. Your resume b. Link to your onlinejobs.ph profile and, c. Names with your relationship for 3 people I can contact whom would say good things about working with you. This could be a priest, former employer, bank manager, school teacher, but no more than 1 of these people can be a family member. 2. Please also complete the tests at the following link and provide a copy of your results: ---------- /leveltest/grammar_level_test.htm ---------- /disc-personality-test/ ---------- /tools/speed-test/work-from-home-speed Please be advised that incomplete applications will be ignored. title: Marketing & Brand Growth Manager
description: **Full-Time | Remote | Philippines** **Company: Credit Gnomes** **Focus: B2B Property Management / PropTech / Financial Services** About Credit Gnomes Credit Gnomes is building a payment-performance and resident financial-engagement platform for the rental-housing industry. Our model creates a win for residents, property managers, and property owners by recognizing responsible payment behavior, helping improve payment performance, and delivering valuable resident benefits. We are a lean, collaborative, entrepreneurial team, so we are looking for someone who is comfortable working across functions, moving quickly, and taking a campaign from concept all the way through execution and measurement. ## The Role We are looking for a versatile, execution-oriented **Marketing & Brand Growth Manager** who can turn an established marketing framework into a consistent operating rhythm. This is not a role for someone who only wants to create social media posts or give high-level strategy. We need someone who can **own day-to-day marketing execution** across social media, email, content, client materials, campaigns, automation, and reporting. You should also be comfortable using AI thoughtfully to increase speed and scale without sacrificing accuracy, trust, or brand quality. ### Your Primary Mandate Build a recognizable and trusted Credit Gnomes brand and a measurable marketing funnel that consistently: * Creates qualified conversations * Supports client adoption * Strengthens retention * Supports the Sales team * Produces measurable marketing results ## What You Will Own ### Brand & Messaging You will help translate Credit Gnomes' positioning, voice, and brand platform into clear and credible messaging for property managers, owners, partners, and residents. You will: * Maintain consistent messaging across presentations, emails, social posts, flyers, client communications, and campaigns * Help maintain a practical message library, editorial standards, and approval process * Review marketing materials for accuracy, tone, visual consistency, and appropriate use of claims before release ### Social Media & Thought Leadership You will own our editorial calendar and day-to-day social presence, with an initial focus on **LinkedIn and B2B property-management audiences**. This includes: * Creating and repurposing social posts * Short-form video * Infographics * Executive thought leadership * Educational content * Campaign series * Monitoring engagement and relevant industry conversations * Identifying conversations and prospects that should be routed to Sales ### AI-Enabled Content Production We actively use AI and automation. You should know how to use tools such as ChatGPT and other generative AI platforms for: * Research * Drafting * Editing * Content repurposing * Personalization * Marketing automation * Prompt creation * Workflow development We are NOT looking for someone who simply copies and pastes unreviewed AI-generated content. You should know how to combine AI with strong human judgment, editing, brand awareness, and quality control. You will also help create reusable prompts, templates, and workflows that improve our marketing production speed and quality. ### Email Marketing & Lifecycle Campaigns You will help review, improve, build, and optimize our email marketing programs. This may include: * Outbound campaigns * Nurture sequences * Prospect follow-up * Client onboarding * Partner campaigns * Resident communications * Retention campaigns * Re-engagement campaigns You should understand: * Audience segmentation * List management * Subject-line testing * Calls to action * Email deliverability * Sender reputation * Bounce and complaint monitoring * Suppression practices * Campaign optimization * Consent and CAN-SPAM practices You will also coordinate campaigns with Sales so email, calls, meetings, and follow-up tasks operate as one connected funnel instead of isolated activities. ### Lead Data, Bots & Marketing Automation Credit Gnomes already has bots and automation workflows supporting our marketing and sales operations. You will work with these systems to support: * Lead research * Qualification * Outreach * Routing * Follow-up * Segmentation * Campaign readiness You will help monitor automation outputs, identify weak results or errors, and recommend improvements. You should also be comfortable working with lead lists, including: * Segmentation * Deduplication * Data quality * Campaign readiness * Human review where judgment or compliance is required ### Client Marketing & Advocacy You may work directly with clients to help create: * Co-branded resident flyers * Notices * Educational content * Lease-support language * Videos * Rollout materials * Client marketing assets You will also help establish a repeatable testimonial and case-study program by identifying strong stories, conducting interviews, coordinating approvals, and turning results into credible marketing proof. You will help keep important company materials current, including: * One-sheets * Sales decks * Proposal content * Website copy * Implementation materials * Client asset kits ### Campaign & Funnel Operations You should be able to build marketing campaigns that connect: **Awareness → Consideration → Urgency → Conversion** across channels such as: * Social media * Email * Referral campaigns * Events * Partnerships * Direct outreach We use **Salesforce as a marketing system of record**, so experience with Salesforce is highly desirable. Marketing-related Salesforce work may include: * Campaign membership * Lead and contact management * Source attribution * Lead status * Task handoffs * Campaign reporting * Funnel reporting * Dashboards You will work with Sales and Client Success to improve follow-up standards, handoffs, dormant-lead programs, and re-engagement campaigns. You will also help produce a concise monthly marketing and funnel dashboard with recommendations based on campaign performance. ### Partnerships, Events & Visibility You may also support: * Conferences * Webinars * Sponsorships * Referral partners * Co-marketing initiatives * Industry partnerships * Pre-event and post-event campaigns * Press-ready messaging * Executive talking points * Marketing asset organization You may also coordinate with external designers, videographers, agencies, or marketing partners when specialized production is needed. ## Who We're Looking For Ideally, you have **4+ years of hands-on B2B marketing experience** across several areas such as: * Content marketing * Social media * Email marketing * Campaign execution * Lead generation * Marketing automation * Client marketing * Brand development * CRM / marketing operations Experience in any of these industries is highly valuable: * Property management * Rental housing * PropTech * FinTech * Banking * Insurance * Consumer finance * Credit reporting * Financial services * Other regulated or trust-sensitive industries Experience involving **TransUnion, Equifax, or Experian** is especially valuable. ## Communication Skills You must have **excellent written and spoken English**. This role may communicate directly with: * Executives * Clients * Partners * Sales * Account Management * Operations * Technical team members Strong grammar, editing judgment, professional communication, and attention to detail are very important. ## Tools & Platforms Experience with the following is helpful: ### Salesforce Campaigns, lead/contact management, reporting, dashboards, task handoffs, and collaborating with technical implementers. ### ChatGPT / Generative AI Research, drafting, editing, repurposing, prompt development, personalization, and workflow support. ### Microsoft 365 Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint. ### Figma Reviewing and adapting branded layouts and coordinating digital assets. ### Adobe Tools Editing PDFs, graphics, images, and marketing collateral. ### Email & Social Platforms Campaign creation, scheduling, analytics, deliverability monitoring, list management, and optimization. Additional experience with Canva or similar creative platforms is also useful. ## Helpful Additional Experience Bonus points if you have experience with: * Video scripting * Recording and light video editing * Webinars * Events * Public relations * Executive thought leadership * SEO * Website content * Paid social * Paid search * Partner marketing * Referral marketing * Client onboarding * Customer marketing * Co-branded marketing materials ## What Success Looks Like We care about measurable business impact, not simply producing a high volume of marketing activity. Success may be measured through areas such as: * Brand consistency * On-time publishing * Qualified audience growth * Reach and engagement * Qualified leads generated * Meetings influenced by marketing * Response and conversion rates * Email deliverability * Opens, clicks, replies, and conversions * List health * Client asset turnaround time * Testimonials and case studies * Campaign attribution * Lead-stage movement * Follow-up compliance * Funnel performance ## The Person Who Will Thrive Here You are a **builder and an operator**. You can move from strategy to a finished campaign. You ask good questions. You can manage multiple deadlines. You care about details. You protect the brand. You are comfortable working in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment. Most importantly, you look for ways to improve the system each time you use it and value **measurable progress over marketing activity for its own sake**. # HOW TO APPLY — PLEASE READ CAREFULLY Before applying, please take the time to understand our company. Visit: ** ---------- ** Please actually review the website before recording your application video. We want to hear what YOU think Credit Gnomes could improve or do with its marketing based on what you learned about the company. ## REQUIRED: 2–3 Minute Loom Video Please record a **short Loom video — maximum 2–3 minutes**. In the video, please introduce yourself and briefly answer: 1. Who are you, and what is your marketing background? 2. What areas of marketing are you strongest in? 3. After taking the time to review ** ---------- **, how do you think you can specifically help Credit Gnomes with its marketing, brand, and growth? Please do not send a long presentation. **2–3 minutes only.** We are not judging video production quality. We simply want to meet you, hear how you communicate, and understand how you think. ## IMPORTANT — DO NOT APPLY THROUGH OLJ ONLY **We do not regularly check OnlineJobs.ph applications or messages.** If you want your application to be reviewed, please send it **DIRECTLY VIA EMAIL**. Send the following: * Your resume * Your 2–3 minute Loom video link * A portfolio or relevant marketing samples, if available to: ---------- ### REQUIRED EMAIL SUBJECT: **Marketing & Brand Growth Manager** Again, **please do not rely on submitting your application through OnlineJobs.ph.** Email your application directly to ---------- so we can review it.

title: Operations Systems Analyst (Process, Tooling & Compliance)
description: We're a Canadian real-estate development company. Our team is remote and mostly in the Philippines — architects, project managers, an automation developer, admin. We design and build multi-unit residential buildings, and we're moving from small projects to considerably larger ones. **The honest problem.** Three weeks ago we wrote a thirty-page operations manual — how a task gets defined, how work gets handed over, how decisions get made, how files get named. It is genuinely good. Almost nobody is following it yet. We have Slack, ClickUp, JobTread, Google Workspace and a full AI stack. And information still lives in DMs, in people's heads, and in whichever tool someone happened to open. Tasks exist without deadlines. Files exist in three places. Two people absorb everything that nobody routed anywhere, and those two people are the bottleneck for the whole company. We don't need more software. We've built plenty. We need one person whose entire job is making the standard real. **What you'll own** 1. The system of record. ClickUp and JobTread reflecting what is actually happening — not what someone meant to update three days ago. 2. Compliance with the standard. Checking that work is registered, planned, traced and closed the way the manual says. Chasing the people who didn't. And doing it yourself when chasing fails — because a record that isn't there is worse than one that's late. 3. Records and file discipline. One home per project. Version control that survives a drawing revision. Naming that means a file can be found by someone who wasn't in the conversation. 4. The friction loop. When someone bypasses the system, your first question is not why did they do that — it's what made the right way expensive? Then you fix that, and the standard sticks. 5. The weekly picture. Our founders currently have no reliable view of what's in flight. You build it and you keep it true. **What is not yours** Managing people — that's our admin manager. Running projects — that's our project managers. Building the software — that's our developer. You own the system, the records, and whether the standard is actually being kept. **Who fits** You probably joined a Western company remotely as a coordinator, assistant or analyst — and ended up building how the company worked, because nobody else was going to. You were handed a tool nobody wanted to own. You watched people ignore it and keep working in email. And you figured out that the fix was never reminders — it was making the right way easier than the workaround. That path matters more to us than any credential. If you also have ISO 9001 / QMS document control, or BPO quality assurance or workforce management behind you, say so early — both build exactly the discipline this needs. You are comfortable telling a senior person that their meeting has no agenda, or that their task has no deadline, and doing it in a way that doesn't make an enemy. That specific social skill is most of the job. You're fluent with AI tools, or you'll be fluent within a fortnight. We use Claude daily and we'll pay for whatever you need. **Who doesn't** If your PMO experience is from a large company where you had a mandate, a budget and a governance committee, this will frustrate you — here you'll have a manual, a Chief of Staff who backs you, and no committee at all. If you're a systems administrator who configures beautifully and never chases a human, the configuration is the easy half. And if your answer to non-compliance is "I would remind them," this isn't the role. **Hours** You work with the team, so you're on the team's hours, which we are actively shifting toward PHP day time, right now it goes to about 3am. **Pay** Tell us your number and why. **To apply** Put PLUMBLINE as the first word of your application. Then three answers. Specifics win. 1. The diagnosis. Here is a real situation. A company has four Slack channels for one project, two of them dormant. Their project tool has thirty open tasks; eleven have no deadline and six have no owner. The current drawing set exists in three folders with names like final_v2_REVISED.pdf. Two people answer every question because everyone asks them directly. What's actually wrong here, ranked by what you'd fix first — and why that one first? 2. The rollout that failed. Tell us about a system, tool or process you put in place that people didn't use. What broke, what you changed, and did it work the second time? Screenshots beat descriptions. 3. The enforcement problem. You've set a standard and half the team is quietly ignoring it. Walk us through your first week of dealing with that. Shortlisted candidates get a 30-minute call, then a paid trial: two days inside our actual systems, producing one real weekly report.
