title: SEO, GSC & Analytics Specialist
description: Seeking a highly experienced SEO, Google Search Console, and Analytics Specialist to take ownership of our organic-search performance, technical SEO, conversion measurement, reporting, and performance-recovery planning. This is not a basic content-publishing, indexing, or keyword-entry position. We need someone who can independently analyze complex performance data, identify declines before management discovers them, determine their likely causes, and develop measurable plans that improve qualified traffic, conversions, and business growth. Primary Responsibilities SEO Performance and Google Search Console * Monitor GSC clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position * Separate branded and non-branded search performance * Analyze results by page, query, device, country, and search appearance * Identify the highest-gaining and highest-declining queries and pages * Proactively report material ranking, impression, CTR, indexing, and traffic changes * Diagnose whether losses resulted from rankings, search demand, migration issues, content changes, cannibalization, technical problems, or other causes * Identify commercial, informational, local, branded, and decision-stage opportunities * Create and maintain a prioritized keyword-to-URL map * Identify content overlap, search-intent conflicts, and keyword cannibalization * Develop recovery plans for declining and underperforming pages * Monitor completed changes after 7, 14, and 28 days Reports must go beyond exported data. They must explain what changed, why it matters, which URLs and queries are affected, what actions are recommended, and how success will be measured. Technical SEO and Website Auditing * Audit redirects, canonicals, robots directives, XML sitemaps, and indexing controls * Review HTTP/HTTPS and www/non-www configurations * Identify 404 errors, redirect chains, broken links, duplicate pages, and crawl issues * Evaluate website migrations and redesigns for lost URLs, changed content, missing redirects, altered internal links, and ranking impact * Establish pre-change and post-change baselines for redesigns and major website updates * Monitor Core Web Vitals, mobile SEO, crawlability, renderability, and page performance * Review titles, metadata, headings, schema, internal links, and URL architecture * Determine when pages should be created, updated, consolidated, redirected, retained, or removed * Maintain a detailed SEO change log * Coordinate technical implementation with WordPress developers or implement changes directly when qualified and authorized * Validate significant changes before and after deployment * Use staging, backups, testing, and rollback procedures for changes that could affect the live website Repeatedly testing or resubmitting URLs is not considered a substitute for diagnosing the underlying indexing, canonical, content-quality, or technical problem. GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Lead Attribution * Audit or configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager from the ground up * Install and verify GTM and GA4 across the website * Configure tags, triggers, variables, events, and key events * Track consultation forms, calls, appointment bookings, signups, CTA clicks, and other qualified lead actions * Configure source, medium, campaign, landing-page, device, and conversion attribution * Prevent duplicate, missing, or incorrectly triggered events * Test configurations through GTM Preview, Tag Assistant, and GA4 DebugView * Exclude internal, developer, spam, and other inappropriate traffic * Create useful GA4 reports, Explorations, or Looker Studio dashboards * Connect organic landing-page performance with engagement, lead activity, and conversion results * Document the complete tracking configuration and monitor its continued accuracy * Clearly distinguish general events from actual leads, appointments, enrollments, and other business outcomes The specialist must understand that increases in total users or events do not automatically demonstrate SEO or business growth. Performance conclusions must separate Organic Search from Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, and unassigned traffic. Reporting and Performance Accountability Extensive and accurate reporting is a core requirement of this position. Reports must provide decision-ready analysis—not screenshots, automated summaries, raw exports, or lists of completed activities. The specialist will establish reliable historical baselines, compare current performance with relevant prior periods, identify developing trends, recommend corrective actions, and measure whether completed actions produced the intended results. Initial Baseline Report The initial report must establish the website’s condition before major corrective work begins, including: * Available historical GSC and GA4 performance * Pre-redesign, redesign, launch, and post-launch comparisons when data is available * Current clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, users, sessions, engagement, and qualified lead activity * Branded versus non-branded performance * Organic versus Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, and unassigned traffic * Leading and declining queries, pages, and landing pages * Commercial versus informational search visibility * Current indexing, canonical, redirect, sitemap, Core Web Vitals, mobile, and technical status * Current conversion events, tracking gaps, and attribution limitations * Confirmed findings, reasonable hypotheses, immediate risks, and recommended priorities Weekly Performance Report A complete report will be required every Monday and must include: * Current 7-, 28-, and 90-day performance compared with corresponding prior periods * Clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position * Branded and non-branded search performance * Top gaining and losing queries * Top gaining and losing pages * Organic traffic by landing page * Qualified leads and conversion rates by source, medium, landing page, campaign, and device * Significant ranking, indexing, technical, or conversion changes * Exact URLs affected and supporting evidence * Work completed during the previous week * Results of previously completed changes * Items awaiting recrawl, implementation, additional data, or validation * Corrective actions for declining performance * Priorities for the next seven days, ranked by expected impact * Risks, blockers, and decisions requiring management attention Monthly Trend and Business-Impact Report The monthly report must include: * Month-over-month and year-over-year trends when sufficient data is available * Progress against established baselines and performance targets * Commercial versus informational visibility * Organic traffic quality and engagement * Consultations, signups, qualified calls, appointments, and other tracked lead actions * Pages and queries producing meaningful business activity * Actions that produced measurable improvements * Actions that did not produce the expected results * Content that should be retained, refreshed, retitled, consolidated, redirected, expanded, or stopped * Technical issues affecting growth * Priorities for the next 30, 60, and 90 days Change and Validation Reporting Every significant SEO or analytics change must document: * Exact URL or tracking component * Date of change * Previous condition and baseline * Problem being addressed * Supporting evidence * Action completed * Person responsible * Expected result * Validation method * Status after 7, 14, and 28 days * Actual result * Decision to retain, revise, expand, or reverse the change Material performance declines, tracking failures, indexing problems, or website issues must be reported when discovered. The specialist should not wait until the next scheduled report when an issue could materially affect rankings, traffic, leads, or website functionality. Strategy and Performance Planning The selected specialist must transform data into a prioritized performance plan—not simply provide screenshots, exports, generic recommendations, or lists of completed activities. The specialist will be expected to: * Identify and explain material declines proactively * Separate verified findings from reasonable hypotheses * Prioritize the highest-impact actions based on evidence * Create realistic 30-, 60-, and 90-day performance plans * Establish baselines, targets, and measurable success indicators * Protect existing informational authority while expanding commercial visibility * Improve qualified organic traffic, search CTR, service-page visibility, consultations, and lead activity * Connect work to specific URLs, queries, business objectives, and expected outcomes * Develop on-page, technical, content, local, and legitimate off-page recommendations * Review completed work and change direction when the data does not support continuing the same activity * Communicate risks before making changes that could affect rankings, traffic, tracking, or website functionality Content and Website Coordination The specialist will provide or approve SEO content briefs containing: * Approved topic and working title * Primary and supporting queries * Search intent and intended audience * Create, update, consolidate, or redirect decision * Target URL * Existing pages checked for overlap * Recommended outline and questions to answer * Internal links and anchor text * CTA and conversion destination * Metadata and schema requirements * Measurement checkpoint A content and WordPress assistant may implement approved instructions, but the SEO specialist will remain responsible for strategy, performance analysis, and validation. The specialist is not automatically expected to build complete websites. However, they must be highly trained in WordPress technical SEO and capable of directing developers during redesigns, migrations, page-speed work, plugin changes, and other SEO-sensitive projects. Advanced Website Development — Preferred Advanced website-development experience is not required for the core SEO and analytics position, but it is a significant advantage. A candidate who can safely implement complex website improvements—not merely identify or recommend them—may qualify for additional hours and higher compensation based on demonstrated ability. Preferred development capabilities include: * Advanced WordPress development beyond basic page builders * HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and child-theme customization * Custom post types, templates, hooks, and theme modifications * Plugin configuration, conflict diagnosis, and safe troubleshooting * Website migrations, staging environments, backups, and rollback procedures * Redirect implementation, canonical controls, schema, robots directives, and sitemap configuration * Core Web Vitals and advanced page-speed optimization * Database, hosting, CDN, caching, DNS, SSL, and server-level troubleshooting * Secure form, CRM, API, webhook, and third-party platform integrations * Mobile-responsive and conversion-focused website development * Ability to diagnose frontend, backend, plugin, hosting, and performance problems * Ability to document, test, validate, and safely deploy changes without disrupting the live website Basic WordPress page building, theme installation, or plugin installation alone will not be considered advanced development experience. Candidates claiming advanced development skills must be prepared to demonstrate them through a live technical walkthrough and provide examples of completed work. A candidate with verified development abilities may also be assigned: * Website redesigns and new website builds * Technical SEO implementation * Complex WordPress corrections * Website migration and launch management * Performance and Core Web Vitals improvements * Plugin, theme, hosting, and server troubleshooting * Conversion-focused landing-page development * GA4/GTM, CRM, form, and API integrations These additional assignments may increase the available weekly hours and approved hourly rate. Expanded hours, responsibilities, and compensation will be determined by demonstrated skill, project requirements, quality of work, and prior approval. Required Experience * Advanced hands-on SEO experience with measurable results * Expert-level Google Search Console analysis * Strong GA4 and Google Tag Manager implementation experience * Proven experience diagnosing and recovering ranking or traffic losses * Experience managing SEO-sensitive website redesigns and migrations * Advanced technical SEO and WordPress knowledge * Strong understanding of keyword intent, content architecture, cannibalization, and internal linking * Experience configuring lead and conversion attribution * Extensive experience producing actionable SEO and analytics reports * Ability to establish historical baselines and interpret short- and long-term trends * Ability to identify performance problems without waiting for management to point them out * Ability to prioritize high-impact work instead of repeatedly completing low-impact routine tasks * Ability to independently validate AI-assisted findings, recommendations, and technical instructions * Ability to explain complex findings in clear business language * Strong documentation, testing, prioritization, and reporting skills Experience within consumer finance, credit, financial services, legal, healthcare, or another high-trust/YMYL industry is strongly preferred. This Position Is Not a Fit If You * Primarily rely on AI-generated recommendations without independently validating the data or possessing the advanced knowledge required to correct problems and improve performance * Can explain advanced SEO concepts in writing but cannot demonstrate them using live data, tools, and real website examples * Only perform basic content publishing, metadata entry, internal linking, or indexing requests * Report completed activities without connecting them to rankings, qualified traffic, conversions, or measurable outcomes * Provide automated reports or screenshots without analysis, trends, causes, recommended actions, and expected results * Treat impressions, total users, total events, or short-term increases as proof of SEO or business growth without reviewing traffic sources and comparison periods * Cannot distinguish Organic Search from Direct, Social, Referral, Paid, internal, or unassigned traffic * Wait for management to identify major performance declines before investigating them * Cannot diagnose redesign- or migration-related ranking losses * Recommend continuing routine on-page work when the data indicates a more urgent technical or strategic problem * Provide generic audits without exact URLs, evidence, priorities, ownership, validation, and review dates * Make URL, redirect, canonical, plugin, caching, or technical changes without documentation and testing * Use cache purges, plugin adjustments, or repeated indexing submissions as trial-and-error solutions without identifying the root cause * Claim expertise in GA4, GTM, technical SEO, or WordPress troubleshooting but cannot demonstrate hands-on implementation * Cannot work collaboratively with content assistants, WordPress developers, and automation specialists * Cannot demonstrate experience through a live technical walkthrough Estimated Weekly Commitment The anticipated commitment is approximately **15–20 hours per week during the initial audit, GA4/GTM setup, reporting, and SEO-recovery phase**. After the initial implementation, ongoing SEO and analytics work is expected to average approximately **8–12 hours per week**, depending on performance needs and approved priorities. Candidates with verified advanced website-development skills may receive additional project hours for approved website builds, redesigns, migrations, technical corrections, performance improvements, and integrations. Major development projects will be scoped and approved separately. Hours worked beyond the approved weekly schedule must receive prior authorization. Application Requirements Please provide: 1. Your requested hourly rate 2. Weekly availability and preferred working schedule 3. Earliest available start date 4. Years of hands-on SEO, GSC, GA4, GTM, and WordPress experience 5. A brief example of a traffic or ranking decline you independently identified, diagnosed, and corrected 6. A brief example of a website redesign or migration you monitored or recovered 7. A brief example of a GA4/GTM lead-tracking system you implemented 8. An example of how your reporting identified a trend and led to measurable improvement 9. The tools you regularly use for crawling, technical SEO, reporting, and performance analysis 10. An anonymized SEO report, technical audit, dashboard, change log, or recovery plan 11. Examples of advanced WordPress or website-development work, if applicable 12. Two professional references or verifiable client reviews, if available Please answer in your own words. You may use tools to organize your application, but you must be able to independently explain and demonstrate every statement, recommendation, and example during the live verification. Technical Verification Final candidates will participate in a live screen-sharing session. During the session, they may be asked to: * Analyze sample GSC page and query data * Identify material performance losses * Separate branded and non-branded search activity * Diagnose one declining landing page * Explain how a redesign or migration could have affected performance * Identify technical, content, reporting, and conversion risks * Prioritize corrective actions under a limited time or budget * Explain how results would be validated after 7, 14, and 28 days * Design a GA4/GTM lead-event tracking plan * Explain how they distinguish general activity from qualified lead actions * Demonstrate how they would present findings, trends, and recommendations to management * Demonstrate advanced development abilities if claiming those qualifications The purpose of this session is to verify practical experience, independent reasoning, technical ability, reporting quality, and the ability to connect SEO and analytics findings with measurable business outcomes. Engagement This is a remote contractor position. Initial hours will be based on the technical audit, analytics setup, recovery priorities, and ongoing performance-management needs. Continued work will depend on: * Communication and responsiveness * Accuracy and independent reasoning * Proactive identification of problems * Documented and validated execution * Reporting quality * Efficient use of approved hours * Measurable progress toward qualified traffic, conversions, and business growth To apply, use the subject line: SEO & Analytics Specialist – [Your Name]

Below are three versions of the same YouTube title. My voice is simple, short, funny, and written the way I talk. No corporate words. Leveraging AI to Fundamentally Transform Your Content Workflow How I Post 30 Times a Week Without Losing My Mind The Ruthless System Top Creators Use To Dominate Content Tell me which one is mine, and why the other two are wrong. One sentence each. Then write a fourth title that beats all three. I'm not testing your writing. I'm testing whether you can tell good output from bad.

description: **Type:** Part-Time – Long-Term Opportunity **Hours:** 20 hours per week to start **Location:** Remote – Philippines **Salary:** Negotiable **Schedule:** Flexible, with some availability during Canadian Eastern Time ## About the Position We are a Canadian organization looking for an intelligent, resourceful, and highly organized **Grant Researcher & Proposal Writer** to join our team remotely. This is **NOT a general Virtual Assistant position.** Your primary responsibility will be to find funding opportunities in Canada and help us develop strong applications. We need someone who can independently research opportunities, determine whether we qualify, explain why an opportunity is worth pursuing, and prepare professional funding applications. ## Your Responsibilities ### Grant Research You will: * Research Canadian federal, provincial and municipal grants. * Research foundations, corporate giving programs and community funding. * Search government funding portals and other grant databases. * Identify less obvious funding opportunities. * Determine eligibility before recommending a grant. * Identify application deadlines, funding amounts and requirements. * Research relevant statistics and supporting information. * Identify potential partnerships and other opportunities that could benefit the organization. ### Grant Writing You will: * Prepare grant applications and proposals. * Write Letters of Intent and funding requests. * Develop needs statements, program descriptions, objectives and measurable outcomes. * Assist with grant budgets and supporting documentation. * Edit and proofread applications before submission. * Ensure applications directly answer the funder's requirements. ### Grant Management You will maintain an organized Grant Tracker showing: * Funding opportunity * Funder * Amount available * Eligibility * Deadline * Application requirements * Website/source * Status * Date submitted * Follow-up date * Result You will also provide regular updates on upcoming funding opportunities and application deadlines. ## Who We Are Looking For We want someone who is naturally curious and enjoys research. You should be the type of person who doesn't stop after the first Google search. If information is difficult to find, you keep investigating. You should be able to come back to management and say: “I researched this opportunity. We appear to qualify because of A, B and C. The maximum funding is X. The deadline is Y. These are the documents we need, and I recommend that we apply.” We value **accuracy, initiative and judgment** more than simply producing a large volume of applications. ## Requirements You must have: * Excellent written English * Excellent online research skills * Strong professional writing ability * Excellent attention to detail * Ability to work independently * Strong critical-thinking skills * Ability to follow detailed instructions * Strong organizational skills * Experience with Google Docs and Google Sheets or Microsoft Office * Reliable computer and internet connection Previous grant-writing, proposal-writing, research, nonprofit, academic research or government-funding experience is strongly preferred. Experience researching Canadian, American, UK or Australian grants is an asset. ## AI Use You may use tools such as ChatGPT to assist with your work. However, **AI-generated information must never be submitted without verification.** You are responsible for checking eligibility, deadlines, funding amounts and requirements directly from reliable or original sources. What is your expected hourly rate? 8. What hours are you available to work? 9. Please provide one writing or research sample. ## RESEARCH TEST Please complete the following short exercise. Imagine you are researching funding for a **Canadian nonprofit organization providing residential and community-based programs for children and youth.** Find **TWO currently relevant Canadian funding opportunities** that the organization could potentially pursue. For each opportunity provide: * Name of funding program * Funding organization * Website/source * Maximum funding available, if stated * Eligibility requirements * Application deadline * Why the organization may qualify * Any restrictions or concerns you identified **Important:** Verify the information from the original funding source whenever possible. title: Delivery & Operations Manager
description: We need the person who makes sure nothing gets missed. We're an established Australian growth agency in a highly regulated health sector, building brands, websites, CRM systems and lead nurture journeys — plus internal brands of our own: a 20,000-member community, an education platform and a product brand. Small senior team, founder-led, heavily AI-integrated: Claude is part of daily work here, and it will be part of yours. This is a project management and delivery operations role first. What you'll own: The board (the core of the job). Client requests arrive by portal, email, Slack, WhatsApp and Messenger — every one becomes a ClickUp task the same day, with an owner, a due date and a brief clear enough that the assignee knows what "done" looks like. You run all active projects across ~10 client accounts: deadlines, dependencies, blockers, scope. Nothing client-facing gets missed. This outranks everything else in the role. The weekly rhythm. Monday planning with the founder, Wednesday board audit, Friday end-of-week report, weekly per-account check-ins, monthly client performance reports, fortnightly payroll submission. The rhythm already exists and is documented — your job is to run it without being chased, then improve it. The team's delivery. A senior designer, developer, video editor and social media manager do the work — you brief them, sequence them, chase them and QA against our standards. When something's overdue with no comment, you're the one in their DMs asking what's blocking, with a deadline attached. The clients. Delivery-side client communication: clarifying requests, chasing approvals and assets, running webinar and newsletter logistics, keeping clients informed without the founder in the loop. Clients deal with you for delivery; the founder for strategy. The founder. He is the bottleneck on approvals — that's the honest reality of a founder-led agency. You manage the review queue, batch it, chase it with consequences attached ("if this isn't approved by Thursday, the send moves"). If managing your own boss sounds uncomfortable, stop reading. If it sounds like the missing piece of every PM job you've had — keep going. The systems (the minority of the week, and it matters). Our stack is GoHighLevel, ClickUp, WordPress, Pabbly/n8n, AgencyPro. You don't need to be a master builder — but you need to be technical enough to administer GHL (contacts, workflows, calendars, sub-accounts), make small website updates without a developer, troubleshoot an automation, and write SOPs as processes stabilise. You'll work alongside AI tools daily to draft, document and automate. You're probably a fit if: You've spent 3+ years running delivery in an agency or multi-client environment — briefing specialists, chasing deadlines, managing clients — and you can tell us about specific projects you kept on the rails You're a ClickUp (or Asana/Monday) power user who has actually run a team's board, not just your own tasks You've administered a CRM — GoHighLevel ideally, or HubSpot/Keap/ActiveCampaign with confidence you'd pick GHL up fast You're comfortable in WordPress for content edits and small fixes You chase people — clients, teammates, the founder — directly, politely and relentlessly, and you ship work when an input is missing rather than letting a small blocker stall a whole deliverable You use AI tools daily as working tools, not novelties You're the person who notices the overdue task with no comment, the brief with no due date, the form with no success message Bonus: GHL building experience (funnels, sequences), email marketing, basic analytics (GA4/Search Console), Shopify, SOP libraries you've written, regulated-industry experience (health, finance, pharma). The deal: Independent contractor, 30–40 hrs/week, AUD $12–22/hr depending on experience. 13th-month pay after 12 months. 90-day trial with written goals at day 30, 60 and 90 — you'll know exactly what success looks like. Minimum 6 hours/day overlap with AEST, with the request channels monitored morning, midday and end of day. Long-term seat reporting directly to the founder. How to apply — email ---------- with: A note first: we use AI daily and expect you to. But these questions are about your actual work — if an AI could answer them without you, you've answered them wrong. Specifics, names, numbers and screenshots win. Your CV. Proof you've run a board. One screenshot from inside a ClickUp/Asana/Monday workspace you personally managed (blur client names), plus 3–5 sentences: how many people and projects it covered, and one thing you changed about how it ran. Written answers — from your history, not a textbook: Tell us about a deliverable that was about to miss its deadline because something was missing — an asset, an approval, an answer. What was missing, what did you actually do, and did it ship? Tell us about chasing an approval from someone senior to you — who (role, not name), what was stuck, what did you actually say, and what happened? Describe the messiest client request you've ever received. What did it say, what did you ask, and what did it become? A 2–3 minute video (camera on for the intro, then screen share): 30 seconds on you — who you are, where you're based, what you're into outside work. Then walk us through a project or board you ran — show the actual thing on screen. Finish by answering this out loud, unscripted: it's Monday 9am, you've got 30 tasks across 6 clients, two are blocked on client assets, one deadline slips tomorrow, and the founder just Slacked you something "urgent" — talk us through your first hour. We already serve customers internationally and are preparing to expand our Shopify operation beyond its initial focus on Japan. Many of our products are unique pieces or sets of wood, each with its own photographs, dimensions, grade, weight and price. Our immediate priority is getting substantially more inventory online while improving data accuracy and helping customers find suitable products. About the Role We are looking for someone who can help build, operate and improve our entire product-listing process: Inventory information → Excel → AI-assisted preparation → validation → Shopify → SEO → search and filters → related products → quality control. This is more than a product-upload position. We want someone who can organize data, identify repetitive work, develop practical improvements and think about how customers shop. Website design and Shopify theme development are not the primary focus. Main Responsibilities Product Data and Shopify Operations - Organize product information and photographs with our Japan team. - Maintain accurate Excel records for SKUs, species, product types, grades, dimensions, weights, prices and inventory. - Prepare, validate and manage bulk product imports. - Maintain Shopify products, metafields, tags, collections and product categories. - Ensure photographs and specifications correspond to the correct products. - Verify published listings and resolve errors. Excel, AI and Automation - Help develop a repeatable inventory-to-Shopify workflow. - Use ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar tools to assist with data preparation and content creation. - Validate AI output against source information and flag missing details rather than guessing. - Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual work. - Document processes so other team members can follow. SEO and Product Discovery - Research the terminology customers use when searching for our products. - Improve product titles, descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions and image alt text. - Improve collections, search, filters and navigation. - Help establish appropriate related products, complementary products and alternatives. - Review results and suggest further improvements. title: Social Media Content Manager + Reels Editor for Australian Education Brand

description: We are an Australian education business looking for a talented, reliable Social Media Content Manager who can take ownership of our weekly content creation, editing, scheduling and publishing. This is not a role for someone who simply creates Canva graphics. We are looking for someone who understands short-form content, trends, audience behaviour, retention, strong hooks, repurposing, educational content, thought leadership and how social media can build both trust and long-term business growth. ## About the Brand We are an established Australian education business specialising in writing and literacy programs for children. Our content includes: * Education and parenting content * Writing and literacy advice * Podcast clips * Short-form educational videos * Inspirational content * Travel and lifestyle content connected to the founder’s personality and brand * Reels based on current trends * Carousels and educational graphics * Workshops, courses and educational products The founder already creates a significant amount of original content, ideas, footage and educational material. Your job is to turn that material into strong social content and manage the execution. ## Our Bigger Goal Our goal is not simply to sell through social media. We want to become one of the most trusted voices in education, literacy and children’s writing. Our audience should follow because they genuinely learn from the content. We want parents and educators to think: “I always learn something from this page.” “This explains something about my child I hadn’t understood before.” “I trust what she says about teaching and learning.” For this reason, we care about more than sales. We care about: * Reach and audience growth * Shares and saves * Meaningful engagement * Educational value * Building trust and credibility * Strong thought leadership * Creating content people remember * Growing a community that sees the brand as a trusted source of education Commercial results still matter, but they should grow from genuine trust, authority and value — not constant selling. ## What Is Happening Currently Our current results vary significantly depending on the type of content. Trend-based travel, funny and inspirational Reels can receive approximately 3,000–4,000 views. Podcast and educational Reels typically receive approximately 500–1,500 views. Some professionally designed/static posts receive only around 200 views. We do not want someone who simply continues creating more content because a calendar needs to be filled. We want someone who can look at the data, understand what is working, identify what is not working and continuously improve the strategy. ## Your Responsibilities You will be responsible for: * Researching relevant Instagram and TikTok trends * Identifying trend opportunities that suit our brand * Editing short-form Reels * Editing podcast clips into engaging short-form content * Creating strong hooks and on-screen text * Creating selected educational carousels and graphics * Writing or refining captions * Repurposing existing content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts * Scheduling and publishing content * Maintaining a weekly content calendar * Organising content for approval before publishing * Reviewing analytics and identifying what is performing * Making recommendations based on actual results * Helping grow the brand into a highly trusted educational voice * Creating content that teaches, builds authority and expands reach * Helping social media attention translate over time into trust, enquiries, email subscribers and business growth ## What We Are NOT Looking For Please do not apply if your strategy mainly consists of: * Posting every day just for consistency * Creating generic Canva graphics * Using large groups of hashtags * Following a fixed content calendar regardless of performance * Producing content without reviewing analytics * Copying trends that do not suit the brand * Constantly pushing sales without first building trust * Creating content that looks polished but teaches very little We care about quality and impact more than simply filling every posting slot. ## The Ideal Person You should have strong experience with: * Instagram Reels * TikTok-style short-form editing * CapCut, Premiere Pro or similar * Canva * Social media scheduling tools * Content repurposing * Trend research * Hooks and retention * Storytelling * Educational or thought-leadership content * Social media analytics * Strong written English Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Higgsfield or similar is a bonus. You must have good visual taste and understand what modern, premium social content looks like. Because our primary market is Australia, it is important that you can create content that feels natural to an Australian/Western audience. ## Weekly Scope The exact volume may evolve based on performance, but an initial week may include approximately: * 3 short-form Reels * 1–2 educational carousels or graphics * Podcast clip repurposing * Trend research * Captions * Cross-platform repurposing * Scheduling and publishing * A short weekly performance summary * Recommendations for the following week The founder will provide raw footage, podcast clips, educational ideas, voice notes and existing material. You are expected to take ownership from there. We want the founder reviewing and approving content — not managing every step of production. ## Compensation Initial budget: **USD $400–$600 per month** Part-time ongoing role. We are more interested in finding the right long-term person than the cheapest person. There will be an initial paid trial before an ongoing arrangement is offered. ## To Apply Please include ALL of the following: 1. A link to your portfolio. 2. Three examples of short-form Reels or videos that YOU personally edited. 3. One or more social media accounts you have personally managed. 4. One example where your content significantly outperformed that account’s normal performance. Tell us: * Normal views/reach * Views/reach achieved * What you believe made it perform better 5. Tell us what tools you currently use for: * Video editing * Graphic design * Scheduling * AI/content creation 6. Answer this question: **If trend-based Reels on an account receive 3,000–4,000 views, educational/podcast clips receive 500–1,500 views, and designed static posts sometimes receive only 200 views, what would you change about the content strategy and why?** 7. Answer this question: **How would you build an education founder into a trusted authority while still creating content that performs well on social media?** 8. Answer this question: **How would you use high-reach lifestyle or trend content to strengthen trust in an education brand without making every Reel feel like an advertisement?** 9. Start your application with the words: **PURPLE PENCIL** Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered. We are looking for someone thoughtful, creative, proactive and commercially aware who understands that the goal is not just to create content — it is to build a trusted, recognisable and highly respected education brand over time.

title: Full-Time Video Editor — Short-Form + Long-Form Real Estate Investing Content (Vertical Reels & YouTube)
job_title: Full-Time Video Editor — Short-Form + Long-Form Real Estate Investing Content (Vertical Reels & YouTube)
description: Capital Unlimited is a real estate investing education and funding brand built around a working professional's real story — 21 properties, $10M+ in combined portfolio and transaction volume, built in five years while still holding a full-time corporate job. We publish two kinds of video content, both scripted in detail before they ever reach an editor: Short-form vertical reels (Instagram + TikTok + YouTube Shorts, 9:16, 20–90 seconds) — talking-head teaching pieces, occasional gym/lifestyle b-roll cuts, and branded carousel-style slide reels. Long-form YouTube videos (25–35 minutes, 16:9) — single-camera teaching videos with branded diagram graphics cut in at specific moments, following a written script with exact cue points for every cut. We're looking for a full-time editor to become the dedicated hands on this pipeline — someone who can take a finished script (with its own recording notes and editing notes already written out) and a folder of raw footage, and turn it into a publish-ready file that matches our established house style every time, without needing hand-holding on the basics of what to do. What you'd actually be doing week to week: Cropping and reframing landscape or mixed-aspect raw footage into clean 9:16 verticals, keeping the subject centered even when the source footage shifts position mid-clip. Cutting long-form videos to full-screen branded diagram graphics (navy background, gold accent) at exact moments named in the script — e.g. "cut to diagram-X.png exactly on 'the phrase that triggers it'" — and holding them for the specified duration. Burning in clean, readable captions (one to two lines, centered lower third) across every piece, short-form and long-form alike, in a consistent style. Loudness-normalizing audio so every piece plays at a consistent volume, and building simple instrumental beds into pieces that call for music (most don't — we deliberately use a lot of raw synced audio, no music, no text labels; you'll be told exactly which is which per piece). Adding on-screen exercise/step labels to lifestyle and process b-roll where a script calls for it, checked against reference frames rather than guessed. Doing occasional subtle punch-ins on specific lines the script flags as needing emphasis. Delivering QA'd exports — every long clip gets checked end-to-end before it's called done, not just spot-checked. Turning around a batch of reels or a long-form video within an agreed window, and flagging clearly (not silently guessing) if a script's instructions are ambiguous or footage is missing something the script assumes exists. You will almost never be asked to make creative judgment calls about story, message, or structure — that part is already done before you get the file. Your job is precise, consistent execution against detailed written instructions, plus enough editorial eye to flag it when something in the raw footage doesn't match what the script assumes. Requirements / Qualifications 2+ years of paid video editing experience, ideally with real portfolio examples of short-form vertical content (reels/TikTok/Shorts) and longer-form talking-head YouTube content — not just one or the other. Fluent, comfortable working in Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut (tell us which is your main tool). Strong, demonstrated eye for 9:16 reframing — cropping wide/landscape footage into vertical without losing the subject, including footage where the subject moves within the frame. Experience burning in captions cleanly (style consistency matters more than fancy animation here). Working knowledge of audio loudness normalization (you don't need to know the term "LUFS" going in, but you should already know audio has to be leveled consistently across a channel, not eyeballed per clip). Comfortable following a detailed written script with named cut points and timing instructions, and matching them precisely rather than improvising a different cut. Strong written English — you'll get instructions in writing, and you'll need to flag issues in writing too. This matters more than verbal English. Reliable, fast home internet and the ability to handle large 4K source files without constant upload/download friction. Available for real-time or near-real-time communication during a reasonable overlap with US working hours (exact overlap negotiable, but total radio silence for 12+ hours during a deadline week is a dealbreaker). Nice to have, not required: Basic motion graphics ability (simple lower-thirds, text animation) beyond static caption burn-in. Familiarity with ffmpeg or command-line video tools. Prior experience editing content in the real estate, finance, or coaching/education niche. How to Apply To help me filter for people who actually read this whole posting: start your application with the words "Cut on the cue" as the first line. Please include: Your resume. A link to your portfolio or reel — ideally including at least one 9:16 vertical piece and one longer talking-head YouTube-style edit, so I can see both skills. Which editing software you use as your main tool. Your available start date and your current time zone / working hours. One or two sentences on the largest volume of recurring weekly content you've edited for one client or channel before (we publish multiple reels a week plus regular long-form videos, so pipeline experience matters). Shortlisted applicants will be given one real (paid) test edit from our actual pipeline before any longer-term offer, so you can see the real workflow and we can see real output under our actual instructions.

title: Software Tester - 1 to 2 Month Period
description: We're an Australian manufacturer. We have several web and mobile applications being rolled out across the business, and we need a careful manual tester for approximately one month to find bugs before they go live to staff and customers. This is exploratory testing, not automation. For each application you'll get login details to a test environment, a short brief on what it's supposed to do, and a set of areas to focus on. Your job is to use it like a real user would, then try to break it. What you'll do Learn a new application quickly from a short brief and work out what "correct" should look like Work through core workflows — forms, uploads, search, saving and editing records — and try to make them fail Test edge cases: empty and overlong inputs, special characters, the browser back button, refreshing mid-form, double-clicking submit, dropped connection, two tabs open at once Test across Chrome plus one other browser, on both desktop and mobile Log every issue in our shared tracker with steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, browser and device, and a screenshot or screen recording Check the existing list before logging so we don't collect duplicates Re-test fixed issues when we push a new build Requirements Reliable internet, a computer, and a smartphone Written English good enough to describe a bug precisely and unambiguously Methodical and observant — we want someone who notices small inconsistencies, not just crashes Comfortable working independently and asking questions when something is ambiguous Willing to sign an NDA Not required: coding, test automation, or QA certifications. Hours and rate Around 20 hours per week for approximately one month, with scope to increase based on business needs and testing periods. Some overlap with Melbourne business hours is preferred, but the work is mostly independent. Possible ongoing work on future releases if it goes well. To apply Start your reply with the word "teapot", so I know you've read this. Then describe the last bug you found in any app or website - what you did, what you expected to happen, and what actually happened instead. Shortlisted applicants will be paid for a 2-hour trial task before we commit to the month.

title: Property Acquisition Virtual Assistant / Real Estate Investment Cold Caller
job_title: Property Acquisition Virtual Assistant / Real Estate Investment Cold Caller
description: We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company seeking a professional, reliable, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help identify homeowners who may be interested in selling their property directly to our investment company. This is NOT a real estate agent or brokerage position. Our company is seeking to purchase properties for its own investment purposes and portfolio. ABOUT THE ROLE You will make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved calling systems. Your goal is to determine whether a homeowner may be interested in discussing a potential direct sale of their property to our investment company. You are the first voice homeowners will hear from our company, so we are looking for someone who sounds professional, confident, friendly, and natural. This is NOT a script-reading robot position. You should be able to listen, build rapport, ask appropriate questions, handle rejection professionally, and have a genuine conversation. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved systems. • Follow company-approved scripts, calling procedures, calling hours, and compliance requirements. • Clearly and truthfully identify yourself and the investment company you are calling on behalf of. • Ask property owners whether they would consider selling their property directly to our investment company. • Have friendly and professional conversations with homeowners. • Identify homeowners who have a genuine interest in discussing a potential sale. • Gather approved basic information from interested homeowners, such as property condition, occupancy, motivation for potentially selling, expected timeline, and whether the homeowner has a price in mind. • Accurately document calls, conversations, notes, follow-ups, and outcomes in our CRM. • Categorize leads based on the homeowner's level of interest. • Schedule a follow-up conversation with the company owner when a homeowner expresses genuine interest in discussing a potential sale. • Conduct approved follow-up calls when instructed. • Immediately document any request from a homeowner not to receive additional calls and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach. • Provide regular reporting regarding calls, conversations, interested property owners, follow-ups, and CRM activity. IMPORTANT — REAL ESTATE LICENSING COMPLIANCE This position is for a real estate investment company seeking to acquire properties for its OWN account and investment portfolio. This is NOT a real estate brokerage position. Although the owner of the investment company may separately hold a New Jersey real estate license, this position is for the property investment/acquisition business and NOT for soliciting brokerage clients or real estate listings. The Virtual Assistant must follow all company policies designed to comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including applicable New Jersey Real Estate Commission requirements. YOU WILL NOT: • Represent yourself as a real estate agent, Realtor®, broker, attorney, appraiser, or other licensed professional. • Solicit homeowners to list their property with a real estate agent or brokerage. • Solicit listing agreements or brokerage relationships. • Offer brokerage or real estate representation services. • Represent third-party buyers or sellers. • Provide legal, tax, financing, appraisal, brokerage, or real estate advice. • Provide an appraisal, CMA, or opinion regarding property value. • Negotiate the purchase or sale of real estate. • Make binding purchase offers or agree to purchase prices or other material contract terms on behalf of the company. • Prepare, modify, interpret, explain, or execute real estate contracts. • Discuss real estate commissions or brokerage compensation. • Perform activities requiring a real estate license unless properly licensed and specifically authorized. When a homeowner expresses genuine interest in potentially selling, your responsibility is to gather the approved information, accurately document the lead, and refer the homeowner to the company owner for further discussion. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR • Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on a U.S. phone call. • Strong communication and listening skills. • Previous outbound cold-calling experience strongly preferred. • Experience calling U.S. homeowners strongly preferred. • Previous U.S. real estate investment cold-calling experience is a major plus. • Comfortable with rejection and high call volume. • Able to have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script. • Friendly and professional without being aggressive or misleading. • Organized and disciplined with CRM data entry and follow-up. • Reliable and punctual. • Quiet home workspace. • Quality headset and microphone. • Reliable high-speed internet connection. • Backup internet connection strongly preferred. • Reliable computer capable of operating web-based CRM and calling software. • Spanish-speaking ability is a plus but NOT required. TOOLS & TRAINING The company will provide or designate the approved: • Lead lists • Calling/dialer system • Calling scripts • CRM • Training • Lead qualification procedures • Calling and compliance procedures PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS Performance will be evaluated based on: • Consistent outbound calling activity • Number and quality of live homeowner conversations • Qualified/interested property-owner leads generated • Follow-up completion • CRM accuracy • Reliability and attendance • Professional communication • Compliance with company procedures 100% CRM documentation and compliance with company calling procedures are expected. The first 30 days will be a PAID TRIAL PERIOD. Strong performance can lead to a long-term position, additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation reviews as the company grows. COMPLIANCE — READ CAREFULLY All outbound calling must be conducted using company-approved lead lists, systems, scripts, calling hours, and procedures. The VA may not independently purchase, import, source, or begin calling their own lists unless specifically authorized by the company. The VA must never misrepresent their identity, the company they represent, the purpose of the call, their licensing status, or their authority. If someone asks not to receive additional calls, the VA must immediately document the request and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach. The VA must follow all company policies regarding applicable Do-Not-Call requirements, telephone solicitation requirements, calling restrictions, privacy, caller identification, and recordkeeping. Compliance is a condition of employment. Failure to follow company procedures may result in immediate termination. HOW TO APPLY Applications that do not include ALL of the following may not be reviewed. 1. Send a short message explaining: • Why you are good on the phone • Your previous cold-calling experience • Whether you have called U.S. homeowners • Whether you have worked for a U.S. real estate investor • Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day • Which dialers and CRMs you have used • Your desired hourly rate • Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time 2. Submit a 60–90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING role-playing this scenario: You are calling a homeowner on behalf of our real estate investment company because our company is interested in purchasing properties in their area. The homeowner says: “I wasn't really planning on selling, but I guess I'd consider it if the price made sense.” Continue the conversation naturally. Your objective is to determine whether the homeowner is genuinely interested and gather appropriate basic information. Do NOT negotiate a purchase price, make an offer, provide a property valuation, or provide real estate advice. 3. Send your resume and briefly describe the best cold-calling or lead-generation results you have personally achieved. IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words: “PROPERTY INVESTMENT” This lets us know you read the entire job posting. We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and can grow with our real estate investment company.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description: LEAD THE CREATIVE OPERATION. THEN HELP BUILD WHAT COMES NEXT. Creative Production is the center of this role at the start. You will manage the editors, own the production system, raise the quality of the work, and make sure strong creative moves from brief to final asset without senior leadership having to manage every detail. This is not a coordinator role. It is not a virtual-assistant role. We need a Marketing Operations Manager who can operate the day-to-day work and improve the system at the same time. A NOTE FROM OUR CMO Before applying, watch this short video from our CMO about the role, its expectations, and what success looks like: ---------- Once Creative Production is stable and you have demonstrated the judgment, leadership, and capacity required, the role will expand into Social Media Operations. That second phase will include the team, publishing, community, creator, affiliate, and channel systems around the content. Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date. The exact timing will depend on demonstrated readiness and business needs. ABOUT VERITAS Veritas builds complete Starlink Mini deployment setups—mounts, power, cables, cases, and accessories—for consumers, work teams, and government fleets. We are a growing US company with a small, high-output marketing team in the Philippines. Several team members have grown with the company over the long term. We want the same for this role. THE DETAILS • Full-time independent contractor role with fixed monthly compensation of $2,000–$2,500 USD, based on experience, leadership depth, and overall fit—not an hourly position • Approximately 45–50 hours per week, with the regular work schedule fully aligned with Pacific Time • Philippine graveyard shift: roughly 11:00 PM–8:00 AM or 12:00 AM–9:00 AM, depending on U.S. daylight saving time • Fully remote and long-term • This must be your only job. No part-time employment, side hustles, ongoing freelance clients, or subcontracting • Occasional weekend availability when production, launches, or publishing require management coverage • Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna required; no regular onsite office days, but occasional in-person meetings may be scheduled WHAT YOU'LL OWN At full production, the team aims to produce one long-form video and up to 14 supporting creative assets each week. These may include shorts/reels, static graphics, or carousels and are adapted for distribution across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. PHASE 1: LEAD CREATIVE PRODUCTION • Manage a two-person video-editing team, including their priorities, workload, deadlines, coverage, development, and performance. • Turn approved priorities into clear production plans, briefs, scripts, storytelling direction, B-roll needs, and deliverables. • Own the production pipeline: capacity, assignments, dependencies, revisions, blockers, asset readiness, and delivery visibility. • Review short-form, long-form, ads, thumbnails, static assets, carousels, platform versions, and other creative output. • Evaluate the full story—not only whether one shot matches one line. Check hooks, pacing, B-roll, demonstrations, captions, CTAs, factual accuracy, brand alignment, and viewer flow. • Give editors clear, prioritized, actionable feedback and verify that required revisions were completed correctly. • Use performance findings to identify stronger hooks, packaging, formats, V2/V3 opportunities, and creative tests. • Build and improve SOPs, review standards, production trackers, asset repositories, AI-assisted QA, and backup coverage. • Coordinate minor corrections and urgent production support when needed, without turning the role into a primary editing position. PHASE 2: ADD SOCIAL MEDIA OPERATIONS Phase 2 is planned to begin 60–90 days after your start date, once Phase 1 is operating reliably and you have demonstrated readiness for the expanded scope. At that point, you will also: • Manage the current Social Media Moderator and future social media team members. • Own the publishing calendar, content inventory, platform schedules, launch pushes, and publishing verification across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and X. • Ensure each platform receives the correct version, copy, CTA, description, tags, products, related content, links, and native-platform setup. • Oversee community, marketing inboxes, important comments and messages, channel presentation, and routine reputation handling. • Manage routine creator-partnership and affiliate operations, including communication, records, deliverables, logistics, and escalation. • Own routine UTM, Bitly, campaign-link, profile-link, and destination-verification workflows. • Review social performance and turn findings into decisions, tests, and coordinated creative recommendations. • Build and maintain the social department’s processes, AI workflows, reporting, and continuity systems. HOW THE ROLE FITS You will report to and work closely with senior marketing leadership. In Phase 1, the video editors report to you. In Phase 2, the Social Media Moderator also reports to you. You will have authority over routine departmental planning, assignments, quality, coaching, corrections, and process improvements within approved standards. Cross-functional, sensitive, contractual, financial, policy, staffing, reputation, and other material decisions remain with senior leadership. HOW WE USE AI Our marketing operation uses AI for context, research, briefs, feedback, quality control, documentation, analysis, automation, and institutional memory. We want someone who uses AI heavily to improve judgment and execution—not someone who accepts raw output. Sources must be checked. Brand and product accuracy must be protected. What the team learns should improve the next workflow. YOU'RE A STRONG FIT IF YOU • Have at least eight years of professional work experience. • Have at least three years managing teams and direct reports. • Have at least two years of experience inside a creative or marketing function. • Have meaningful corporate, in-house, agency, or field-based operating experience—not only freelance, VA, or task-based remote experience. • Have managed a creative-production pipeline and can explain the team size, volume, process, problems, decisions, and results. • Are exceptionally strong at storytelling and can diagnose why an edit is technically correct but still wrong for the overall story. • Hands-on video-editing experience is an advantage, but it is not required. You must be able to direct editors, evaluate their work, and clearly explain what needs to change and why. • Can coach editors, address recurring mistakes, manage underperformance, and maintain accountability without becoming the bottleneck. • Take action without waiting for step-by-step direction and consistently look for ways to improve quality, speed, visibility, and continuity. • Use performance evidence to improve creative work—not only report numbers. • Use AI daily with structured context, validation, human review, reusable systems, and feedback loops. • Communicate clearly in conversational American English. • Can sustain a Philippine graveyard schedule and occasional weekend coverage. • Reside in Metro Manila, Rizal, Bulacan, Cavite, or Laguna and be willing to attend occasional in-person meetings. • Have reliable primary internet, a backup connection, and backup power. • Want one company to grow with for the long term. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR • Someone who waits for detailed instructions before acting. • Someone whose experience is limited to task-based VA work, short freelance engagements, or managing multiple clients. • A strong individual contributor who does not want to manage, coach, and hold people accountable. • Someone who reviews only technical editing details but cannot evaluate the complete story and business goal. • Someone who creates more process without improving output, visibility, quality, or results. • Someone planning to keep another job, freelance clients, or subcontract any part of the work. • Someone testing a graveyard schedule for the first time without a credible plan to sustain it. HOW WE WORK Clear priorities. Direct feedback. Strong ownership. Problems are raised early. Decisions are documented. The goal is not to look busy. The goal is to build work that performs and an operation that improves. Our brand voice follows the same standard: short words, short sentences, confident but never salesy. Like a friend who knows the gear. HOW TO APPLY Use this subject line and at least 20 AP: [INSERT REQUIRED WORD] - [X] years of professional experience - [X] years managing teams Include the following: • Your resume with company names, employment dates, role titles, team sizes, and whether each role was corporate, in-house, agency, freelance, or VA work. • Have you directly managed a creative-production or video-production team? Answer Yes or No. If yes, state the team size. • Can you provide examples of videos, campaigns, or creative projects you directly led if you advance to the next stage? Answer Yes or No. Do not send links or detailed explanations at this stage. • In one short logistics block, confirm that this would be your only job and that you would complete all work personally. Include your city or province, most recent U.S.-hours role and actual schedule, primary and backup internet, backup power, and occasional weekend availability. Note: Applications missing any requirement will not be considered.

job_title: Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant
description: # Commercial Lead Research & CRM Virtual Assistant **Remote | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity** ## Compensation & Schedule * **Pay:** $3-$5 per hour based on experience * **Initial schedule:** 10–15 hours per week * **Initial research period:** September–December 2026 * **Location:** Remote * **Opportunity for continued long-term work based on performance** ## About the Company We are a New Jersey-based professional pressure washing and exterior cleaning company that currently serves residential and commercial customers. Our primary growth objective for 2027 is to significantly expand the **commercial side of our business** and develop long-term relationships with commercial properties and organizations. We are building a dedicated commercial prospecting system consisting of: **Research Department → CRM Database → Calling Department → Qualified Opportunities → Owner/Sales → Estimates & Contracts** We are hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to handle the **research and database-building portion of this system.** *VIRTUAL ASSISTANT WILL BE IN CHARGE OF BUILDING CRM SYSTEM FOR COMPANY* This is NOT primarily a cold-calling position. Your responsibility will be to identify high-quality potential commercial customers, research their contact information and decision-makers, and accurately enter and maintain this information in our CRM so our calling team can focus on making calls. --- # Your Primary Objective Your goal is to build/create and continuously maintain a large, accurate database of potential commercial customers for our exterior cleaning services. Our calling department should be able to open the CRM, select the next prospect, and immediately have the information needed to make the call. **We do not want our callers spending their paid calling time searching Google for phone numbers, websites, property managers, or company information.** Your research makes their calling possible. Our long-term goal is to transition the company toward a predominantly **commercial exterior-cleaning business**, while continuing to service residential customers. Your research will directly contribute to achieving these goals. --- # Commercial Prospects You Will Research You will research commercial properties and organizations throughout our assigned New Jersey service territories, including but not limited to: ### Highest-Priority Prospects * Condominium communities * Homeowners Associations (HOAs) * Apartment complexes * Multifamily communities * Property-management companies * Commercial property-management companies * Country clubs * Golf courses * Wedding venues * Event venues ### Additional Commercial Prospects * Hotels * Resorts * Senior-living communities * Assisted-living facilities * Shopping centers * Strip malls * Commercial plazas * Office buildings * Commercial campuses * Restaurants * Restaurant groups * Franchise locations * Swim clubs * Community pools * Private pools/facilities * Schools * Daycare facilities * Churches and religious facilities * Municipal buildings * Municipal facilities * Public facilities * Warehouses * Industrial properties * Car dealerships * Medical facilities * Gyms and fitness centers * Other commercial properties that could reasonably require professional exterior cleaning or pressure washing You should also identify **companies that manage multiple properties**, as these may represent especially valuable opportunities. --- # Information Required for EACH Prospect Accuracy is extremely important. Each qualified prospect should contain as much of the following information as reasonably available: ### Required Basic Information 1. Business/property name 2. Commercial category/property type 3. Full property address 4. City 5. County 6. Main business telephone number 7. Company/property website 8. General business email address, when available 9. Google/business listing information when relevant ### Decision-Maker Information Research the person most likely responsible for hiring exterior-maintenance contractors. Potential titles include: * Property Manager * Community Manager * Regional Property Manager * Facilities Manager * Facilities Director * Maintenance Manager * Maintenance Director * General Manager * Operations Manager * Director of Operations * Purchasing Manager * Procurement Contact * HOA/Condominium Association Manager * Other relevant decision-maker When publicly available, collect: 10. Decision-maker's full name 11. Job title 12. Business telephone number 13. Business/direct telephone number, if publicly available 14. Business email address 15. LinkedIn/profile information when useful and publicly available **Do not collect private or inappropriate personal information. We are looking for legitimate business contact information.** ### Property/Company Intelligence When reasonably available, also research: 16. Property-management company 17. Parent company/ownership organization 18. Approximate property size 19. Approximate number of buildings 20. Approximate number of units for condos/apartments 21. Other properties managed by the same management company 22. Other locations owned/operated by the same organization 23. Relevant notes that could help our calling team For example: **ABC Condominium Association → managed by XYZ Property Management → XYZ manages 11 additional communities.** That relationship is extremely valuable and should be documented. --- # CRM Responsibilities You will be responsible for accurately entering and maintaining all research inside our CRM/database. Every record should be: * Complete * Properly categorized * Properly formatted * Free of obvious spelling errors * Checked for duplicate entries * Assigned to the correct geographic area * Assigned to the correct commercial category * Updated when better information becomes available You may also receive records from our calling department marked **"Research Needed."** For example, a caller may discover that a condominium is managed by a particular property-management company. Your responsibility may then be to research that management company, identify the appropriate contacts, determine what other properties it manages, and add those opportunities to the CRM. You are expected to keep our commercial prospect database organized, useful, and continuously filled with new contacts (potential customers) --- # Productivity Expectations We care about **quality AND quantity**. Entering hundreds of inaccurate names and phone numbers is not acceptable. Spending an entire hour researching only a few basic business phone numbers is also not acceptable. These numbers are performance targets, not permission to sacrifice accuracy. Some high-value prospects may require additional research, particularly large condominium communities, apartment complexes, property-management companies, country clubs, and wedding venues. **One thoroughly researched property-management company responsible for 20 properties can be more valuable than 20 poorly researched businesses.** --- # Priority System Prospects will generally be categorized by potential value. ### A — HIGH PRIORITY Examples: * Large condominium/HOA communities * Large apartment complexes * Property-management companies managing multiple properties * Large country clubs * Golf courses * Large wedding/event venues * Multi-location commercial organizations ### B — MEDIUM PRIORITY Examples: * Hotels * Senior-living facilities * Swim clubs * Shopping centers * Commercial buildings * Schools * Large churches * Medium-sized commercial facilities ### C — STANDARD COMMERCIAL PROSPECTS Examples: * Individual restaurants * Small commercial buildings * Smaller businesses * Other potential commercial exterior-cleaning customers You should always prioritize **quality, high-value commercial opportunities** over simply generating the largest possible number of records. --- # What Success Looks Like When you are doing your job successfully, our cold-calling team should NEVER have to spend significant time searching for companies to call. They should be able to: **Open CRM → Review Prospect → Call → Record Outcome → Call Next Prospect** Your responsibility is to keep that pipeline full. --- # Who We Are Looking For The ideal candidate is: * Extremely detail-oriented * Organized * Reliable * Efficient * Comfortable performing extensive online research * Experienced with CRM systems or willing to learn quickly * Experienced with spreadsheets/databases * Able to follow written instructions EXACTLY * Able to work independently * Comfortable researching businesses and commercial properties * Able to verify information rather than guessing * Strong written English skills * Consistent with formatting and data entry * Able to recognize duplicate information * Able to understand company relationships and decision-maker roles * Comfortable being measured against weekly productivity goals Experience researching property managers, real estate companies, facilities managers, commercial businesses, or B2B prospects is a major plus. --- # IMPORTANT — APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS **Attention to detail is extremely important for this position.** We receive many applications. One of the first things we will evaluate is whether you carefully read this entire job posting and followed the instructions below. To apply, please do ALL of the following: ### 1. Use this exact subject line: **COMMERCIAL RESEARCH 2027** ### 2. Begin your application with this exact sentence: **“I read the entire Commercial Research job description and understand that accuracy and attention to detail are essential.”** ### 3. Answer these five questions: **A.** Tell us about your previous experience researching businesses, leads, properties, or decision-makers. **B.** What tools or websites have you previously used to find business contact information? **C.** What CRM systems have you previously used? **D.** If you discovered that one property-management company manages 15 condominium communities, explain what you would do with that information. **E.** In 2–3 sentences, explain what you believe the main purpose of this position is. ### 4. Final Attention-to-Detail Test At the **very end of your application**, after answering all five questions, write: **LWPWS* Do not place these words anywhere else in your application. Applications that do not follow these instructions exactly may not be considered. --- # Final Note This position is extremely important to the growth of our company. We are not looking for someone to simply copy and paste business names. We are looking for someone who can help us build a **high-quality commercial prospecting database** that our sales/calling department can continuously work from. The information you gather will directly support our effort to acquire commercial pressure-washing and exterior-cleaning contracts throughout New Jersey. If you are organized, efficient, reliable, excellent at online research, and take pride in accurate work, we would like to hear from you.
