title: Claude + Funnel, Funnelish Expert / AI Localization & Conversion Specialist
job_title: Claude + Funnel, Funnelish Expert / AI Localization & Conversion Specialist
description: READ EVERY WORD AND WE HIRE LONG TERM! Claude + Funnel Expert / AI Localization & Conversion Specialist We are a performance-driven eCommerce company operating primarily with direct-response funnels, dropshipping offers, paid traffic and international markets. We are looking for a very high-level specialist who combines: Claude expertise Funnel building AI automation Localization AI image adaptation Proofreading Target-market research Direct-response eCommerce thinking This is NOT a basic VA role and NOT a simple translation job. We need someone who can take a proven funnel, understand why it converts, adapt it for another product or country, rebuild it accurately, localize every element, QA the final result and improve it for the target audience. The ideal candidate is part funnel builder, part AI operator, part localization expert and part conversion-focused problem solver. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING You will work across our eCommerce funnels from initial research to final launch. Typical projects may look like this: We give you a winning funnel from the US market. Your responsibility is to: Study the entire funnel Understand the target customer Understand the offer and selling mechanism Rebuild or adapt the funnel Translate and localize it for another country Change images where required Adjust product visuals Change cultural references Adapt testimonials Adapt currencies and pricing Adapt units of measurement Adjust names and locations Proofread every section Check the entire funnel against the target market Test desktop and mobile Fix issues Deliver a final launch-ready funnel The job is not complete because the words have been translated. The job is complete when the funnel looks and feels like it was originally created for that market. CLAUDE EXPERTISE You should be highly capable with Claude. We especially value candidates who understand: Claude Claude Code Projects Large-context workflows Prompt engineering Structured prompting Reusable prompt systems AI research workflows AI-assisted coding HTML/CSS/JavaScript generation Content transformation Translation workflows Localization workflows Automated QA Data extraction Bulk content processing You should know how to turn Claude into an actual production system rather than using it like a basic chatbot. We want someone who can build repeatable workflows. For example: Original funnel → Claude extracts structure → customer avatar analysis → translation → localization → copy adaptation → image requirements identified → localized assets created → funnel rebuilt → automated QA → human proofreading → final market check → publish If you have built Claude workflows, scripts, MCP setups, agents or automation systems, tell us. FUNNEL EXPERTISE You should have real experience working with high-converting eCommerce funnels. Experience with Funnelish is strongly preferred. Experience with other platforms is also valuable, including: Shopify Replo GemPages PageFly ClickFunnels Webflow Custom HTML/CSS/JavaScript You need to understand: Landing pages Product pages Advertorials VSL funnels Pre-sell pages Checkout pages Upsells Downsells Order bumps Bundles Sticky CTAs Social proof Reviews Guarantees Urgency Scarcity Offer stacks More importantly, you need to understand why those elements exist. We are not hiring someone to simply drag sections around. We want someone who understands conversion. FUNNEL COPYING / RECREATION We frequently work from proven funnels. You may receive a reference funnel and be asked to recreate it for another product, brand or country. You should be able to accurately reproduce: Page structure Section order Layouts Spacing Typography Offer presentation Product positioning Comparison tables Reviews Testimonials CTA placement Sticky elements Visual hierarchy Mobile layouts Checkout flow You need excellent attention to detail. The goal is not to create something vaguely similar. The goal is to identify what makes the reference work and preserve those conversion principles in the new version. HIGH-END LOCALIZATION Localization is one of the most important parts of this position. You need to understand that translation and localization are NOT the same thing. A direct translation can still produce a terrible funnel. You need to check whether the finished page sounds natural to a real native customer. Depending on the market, this can include adapting: Language Tone Vocabulary Idioms Currency Pricing presentation Date formats Phone numbers Addresses Names Testimonials Measurement units Product claims Delivery language Payment terminology Guarantees CTAs Cultural references Visuals Customer expectations We expect extremely high standards. The customer should never feel like they are reading a translated American website. TARGET MARKET CHECK Before completing a localized funnel, you should think about the actual customer in that country. You should be comfortable researching questions such as: Who is the target customer? What are their main pain points? What terminology do they actually use? How aware are they of this type of product? Which objections are strongest? Which benefits matter most? What competitors are already selling there? How do those competitors communicate? What does a trustworthy local website look like? What payment methods do customers expect? What type of testimonials feel credible? What claims might sound strange in that market? What imagery feels authentic? Are there cultural differences affecting the offer? We want someone who questions things that do not make sense. Do not blindly translate. Think. AI IMAGE TRANSLATION & LOCALIZATION You will also work with visual assets. For example, an original funnel may contain an image with English text embedded inside it. We may need the same image localized into: German French Spanish Italian Dutch Swedish Polish Portuguese or another market. You should be comfortable using AI and image-editing tools to: Extract text from images Translate image text Replace text accurately Preserve the original design Match fonts Match spacing Match hierarchy Change currencies Change labels Adapt diagrams Adapt screenshots Localize comparison graphics Rebuild charts Change product packaging text where appropriate Generate replacement visuals Create localized lifestyle images Experience with tools such as these is valuable: ChatGPT image generation Nano Banana / Gemini Photoshop Canva Figma Midjourney Kling Runway Google Veo Other image-generation or editing tools The final image should not look like someone simply pasted translated text over the original. It should look professionally designed. PROOFREADING IS NON-NEGOTIABLE You need extremely strong proofreading skills. Before submitting anything, you should check: Spelling Grammar Punctuation Sentence structure Natural language Wrong translations Untranslated English Product names Prices Discounts Currencies Percentages Guarantees Shipping information Testimonials Names Dates Measurements CTAs Buttons Image text Mobile layouts We do not want to receive a funnel with obvious mistakes and then become your QA department. Your responsibility is: Build it. Check it. Fix it. Check it again. Then submit it. DIRECT-RESPONSE ECOMMERCE KNOWLEDGE You need to understand eCommerce customers. You should be familiar with: Customer avatars Pain points Desires Dream outcomes Objections Awareness levels Market sophistication Hooks Angles Offers Mechanisms Benefits versus features Social proof Risk reversal Urgency Scarcity CTAs AOV Conversion rate Upsells Funnels We especially value experience with dropshipping and performance marketing. Our funnels are built to sell. The goal is not: "Does this page look beautiful?" The goal is: "Will this customer buy?" AUTOMATION & TECHNICAL SKILLS We want someone who constantly looks for ways to increase production speed without reducing quality. High-value skills include: Claude Code Cursor HTML CSS JavaScript Python APIs Webhooks n8n Make Zapier Browser automation Web scraping OCR workflows GitHub AI agents Automated QA systems You do not need every technical skill. But you need the mentality of someone who automates repetitive work. If something takes 5 hours manually and can reliably be reduced to 30 minutes with AI and automation, we expect you to explore that. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR You are probably a good fit if you: Have strong Claude expertise Have real funnel-building experience Understand Funnelish Understand eCommerce Understand dropshipping Understand direct response Can recreate funnels accurately Can localize funnels professionally Have excellent proofreading skills Can research target markets Can adapt visual assets Know how to use AI image tools Can work with AI coding tools Understand HTML/CSS Can solve technical problems independently Have very high attention to detail Can follow references accurately Can work quickly Can manage multiple markets Think about conversion instead of just design WHAT WE DO NOT WANT Do not apply if you are only: A translator A graphic designer A basic Shopify VA A basic Funnelish builder A copy-paste page builder Someone who depends entirely on Google Translate Someone who blindly trusts AI output Someone who cannot proofread their own work Someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every task AI should make you faster. It should not replace your judgment. PAID TEST The hiring process will include a paid practical test. We may provide: A reference funnel A product A target country Existing product assets You may be asked to recreate and localize part of the funnel. We will evaluate: Funnel accuracy Localization quality Translation quality Proofreading AI usage Image localization Understanding of the customer Attention to detail Mobile quality Problem-solving Speed Overall conversion quality HOW TO APPLY Start your application with the word: CLAUDE Then send us: 1. Three funnels you personally built or worked on 2. One example of a funnel you recreated from a reference 3. Examples of localized funnels you have worked on 4. Examples of AI-localized images or graphics 5. Which countries/languages you have localized for 6. Your experience with Funnelish 7. Your experience with Claude 8. Whether you use Claude Code 9. Which AI tools you currently use 10. Your HTML/CSS/JavaScript experience 11. Any automation systems you have built 12. Your eCommerce or dropshipping experience 13. Your current availability 14. Your expected monthly full-time salary Then answer these three questions: Question 1: We give you a US funnel that is already profitable and ask you to launch it in Germany. Walk us through your entire process from receiving the original funnel until the German version is ready for paid traffic. Question 2: Claude translates a headline correctly from a grammatical perspective, but it sounds unnatural and weak to a native customer. What do you do? Question 3: We currently need 6 hours to recreate and localize one funnel. How would you use Claude, AI, coding or automation to reduce this dramatically without lowering the final quality? Generic AI-generated applications will be rejected. We are looking for someone who combines: Claude expertise + Funnel expertise + Localization + AI image editing + Proofreading + Target-market understanding + Automation + Direct-response eCommerce. If you genuinely have that skill set, this can become a major long-term position within our company.

title: Outbound Sales Specialist
description: Company Description - Founded in 2016, Printbelle is a global Print-on-Demand provider offering end-to-end production, fulfilment and shipping solutions for eCommerce businesses. - With fulfilment centres across China, the US and Europe, we support sellers worldwide with thousands of products across our portfolio. We continuously develop new products and solutions to help our customers stay competitive and respond quickly to changing market trends. - Having recently celebrated our 10th anniversary, we are actively expanding our global presence. We're now looking for anOutbound Sales Specialist to help us acquire new B2B customers, nurture existing customer relationships and drive account growth across Europe and the US, with a particular focus on the European market. Key Responsibilities - Actively follow up with qualified leads generated by the marketing team and convert opportunities into new business - Independently identify and approach new B2B prospects through effective channels e.g. cold calling, email, LinkedIn and industry events - Take a results-oriented approach to prospecting, with the freedom to test different outreach methods and focus on what delivers measurable outcomes - Participate in online events globally and attend relevant offline events in Vietnam to build relationships and generate valuable business contacts - Work directly with the Global Commercial Lead and European commercial team to develop and execute go-to-market and market expansion strategies across Europe and the US - Build and nurture long-term customer relationships, support onboarding and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts - Maintain a flexible balance between new customer acquisition and account development, initially around 55% active acquisition and 45% existing account nurturing. This balance may shift throughout the year—for example, with a stronger focus on acquisition during non-peak periods and more focus on supporting existing customers during peak periods to ensure smooth operations Key Qualifications - Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or a related field is required. A master's degree with an international academic background is a strong advantage - At least 2 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or account management within the Print-on-Demand industry - International experience gained through work, education or employment at a company operating across Europe and the US - Strong understanding of Western communication styles, business culture and customer expectations - Strong written and spoken English. Additional European languages, particularly German, French or Spanish, are a major advantage - Curious and commercially minded, with strong communication and relationship-building skills when engaging with prospects, customers and partners - A critical and results-oriented thinker who doesn't simply follow instructions, but continuously evaluates and improves their approach to achieve stronger outcomes - Able to work independently, take ownership and remain productive in a fully remote environment - Goal-oriented and comfortable managing both new customer acquisition and existing account growth What We Offer - An above-market competitive salary package, plus a fair and motivating commission structure linked to the orders and revenue you generate - A fully remote position with the flexibility to structure your own working day - Direct collaboration with our Global Commercial Lead and international teams - Exposure to the European and US markets - Opportunity to take ownership of projects and contribute directly to Printbelle's global expansion - A dynamic, international and fast-growing working environment - Long-term development opportunities as our global commercial team continues to grow Interview Process 1. Initial call with HR (online, 30 minutes) 2. Interview with the Global Commercial Lead (online, 45 minutes) 3. Offer discussion

title: Interior Design & Construction Coordinator / PM
description: We are looking for a highly organized and resourceful Interior Design & Construction Coordinator to support NYC residential, high-end residential, and light commercial renovation projects. Deep working knowledge in Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing Engineering a big plus. This is an execution-focused interior design and construction coordination role, with significant involvement in material sourcing, procurement, finish selections, vendor coordination, subcontractor coordination, construction sequencing, and field execution. We are especially interested in interior designers or interior design project coordinators who understand how a design actually gets built. You should have a strong eye for high-end interiors and understand appropriate materials, finishes, proportions, details, and quality standards — while also being practical enough to understand construction sequencing, installation requirements, lead times, budgets, and field conditions. A major part of the role is taking a design or selection and carrying it through: Design/Selection → Specification → Pricing → Vendor Leveling → Approval → Procurement → Delivery → Field Coordination → Installation → Punch List You should be comfortable working with items such as millwork, cabinetry, mouldings, doors and hardware, flooring, tile, stone, slabs, plumbing fixtures, lighting, glass, mirrors, metalwork, paint, specialty finishes, wallcoverings, appliances, decorative hardware, and other architectural finish materials. You should have enough construction knowledge to understand when different trades need to enter the project and what must happen before them. For example, you should recognize that cabinetry may require blocking and coordinated electrical/plumbing rough-ins before walls are closed; stone may require final field templating after preceding work reaches the correct stage; tile requires proper substrate and waterproofing; and finish trades must be sequenced carefully to avoid damage and rework. We want someone who notices details such as poor moulding transitions, awkward reveals, inconsistent grout joints, incorrect material transitions, misaligned fixtures, poorly located switches/outlets, improper paint finish, bad hardware selections, incorrect tile layouts, or details that simply do not look appropriate for a high-end project. You should have both taste and technical curiosity. If you do not know the correct material or installation technique, you should know how to research it, speak with the appropriate trade or manufacturer, understand the options, and come back with a recommendation. The position is also heavily involved in procurement and sourcing. You should be comfortable obtaining multiple quotes, leveling vendors apples-to-apples, finding alternate sources, negotiating pricing, tracking lead times, samples and approvals, and evaluating cost vs. quality vs. appearance vs. schedule vs. risk. Most importantly, we need someone who is self-reliant and execution-oriented. Do not simply forward information to management. Turn it into clear next actions: Management: Approve / Buy / D ---------- Field: Measure / Prepare / Verify / Install Vendor: Price / Sample / Fabricate / Deliver Coordinator: Follow Up / Schedule / Resolve / Confirm If a specified product is too expensive, unavailable, or has an unacceptable lead time, research alternatives and present the best options. If a field condition conflicts with the design, identify the issue and coordinate toward a solution. If a trade cannot proceed because something is missing, determine what is missing and help get it resolved. If work may require a NYC permit, inspection, licensed trade, DOB/LPC coordination, architect, engineer, or other approval, recognize it and flag it early. Ideal Candidate An interior designer, interior design coordinator, procurement coordinator, or construction coordinator with practical experience in residential or light commercial construction would be an excellent fit. We value: Strong taste and understanding of high-end interior finishes Excellent attention to detail Material and finish knowledge Procurement and vendor sourcing experience Residential/light commercial construction knowledge Construction sequencing and trade coordination Ability to read architectural and interior drawings Budget awareness and ability to find competitive pricing Fast communication and response times Logical problem solving Self-reliance and ability to infer the next logical step Clear, concise action items for management and field personnel Ability to follow through and close open items without continuous direction When applying, please provide examples of interior projects you have worked on, your role in material selection/procurement and construction coordination, any experience with high-end residential interiors, relevant software, licenses/certifications, availability, typical response time, and desired hourly rate. job_title: Sales Follow-Up Specialist — Warm Inbound Leads (Path to Closer) · Full-time · Remote
description: We're a performance marketing agency. We run paid acquisition for clients worldwide, and our sales happen entirely in writing on Telegram — with buyers in the US, UK and Europe. Our leads come to us. They're warm. This is not a cold-calling role — you will not dial a single number, and there is no script. Right now our inbound is growing faster than one person can hold, and the losses aren't at the front — they're in the follow-up. Buyers who asked a real question and waited. Clients who signed and never got chased through onboarding. That's the job: nothing goes cold on your watch. What you'll do Own every conversation where a customer is waiting on us, and clear it inside 20 minutes Chase the middle of the pipeline — proposals, quotes, pending answers, open questions Chase new clients through onboarding until they're properly live Revive stalled conversations and hand the warm ones back to the closer Report every week on what's open, what's moving, what's dead Where it goes This starts as a follow-up seat and is built to become a closing seat. Hit the standard for three months and you take your own live leads, with commission on what you close. We'd rather grow a closer than hire one. What you need You've handled customers in writing before — chat, email or CRM. Support counts. Cold calling doesn't. Clean, short, natural English. Our buyers read three-line messages on a phone. No formal letter-writing. You can tell a "thanks!" from a real question without being told You close your own loops. An unanswered message genuinely bothers you. Reliable internet and a quiet setup, 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine time, Monday to Friday Every other weekend you're on call — three 30-minute queue checks across the day, then you're free. The alternate weekend is completely yours. Our clients We work in regulated and high-risk verticals — crypto, online gambling, adult/creator platforms, IPTV and peptides. This is real, it's most of our book, and you'll be in those conversations daily. If that's not for you, this isn't your role, and that's completely fine — please don't apply. Pay $650/month base to start, plus up to $150/month performance — so $650–800 depending on your numbers On promotion to closer: higher base plus commission on every deal you close Paid trial task before any offer Full-time, 40 hours, permanent HOW TO APPLY — read carefully, we reject applications that skip these Reply with exactly these four things, in this order: Start your message with the word PIPELINE so we know you read this Paste one real follow-up message you actually sent to a customer who had gone quiet. Copy it exactly as you sent it. Change the names if you need to. If you have never sent one, say so honestly — that's an acceptable answer, an invented one is not. In two sentences: a customer asked us a question four days ago and nobody replied. What do you send now? Write the actual message, ready to send. Your monthly rate in USD, and the earliest date you could start a paid trial. No cover letter. No CV summary. We read every reply that follows these four steps.

title: Accountability Coach — Up to $300/Mo Part-Time, WhatsApp Only, No Sales, No Calls
job_title: Accountability Coach — Up to $300/Mo Part-Time, WhatsApp Only, No Sales, No Calls
description: READ THIS FIRST Most jobs on this site are about tasks. This one is about people. Momentum is a habit-coaching service. Our members pay a monthly subscription for exactly one thing: a real human being who notices whether they did what they said they would do. Not an app. Not a chatbot. A person who reads their week and writes to them like they matter. We are hiring the people who do the noticing. If you are the person your friends message when things are hard, and you write kind, clear English, keep reading. WE ARE EARLY, AND THAT IS THE POINT We are a growing startup, not a big company with a call centre. You would be one of our first coaches. That means two honest things. First, the roster grows as we grow — new members arrive through campaigns our influencer partners are running, so your numbers build over the coming months rather than landing on day one. Second, the people who join at this stage are the people who shape how this works. Our best coaches become Trusted, then Senior, then Lead — mentoring a small group of coaches, carrying fewer members, and earning an override on every member in their group. Those roles will be filled from this intake. If you want a finished, fixed job with a fixed number on it, this is not that. If you want to be early in something and grow with it, it is. Have a look at mymomentum.coach before you apply — the method, the science and the FAQ pages. That is the actual product you would be delivering, and if it does not appeal to you, this job will not either. PART-TIME, AND GENUINELY SO Six to ten hours a week at a full roster, spread across the week rather than sat in one block. You choose your own hours inside one daily window (see TIMING below). Most of our coaches will be doing this alongside study, family, or other client work, and that is completely fine — it is designed to fit around a life rather than replace one. EXAMPLE OF A TUESDAY, START TO FINISH It is 4pm your time. You open your coaching desk. There is one queue. At the top: Grace has marked nothing for three days. The system already knows this matters, tells you why, explains what a good coach does here, and offers you five draft messages. You read her file first — at intake she wrote she wants to "walk 10,000 steps and sleep properly" — then make one of the drafts your own: short, warm, no lecture, asking what got in the way. Tap through to WhatsApp. Send. Mark it done. NEXT: Daniel's birthday is tomorrow. One line, no habit talk, no ask. Next: Priya has hit 7 of 7 days sealed for the first time. You name it specifically and attach nothing to it. Four more people are in your queue. Eleven are not, because the app already nudged them today and nothing has changed. You are done in forty minutes. The system does the watching, the sorting and the first draft. You do the judgement and the warmth. That is why this takes forty minutes and not four hours. THE REST OF THE WEEK EVERY SUNDAY (1-2 hours at a full roster) Read each member's whole week. Find the one true thing to celebrate and the one thing to gently address. Adjust their plan if it needs it — most weeks it does not. Write a short coach note. Send every member a warm, personal check-in. Every member, every week, without fail. TIMING: our members are in the UK, the US and elsewhere. You are matched to ONE region, so you keep one steady window rather than being on call around the clock. * UK/Europe roster: be at your desk once between 3pm and 8pm Philippine time (their morning). * US roster: once between 8am and 12pm Philippine time (their evening), or 9pm and midnight (their morning). Tell us in the task which of those you could genuinely hold. You do not need to be available at 3am, and we do not want you to be. Anything urgent outside your window goes to a monitored escalation inbox covering your members' hours, not to you. WHAT YOU NEVER DO * Never mark a member's day for them. That belongs to them alone. * Never shame a missed day. A miss is information, not a crime. * Never pretend to be a therapist, doctor or crisis service. When something is bigger than habits you say so kindly and escalate the same day. * Never put a member's information into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or any other AI tool. Not to draft, not to summarise, not ever. Your lead reads your messages, and flat, templated writing is obvious. This is a firing matter. * Never repeat what a member told you. Confidentiality is absolute. TRAINING, AND SKILLS YOU KEEP Full training is provided. You work through our coach training programme — assessed modules covering the method, the voice, habit design, the rules that d ---------- when a coach speaks up, the weekly check-in, and where a coach's job ends. You need 80% to pass each module, with unlimited retakes, and you finish with a certification. Then a practice fortnight. For your first two weeks you are paired with the other new coaches and you coach each other for real: you design their habits, they design yours, you both log honestly every day and run a proper weekly check-in. Nobody touches a real member until that fortnight is done. It is the fastest way to learn the job, and it means the first person you write to as a coach is someone who can tell you exactly how it landed. Training and the practice fortnight are unpaid. You are paid from your first real member. What you take away, whatever happens next: behaviour-change coaching, written client communication, difficult conversations, knowing where a duty of care ends and when to escalate. Those transfer to almost any client-facing role, and very few remote jobs on this site teach them. The unusual part: every Momentum coach stays a Momentum member. You keep running your own habits on the same dashboard, logged honestly, coached by your lead exactly as your members are coached by you. We do not prescribe anything we do not live. PAY $10 USD per member, per month. 5 members = $50. 10 = $100. 15 = $150. 20 = $200. (You can earn more than $200 if you become a Lead Coach or based on your performance and reviews we feel you can handle more capacity without compromising quality) Paid monthly by mobile payment (GCash) on the 1st, for the month before. * Member cancels mid-month? You are paid the full month for them. Joins mid-month? Same. It evens out. * You are paid from your first real member. Training and the practice fortnight are unpaid. * Your roster grows as members arrive from partner campaigns. We add to it as fast as you can hold people well. If you need to leave, we ask for two weeks' notice so we can move your members properly. Disappearing on people who trusted you is the one thing we cannot forgive. WHAT YOU NEED * A laptop or desktop computer. The coaching desk is not a phone tool. * A smartphone with WhatsApp that you actually use daily. * Fast, reliable internet. You will send us a speed test screenshot with your task. * Excellent written English that sounds like a person. The single most important requirement, and not the same as perfect grammar. Warm, plain, short sentences. If you write "kindly ensure compliance", this is not for you. If you write "let's not let it become three days, what got in the way?", it might be. * Genuine care. You will hear about drinking, debt, weight, grief and failure. You must receive that with total calm and zero judgement, every time. * Reliability. A member left in silence quits. Sunday cannot be optional. * Judgement. Half this job is knowing when to say nothing. * Discretion. Nothing a member tells you ever leaves the system. No psychology degree, coaching certification or technical skill required. Backgrounds that transfer well: customer support, community management, teaching, nursing, care, counselling. Not for you if you want to run this on AI, are juggling five other clients who will make Sunday slip, or find other people's setbacks irritating. ***IMPORTANT*** PAID SCREENING TASK — REQUIRED!!! Applications without it will not be read. Follow the instructions exactly. That is half of what we are testing. Answer the following questions (Part 1-3) and submit them with your application in a document. PART 1 — Did you read this advert? (4 mins) Answer in one short line each. The answers are all above. 1. How much do you earn per member, per month? 2. What is the one thing you must never put a member's information into? 3. How much notice do we ask for if you leave? 4. How many days in a row without a mark does it take before Grace appears at the top of the queue? 5. What are the two things the system does for you, and the two things you do yourself? PART 2 — Judgement (6 mins) Choose A, B or C for each, then give ONE sentence saying why. The reason matters more to us than the letter. Scenario 1. A member has kept every habit for 21 days straight and says nothing to you all week. A) Message them to celebrate the 21 days. B) Say nothing — they are doing fine and do not need interrupting. C) Message them to suggest adding a harder habit while they have momentum. Scenario 2. A member missed one day yesterday. Before that, three solid weeks. A) Check in today so it does not become a pattern. B) Leave it. One miss is normal. C) Ask them to explain what happened. Scenario 3. A member has marked nothing at all for four days. They were doing well before that. A) Wait a few more days — chasing people pushes them away. B) Message today, warmly, with no lecture. C) Message asking why they have stopped and reminding them what they are paying for. PART 3 — Your setup and you (5 mins) * A screenshot of an internet speed test (speedtest.net or ---------- ). Attach the image. * What computer and phone do you use? * Which region window can you genuinely hold, every day? --- UK/Europe roster: be at your desk once between 3pm and 8pm Philippine time (their morning). --- US roster: once between 8am and 12pm Philippine time (their evening), or 9pm and midnight (their morning). * What else do you do in a week — study, family, other work? We are asking so we can see this fits, not to rule you out. * One habit you have personally kept for more than a month, and how you did it. HOW TO SUBMIT One document with Parts 1-3, including the speed test screenshot. Name the file: [YourName]_Momentum_Coach_Task — for example, MariaSantos_Momentum_Coach_Task QUICK SUMMARY $10 USD per member per month, by GCash on the 1st. $50/mo at 5 members up to $300/mo at 20. 6-10 hrs/week, part-time, fits around other work. Full training provided plus a certification, then a two-week practice fortnight coaching the other new coaches. Matched to one region: UK/Europe (3-8pm PH) or US (8am-12pm or 9pm-12am PH). Laptop, smartphone and fast internet required. Growing startup — Trusted, Senior and Lead roles will be filled from this intake. We are building something where the whole promise is that a real person is paying attention. If you would be good at that, we would very much like to read your task.

description: We are looking for an experienced e-commerce / dropshipping product researcher who can consistently find strong, data-backed products with potential to launch and scale in Japan. Prepare weekly and monthly PPC performance reports. - Clearly explain campaign performance, problems, opportunities, and recommended actions. - Track advertising spend, revenue, conversions, ROAS, ACOS, TACOS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates. - Use data to make informed decisions about campaign budgets and strategy. - Identify trends and opportunities for scaling profitable campaigns. - Maintain organized campaign records and performance documentation. **Required Qualifications - Google Ads certification. - Amazon Ads certification. - Experience with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager. - Experience with Google Merchant Center. - Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms. - description: We run international luxury fashion e-commerce stores (Shopify, selling to Europe, US, and Australia). We need a careful, detail-obsessed VA for a LONG-TERM role. One person, growing responsibility, no churn — our longest team members have been with us for years. THE WORK (about 20 hrs/week to start): 1) Weekly competitor price research (the core of the job): for a list of luxury products (Canada Goose, Lemaire, Zegna, Loro Piana, etc.), find the LOWEST LEGITIMATE price online — brand-new condition only, from official brand sites or authorized retailers. You must reject secondhand/resale sites (eBay, Vestiaire, StockX, etc.) and suspicious "outlet" sites. You deliver an evidence spreadsheet: our price, competitor URL, their price, whether it's a sale price, and your recommendation. Accuracy matters more than speed — every price you report must be real and verifiable. 2) Shopify product work (occasional): adding/editing products — photos (light background, clean), descriptions, tags, SEO fields, metafields, CSV uploads. We encourage using AI tools (ChatGPT etc.) to work faster — but every fact and price must be verified by you on the actual retailer page. REQUIREMENTS: - Experience with e-commerce product research or competitive pricing (or provable ability to learn it fast) - Shopify admin experience - Meticulous: you keep change logs, double-check your work, and tell us early if something will be late - VPN (or willingness to set one up) to check European/US market prices - Good written English; some working-hours overlap with Hong Kong time - Long-term intent — we are not looking for a 3-month gig PAY: $7–10/hour USD depending on experience (≈ $600–850/month at 20 hrs/week), paid reliably. Mini-task (10–15 min): Find the lowest legitimate price for the "Canada Goose Women's Expedition Parka" — new condition, from the brand or an authorized retailer. Paste: the URL, the price, and one sentence on why you trust that retailer. Q3. Your longest client engagement: how long, what you did, why it ended. Plus: how many hours/week you can commit now, and what times of day you work. Q4. How do you use AI in your work today? And would you trust an AI chatbot's answer about a competitor's current price — why or why not? We reply to shortlisted applicants within 2 weeks. title: CUSTOMER SUPPORT & ENGAGEMENT SPECIALIST
description: Ask Yuna is a fast-growing personalised guidance brand serving thousands of customers worldwide. We help people navigate relationships, personal decisions, and life transitions through personalised written guidance and one-on-one consultations. Our customers come to us during emotional, high-stakes moments in their lives, and the way we communicate with them matters as much as the product itself. We are looking for a Customer Support & Engagement Specialist to join our team. This is not a typical support role. You will be the voice of "Yuna," our brand persona, across email, WhatsApp, and SMS. You will handle customer questions and refund requests with genuine care, while also building real rapport that leads customers to explore other services we offer. THE ROLE You will manage day-to-day communication with customers across three channels: email, WhatsApp, and SMS. Your work falls into three connected areas: 1. Respond to Customer Emails and Messages Reply to inbound emails, WhatsApp messages, and SMS as "Yuna," maintaining a warm, personal, and consistent voice Answer questions about orders, delivery timelines, and how our services work Provide emotional support and reassurance to customers who are going through difficult personal situations Escalate anything sensitive, unusual, or outside your scope to the relevant team member 2. Handle Refund Requests Process refund requests professionally and empathetically, following our internal refund policy and guidelines Understand the reason behind each request and document it accurately Where appropriate, offer alternatives or additional support before processing a refund Ensure every refund conversation leaves the customer feeling heard and respected, regardless of outcome 3. Build Engagement and Drive Upsells Follow up with customers after their purchase to check in on their experience and build genuine rapport Identify natural moments to introduce other relevant services based on what the customer shares with you Send personalised follow-up messages via WhatsApp, email, and SMS that feel like a continuation of a real relationship, not a sales pitch Track which customers are engaged and warm, and prioritise outreach accordingly Meet monthly targets for engagement-driven revenue WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR Excellent written English. You need to write warm, natural, human messages that do not sound like scripts or templates Strong emotional intelligence. Many of our customers are going through difficult moments and need to feel genuinely cared for Sales instinct without being pushy. You know how to guide a conversation toward a next step without it feeling like a hard sell Comfortable working across multiple channels (email, WhatsApp, SMS) and switching tone appropriately for each Organised and self-directed. You can manage a queue of conversations without letting anything slip Experience in customer support, sales, or client-facing roles preferred but not required if you can demonstrate the skills above Comfortable working within brand voice guidelines and following a defined tone of voice consistently WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Fast, warm, helpful responses that make customers feel personally looked after Refund requests handled with empathy and professionalism, protecting the customer relationship even when a refund is issued A steady stream of engaged customers moved toward additional purchases through natural, well-timed conversation Customers who reply to your messages the way they would reply to a friend, not a company COMPENSATION This role includes a base salary plus commission on upsell revenue you generate through engagement. Base salary: Competitive, based on experience Commission: A percentage of revenue from any additional purchase made by a customer you engaged with, following an attributable conversation via email, WhatsApp, or SMS Commission is paid monthly alongside base salary, based on tracked and attributed sales This structure rewards genuine relationship-building. The better you get to know our customers and the more naturally you guide them toward the right next step, the more you earn on top of your base. HOW TO APPLY Please submit: Your CV or a brief summary of relevant experience A short writing sample: respond, in Yuna's voice, to a customer who says "It's been two weeks and nothing has changed. I want a refund." ( ---------- words) We review applications on a rolling basis and will follow up with shortlisted candidates for a short trial task before a final interview.

title: Booking Agent
description: PIKT Entertainment is an events company in Melbourne, Australia. We supply the DJs, photographers, photo booths and 360 booths for weddings, engagement parties, 21st birthdays and school formals. People enquire through our website every week and we do not call them all back fast enough. That is your job. What you will do Call people who have already enquired. These are warm leads, not cold calls. Ask about their event, recommend the right package, send the quote. Follow up until they book or say no. Most people book on the third or fourth call. Log every call in our CRM. Hours 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Manila time, Monday to Friday. Day shift. No graveyard. Pay $250 USD per month, plus $[5] USD for every booking you close. What you need Clear spoken English. Australians need to understand you easily on a phone line. At least 1 year on the phone. Sales, appointment setting or BPO. Stable internet, 25 Mbps minimum, with a backup connection. A USB headset with a proper microphone, and a quiet room to work in. What we give you You call from our Melbourne number through a browser dialer. You pay nothing for calls. Full training on our packages, pricing and scripts. Paid on time every month via [Wise / PayPal]. How to apply Start your message with MELBOURNE. Attach your resume. Record a voice recording on your phone, 60 seconds maximum. Say your name, then tell us about the best party you have ever been to. Speak normally, do not read a script. No voice recording, no interview. This is a phone job, so we want to hear you. Notes for you (do not post) Set the bonus properly. At $250 base the bonus is what makes this competitive, so make it worth chasing. $15 a booking is a starting point, not a recommendation, since I do not know your margin per job. Whatever the number, put it in the ad. "Bonuses available" reads as nothing. Expect entry-level. $250 full time sits at the floor of the platform, so you will get people with less phone experience than the ad asks for. The voice recording is what protects you. Listen to it before you read anything else, and reject anyone you have to concentrate to understand. The MELBOURNE keyword will remove most of the mass-appliers on its own. First week should be paid training with you listening in, not solo dialling. Australian and Philippine public holidays differ. Agree in writing which calendar they follow. Calls are recorded through the CRM. Tell them, and make sure they tell the customer. Australian law requires it.

title: Marketing Agency Operations Manager
description: The Person Who Gets Things Done This role is unique — because the work will be different every day. One day, you might clean and restructure a spreadsheet. The next, you could review job applicants, check that social media content has been published correctly, improve a process, follow up with a team member or identify why a project is not moving forward. The common thread is simple: Something needs to get done properly, and you make sure it happens. We are looking for an experienced, highly capable person who can work across the operations of a growing marketing agency. You do not need to be an expert in every area of marketing. We have processes, systems and training for everything we do. What we cannot train as easily is judgement. You need to be able to understand the end goal, work backwards, see the steps required and notice what is missing — without becoming so caught up in minor details that nothing moves forward. Progress Over Perfection We care about quality, but we do not believe perfection should prevent progress. You need to know: Which details genuinely matter Which issues need to be resolved immediately Which improvements can wait When to keep investigating When to make a sensible decision and move forward You will check and double-check your work, but you will not allow perfectionism to become procrastination. We want someone who creates momentum. What You Could Be Doing Your responsibilities will be varied and may include: Cleaning, organising and maintaining spreadsheets and internal data Turning repeated tasks into clear processes, checklists and systems Reviewing work for errors, missing information or inconsistencies Checking that content, campaigns and social media tasks have been completed correctly Coordinating projects across different agency departments Monitoring deadlines, following up on outstanding work and identifying blockers Reviewing job applications and helping us identify strong candidates Supporting the onboarding and management of team members Checking that our processes are being followed and improving them where required Spotting gaps before they become problems Taking ownership of unexpected operational tasks Keeping projects moving without needing constant reminders Helping us build a stronger team as the agency continues to grow Sometimes, you will be given a clearly defined task. Other times, you will be given an outcome and expected to determine the best way to reach it. Who We Are Looking For You will ideally have: Experience working within a marketing agency Experience in project management, operations or team coordination Some experience managing people, freelancers or external contractors Strong written communication and attention to detail The ability to manage several priorities without losing sight of the main objective Excellent judgement and practical common sense The confidence to ask questions when something genuinely is not clear The initiative to solve straightforward problems independently The ability to recognise missing steps, risks and weak points Strong emotional intelligence when working across different departments A calm, persistent and solutions-focused approach A low-ego attitude and willingness to embrace the way we work You do not need to be highly extroverted, sales-focused or comfortable spending your day in meetings. We have very few meetings and phone calls. Most collaboration happens through written communication, tasks and clearly documented processes. However, emotional intelligence still matters. You will work across several parts of the agency and need to understand how to communicate respectfully, follow up effectively and work with different personalities. How We Work We do not care where you work, what you wear or exactly when you complete your work. We do not micromanage. What we do care about is trust, ownership and visible progress. Freedom comes with accountability. If you say something will be completed, we need to trust that it will be completed — or that you will communicate early if something changes. There is no ego in our approach. It is not about who is right. It is about finding what works. You may have done something differently in a previous role. We will listen to your ideas, but you must also be willing to learn and embrace our systems, processes and standards. Our One Objective Everything we do comes back to one goal: Achieving the best possible results for our clients. Our decisions are not driven by what creates the easiest work or the most short-term profit. We ask what will genuinely help our clients achieve a better outcome. As we attract more clients, we need better systems, stronger processes and more exceptional people. Once you understand and embrace that objective, you will be trusted to take ownership, make sensible decisions and pursue the outcome with grace, precision and persistence. You Will Thrive Here If You… Naturally take ownership instead of waiting to be chased Enjoy bringing order to messy or incomplete information Can move comfortably between small administrative tasks and larger operational challenges Notice what other people miss Care about the final result, not just completing your assigned step Are comfortable receiving varied tasks and d ---------- how to approach them Value respect, trust and direct communication Prefer meaningful work over meetings, office politics and unnecessary bureaucracy Want the freedom to work independently while contributing to a growing agency This Role May Not Suit You If You… Need every task explained step by step before you can begin Regularly miss details because you do not check your work Become overwhelmed when priorities change Focus on being busy rather than producing outcomes Avoid responsibility when something goes wrong Need constant supervision, reassurance or reminders Allow perfectionism to prevent work from being completed Are more interested in proving your approach is right than finding the best solution How to Apply We are less interested in a long, polished cover letter than in understanding how you think. Please include: A brief overview of your marketing agency, project management and team management experience. An example of a messy or unclear task you took ownership of and successfully completed. An example of a problem or missing step you identified before anyone asked you to look for it. How you prioritise when several tasks appear urgent. The systems and project management tools you have used. Your availability, time zone and expected rate. If you are intelligent, dependable and exceptionally good at turning intentions into completed work, we would love to hear from you.

I'm Hunter Garnett, a personal injury lawyer and the owner of Garnett Patterson Injury Lawyers in Huntsville, Alabama. I run a team of dozens, and I work in bursts — early mornings, late nights, weekends, whenever the case needs it. I try to respect my team's time. But I'll be honest: the fastest way to impress me is to be responsive. Nothing else comes close. Here's the real job. You'll own my inbox. Triage it, answer what you can, flag what needs me, and make sure nothing sits. You'll sit in on my meetings, take the notes, and turn my scattered thinking into a clean list of what happens next. You'll run my to-do list, and I mean run it: delegate what belongs to someone else, knock out what you can yourself, and keep the big-ticket items in front of me so I stop drowning in the small ones. You'll watch our dashboards and KPIs and tell me when a number moves before I have to ask. The short version: your job is to reduce the noise in my life so I can do the part only a lawyer can do. Here's why this role is different from the last EA job you looked at. You won't stay an EA. As you earn trust, you'll start helping me oversee our mid-level managers and track performance across dozens of team members. If you've got a background in digital marketing, operations, or project management and you're ready for more responsibility than your current job will give you, this is where you get it. Personal injury experience is a huge plus but not required. Being sharp, organized, and fast is. What this is not: a wait-for-instructions job. We do a daily check-in and a weekly tag-up. Between those, you figure out what needs to happen and you make it happen. If you need someone standing over your shoulder, you'll be miserable here. If you've been waiting for someone to get out of your way, you'll feel like we built this for you. The details. Full-time. Remote. Flexible hours, but you need real overlap with US Central business hours and you need to be reachable. Pay: $7.50–$12.50/hour, reviewed as your responsibilities grow. We're a faith-driven firm and our Christian faith shapes how we treat clients and each other; you don't have to share it, but you should be comfortable working somewhere it matters. Tools we live in: Filevine, Microsoft 365, and Asana. Target start: as soon as we find the right person. HOW TO APPLY Use the Apply button on this page. Please do not email us. Applications sent by email will not be reviewed. BEFORE YOU APPLY, TWO THINGS HAVE TO BE TRUE. 1. YOUR PROFILE MUST SHOW YOUR DISC PROFILE AND YOUR IQ TEST RESULTS. Both are free through OnlineJobs.PH and take about twenty minutes between them. We will not review an application without both showing on your profile. 2. THIS HAS TO BE YOUR ONLY JOB. Full time, and we mean it. We are not looking for someone to fit us around other clients or a second job. If you are working somewhere else right now, that is fine. Just tell us when you could start. WHAT TO INCLUDE Begin your application with the words: I ANSWER BEFORE YOU FINISH ASKING Then answer all five questions below. Applications missing a section will not be reviewed. 1. THE QUESTION Tell us about a time you fixed a problem before your boss knew it existed. What was it, what did you do, and how did they find out? We are not looking for a perfect answer. We are looking for a real one. 2. PERSONAL INJURY EXPERIENCE Not required for this role. If you have any, tell us how long and what you actually handled. Write NONE if you have none. 3. CONTENT WRITING EXPERIENCE What have you written, who was it for, and where can we read it? Write NONE if you have none. 4. TASK RANKING Give us your top five from this list, most comfortable first. 1 Inbox and calendar ownership for an attorney 2 Task and follow up tracking in Asana or similar 3 Meeting notes, turned into action items someone can work from 4 Case file management in Filevine or similar 5 Medical records requests and provider follow up 6 Client communication and intake follow up 7 Content writing for blog, email and social 8 Reporting and dashboards 9 Overseeing other assistants 10 Billing and finance admin My top five, best first: 5. AVAILABILITY Confirm you can work a full day with meaningful overlap with US Central time, and tell us the earliest date you could start. WHAT HAPPENS NEXT We read every application. After the deadline we reach out to schedule short conversations with the people we want to talk to. Either way, you will hear back from us. You will not be left wondering.

title: REAL ESTATE WHOLESALING ASSISTANT
description: ABOUT REDEMPTIVE GRACE Redemptive Grace is a U.S.-based real estate investment company that identifies distressed and off-market residential properties across the United States. We work directly with homeowners who may need a fast, simple, and respectful solution for selling their property. We are looking for a motivated, dependable, and confident Real Estate Wholesaling Assistant based in the Philippines. The assistant will help find distressed properties, contact homeowners, qualify potential sellers, conduct property research, and manage leads until they are transferred to the acquisitions manager. -------------------------------------------------- PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES - Research and identify distressed and off-market residential properties in the United States - Find vacant, inherited, pre-foreclosure, tax-delinquent, absentee-owned, damaged, and neglected properties - Research property ownership information using company-provided software and resources - Use approved skip-tracing tools to locate homeowner phone numbers, email addresses, and other available contact information - Make outbound calls to property owners using company-approved scripts - Introduce Redemptive Grace professionally and explain the purpose of the call - Determine whether the homeowner may be interested in receiving a cash offer for the property - Ask qualifying questions about the homeowner's situation and motivation to sell - Gather information about the property's condition, needed repairs, occupancy, ownership, asking price, mortgage balance, and desired selling timeline - Build respectful relationships with homeowners who may be experiencing difficult or sensitive circumstances - Follow up consistently with warm and interested leads by phone, text message, or email - Schedule qualified appointments and follow-up calls for the acquisitions manager - Conduct basic property research, including estimated property value and comparable property sales - Enter all lead information, call notes, seller details, property information, and follow-up dates into the company CRM - Maintain an organized pipeline of new leads, warm leads, follow-up leads, appointments, unqualified leads, and closed opportunities - Update every lead immediately after a call or conversation - Provide daily and weekly reports showing calls made, homeowners contacted, qualified leads, appointments scheduled, and follow-up activity - Meet company-established calling, lead-generation, and appointment-setting goals - Protect confidential homeowner, property, and company information - Follow all company procedures related to calling, privacy, recordkeeping, and Do Not Call requirements -------------------------------------------------- COMPENSATION AND COMMISSION - Starting base salary of PHP 25,000 per month during the first 90 days - Opportunity to increase to PHP 28,000 per month after a successful 90-day performance review - Additional commission or performance bonus for qualified leads that result in successfully closed real estate transactions - A commission is earned only when the assistant originally generated or contacted the lead - The lead must be properly recorded and attributed to the assistant in the company CRM - The transaction must successfully close - Redemptive Grace must receive the assignment fee or other proceeds from the transaction before the commission is paid - No commission will be paid for deals that are canceled, terminated, or do not close - Complete commission amounts, eligibility requirements, and payment dates will be included in the written compensation agreement -------------------------------------------------- SOFTWARE AND RESOURCES PROVIDED Redemptive Grace will provide access to the software and resources needed to perform the job, including: - Customer relationship management software - Calling and dialing software - Property research tools - Lead lists - Skip-tracing tools - Company email account - Calling scripts - Lead qualification questions - Training materials - Follow-up procedures - Reporting templates -------------------------------------------------- CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS - Excellent spoken and written English - Clear, confident, and professional phone communication - Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls - Comfortable speaking with American homeowners - Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, customer service, sales, lead generation, or real estate is preferred - U.S. real estate wholesaling experience is helpful but not required - Strong internet research and information-gathering skills - Ability to follow scripts while still sounding natural and conversational - Ability to ask questions, listen carefully, and document accurate information - Strong organizational and time-management skills - Consistent and dependable with follow-up activities - Able to handle rejection professionally without becoming discouraged - Honest, respectful, coachable, and motivated by results - Able to work independently and meet daily and weekly performance expectations - Comfortable using spreadsheets, Google Workspace, calling systems, email, and CRM platforms - Willing to learn U.S. real estate terminology and the real estate wholesaling process - Able to work overnight Philippine hours corresponding with 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time -------------------------------------------------- TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS The company will provide the required software, but the assistant must provide: - A reliable computer or laptop - A high-quality headset with a clear microphone - A reliable high-speed internet connection - A quiet and professional working environment - A backup internet connection or mobile hotspot - A backup power solution is strongly preferred -------------------------------------------------- PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS - Report to work on time and remain available throughout the assigned shift - Complete assigned outbound calling and lead-generation activities - Produce accurate and properly qualified seller leads - Maintain complete and updated CRM records - Follow up with leads according to the company's schedule - Communicate promptly with the Redemptive Grace team - Attend required training sessions and team meetings - Submit daily and weekly performance reports - Maintain professional and respectful communication with every homeowner - Focus on both the number of calls completed and the quality of each conversation -------------------------------------------------- IMPORTANT ROLE LIMITATIONS - The assistant may research properties, contact homeowners, gather information, qualify leads, conduct follow-up, and schedule appointments - The assistant must use company-approved scripts and procedures - The assistant may not represent themselves as a licensed real estate agent or broker - The assistant may not provide legal, tax, financial, or investment advice - The assistant may not negotiate or approve final purchase prices without authorization - The assistant may not explain or interpret legal contracts - The assistant may not sign documents on behalf of Redemptive Grace - The assistant may not promise that Redemptive Grace will purchase a property - Final offers, negotiations, and contracts will be handled by authorized members of the Redemptive Grace team -------------------------------------------------- IDEAL CANDIDATE The ideal candidate is persuasive without being aggressive, compassionate without becoming emotionally overwhelmed, and motivated by measurable results. Many homeowners may be experiencing financial hardship, foreclosure, divorce, relocation, inherited-property challenges, major repairs, or other difficult circumstances. Every homeowner must be treated with dignity, patience, honesty, professionalism, and respect. -------------------------------------------------- HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: - Your updated resume - A brief introduction explaining your cold-calling, sales, real estate, customer-service, or lead-generation experience - A short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a strong fit for this position - Your internet speed test results - Information about your computer, headset, internet connection, and backup arrangements - Confirmation that you can work Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Central Time - Your earliest available start date Join Redemptive Grace and help us identify real estate opportunities while providing homeowners with respectful and professional solutions.

title: Corporate Accounts Sales Representative
description: Corporate Accounts Sales Representative (Cold Outreach + Account Research) Company: Silver Fox Cooling and Heating / Commercial HVAC Location: Remote, Philippines-based Type: Full-time; Reports to: Business Development Lead About the Role We are a C-20 licensed HVAC and refrigeration contractor based in Irvine, California, serving Orange County and LA County. We are building a sales team to grow our corporate accounts business, property management companies, restaurant chains, and grocery stores, where deals involve multiple decision-makers and longer sales cycles. We are not looking for a high volume dialer. We are looking for someone who does the homework on a prospect before ever reaching out, who they are, who the real decision makers and influencers are, what they likely care about, and how to use that to open a real conversation. If you have used a "show me you know them" approach with prospects before, even if you called it something else, this role is built for you. What You Will Do Research target accounts (property management companies, restaurant chains, groceries, supermarkets, etc) in depth before outreach, mapping out likely decision makers, influencers, and their priorities Run cold outreach, calls and emails, that is personalized based on that research, not templated Manage relationships with accounts over a multi touch, multi stakeholder sales cycle rather than one and done pitches Work as part of a team under Business Development Lead, following his direction on priorities and process Keep accurate records of research, outreach, and account progress in our CRM (Jobber / GHL Skills We Are Looking For Primary: Deep customer and account research. You know how to dig into a company and its people before you ever pick up the phone or send an email, and you use what you find to make the first conversation land. Secondary: Cold outreach experience, cold calling and cold emailing Account management experience, comfortable owning a relationship over weeks or months rather than a single touch Who Will Succeed Here 4 plus years of relevant sales, business development, or account management experience Comfortable with longer B2B sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders Strong team player who works well taking direction from a team lead Money motivated and genuinely has a sales nature, not just administrative support with a sales title Strong written and spoken English Compensation We know corporate account sales cycles take time to produce closed deals, so this pay structure is built to keep you paid fairly while you do the research and outreach work that builds your pipeline, even before results show up. Month 1: $8.00 per hour, base pay only, no commission. This is your onboarding and account research ramp up period. Months 2 and 3: $11.00 per hour, base pay only, no commission, while you keep building your pipeline of qualified accounts. At full time hours this comes out to roughly $1,900 per month. Month 4 onward: Commission structure and rates will be shared during your final interview. Application Questions Walk us through how you would research a property management company or restaurant chain before your first outreach. Who would you look for, what would you want to know about them, and how would you use it in your first conversation? Tell us about your cold outreach experience. How many calls or emails have you typically run per day or week, and how do you balance that volume with actually personalizing your approach? Describe a real account you managed over a long sales cycle with more than one decision maker or stakeholder involved. What did that relationship look like over time, and how did you move it forward? This role reports to a Business Development Lead who sets priorities and process for the team. Tell us about a time you worked under someone else's direction on a sales or outreach team. How did that go? Note on the Selection Process Resumes and profile descriptions only tell us so much. Candidates who make it to the final round will be asked to complete a short, real work sample: research one sample target account and produce a one page brief identifying likely decision makers and influencers, what matters to each of them, and how a first outreach would differ between them. This is the main way we will evaluate the primary skill for this role, so please be prepared for it.

description: Are you empathetic, detail-oriented, and skilled at guiding people through emotionally challenging situations? Our rapidly growing family law practice is seeking a Full-Time Client Success Associate to serve as the first point of contact for individuals navigating divorce and custody matters. In this role, you will support potential clients with clarity, compassion, and confidence - helping them feel seen, heard, and understood at one of the most difficult times in their lives. This is not a standard administrative role. This is a relationship-driven, high-touch, client communication and lead qualification position where your conversations directly influence each prospective client’s journey and our firm’s growth. As a Client Success Associate, you will guide Potential New Clients through the initial stages of their divorce planning process, help them understand their options, and assess whether they are a fit for moving forward with our firm. Your work ensures that only qualified and ready clients are scheduled with our Client Success Managers, driving meaningful sales outcomes while creating a transformative experience for the individuals we serve. Key Responsibilities • Serve as the first compassionate point of contact for individuals seeking legal help during emotionally difficult transitions. • Conduct structured screening conversations to evaluate case fit, readiness to hire, pricing alignment, and attorney-fit criteria. • Provide clear, intelligent, and empathetic answers to prospective client questions without providing legal advice. • Help callers understand the Firm's process, offering clarity, options, and guidance that supports confident decision-making. • Organize paperwork and complete data entry in the case management system to streamline client onboarding. • Manage attorney and Client Success Manager calendars, ensuring qualified PNCs are scheduled efficiently. • Handle inbound calls, emails, and inquiries with professionalism - triaging, forwarding, or documenting as needed. • Assist with administrative tasks including document management, data organization, and research to support firm operations. • Collaborate with marketing to support prospective client pipelines and partnership initiatives. Qualifications • 4+ years of experience in client service, intake, sales, customer success, or a similar client-facing role (law firm or professional services experience preferred). • Exceptional English communication skills - empathetic, articulate, and confident handling sensitive conversations. • Proven ability to have difficult conversations while staying grounded, supportive, and solution-focused. • Strong listening and assessment skills, especially when evaluating client fit and readiness. • Highly organized with excellent follow-through and accurate documentation habits. • Comfortable using case management systems (Clio Manage or similar), CRMs, and Google Workspace. • Ability to work full-time during U.S. Eastern Time business hours. Work Schedule • Full-time (40 hours/week) • Must be available during U.S. Eastern Time for client communication and team collaboration Compensation & Benefits • USD 5/hr • Performance-based bonuses • Paid training and ongoing professional development • Long-term, growth-focused role within a mission-driven firm Screening Questions (please answer all to be considered) 1. Tell me about a time you helped someone through an emotionally difficult situation. How did you make them feel supported while still guiding the conversation? 2. How would you explain a complex process to a client in a way that gives them clarity without crossing into giving legal advice? 3. What steps do you take to determine whether a prospective client is a good fit to move forward, and how do you communicate that in a supportive way? 4. Tell me about your experience using systems (CRM, case management, or similar tools) and how you ensure your notes and data are accurate and organized. title: Product Research & Development Associate
description: # Product Research & Development Associate **Full-time | Remote | Product Department** We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating across the USA, UK and EU, with a growing portfolio of health and children's products. We are looking for a highly **curious, analytical and commercially minded** person to identify the next generation of products for our business. Your job is to find opportunities, investigate them deeply and determine **whether they are actually worth pursuing**. ### What You Will Do **Product & Market Research** * Research new product opportunities within our niches * Identify trends, customer needs and market gaps * Find product variations, line extensions and improvements * Research competitors, pricing, positioning and features * Analyse customer reviews to understand what people love, dislike and want improved **Validate Product Opportunities** Before we invest time and money developing a product, you will help determine: * Is there genuine demand? * What problem does it solve? * Who is the target customer? * What are customers currently buying? * What are competitors failing to solve? * What could we do differently? * How competitive is the market? * What price could we sell at? * What are likely product costs and margins? * Is this opportunity commercially worthwhile? We don't want research for the sake of research. We want to know: **“Should we make this product — and why?”** ### Customer Insight You will also become responsible for systematically learning from our existing customers. You will: * Collect and analyse customer reviews and complaints * Identify recurring product problems and requested features * Categorise feedback and identify patterns * Track changes in customer feedback * Turn customer insights into product improvement recommendations You will pass these insights to our **China-based Product Development Specialist**, who will investigate and solve the physical product issues. ### Product Development & Pipeline Once a product is approved, you will continue supporting development with: * Customer research * Competitor analysis * Target customer requirements * Feature recommendations * Pricing and positioning research * Market trends * Key problems the product must solve You will also maintain our **product opportunity pipeline**, research documents, customer feedback and project information, ensuring important insights and decisions don't get lost. ### We Are Looking For Someone Who * Is naturally curious and constantly asks **“why?”** * Has excellent research, analytical and critical-thinking skills * Thinks commercially rather than simply finding “interesting” products * Can distinguish a genuinely attractive opportunity from a bad one * Is comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and data * Can turn large amounts of customer feedback into clear insights * Has excellent written communication and organisation skills * Is proactive and takes ownership * Has strong attention to detail Experience in **e-commerce, Amazon, product research, market research, product management or consumer products** is strongly preferred. Experience with Amazon research tools, Google Trends, competitor intelligence tools and spreadsheets is an advantage. ### The Type of Person We Want We are **not looking for someone who simply searches Amazon and produces product lists.** If you see a product with 10,000 reviews, we want you asking: **Why is it selling? Who is buying it? What are customers complaining about? What are competitors failing to solve? Could we build something meaningfully better? Would customers pay enough for it to be profitable?** You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and telling us when an idea **isn't good enough to pursue**. We are a remote female team that moves quickly, takes work seriously and invests in training and development. **We do not do graveyard hours.** **Full-time | Competitive salary based on experience** ### To Apply Please send: 1. Your resume 2. 2 examples of product research you personally completed and the conclusions you reached 3. One product opportunity you identified and why it was commercially attractive 4. One customer problem/insight you identified from reviews and what action you recommended 5. One product you think is currently poorly designed or underserved and how you would improve it
