title: Operations Manager
description: About the role Formula Inbox is a boutique email deliverability consultancy. We run cold outbound, marketing, and transactional email programs for clients, plus white-label work for agencies. The business runs on a small distributed team of contractors, a set of documented processes, and a handful of client engagements running at the same time. We are looking for an experienced operations manager to own the machine so the principal can focus on client strategy and delivery. This is not a task-taker role. You will coordinate contractors, keep client work moving through its stages, maintain our process documentation, and make sure nothing slips between the cracks across several concurrent engagements. This is a part-time role to start, roughly 20 hours per week, with room to grow as the business does. Fully remote. You set your own hours as long as there is reliable overlap with US business hours and responsive async communication throughout the day. What you will own Contractor coordination. Assign and track work across our offshore contractors. Keep everyone clear on priorities, unblock them, and flag when something is behind before it becomes a problem. Client operations. Move client engagements through their stages, from onboarding through delivery. Track deliverables, deadlines, and handoffs. Keep a clear picture of what is due, what is done, and what is at risk across every active engagement. Process and documentation. Maintain and improve our internal SOP hub in Notion. When we find a better way to do something, you capture it. When a process is missing, you build it. You keep our documentation current instead of letting it rot. Administrative and financial coordination. Help keep invoicing, contractor payments, and financial records organized in coordination with our bookkeeper. You will not be doing the accounting, but you will make sure the right things get to the right people on time and that nothing falls through. Reporting and visibility. Give the principal a clear weekly picture of where everything stands without needing to be asked. Surface risks early. Bring solutions, not just problems. What we are looking for 4+ years managing operations for a Western agency, consultancy, or services business, ideally remote and distributed Direct experience coordinating other contractors or a small team, not just executing your own task list A track record of owning a recurring process end to end, not just following one someone else built Strong written English and clear, proactive async communication Comfort with modern operations tools. We run on Notion, and touch Xero and Mercury on the financial side. You do not need to know every tool we use, but you should pick up new systems fast. Reliable overlap with US business hours and a fast, consistent response time during the workday Self-directed. You do not wait to be told what to do next. You see what needs doing and you do it. Nice to have Experience in a B2B services or marketing/agency environment Familiarity with email, deliverability, or outbound (we can teach the domain, but context helps) Experience building or cleaning up SOPs and internal documentation from scratch

title: Experienced Video Editors Wanted (Multiple Hires)
description: I help run a training program that teaches beginners how to build YouTube Channels. Part of this training is I encourage our members to outsource some or all of the skilled tasks required, particularly the video creation. I am looking for experienced video editors who can help our members build these channels. A few may want compilation videos, but a vast majority will be doing AI videos. Typically around 8 to 10 minutes in length. Here is how the process will work. Should you be accepted, I will add you to my preferred list of Video Editors available for hire. This list will include your profile link here on Onlinejobs along with any information you wish to share with me about yourself. My members will reach out to you via WhatsApp or email. The interview process should be brief as they will know that you have already been pre-screened by me. Should they feel comfortable with you at this point they will most likely ask you to do a paid test. The test will involve them giving you their first script and asking you to create a video doing the first few minutes of it. Should they like what they see they will hire you. It is important to understand you will be working with them, not me. Also most will be inexperienced in working with Assistants so some patience and understanding may be needed on your part. I will not step in and get involved in this business arrangement unless there is a problem. Tasks you will be asked to do will range from only making the video and sending it to them, to full service doing everything from doing thumbnails, uploading into their channel, analytic review, etc. It is up to you to d ---------- how much you feel comfortable taking on and setting those expectations with my members. We provide all members with AI prompts that will generate the scripts for them. In most cases they will be asking you to do two to three videos a week. The big advantage for you here is that my members will be coming to you. If your work is good and your prices are reasonable there will be no need for you to continue job hunting. You will get all the work you can handle. I can pretty much guarantee that. We have dozens of active members right now, and we are scaling up our operation. There are just a few do’s and don’ts I need to point out. You MUST create good, high-quality videos. NO AI SLOP! All content must be watermark free and good high quality voice over. If you use ElevenLabs, you need to be using voices offered at Creator level membership or higher. YouTube will no longer monetize channels with low-quality, low-effort videos. If I start getting reports that you are putting out subpar work, you will be removed from my list. You must have your own apps to do the job. Do not ask my members to pay for your tools. Asking them to cover the cost of points used in your app is fine, but not the monthly cost of the app. With the amount of work you will get from this you can just charge an extra two or three dollars a video, and that should more than cover the monthly subscription fee. Do not ask members to pay for videos upfront. I understand some of the risk you take on when doing this, but I can assure you this should not happen with my members. If they do not pay, you can contact me, and I will speak to them. If it is true and they have no legitimate reason for not paying you, they will be kicked out of our program that they paid a lot of money for. If a member reaches out to you, I do ask that you ALWAYS respond. Even if it is to tell them you are not taking on any new clients at this time. If you want to be taken off my list for a while, that is fine. Just reach out and let me know, and I can do that for you. When you want to be back on, then again, let me know, and I will put you back on. However, if I continually get reports from my members that they reached out to you and got no response, I will remove you from my list and you will get no further referrals from me. As far as what the expectation is for what to charge, I will just say this. You can charge whatever price you feel you need to set it at. My advice to you, though is not to look at this as singular jobs coming in. I would ask that you consider giving your best quantity discount you can muster up to each individual member that comes to you. Just as an example, if you do good quality work and were to charge $40/video or less. I can pretty much guarantee you that within one to two months you will be turning down work because you simply can’t take on any more clients. If you feel you can’t do it at that price, regardless of the amount of work it will bring, that's fine. I get it. Charge whatever you feel you need to. I am not saying you won’t get any work, just that the higher your price the fewer inquiries you will be getting. STILL INTERESTED? If so, read on. If this is something you want to jump into then here is what you need to do Reply to this job post within the Onlinejobs portal. Do NOT email me directly outside of onlinejobs. If you do so I will not respond. In the subject line include the word “TIGER” Send to me everything you would like included in my referral directory. This can be as much or as little as you like. Whatever you put will, for the most part, be cut and pasted into my directory. Do NOT include your contact information in this. My advice to get the most inquiries would be to include as much as the following as you can: Years of experience as a video editor What types of videos you specialize in What tools do you use Links to your portfolio Links to any work you have done on YouTube or other sites. What skill sets you have beyond video editing that might be of interest Other tasks you are willing to assist in running a YouTube channel. Your price range Anything else you feel would be helpful to know about you. I will say that including any additional tasks and price range are the things that will give you the best results. The price range can come with the caveat that it depends on the scope of your project. Also, if it is for Video only. You can d ---------- what additional tasks will be extra. When I say best results, I don’t mean having the lowest price. I mean you will only get inquiries from members who already understand your pricing. If you are at $70/video and someone has a budget of $40/video, then contacting you will be a waste of time for both of you. You can avoid that by including this information. Once you respond, I may have some additional questions for you. I am not going to simply put everyone on the list that applies. There will be some pre-screening. If you have any questions for me, feel free to ask before applying. Please give me time to respond. It may be several days. I am very busy with a lot on my plate, and I anticipate getting a lot of inquiries for this. So be patient, please.

title: SCHEDULER / APPOINTMENT COORDINATOR – PET GROOMING
description: IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION Please read before applying. To be considered for this position, you MUST submit BOTH of the following: Your updated CV/Resume A short introduction video introducing yourself, your relevant experience, and why you are a good fit for this role Applications without BOTH an introduction video and CV/Resume will not be reviewed or entertained. SCHEDULER / APPOINTMENT COORDINATOR – PET GROOMING We are looking for two reliable, organized, and customer-focused Schedulers / Appointment Coordinators to support a busy mobile dog grooming business. This is not a basic appointment-setting position. You will be responsible for keeping the grooming calendar full, organized, and efficient while coordinating customers, groomers, geographic service areas, travel time, and daily routes. The two Schedulers will share the same core responsibilities while working rotating and flexible shifts to provide consistent 7-day coverage. You will manage daily grooming appointments, answer inbound calls and text messages, respond to customer inquiries, review online booking requests, and communicate with both new and existing customers. You will also follow up with new leads, explain grooming services and pricing, identify appropriate appointment options, and help convert qualified inquiries into booked appointments. A major part of this position is route and schedule management. You will coordinate appointments based on groomer availability, geographic zones, customer location, traffic, travel time, appointment duration, and route efficiency. Returning customers should also be matched with their preferred or previous groomer whenever possible. You will handle cancellations, rescheduling requests, open appointment slots, last-minute changes, and scheduling conflicts. You should be comfortable making decisions and adjusting the schedule when necessary to keep groomers productive and minimize unnecessary travel. You will regularly review upcoming appointments to identify poor routing, missing services, incomplete appointment information, rabies vaccination expiration dates, customer history, previous cancellations or reschedules, and other details that could affect the appointment. You will also contact customers with upcoming appointments who have not reconfirmed, follow up by phone when necessary, update appointment statuses, and maintain accurate customer and scheduling records. Daily responsibilities include monitoring ACMS texts, voicemails, Outlook emails, online appointment requests, new lead inquiries, Facebook messages, cancellations, rescheduling requests, and other time-sensitive customer communications. You will process online requests from both existing and new customers, verify customer information, check requested services and charges, identify duplicate leads, adjust scheduling when necessary, create tentative appointments, and send appropriate email and text confirmations. You may also be responsible for running scheduling conflict reports, correcting appointments that create route or service-area conflicts, reviewing future schedules for optimization opportunities, and contacting previous customers who have not booked services recently. DOG & GROOMING KNOWLEDGE Because this is a dog grooming business, applicants must be comfortable discussing dogs and grooming services with customers. You should have a solid working knowledge of common dog breeds and breed mixes, general breed sizes, coat types, and basic grooming requirements. You should understand that grooming time, services, and pricing can vary depending on the dog's breed, size, coat type, coat condition, behavior, grooming history, and requested services. You must be comfortable asking customers questions about their dog's breed, size, coat condition, behavior, grooming history, and service needs and accurately communicating that information to the groomer. Previous experience with dog grooming, pet care, veterinary services, mobile grooming, pet boarding, or another pet-related business is a strong advantage. TOOLS & SYSTEMS You will work across multiple systems, including Outlook, OpenPhone, ACMS, Connecteam, and OneNote. You do not need to know every system before starting, but you must be comfortable learning new software and working across several platforms throughout the day. REQUIREMENTS Strong written and spoken English is required. Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, appointment coordination, customer service, lead follow-up, or sales is highly preferred. You must be comfortable answering inbound calls and making outbound calls to customers and groomers. You should be highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple customers, appointments, groomers, and priorities at the same time. Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills are important. We are looking for someone who can recognize a scheduling problem and take appropriate action instead of waiting to be told what to do. You must be dependable, comfortable working independently, and available for assigned rotating shifts, including weekends. Experience scheduling field-service teams, mobile services, technicians, delivery routes, or other location-based appointments is a strong advantage. MAIN GOAL Your goal is to make sure the grooming calendar stays full, customers receive excellent service, and groomers have organized and efficient daily routes. Success in this role means balancing customer preferences, groomer availability, geographic zones, travel time, traffic, grooming requirements, appointment duration, route efficiency, cancellations, and new booking opportunities while making sure important customer communications never fall through the cracks.

title: AWS Infrastructure & Cost Optimisation Engineer — Part-Time / Fractional
job_title: AWS Infrastructure & Cost Optimisation Engineer — Part-Time / Fractional
description: **Votari.App Ltd** is looking for an experienced **AWS Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer with strong cost-optimisation skills** to take ongoing ownership of the efficiency, reliability and cleanliness of our AWS environment. We are a small UK technology company operating a live production application on AWS. Our infrastructure has grown over time and is already supported by substantial internal documentation, inventories, governance records and operational runbooks. We now want someone who can take responsibility for ensuring that our AWS environment remains **cost-efficient, secure, understandable and appropriately sized**. This is **not primarily a software-development, CI/CD or Kubernetes role**. The main objective is to understand an existing AWS estate, identify unnecessary or inefficient infrastructure, recommend improvements, and safely implement approved changes. ### Responsibilities * Analyse AWS Cost Explorer, billing data and resource utilisation * Identify idle, unnecessary, duplicated or oversized AWS resources * Review EC2 utilisation and recommend rightsizing or consolidation * Review VPC networking and VPC Endpoints for cost and necessity * Identify unused Elastic IPs and public IPv4 resources * Review EBS volumes, snapshots, AMIs and backup retention * Review CloudWatch dashboards, metrics, alarms, logs and monitoring costs * Identify legacy development or test infrastructure that can safely be retired * Review containerised Linux workloads running on AWS * Maintain accurate infrastructure and cost documentation * Monitor monthly AWS spend and investigate anomalies * Recommend improvements with clear financial and operational justification * Implement approved AWS changes carefully and document the outcome Our environment uses AWS compute, networking, monitoring, storage, IAM and containerised Linux workloads. Experience with EC2, VPC, EBS, CloudWatch, S3, IAM, Docker and Systems Manager will be particularly useful. ### How we work Production infrastructure must not be changed casually. For significant changes, we expect you to explain: **Current situation → proposed change → expected saving → risk → rollback plan** Production-sensitive changes require approval before implementation. You will also have access to an existing private infrastructure/governance repository containing previous AWS investigations, resource inventories, decisions and operational evidence. We expect you to use this material rather than repeat work unnecessarily. ### Initial Assignment Your first assignment will be a **read-only AWS infrastructure and cost review**. You will compare the current AWS environment against our existing documentation and identify the highest-value opportunities for optimisation. Areas of interest include EC2 utilisation, AWS networking, CloudWatch costs, unused IP resources, legacy infrastructure, storage and snapshots, and duplicated or unnecessary services. Your report should prioritise each proposed change and include: **Current situation | Proposed action | Estimated saving | Risk | Production impact | Rollback approach | Recommendation** No production changes should be made during the initial audit without approval. ### Who We Are Looking For We are looking for someone with strong practical AWS experience, ideally including previous responsibility for reducing infrastructure costs. Real-world experience is more important to us than certifications alone. You should be comfortable inheriting an AWS environment that you did not design and understanding dependencies before changing anything. Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools is useful but is not the primary requirement. ### Time Commitment Initially approximately **10–15 hours** for the infrastructure review and optimisation plan. After that, we expect approximately **3–5 hours per week** on an ongoing fractional basis. The goal is for you to gradually take ownership of AWS infrastructure efficiency rather than waiting for us to identify every issue. ### Application Questions Please answer these questions when applying: 1. Tell us about an AWS environment where you personally reduced the monthly infrastructure cost. What did you discover, what did you change, and approximately how much was saved? 2. You inherit an AWS environment with several Interface VPC Endpoints whose recurring cost appears high relative to their traffic. How would you determine whether any can safely be removed? 3. A small production environment has unexpectedly high CloudWatch costs. How would you determine what is necessary and what can safely be reduced? 4. What AWS tools and metrics would you use to identify idle or oversized EC2 instances? 5. When you inherit an AWS environment that you did not build, what checks do you perform before deleting or changing an apparently unused resource? 6. How many hours per week are you available, and what is your hourly rate in USD? **Please do not send a generic cover letter.** We will shortlist candidates primarily based on the quality of their answers and evidence of real AWS operational and cost-optimisation experience.

description: Summary: We seek a senior-level creative strategist to lead performance-driven advertising for fast-growing direct-to-consumer brands. Testing Roadmaps: Develop structured testing plans and hypotheses for new creatives. Creative Development: Write and brief creative concepts yourself (scripts, hooks, ad copy, storyboards). Own production of ads with designers, video editors and creators. Provide clear, actionable briefs detailing hook/messaging frameworks and visual direction. Iteration & Optimization: Launch high velocity (dozens) of new ads weekly, monitor their performance (hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS), and analyze results. Identify winners (e.g. 25%+ of tests hitting ROI targets) and double down while killing losers. Feed learnings immediately into the next week’s creative batch. Leadership & Collaboration: Lead and mentor junior strategists, writers, and editors. Partner closely with media-buying, account and production teams. Provide strategic direction to designers and video teams, reviewing creative output for on‑brand messaging and performance potential. Communicate campaign strategy and results confidently to executives and clients, aligning creative direction with overall business goals. Creative Operations: Establish and refine creative processes and testing infrastructure (creative briefs, asset libraries, analytic dashboards). Manage production timelines and budgets for creative projects. Champion new tools (e.g. AI-assisted ideation) to improve efficiency and creative quality. Must-Have Skills and Experience: 5+ years in performance marketing or DTC creative strategy. Proven track record of scaling paid social or video ads with measurable ROI – e.g. campaigns you wrote that hit six- or seven-figure spend. Deep expertise in Meta Ads (required) and at least one other platform (TikTok, YouTube, Google, Snap, etc.). Comfortable with Facebook/Google Ads managers and analytics tools. Data- and hypothesis-driven mindset: strong comfort with CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS and other KPIs. Able to translate data into creative insights and prioritize tests accordingly. Excellent copywriting skills (hooks, scripts, ad copy, on-screen text). You’ll be writing much of the ad copy yourself, not just delegating. Strong leadership and communication: experience leading creative teams or client relationships. Able to present strategy and feedback clearly. Highly organized, detail-oriented and able to juggle multiple fast-moving projects/deadlines. Nice-to-Have: experience with agency-side DTC brands, additional channels (Amazon, Pinterest), advanced CRO/landing-page testing, or creative ops background. Familiarity with audience research methods (survey design, ethnography) and creative analytics tools is a plus. Benefits: Competitive salary (see below), performance bonus, equity or profit share (if applicable), fully remote/hybrid work, flexible hours, professional development budget. How to Apply: Submit your resume and a link to your portfolio or examples of ad campaigns with metrics. (See screening questions below for details.) As part of the online application, candidates should provide basic info and answer prescreen questions. Years of Experience: “How many years have you worked in performance marketing or creative strategy?” Brand/Channel Fit: “List direct-to-consumer brands or accounts you’ve managed. Which ad platforms have you used (Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)?” Portfolio Link: “Please provide a link to your portfolio or examples of ad campaigns you created.” Campaign Metrics: “For one of your campaigns, provide key results (e.g. CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS) and budget spent.” Creative Role: “Describe your specific role in the campaign(s) above. Did you write scripts, direct production, etc.?” Channel Preference: “Which creative/ad channel are you strongest at (e.g. Meta videos, TikTok, YouTube)? Why?” Testing Experience: “Give an example of an A/B or multivariate test you ran on creative. What was your hypothesis and outcome?” Leadership: “Have you managed or mentored creative teams (copywriters, designers, video editors)? Describe your experience.” Collaboration: “How do you work with media buyers and account teams? Provide an example of a cross-functional project.” Salary Expectation: “What is your desired salary or current compensation?” (optional, to gauge range). These questions ensure candidates explicitly address the “must-have” criteria (DTC/Meta/TikTok experience, performance results, team leadership) before moving forward. 3. Interview Guide Behavioral Questions Leadership: “Tell us about a time you led a creative team (writers, editors, designers) on a high-stakes campaign. What approach did you take, and what was the outcome?” Stakeholder Communication: “Describe a situation where you had to convince a skeptical executive or client to try a new creative strategy. How did you present your case?” Problem-Solving: “Give an example of a campaign that initially failed to meet goals. How did you diagnose the issue and what did you do to turn it around?” Collaboration: “How do you balance creative vision with performance data? Have you ever had to push back on a designer/editor or media buyer? How?” Adaptability: “In a fast-paced sprint environment, priorities change quickly. How do you manage stress and ensure deliverables on time?” Technical Questions Data Analysis: “Explain how you measure creative performance. Beyond CTR, what metrics do you track and why?” Testing Framework: “Walk me through your process for designing a creative A/B test. How do you formulate hypotheses and d ---------- when an ad is a ‘winner’?” Research Methods: “How do you develop audience personas? description: META MEDIA BUYER – B2B & B2C HIGH-TICKET LEAD GENERATION SPECIALIST (FULL TIME) Solar experience a strong advantage – not a requirement. Salary: $1,500–$2,000 USD/month (based on experience) + performance bonuses Location: Remote Time Zone Overlap: Minimum 4 hours with US (PST or EST) or UK business hours Tracking Software: Time Doctor is required ABOUT US We are a fast-growing AI appointment generation agency. We help our clients turn ad spend into premium leads and sales-qualified appointments – the kind that convert into high-ticket sales, long-term contracts, and lasting customer value. At our core, we are a high-ticket lead generation agency. We're looking for a skilled Meta Media Buyer with a proven track record of generating qualified B2B leads (and B2C where relevant) through Meta Ads – in any high-intent, consultative, high-ticket vertical. Solar is one of our largest verticals (UK and USA), so direct solar lead gen experience is a strong advantage. But it is NOT a requirement. What is non-negotiable is proven high-ticket lead gen skill that transfers – work where each lead carries real value, the sales cycle is consultative, and the buyer is qualified before they ever reach sales. If you've consistently driven qualified leads and appointments in high-ticket verticals (B2B services, finance, real estate, healthcare, B2B SaaS, home services, premium consultations, and similar) and can adapt fast, we want to hear from you. WHAT YOU'LL MANAGE - Large monthly ad budgets across multiple client accounts - Full campaign lifecycle: strategy, setup, optimisation, scaling, and reporting - Advanced audience segmentation and lookalike modelling - CRM and automation integrations: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly, Zapier B2B Campaigns (primary focus) – qualified consultations, partnership and channel/dealer recruitment, strategy calls, and high-ticket appointment generation. B2C Campaigns – consumer consultations, quote and assessment campaigns, financing and rebate offers, and high-intent lead capture. Our current mix spans high-ticket B2B across several industries, with a strong concentration in solar (commercial and residential solar, battery storage, energy independence, solar financing, dealer recruitment, EPC partnerships). You'll be trained on our offers and qualification processes – what we need from you is proven high-ticket lead gen skill that carries over. CREATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES - Develop AI-driven ad creatives using tools such as HeyGen, Sora, ElevenLabs, and Nano Banana Pro - Produce static and video ads in Canva Pro, Premiere Pro, and CapCut - Test fresh hooks, angles, and offers tailored to each audience and buyer stage - Analyse creative performance and iterate quickly - Maintain brand consistency while scaling creative assets - Ship fresh creative consistently to stay ahead of ad fatigue Hooks and angles vary by account, but generally fall into: B2B / commercial: cost reduction, ROI and long-term savings, tax incentives, sustainability and ESG positioning, operational efficiency B2C / consumer: bill savings, rising costs, government rebates and tax credits, security and resilience, financing options, long-term value PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS You'll be measured on qualified leads and appointments – quality first, volume second. Example targets (solar accounts, for reference only – the same discipline applies across verticals): - B2B USA: $120–400 CPA depending on market, offer, and qualification criteria - B2B UK: £80–300 CPA depending on targeting and project size - B2C: CPA/CPL targets vary by market, offer structure, and qualification process Core KPIs across all accounts: - Minimum 2.5% CTR across campaigns - Strong landing page conversion rates - Improved booked-appointment show rates - High lead-to-close quality metrics - Sales-qualified appointment generation - Weekly performance reporting with actionable optimisation insights EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS Required: - 2+ years of Facebook/Meta Ads experience - Proven track record generating qualified B2B leads through Meta Ads (B2C experience a plus) - Strong command of: - B2B lead generation and high-ticket consultation funnels - Multi-step qualification processes - B2C consumer acquisition funnels - Meta audience targeting (LinkedIn targeting a plus) - Portfolio showing ad spend managed, CPL/CPA results, lead gen metrics, and scaling results - Proven ability to scale campaigns 3x+ while holding target CPA/CPL - Experience running local and multi-location campaigns - Ability to diagnose underperforming campaigns and rapidly turn them around Strong advantage (not required): - Proven high-ticket lead gen in any vertical – where each lead is valuable, the sale is consultative, and qualification matters - Direct solar lead gen experience (commercial, residential, or both) - UK or US market experience - Familiarity with high-ticket or solar sales cycles and offer structures WHAT TO PROVE IN YOUR APPLICATION - Screenshots of ad account dashboards showing spend and performance - Specific CPL or CPA improvements you've achieved (with numbers) - Your best campaign scaling or turnaround story - Experience managing large monthly budgets - The industries/verticals you've generated leads in (high-ticket B2B and solar a plus) - Whether your experience is primarily B2B, B2C, or both We fully respect NDAs and client confidentiality. We are NOT asking for confidential client information – we're looking for proven ability to deliver results, shown through metrics, tangible proof, or performance breakdowns. TRAINING & GROWTH PATH First 30 days – Onboarding into our lead generation systems; understanding offer positioning and qualification processes (including our solar offers). Months 2–3 – Full account ownership, performance accountability, and scaling of winning campaigns. Ongoing – Advanced AI creative training, high-ticket lead gen mentorship, and funnel optimisation frameworks. Performance bonuses are tied to lead quality, appointment show rates, client retention, campaign scalability, and qualified lead generation. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS - Advanced Facebook Business Manager and Ads Manager skills - Conversion tracking setup and optimisation - CRM integration experience: GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Calendly - Landing page optimisation knowledge - Familiarity with CapCut, Premiere Pro, and/or DaVinci Resolve - Understanding of Pixel tracking, CAPI setup, and lead attribution WHO THRIVES HERE - Obsessed with lead quality and conversion rates, not just lead volume - Creative problem solver who thinks beyond generic ads - Takes full ownership of campaign performance - Strong communicator with proactive reporting habits - Organised, trustworthy, and deadline-driven - Comfortable in a fast-paced, full-time agency environment - Performance-oriented and highly accountable - Comfortable using Time Doctor for productivity tracking RED FLAGS – DON'T APPLY IF - You can't commit to a full-time 40-hour work week - You can't provide specific metrics from previous campaigns - You've never run lead generation campaigns on Meta - You rely on generic creatives and copy - You can't explain your optimisation decisions with data - You've never scaled lead gen campaigns profitably - You can't commit to overlap with US or UK business hours - You're uncomfortable being accountable to KPIs - You're not comfortable using Time Doctor COMPENSATION Base salary: $1,500–$2,000/month depending on experience Performance bonus – paid per client campaign managed, based on qualified leads generated, lead quality, appointment show rates, campaign performance and optimisation, client retention and account growth, and consistently hitting CPA/KPI targets. Typical bonuses range from $200–$500+ per month depending on results and number of accounts managed. Additional benefits: - Annual raises for top performers - Paid vacation and sick leave eligibility after probation - 13th month salary eligibility after 3 months - Access to premium software, AI tools, masterminds, and paid communities HOW TO APPLY Your application will not be considered if you do not follow the format below. Start your message with the subject line: Meta Buyer – [Years Experience] – [Highest Monthly Spend] – [Best Cost Per Appointment] Please include: - Latest resume/CV - Portfolio or screenshots of campaign results - A brief explanation of your high-ticket lead generation experience (and solar experience, if any) - Markets you've worked in - Whether your experience is primarily B2B, B2C, or both SELECTION PROCESS 1. Application review (3–5 days) 2. Skills assessment / pre-qualifying interview 3. Video interview with campaign deep-dive 4. One-week paid trial project 5. Final decision and onboarding IMPORTANT Please do not apply if you're not comfortable with: Time Doctor, performance accountability, KPI tracking, full-time commitment, campaign ownership, data-driven optimisation, and a fast-paced agency environment. Previous applicants need not apply.

title: Tekla Structures Modeller/Detailer
description: We're an Australian steel fabricator bringing Tekla Structures fully in-house, and we're looking for a detailer who can own entire projects — from the first model through fabrication detailing to installation GAs. Not a CAD operator working off redlines. A detailer who can be handed a set of engineer's design drawings and deliver a complete, workshop-ready drawing package. ABOUT US We are a multi-discipline fabrication and engineering company in Queensland, Australia servicing major mining operations. We do structural steel fabrication, CNC machining, plasma and waterjet profile cutting, and industrial coatings — all in-house. Your drawings won't disappear into an inbox: they go straight to our own workshop floor, get fabricated, coated, and installed on operating mine sites. You'll get real feedback from the boilermakers building your work, and you'll see photos of your structures standing on site. THE ROLE Twelve months in, you'll be independently running structural packages: modelling, connection detailing, shop drawings, and erection documentation, with minimal supervision. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build Tekla models from engineers' design drawings — structural steel including PFC/UB/UC sections, plate work, platforms, stairs, handrails, and mining infrastructure - Detail connections suited to practical fabrication and site erection - Produce full fabrication drawing packages: assembly drawings, part drawings, and marking plans - Produce installation / erection general arrangements (GAs) for site crews - Generate bolt lists, material take-offs, and BOM reports - Export NC/DXF files for our CNC plasma and waterjet cutting - Manage revisions, respond to workshop queries, and keep a clean drawing register WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Required: - Genuine proficiency in Tekla Structures — ability matters more to us than years of experience, but you must be able to demonstrate it - Able to carry a project end-to-end: model, fabrication detailing, and installation GAs, without hand-holding - You detail for the workshop, not just the screen — you think about weld access, fit-up, transport, and coating when you model - Good written English and reliable communication Preferred (not dealbreakers): - Experience detailing to Australian standards (AS 4100, AS/NZS 5131, AS 1101.3 welding symbols) — or the ability to pick up our standards quickly - Experience with mining or industrial structures (platforms, access steel, conveyor or chute work) WHAT WE PROVIDE - A full Tekla Structures license — provided by us, no cost to you - Full-time, long-term, stable role dedicated 100% to GNH Engineering, formally engaged through our Philippine outsourcing partner, Smart Outsourcing Solutions — proper payroll and compliant employment, the same arrangement as our existing team member - Flexible hours - we care about output and drawing quality, not clock-watching. - Direct access to the workshop team building your drawings — fast answers, real feedback HOW TO APPLY - Attach a portfolio of your Tekla work — model screenshots plus PDF examples of your GAs and shop drawings - Include your expected monthly salary - In a few sentences, describe the most complex structure you have detailed end-to-end, and your role in it

title: Client Relationship & Operations Manager
description: # Client Relationship & Operations Manager **Full-Time Remote Position (Philippines)** Established U.S.-based home service company seeking a highly organized, proactive, and professional **Client Relationship & Operations Manager** to become a long-term part of a fast-growing operation. This is **NOT an entry-level virtual assistant role**. We are looking for someone capable of handling real operational responsibility, customer communication, scheduling coordination, follow-ups, organization, and administrative oversight in a fast-paced environment. If you require constant supervision, struggle with communication, or are uncomfortable taking initiative and ownership, this role will not be a good fit. We are looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, highly responsive, and capable of helping maintain structure and organization across multiple moving parts of the business. ## Work Schedule * Monday through Friday * 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time * 1-hour lunch break * 40 hours per week Applicants **MUST** be fully available during U.S. Eastern business hours. This is a real-time operational role, not passive task work. You are expected to remain online, responsive, and immediately available during working hours for: * Phone calls * Customer communication * Scheduling updates * Internal team coordination * Operational support * Video calls when needed ## Communication Requirements Applicants must be comfortable being on camera and participating in live video calls during work hours. There will be situations where management or field staff may initiate video calls to: * Discuss live field situations * Review projects in real time * Coordinate customer concerns * Assist with active jobsite situations * Communicate face-to-face regarding operational matters Professional appearance, strong communication skills, and comfort on camera are required. ## Compensation Starting compensation is **$5 to $7 USD per hour**, depending on experience, qualifications, communication skills, and interview performance. In addition to hourly pay, this position includes a **generous performance-based incentive program** connected to specific operational and performance benchmarks. Performance incentives are tracked and calculated **weekly**, giving strong performers the opportunity to increase their income quickly. A successful Brand Manager who consistently meets or exceeds performance expectations should be capable of earning an effective income of **$10+ per hour** through a combination of hourly pay and incentives. Additional compensation growth is available as performance, responsibility, and the company continue to grow. We are looking for a long-term team member, not a temporary freelancer. ## Core Responsibilities ### Client Relationship Management * Answer inbound phone calls professionally * Respond to customer texts and emails quickly * Maintain strong customer communication and follow-up * Assist with scheduling and appointment confirmations * Follow up with leads, estimates, and existing customers * Handle customer questions and concerns professionally * Help maintain an excellent customer experience * Ensure customers do not get forgotten or lost during the sales and service process ### Operations Coordination * Coordinate calendars, schedules, and field operations * Organize and track ongoing tasks and follow-ups * Maintain accurate CRM notes and customer records * Monitor pending estimates, appointments, and customer opportunities * Ensure important operational details do not fall through the cracks * Coordinate internally with management, office staff, and field crews * Help improve workflows and organization throughout the company * Identify problems and help find solutions before they become larger issues ### Administrative & Management Support * Assist management with organization and operational oversight * Track pending items, priorities, and project updates * Maintain structure, accountability, and communication * Help management stay organized in a fast-paced environment * Take ownership of assigned responsibilities without requiring constant supervision ### Sales Follow-Up & Customer Retention * Consistently follow up with leads and open estimates * Help move potential customers through the decision-making process * Reconnect with customers who have not responded * Follow up after completed projects * Assist with review requests and customer retention * Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional services This is not an aggressive sales position, but strong follow-up and communication are a major part of the role. ### Social Media & Marketing Coordination * Organize project photos and videos * Assist with social media scheduling and posting * Coordinate customer review requests * Respond to messages and engagement when needed * Help maintain brand consistency and online presence ## Required Qualifications * Excellent spoken and written English * Clear and confident phone communication * Strong organizational skills * High attention to detail * Fast response time * Strong customer service skills * Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment * Comfortable participating in live video calls * Professional appearance and communication * Ability to think critically and solve problems independently * Ability to prioritize responsibilities without constant direction * Strong follow-up habits * Reliable internet connection * Quiet and professional work environment * Ability to take ownership and accept accountability ## Preferred Experience Experience in any of the following is strongly preferred: * Operations coordination * Scheduling and dispatching * CRM management * Customer service * Lead follow-up or sales support * Social media management * Executive or administrative support * Workflow and systems management * Home service or construction industry Previous experience working directly with U.S.-based customers is a major plus. ## Who This Position Is For We are building a serious operation and looking for serious professionals. This position is best suited for someone who enjoys: * Organization * Customer communication * Follow-up * Problem-solving * Operational structure * Improving systems * Taking responsibility * Helping businesses grow This is **NOT a passive assistant role**. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational asset, take ownership of their responsibilities, and become a long-term part of the company. ## How to Apply Please submit: 1. Your resume 2. A short introduction explaining your relevant experience 3. A **1–2 minute video introduction** so we can see and hear how you communicate 4. A brief description of your experience with CRM systems, scheduling, customer communication, and follow-up 5. An example of a system, workflow, or process you helped improve in a previous position In your application subject line, include the phrase: **“Structure Creates Growth”** **Please include a 1–2 minute video explaining why your previous experience, skills, and work style would help contribute to the growth of our business.** Applications that do not follow the instructions may not be considered.

title: Product Analytics Manager (Amplitude)
description: We’re a growing digital business looking for an experienced Amplitude analytics specialist to take day-to-day ownership of our product analytics. title: Content Quality & Localization Analyst
description: Content Quality & Localization Analyst Full-Time | Remote | Starting $2.00/hour ( training period 2-3 weeks ) | Hired: $3.00/hour | Starting Date: Immediately Who we are: This is one of those rare opportunities where joining early actually matters. We're an AI-first DTC e-commerce company across Europe. While many companies are still experimenting with AI, we've built our entire operation around it. Today we operate multiple stores across Europe, and over the coming months we're expanding into several new markets — each with its own language, currency, and audience. We're still a relatively small company. That means every new person has the opportunity to make a real impact. This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant job. Yes... You'll prepare funnels. You'll localize advertorials and sales pages into new languages and markets. You'll follow SOPs. But that's only the beginning — and honestly, the SOPs and the AI already handle most of the "following instructions" part. What we actually need is someone who keeps thinking after the instructions run out. We're looking for people who want to grow into much bigger roles as our company expands. Everyone starts in operations. From there, people naturally grow into areas like: * Localization & Quality Control Lead * Data Operations * AI Operations * Automation * Team Leadership * Process Improvement If you're only looking for repetitive work, this probably isn't the right company. The most important thing about this role: We can teach almost anything in this job. We cannot teach curiosity. We'd rather hire someone who's never touched Shopify but once took something apart just to understand how it worked, than someone who's used every tool in the book but has never once asked "wait, why does it work this way?" Here's why that matters so much for this specific role: our system (Library) already does 80-90% of the work automatically — scraping competitors, drafting pages, cloning them into new languages. It's good. It's also not perfect, and it repeats the same small mistakes in predictable places if nobody's paying real attention. The people who do well here aren't the ones who follow the checklist and move on. They're the ones who read a line, feel that something's slightly off, and stop to check — even when nothing on the checklist told them to. If that sounds like how your brain already works, keep reading. About Library: Library is our custom-built operating system. It already performs most of the manual work involved in launching and localizing a product funnel. The AI gets most of the way there. It does not get all the way there. Your job is where the last, most important stretch happens: * Prepare and organize new product funnels * Localize advertorials and sales pages into new markets (language, currency, cultural references) * Review AI-generated and cloned content line by line before it goes live * Catch what the AI or a first pass missed * Keep pricing, guarantees, dates, and claims consistent with the source of truth across every market * Organize workflows and keep operations moving Over time you'll also learn how the entire business works behind the scenes. What quality control actually looks like here: A few real examples of the kind of thing that needs catching before a page goes live — not because a checklist says to look for it, but because it just doesn't add up if you're actually reading: * A guarantee that says "60 days" in one place and "90 days" three paragraphs later * A price in the body copy that doesn't match the official price table for that country * Delivery copy that still promises shipping to the wrong country after cloning to a new market * A product name that's correct everywhere except one leftover sentence * A reply in the comments section timestamped as older than the comment it's replying to * An email address that displays correctly but links to the wrong domain * A translated page where one sentence was never actually translated None of these are hard to catch. That's exactly the point. The bar isn't "can you catch this if someone points at it" — it's "do you notice it on your own, on page 40 of the day, when nobody's watching." Who we're looking for, This is much more important than experience. We're looking for people who: * Are naturally curious — you ask "why" before you ask "how" * Learn extremely fast, because you actually enjoy learning * Notice when something is almost right and can't just let it go * Take things apart (literally or figuratively) to understand them * Take ownership of a problem instead of waiting to be told * Ask questions when they don't know something, instead of guessing * Like working with systems and finding smarter ways to run them We don't really care if you've used Shopify, launched Facebook Ads, or built funnels before. Those things can be taught in a week. What can't be taught in a week is whether you're the kind of person who double-checks your own work before calling it done. You'll probably enjoy this role if... * You've built or automated something simply because you thought it would be useful — not because anyone asked you to * You've caught a mistake in something everyone else had already approved * You often think: "There must be a smarter way to do this" — and then you actually go find it * You use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini not just to get answers, but to understand things better (Quietly noted: if you've read this far, remember the word Lighthouse. You'll need it later.) Nice to have (genuinely not required): If you happen to have touched any of these, great — it means less ramp-up time. If not, it changes nothing about your chances: Canva, CapCut, Shopify, Facebook Ads Manager, n8n, ---------- , basic HTML, Google Sheets/Excel, multi-language content or translation QA. We mean it when we say these are bonuses. We've seen people with none of this on their resume outperform people with all of it, simply because they asked better questions on day one. What you'll actually do, Initially you'll learn: * Funnel preparation and product launches * Ad and page localization across languages and markets * Line-by-line quality control of localized content * Workflow organization inside Library As you grow, you'll gradually receive more responsibility depending on your strengths — some people move into leading QA across a whole market, others move toward automation and process design. What we offer: * Full-time remote position ( 2-3 weeks training 8.30-16.30 fixed hours ) after that we see how much you know and you can get more freedom to schedule hours ) * Small, ambitious team * AI-first company, built around modern tools from day one * Opportunity to grow into different roles as we expand * Internal training * Daily use of modern AI tools * Real career growth, not a repetitive dead-end task We're building long-term. We hope you are too. Before you apply This probably isn't the right role if you... * Need someone constantly telling you what to do * Follow instructions well but rarely question them * Only want repetitive work * Skim past a small mistake instead of flagging it We'd love to hear from you if... * You're genuinely curious, not just adaptable * You like making things better, even when nobody asked * You want to grow together with a company that's still in its early stages How to apply: This job is about noticing details, following through completely, and doing the small extra step nobody asked for out loud. So the application works the same way — read the whole thing, follow every step exactly, and don't skip the one that feels optional. 1: Step 1 — Written answers: Send us a short message telling us: *Why this role interests you. *What's the last thing you taught yourself — and what made you d ---------- to learn it, with nobody asking you to? *Have you ever built, automated, or improved something simply because you thought it would be useful? Tell us about it. *Which AI tools do you currently use, and how do you actually use them day to day? *Describe a time you caught a small mistake or inconsistency that someone else missed. What made you stop and look twice, when everyone else had already moved on? 2: Step 2 — Prove you read the whole post Somewhere above, we quietly asked you to remember a word. Put that exact word as the subject of your email. If it's not there, we'll assume this posting didn't get a full read — which tells us something too. 3: Step 3 — A 30-second video Record a short video, 30 seconds or less, telling us why we should hire you for this specific role. Camera-facing, just you talking — no editing required, no production value expected. We're not judging the video quality. We're seeing how you think and communicate in 30 seconds flat. 4: Step 4 — Send everything to one place Email your written answers, the word from Step 2, and your video to: ---------- We're not scheduling calls or interviews at this stage. This email — completeness, the word, and the video — is how we'll d ---------- who moves forward. Incomplete applications (missing the word, missing the video, or answers that clearly skip questions) won't move forward, no matter how strong the resume looks.

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor (DaVinci Resolve)
description: I’m looking for a video editor to work with me on a YouTube channel focused on global health, medicine, science, and current events. The videos are research-heavy and should have a clean documentary/commentary style rather than constant effects, zooms, or flashy editing. At first, I will provide a nearly completed story cut in DaVinci Resolve, which will establish: * The main sequence of the video * Which talking-head takes I want to use * The important original/source clips that I am reacting to * The overall argument and structure Your job will be to take that story cut and bring it much closer to a finished video. * Tightening pauses, repetitions, dead space, and unnecessary material * Improving pacing * Smoothing cuts and transitions * Adding appropriate B-roll, screenshots, documents, and supporting visuals * Creating simple, professional graphics and text * Adding source labels * Basic audio cleanup and leveling * Reframing/punch-ins when useful * Helping make the video visually engaging without over-editing it I am looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship, not just one-off editing jobs. Initially, I will make the major story decisions myself, but as you become familiar with my style, I would like you to gradually take on more editorial responsibility. This could eventually include: * Choosing supporting footage * Selecting clips from source videos * Making more substantial tightening decisions * Helping assemble sections of the story cut from raw talking-head footage and source material * Eventually taking a video from much earlier in the editing process to near-final I expect this to be something we learn together over multiple videos. DaVinci Resolve is required. You can use either Mac or Windows, but I use Resolve, and we need to be able to exchange and collaborate on Resolve projects. I am particularly interested in someone who: * Has strong basic editing skills * Has excellent English comprehension * Can follow a complicated argument or story * Has good judgment about pacing * Knows when *not* to add an effect * Can take detailed feedback and apply it consistently * Is reliable and communicates well * Wants to learn the style of one channel over time * Is interested in regular, ongoing work Experience with documentary, news, educational, science, commentary, or video-essay content would be especially useful. You do not need to be a highly experienced senior editor. I am open to someone earlier in their editing career who has good instincts and wants to improve. For the initial workflow, I expect to pay approximately $100 USD per finished 15–17 minute video, depending on the amount of work required. The rate can increase as you become more familiar with the channel and take on more responsibility. Before choosing an editor for regular work, I will invite a few finalists to complete the same paid editing audition. The audition will involve approximately 2–3 minutes of finished video using real footage from an upcoming video. Please send: 1. A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience. 2. Links to 3 examples of your most relevant work. Please do not send a large generic portfolio. 3. Tell me how long you have been using DaVinci Resolve and whether you use the free or Studio version. 4. Tell me approximately how many hours you would expect to spend editing a 15–17 minute video given the workflow described above. 5. Watch at least one video out of the last five from my YouTube channel, Furious Doctors ( ---------- ), and tell me one thing you think works well about the editing, and one thing you would consider changing or improving. I’m hoping to find one editor who can work with me regularly, learn the channel’s style, and gradually take on more of the editing process.

APPOINTMENT CONFIRMATION ROLE-PLAY My calendar contains the following information: Customer: Maria Carter Appointment: Tomorrow at 3:00 p.m. Address: 18 Oak Lane, Gainesville, GA 30501 Purpose: Scheduled home visit Demonstrate exactly what you would say when calling Maria to confirm the appointment. Then demonstrate the voicemail you would leave if she did not answer. 4. PRIORITIZATION EXERCISE Imagine all of the following happen within two minutes: * My phone begins ringing with an inbound call * Someone scheduled for later today sends a message saying they will not be home * I send you a voice message saying, "I just left 214 Cedar Street. The homeowner is interested but wants me to follow up next Tuesday after 6." * Three appointments for tomorrow still need confirmation * I am working in the field and may not respond immediately Explain the exact order in which you would handle these items, why you chose that order, and how you would make sure nothing is forgotten. 5. INCOMPLETE INSTRUCTIONS EXERCISE Imagine I send you this message: "Move tomorrow's appointment with Maria to later because she said she works. Explain: * What information is missing * What you can do without interrupting me * What you need to verify * How you would record the task while waiting for clarification * At what point you would contact me Do not invent information that was not provided. 6. SELF-EVALUATION Choose one of your previous answers and explain one thing that could go wrong with your approach. Then explain how you would prevent or correct that problem. NEXT STEP Applicants who pass the voice screening will be invited to a short live interview. The interview will include an unscripted telephone role-play and a basic note-taking or scheduling exercise. The scenario will not be provided in advance.

title: Executive & Operations Assistant for U.S. Restaurant Owner (Long-Term, Full-Time)
job_title: Executive & Operations Assistant for U.S. Restaurant Owner (Long-Term, Full-Time)
description: Please start your application with the word CUSTARD so I know you read this post carefully. ABOUT US We are a family-owned business in Louisiana, USA. We own and operate three restaurants under two national brands - Chicken Salad Chick and Freddy's Frozen Custard & Steakburgers - with a fourth location under construction. I am the owner. I am also the lead pastor of a church here, so part of this role touches that side of my life as well. I am looking for one person to work with me long-term - not a project, not a trial gig. The person I hire will still be with us in five years. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO I run a lot of things at once, and my day does not sit neatly in one place. This role exists to give me one person who knows where everything stands and keeps it moving. BE THE SINGLE POINT OF CONTACT INTO ME. Right now people reach me five different ways. That will change. Managers, vendors and staff will message you in Slack instead of texting me. You will handle what you can, route what belongs to someone else, and bring me what genuinely needs me - as one organized queue instead of chaos. RUN MY CALENDAR - ALL OF IT. Business meetings, vendor and contractor calls, personal appointments, and church commitments. You will protect my time, prevent double-bookings across three parts of my life, and make sure I am prepared for what is coming next. PREPARE AND CAPTURE MEETINGS. Put together what I need before a meeting. Join the call, take notes, and send the recap with decisions and action items so nothing gets lost. KEEP OUR OPERATIONS CURRENT. Budget trackers, vendor logs and project timelines. When a bid is accepted or a payment goes out, you update the tracker the same day. You file permits, contracts and invoices where they belong, using our naming convention. CHASE OPEN ITEMS UNTIL THEY CLOSE. A contractor has not returned a signed document. A vendor has not sent a certificate of insurance. A bank needs three more items. You track every open item and follow up until it closes - politely, persistently, and without me reminding you. This is the part I most need. HANDLE DATA AND SPOT PROBLEMS. Daily sales and labor numbers into our dashboard. You will notice when a number looks wrong before I do. DRAFT MY COMMUNICATIONS. Follow-up emails to vendors, contractors and our bank. I review and send. Your drafts should need very little editing. SUPPORT THE CHURCH SIDE. Scheduling, meeting coordination, service planning documents and communication logistics. This is administrative and organizational work. It does NOT involve giving records, counseling notes or member care - those stay with our pastoral team. ABOUT THE HOURS - PLEASE READ THIS PART CAREFULLY Your regular schedule is 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday (8:00 AM to 5:00 PM where I am). That is the shift. Here is the honest part. I work long and irregular hours, and I will sometimes send you a message at what is the middle of the night for you. YOU ARE NOT EXPECTED TO ANSWER IT THEN. We use a clear system, and the channel itself tells you how urgent it is: - SLACK - I send whatever, whenever. You pick it up on your next shift. No rush, genuinely. - TEXT MESSAGE - Please look at it when you wake up and handle it at the start of your shift. - PHONE CALL - This means it is truly urgent. I will use it less than once a month. I want someone who is comfortable with a boss whose brain does not switch off at 5:00 PM. I do not want someone who feels they can never sleep. Those are different things, and I will put this in writing in your contract. I also protect your days off and your Philippine holidays. Those are yours. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU Required: - Excellent written English. You will draft emails going to U.S. bankers and contractors, and you will represent me in messages to my own team. This is the most important requirement. - Strong organizational judgment. You will d ---------- what reaches me and what does not. - Strong Google Sheets skills - formulas, filtering, pivot tables. - Genuine attention to detail. We work with dollar amounts, permit numbers and contract dates. - 2+ years as an executive assistant, virtual assistant, operations or administrative support. - Discretion. You will see financial information and personal calendar details. It stays with you. - Reliable fiber internet (minimum 25 Mbps) and a backup connection. - A computer with a webcam and a quiet place to work. A strong plus: - Experience supporting a business owner or executive directly - Experience with U.S. businesses - QuickBooks, or construction and project administration - Restaurant or hospitality background - Comfort with church or ministry administration Who this is not for: - Anyone juggling multiple clients. This is a full-time, single-employer role. - Anyone who needs to be told what to do next every day. - Anyone uncomfortable telling me directly when something is wrong or when I have missed something. I need someone who will push back on me. That is part of the job. WHAT WE OFFER - $1,100 USD per month to start, paid twice monthly via Wise (15th and last day of the month). - A review at 90 days with a clear path to a raise. - 13th month pay every December. - Paid time off - 10 days annually after 6 months, plus Philippine holidays. - A stable, long-term seat. I am hiring one person, once, and investing in them. - Real trust and real ownership. You will run my calendar and my communications. That is a position of confidence and I will treat it as one. HOW TO APPLY 1. Begin your message with the word CUSTARD. 2. Tell me about a time you caught an error that someone above you had missed - what it was, how you found it, and how you raised it. 3. Tell me honestly how you feel about the hours I described above. 4. Describe your internet setup and your availability in Manila time. 5. Attach your resume. Applications that skip any of these five items will not be reviewed. I read every complete application personally and I respond to everyone who makes the short list.

title: Digital Product & Email Automation Builder (MailerLite + WordPress)
job_title: Digital Product & Email Automation Builder (MailerLite + WordPress)
description: We are a UK GP-led women's health education platform selling downloadable patient guides (PDFs) across three content hubs: vulval/vaginal health, fibroids, and menopause. We have a library of ~10 guides — some free email-capture magnets, some paid products — living on MailerLite landing pages, linked from a WordPress website. The system exists and partly works. It needs to be audited, cleaned up, and redesigned into a coherent digital shop — NOT built from scratch. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO 1. Audit what exists first. Before changing anything, review the current MailerLite automations, landing pages, central guide-hub pages, and how the WordPress site links to them. Map what's live, what's broken, and what's duplicated. Document it back to us before touching anything. (Patience for this step is non-negotiable — we need someone who respects what's already there rather than ripping it out.) 2. Update the guides in MailerLite. Refreshed PDF versions of existing guides are produced continuously. You'll swap old files for new across the relevant pages and automations, and make sure the RIGHT email in each automation points to the RIGHT updated guide. 3. Rebuild the MailerLite guide pages. Central guide-hub pages and standalone guide pages, redesigned into a consistent mini-shop pattern (free magnet first → paid guide → bundle offer → proof line), matching our existing brand. 4. Build a "shop" page on the WordPress site that presents the full guide library and links cleanly into the MailerLite pages/checkout. 5. Wire paid delivery securely. PDF unlocks only on successful payment + email capture (no bookmarking around the paywall). Payments via Stripe/PayPal — we never handle card data. WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU - Proven MailerLite automation + digital-download delivery experience - WordPress (Elementor preferred) page-building - Working GDPR knowledge: double opt-in, consent tick-boxes, privacy-policy hook-up, unsubscribe handling - Clean communication and the ability to document your work - Comfort working to brand guidelines and a pre-set price/bundle structure (we supply the copy and pricing architecture — you implement, you don't invent strategy) DELIVERABLES & PROCESS - Written audit of the current setup before any changes - The redesigned hub + standalone guide pages (MailerLite) - The WordPress shop page - Updated automations with refreshed guide files, tested end-to-end - We approve every stage before it goes live; nothing ships without sign-off - Handover documentation so our team can maintain (email sends, template tweaks) after you finish SCOPE NOTE: The build and a parallel content refresh run at the same time. The audit and structural build do NOT depend on final content, so please price the AUDIT + ARCHITECTURE BUILD and the later CONTENT SWAP as two separate phases. Final content lands ~5 weeks from now. WHAT YOU MUST AGREE TO (NON-NEGOTIABLE) - NDA + full IP assignment — everything you build or touch is our property - Access — you work as an admin/editor on MailerLite and WordPress; we retain sole ownership - No exporting our subscriber list to personal accounts or machines - 2FA on for any account you work on - No live deployment without our written approval TO APPLY Reply with: (1) one example of a MailerLite automation you built that sells a digital download, (2) one WordPress page with a paid checkout, and (3) a 2–3 sentence note on how you'd approach auditing an existing system you've never seen before.

title: Seasonal Outbound Call Agent (Open Enrollment Support)
job_title: Seasonal Outbound Call Agent (Open Enrollment Support)
description: Employment Type: Seasonal Contract (via Native Teams – Employer of Record) Contract Duration: September 28, 2026 – December 15, 2026 Compensation: PHP 40,600 per month + Performance Incentives Schedule: September 28 – October 31: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (US Central Time) November 1 – December 15: 11:00 AM – 7:00 PM (US Central Time) About Marketplace Insurance Exchange The Marketplace Insurance Exchange is committed to helping individuals and families maintain their health insurance coverage by providing exceptional service throughout the Open Enrollment period. We're looking for three (3) Seasonal Outbound Call Agents to join our team during one of the busiest and most important times of the year. If you enjoy helping people, communicating over the phone, and working toward measurable goals, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role This is not a sales position. As a Seasonal Outbound Call Agent, your primary responsibility is to contact existing clients who have not yet completed their Open Enrollment forms and assist them in completing the required paperwork to help continue their health coverage. You'll follow up with clients through phone calls, SMS, and WhatsApp while accurately documenting every interaction. If a client has questions regarding insurance coverage or benefits, you'll escalate the matter to the appropriate internal team or designated insurance agent. Key Responsibilities - Contact existing clients with incomplete Open Enrollment forms. - Assist clients in completing their enrollment forms during the call whenever possible. - Conduct follow-up calls, SMS, and WhatsApp messages until the enrollment process is completed. - Make approximately 100–150 outbound calls per day. - Document all client interactions accurately in iAgencyPal CRM. - Update shared Excel tracking sheets with notes and status updates. - Coordinate with internal tea ---------- mbers regarding client progress. - Escalate complex inquiries to the appropriate tea ---------- mber or insurance agent. - Participate in daily team huddles and coaching sessions. What This Role Does NOT Include To set clear expectations, this position does not involve: - Selling insurance products - Recommending insurance plans - Explaining policy benefits or coverage - Providing licensed insurance advice Your role is to assist clients in completing their required enrollment paperwork and connect them with the appropriate representative when necessary. Performance Expectations Success in this role will be measured through: - 100–150 outbound calls per day per agent - 15 completed enrollment forms per day per agent - Accurate CRM documentation - Timely follow-ups - Reliable attendance and punctuality Qualifications We're looking for candidates with: - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. - Previous experience in customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, administrative support, or a similar role. - Strong phone etiquette and active listening skills. - Basic Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets knowledge. - Strong organizational and documentation skills. - Reliable high-speed internet connection. - A quiet work environment. - A professional headset suitable for remote work. - Experience in healthcare or insurance is an advantage but not required. Tools You'll Use - iAgencyPal CRM - Nextiva Phone System - Microsoft Teams - Outlook - Shared Excel Tracking Sheets - WhatsApp Training & Onboarding Comprehensive training will be provided before you begin taking calls, training includes: - Company Overview - HIPAA & Data Privacy - Open Enrollment Process - iAgencyPal CRM - Nextiva Phone System - Call Scripts - Documentation Standards Training begins on September 28, 2026. Compensation & Benefits - PHP 40,600 monthly salary - Performance incentive program - Seasonal employment through Native Teams (Employer of Record) - Company-issued laptop provided for the duration of the seasonal contract (A company-issued laptop will be provided to successful candidates for use throughout the duration of the seasonal contract. The laptop remains the property of Marketplace Insurance Exchange and must be returned at the end of the engagement in accordance with company policies.) Application Process To be considered for this opportunity, please submit the following: 1. Updated Resume 2. Video Introduction (2–3 Minutes) - Record a short video introducing yourself in English. - In your video, please tell us: Introduce yourself. Briefly describe your professional background and relevant experience. Tell us about your experience with customer service, outbound calling, virtual assistance, or administrative support. Share why you're interested in this seasonal opportunity. Explain why you believe you would be a great fit for this role. 3. Mock Outbound Call Recording Please submit a separate voice recording using the following script: Good morning/afternoon. May I please speak with [Client's Name]? Hi [Client's Name], my name is [Your Name], and I'm calling on behalf of Marketplace Insurance Exchange. I'm reaching out because we noticed that your Open Enrollment form hasn't been completed yet. I'd be happy to help you complete it today if you have a few minutes available. Completing this form helps ensure we can continue assisting you with your health coverage. If now isn't a convenient time, I'd be happy to schedule a callback at a time that works best for you. If you have questions about your insurance coverage or benefits, I'll make sure your designated insurance agent contacts you as soon as possible. Thank you for your time today. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to helping you complete your enrollment. Join Our Team This is an excellent opportunity to be part of a supportive, collaborative team during one of the most important campaigns of the year. If you're an excellent communicator who enjoys helping people and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today and help us make Open Enrollment a success!

title: E-Commerce Video Editor – CapCut Expert | Long-Term Opportunity
