job_title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller / ISA – Motivated Seller Leads | $6–$7/hr + Appointment & Closing Bonuses
description: OnlyOffers is a Chicago-based real estate solutions and home-buying company. We speak with homeowners who may be dealing with situations such as: * A property that needs major repairs * Problem tenants or nonpaying occupants * An inherited or probate property * Pre-foreclosure or financial pressure * A vacant or boarded property * Tax or code issues * An unwanted rental property * Divorce, relocation or another life transition * A desire to sell as-is without preparing the property for the traditional market Depending on the homeowner’s situation, our local team may discuss a direct purchase, an as-is sale, a traditional real estate listing or another legitimate option. We are not looking for someone who pressures homeowners or simply reads a script. We need someone who listens carefully, asks intelligent questions, recognizes genuine motivation and schedules qualified conversations for our local team. This is intended to be a stable, long-term position with the opportunity to grow into a Senior ISA or Lead Manager as OnlyOffers expands. ----- YOUR ROLE You will be the first voice many homeowners hear from OnlyOffers. Your responsibilities will include: * Making outbound calls to property owners using our company-provided dialer * Having professional, natural conversations with Chicago-area homeowners * Identifying whether the owner is open to discussing a sale * Asking appropriate discovery questions about: * Reason for considering a sale * Desired timeline * Property condition and needed repairs * Whether the property is occupied, vacant or tenant-occupied * Tenant or eviction-related complications * Ownership and other decision-makers * Price expectations, when appropriate * Recognizing motivated sellers without forcing or misleading them * Scheduling qualified appointments or callbacks with our acquisitions or real estate team * Completing assigned follow-up calls * Sending approved SMS or email follow-ups through company systems when assigned * Recording accurate notes, dispositions, tags and follow-up tasks in the CRM * Keeping every lead organized so no legitimate opportunity is lost * Submitting an accurate end-of-shift report * Immediately recording and honoring every do-not-call request * Following all OnlyOffers calling, privacy and compliance procedures We provide the lead lists, dialer, CRM, scripts, training and qualification process. ----- WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO You will not: * Quote a cash offer or property value * Estimate what a property is worth * Negotiate purchase prices or contract terms * Give legal, tax, foreclosure or eviction advice * Promise that OnlyOffers will purchase a property * Misrepresent the company or the purpose of the call * Continue calling someone who has asked not to be contacted Those matters are handled by our acquisitions team, licensed real estate professionals or appropriate third-party professionals. Your responsibility is to start a genuine conversation, collect accurate information and make a professional handoff. ----- WHAT COUNTS AS A QUALIFIED APPOINTMENT A $25 appointment bonus is earned only when all of the following are true: 1. You spoke with the property owner or a confirmed decision-maker. 2. The property is within an approved OnlyOffers market or campaign. 3. The homeowner expressed genuine openness to selling or discussing available options. 4. There is a real timeline, reason, problem or circumstance behind the potential sale. 5. You collected the required property and seller information. 6. Clear and accurate notes were entered in the CRM. 7. The homeowner agreed to a specific appointment or callback time. 8. The scheduled conversation was actually held by our team. Duplicate leads, existing active leads, fake appointments, homeowners who were misled or appointments missing required information do not qualify for the bonus. Quality is more important than simply placing appointments on the calendar. ----- PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS After training and ramp-up, reasonable performance targets may include: * Consistent high-volume outbound activity during assigned calling blocks * Approximately 10–25 real homeowner conversations per day, depending on list and dialer performance * Approximately 3–8 legitimate seller opportunities per week * Approximately 1–4 qualified appointments held per week * Accurate same-day CRM notes and follow-up tasks * Reliable attendance and punctuality * Professional communication with the OnlyOffers team * Immediate and accurate handling of do-not-call requests These targets may be adjusted based on list quality, connection rate, campaign type and dialer setup. We do not reward meaningless dials or unqualified leads. ----- REQUIRED EXPERIENCE To be considered, you must have: * At least one year of outbound calling, appointment setting or inside-sales experience * Previous experience calling U.S. homeowners * Previous U.S. real-estate cold-calling experience * Experience identifying seller motivation, timeline, condition and price expectations * Experience handling objections without sounding robotic or aggressive * Clear, confident and easy-to-understand spoken English * Strong listening and note-taking skills * Experience working inside a CRM * Experience using a power dialer or real-estate calling platform * Reliable attendance during U.S. Central Time business hours * A professional, quiet work environment * A reliable computer and quality USB or noise-cancelling headset * Stable high-speed Internet with a backup Internet option * A backup plan for power interruptions Experience working for a real-estate investor, wholesaler, cash-home-buying company or acquisitions team is strongly preferred. ----- HELPFUL EXPERIENCE Experience with any of the following is a major plus: * Follow Up Boss * GoHighLevel * REsimpli * Podio * ReadyMode * CallTools * BatchDialer * Mojo * BatchLeads * PropStream * Absentee-owner lists * Tired-landlord lists * Pre-foreclosure * Probate or inherited-property leads * Vacant-property leads * Expired listings or FSBOs * SMS and email follow-up * Chicago or Midwest homeowners * Conversational Spanish Follow Up Boss experience is especially valuable. ----- THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR You may be a strong fit when: * You can follow a call framework without sounding like you are reading * You listen more than you speak * You ask a thoughtful second question instead of immediately giving up * You remain professional when someone is rude or dismissive * You can hear the difference between curiosity and genuine motivation * You do not manufacture or exaggerate leads * You are comfortable receiving coaching and reviewing your calls * You keep excellent notes without being reminded * You take responsibility for your attendance and results * You want one stable, long-term role rather than constantly changing clients This is a direct-hire position. No agencies, subcontractors or applicants working overlapping full-time shifts. ----- SCHEDULE Monday through Friday 10:00 AM–7:00 PM U.S. Central Time One-hour unpaid meal break 40 paid working hours per week This is an overnight/graveyard schedule in the Philippines. The Philippine schedule changes when U.S. daylight-saving time changes. Consistent availability during the complete shift is required. ----- COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS * Starting compensation: $6–$7 USD per hour, depending on verified experience and interview performance * Paid training at your regular hourly rate * $25 for each qualified appointment that is actually held * $250 for every transaction generated from your original lead that successfully closes * Compensation review after the first 90 days * Additional reviews based on reliability, call quality, CRM accuracy and results * Payments every two weeks * 13th-month loyalty bonus after 12 consecutive months in good standing * Five paid personal days after six months * Long-term opportunity * Advancement opportunity into Senior ISA or Lead Manager * Additional responsibility and compensation as the OnlyOffers calling team expands Closing bonuses are paid after the transaction has successfully closed and OnlyOffers has received the applicable transaction proceeds. ----- HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY Applications missing any required item will not be reviewed. Begin your application with the words: ONLYOFFERS CHICAGO Then provide all of the following: 1. Your full name and current city in the Philippines. 2. Your résumé. 3. A two- to three-minute video using Loom, Google Drive or an unlisted YouTube link. The link must be accessible without requesting permission. Your video must include: * A brief introduction * Your U.S. real-estate cold-calling experience * The types of seller lists you have called * A natural response to the following homeowner: “I’m not interested. Everybody keeps calling me. Besides, I have a tenant who won’t leave and the property needs too much work, so selling isn’t simple.” Do not read a prepared answer. Respond naturally and demonstrate what you would say next, including at least two follow-up questions. 4. Written answers to the following: * How many months or years have you cold called U.S. homeowners? * Have you worked for a wholesaler, investor or cash-home-buying company? * Which seller lists have you called? * Which CRMs have you used? * Which dialers have you used? * What were your average daily dials? * What were your average weekly homeowner conversations, qualified leads and appointments? * How do you determine whether a seller is hot, warm or cold? * What would you do immediately if a homeowner asks never to be called again? * Are you currently working for another client or employer? * Can you work the complete U.S. Central Time schedule without overlapping work? * What is your primary Internet speed? * What is your backup Internet plan? * What is your backup plan during a power interruption? * What computer and headset do you use? * When are you available to begin? 5. A screenshot of your current Internet speed test. 6. A screenshot of your computer specifications. Applicants who complete the first stage may be invited to a live video interview and real-time seller role-play. We are hiring carefully because we want the right person to become a long-ter ---------- mber of OnlyOffers—not simply someone to read a script and make calls.

job_title: US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Specialist — Benefits, Prior Authorization & Billing Support
description: TRUBRIETY is a growing U.S.-based behavioral health practice providing outpatient and intensive outpatient treatment for mental health and substance use conditions. We are looking for an experienced **Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Specialist** in the Philippines who wants a long-term role and can grow with our company. This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience working with **U.S. healthcare insurance, benefits verification, prior authorization, medical billing, claims, or revenue cycle management.** The position will initially focus heavily on **insurance eligibility/benefits verification and prior authorization**, then expand into broader revenue-cycle and healthcare operations responsibilities as our patient volume grows. ## Schedule Approximately **4 hours/day, 3 days/week — 12 hours/week** to start. We expect this role to grow toward **20–40 hours/week** as TRUBRIETY grows. Some working hours must overlap with **U.S. Pacific Time business hours** because you will need to call insurance companies and work with payer portals. ## Initial Responsibilities Your first priority will be making sure new insured patients are financially cleared before treatment whenever possible. For each patient, you will verify and accurately document: * Active insurance coverage * In-network/out-of-network status * Behavioral health benefits * Mental health and substance use benefits * Deductible and amount met * Out-of-pocket maximum and amount met * Copay * Coinsurance * Coverage for anticipated services * Whether prior authorization is required * Authorization requirements * Visit/day limits * Payer representative name * Call/reference number * Exclusions or unusual coverage issues You will enter this information accurately into **SimplePractice** and our insurance tracking system. Our goal is to clearly know where every patient stands: **Benefits Verified → PA Required/Not Required → PA Submitted → PA Approved → Ready for Services/Billing** ## Prior Authorization Responsibilities As you demonstrate accuracy, you will also: * Initiate prior authorization requests * Submit administrative information and clinical documentation supplied by our clinical team * Call payers regarding authorization status * Follow up on pending authorizations * Track authorization numbers * Track approved visits/days * Track authorization dates and expiration dates * Identify additional information requested by payers * Alert the team before authorizations expire * Document payer responses and reference numbers ## Revenue Cycle Responsibilities The position will expand into broader RCM responsibilities, including: * Checking claim status * Researching unpaid claims * Researching denials and rejection reasons * Identifying missing information * Calling payers regarding claim issues * Tracking accounts receivable follow-up * Maintaining outstanding claim and follow-up reports * Coordinating findings with our billing specialist * Assisting with ERA/EFT administrative issues * Tracking patient responsibility, copays, coinsurance, and deductibles * Identifying billing or insurance problems before they become aged receivables ## Credentialing and Payer Enrollment Support Responsibilities may also include: * Tracking provider credentialing applications * Following up with payer credentialing departments * Maintaining provider credentialing documentation * Tracking licenses and expiration dates * Assisting with CAQH and payer roster administration * Supporting Medicaid/OHP and commercial payer enrollment processes ## Back-Office Healthcare Operations As the role grows, you may also help with: * Auditing SimplePractice for missing insurance information * Maintaining authorization and insurance-clearance trackers * Organizing payer correspondence * Following up on outstanding administrative tasks * Creating concise weekly RCM status reports * Identifying workflow problems * Helping us document and improve repeatable revenue-cycle processes ## Required Experience Applicants must have prior experience with **U.S. healthcare insurance or revenue cycle management**. We strongly prefer candidates with experience in several of the following: * Insurance eligibility and benefits verification * Prior authorization * Medical billing * Claims follow-up * Denial management * Accounts receivable follow-up * Provider credentialing * Payer enrollment * Patient responsibility * Calling U.S. insurance companies * Working with payer portals Experience with **behavioral health, mental health, substance use treatment, outpatient programs, or intensive outpatient programs (IOP)** is highly desirable. ## Strongly Preferred Background We are particularly interested in candidates who have previously worked with or for: * UnitedHealthcare / UHC * Optum * Blue Cross Blue Shield * Regence * Aetna * Cigna * Kaiser * Carelon * Elevance * U.S. medical billing companies * U.S. healthcare revenue-cycle companies * Healthcare BPOs serving U.S. providers Experience with any of the following is a plus: * SimplePractice * Availity * CAQH * Provider portals * Prior authorization portals * CPT / HCPCS terminology * S9480 * H0015 * 90834 * 90837 * 90853 ## You Should Already Understand You should be comfortable with terms such as: * Eligibility * Benefits verification * Deductible * Copay * Coinsurance * Out-of-pocket maximum * In-network / out-of-network * Prior authorization * Authorization dates * Visit/day limits * Claims * Denials * Accounts receivable * CPT / HCPCS codes * Patient responsibility You will not be expected to independently make clinical decisions or determine coding strategy. You will be expected to **investigate discrepancies, obtain accurate information from payers, document your findings clearly, and know when an issue should be escalated.** ## What We Are Looking For You should be: * Extremely detail-oriented * Organized * Persistent * Reliable * Comfortable calling U.S. insurance companies * Fluent and professional in spoken English * Strong in written English * Comfortable spending time on hold and following through until an issue is resolved * Able to document payer conversations accurately * Comfortable questioning inconsistent information * Able to distinguish between administrative issues and matters requiring escalation * Interested in growing into a larger healthcare operations and RCM role This position involves protected health information. Strict **HIPAA, confidentiality, privacy, and information-security requirements** will apply. ## Technology Requirements You must have: * Reliable high-speed internet * Quiet and private workspace * Reliable computer * Headset appropriate for U.S. payer calls * Backup internet connection * Reasonable backup plan for power interruptions ## Compensation **$8–$10 USD/hour to start depending on directly relevant U.S. healthcare experience.** There will be opportunities for increased hours, responsibility, and compensation as you demonstrate the ability to independently manage these workflows. ## How to Apply Please do not send a generic application. Start your application with: **TRUBRIETY RCM** Then answer: 1. How many years have you worked with U.S. healthcare insurance or revenue cycle management? 2. Describe your experience performing insurance eligibility and benefits verification. 3. Describe your experience with prior authorization. 4. Describe any claims, denial, or accounts receivable experience. 5. Which U.S. insurance companies have you worked with? 6. Which payer portals have you used? 7. Have you worked in behavioral health, mental health, addiction treatment, or IOP? 8. Which EHR/EMR systems have you used? 9. Have you used SimplePractice? 10. What is your requested hourly rate? 11. What hours are you available in U.S. Pacific Time? 12. What is your primary internet connection and backup internet/power plan? ### Scenario A behavioral health patient has Regence insurance. The benefit check shows: * $1,500 deductible * Deductible has not been met * 20% coinsurance after the deductible * The payer representative says **S9480 is not covered** * The patient reports that Regence previously authorized IOP treatment at another facility **Before telling the practice that IOP is not covered, what would you investigate and document?** Please explain your process. We are looking for someone who wants a **long-term position and an opportunity to grow with the company**, not someone looking for a temporary freelance project.

title: Physics Curriculum Assistant – Worksheet & Curriculum Development
job_title: Physics Curriculum Assistant – Worksheet & Curriculum Development
description: I am looking for someone with a strong understanding of Physics, particularly Mechanics, to help me develop educational materials for high school Physics courses. This position will initially focus on creating Physics worksheets, homework assignments, quizzes, reviews, and test questions. However, I am looking for someone I can work with long-term who may eventually help me develop larger portions of complete Physics curricula. IMPORTANT: Strong Physics Knowledge Required You must have a solid understanding of Physics. During the interview process, I will ask you to solve Physics problems in real-time and explain your reasoning. If you are not confident solving high school and introductory college-level Mechanics problems, please do not apply. A Physics degree or previous experience teaching Physics would be a major advantage, but it is not required if you can demonstrate strong Physics knowledge. What You Will Be Doing I am currently developing Physics courses and need help creating original Physics questions and solutions for high-level high school students. These questions may be used for: Homework assignments Worksheets Quizzes Unit reviews Tests Future curriculum materials I will provide examples and templates showing the style and difficulty level I am looking for. For each assignment, I will provide: - The Physics topics being covered. - Examples of the types and difficulty of questions I want. - Formatting/templates when necessary. You will provide: - Original Physics questions that do not create copyright issues. - Complete and accurate solutions/answer keys. - Materials formatted according to the provided template. - Careful review of every question to make sure the wording, numbers, diagrams, units, and answers are correct. Using AI Using AI tools such as ChatGPT is encouraged. However, you cannot simply copy and paste AI-generated questions. You are responsible for checking that: The Physics is correct. - The problem actually makes sense. - All necessary information is provided. - The numerical answer is correct. - Units and significant details are correct. - The question is appropriate for the intended student level. Strong ATTENTION TO DETAIL is extremely important for this position. The Ideal Candidate I am looking for someone who: - Has a strong understanding of Physics, especially Mechanics. - Has excellent attention to detail. - Can solve Physics problems accurately. - Can follow detailed instructions. - Is comfortable using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint. - Has experience using AI tools effectively. - Communicates clearly and asks questions when something is unclear. - Is interested in learning how to create high-quality educational curriculum. Previous experience as a Physics teacher, tutor, Physics major, engineer, or curriculum developer would be especially helpful. Application Process If you are interested: - Send me your resume. - Tell me about your background and experience with Physics. - Briefly explain your experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT. Applicants who appear to be a good fit will receive a small sample/test assignment. If you complete the assignment accurately and follow the instructions well, we will schedule an online interview. During the interview, I will ask you to solve several Physics problems in real-time so I can evaluate your Physics knowledge. Hours & Long-Term Opportunity I expect approximately 5–15 hours of work per week for the next 4 months. If we work well together, I would like this to become a longer-term position. Future work may include helping me: - Develop complete Physics units. - Build worksheets and activities. - Review existing curriculum. - Help develop complete Physics courses. There is significant opportunity for increased responsibility for the right person. Payment Initial work will generally be paid per completed worksheet/project, with the expected compensation roughly equivalent to $5–$10 USD per hour, depending on the complexity of the work and your efficiency. I am open to increasing the rate for someone who consistently produces excellent work, demonstrates strong Physics knowledge, and can take on more responsibility over time.

title: Insurance Sales Support
description: About Us McGarr Insurance is an independent insurance agency on Florida's Treasure Coast. We primarily handle home, auto, flood, and umbrella policies with a focus on education over sales. Our clients aren't just policy numbers—they're people who deserve to understand what they're paying for. We've been growing steadily since 2019 and need another person to help our sales team keep up. We're not a call center. You'll work directly with our team of 8, learn our clients by name, and handle real problems—not scripts. The Role You'll support our sales team by handling the quoting and follow-up work that eats up their time. Your job is to be the oil in the sales engine—freeing up our agents to focus on talking to clients and closing business, not chasing data entry and underwriting paperwork. Day-to-day work includes: Loading new clients into our management system, Applied Epic Submitting quotes through QuoteRUSH and Epic Quotes (our comparative raters) Following up on underwriting items and outstanding requirements Calling carriers on behalf of our sales agents Any other miscellaneous work that frees up the sales agents to sell Down the line, this role may grow to include speaking with clients directly to gather information or follow up on underwriting items, and evaluating quotes across carriers in QuoteRUSH—not just submitting them, but comparing results and getting final quotes ready for our sales team to send out. Prior Property & Casualty insurance experience is required (personal lines strongly preferred). We'll train you on carrier systems, Florida-specific processes, and our workflows. What matters most: you're detail-oriented, you communicate clearly, and you follow through. Hours & Schedule Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time including a 1 hour paid lunch break. This schedule is firm—you'll need to be available during these hours to handle calls and coordinate with the team. Compensation $700-1,000/month depending on experience, paid via Deel. You'll be hired as an independent contractor. What We're Looking For Strong written and spoken English Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for calls Comfortable learning new software (we use Applied Epic, QuoteRUSH, Epic Quotes, carrier portals, Teams) Detail-oriented—insurance work has zero tolerance for sloppy data entry Communicates proactively when stuck or confused How We Hire We'll send some questions via the onlinejobs.ph portal, then we'll do a video interview, and if it goes well, you'll start a 2-week paid trial. During that time, you'll work alongside our team on real tasks. If it's a good fit for both sides, you're on the team. If not, no hard feelings—we'll pay you for your time and part ways.

Support project timelines by independently managing assigned drafting and documentation priorities. Required Qualifications & Skills Advanced Revit proficiency with strong production drafting experience. Strong AutoCAD skills. Significant professional experience in residential architecture and construction documentation. Demonstrated experience producing complete or substantial portions of residential construction drawing sets. Ability to independently develop floor plans, elevations, sections, wall sections, and architectural details. Strong understanding of residential construction methods, framing, wall and roof assemblies, building systems, and detailing. Ability to interpret architectural sketches, markups, specifications, and design direction. Strong understanding of how architectural drawings translate into actual construction. Excellent attention to detail and drawing accuracy. Strong English communication skills. Ability to receive feedback, incorporate redlines accurately, and manage multiple revisions. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a remote design and construction team. Proactive, organized, dependable, and comfortable asking questions when information is unclear. Preferred / Bonus Qualifications Degree in Architecture or a related field. Licensed Architect preferred, but not required. Experience with luxury or high-end custom residential projects. Traditional or classical architecture experience. Familiarity with U.S. residential construction practices and documentation standards. SketchUp proficiency. Interior architecture, millwork, cabinetry, or interior detailing experience. Experience coordinating architectural drawings with structural, MEP, or other consultant drawings. Previous experience working remotely with U.S.-based architecture, design-build, or construction teams. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who is more than a Revit operator. title: YouTube Channel Editor (Faceless, Crypto + Trading) - Script, Voiceover, Charts, Edit, Upload
job_title: YouTube Channel Editor (Faceless, Crypto + Trading) - Script, Voiceover, Charts, Edit, Upload
description: **[IMPORTANT: READ THE WHOLE POST. Short on time? There is a fast track at the bottom.]** I run a YouTube operation covering crypto and trading. I am opening a new faceless channel and I need one person to own it, from the script to the published video. I am John. You work with me directly, not through an agency. **How it works, day to day** 1. I pick the topic and the type of video, and I send you 3 title options. 2. You do the market research and write the script. You get an AI account for this, and there is a library of example videos you can learn from and take heavy inspiration from. You are not inventing a format. You are executing one that already works. 3. I approve the script. Usually a few notes, sometimes none. 4. You build the video. Voiceover first, then charts and exchange screens, then the edit. You upload it as private. 5. You show it to me. I say go, or I say what to change. Then it goes live. That is the loop. One full-length video a day, 8 to 12 minutes. **The work** * **The channel uploads 7 days a week.** Your working schedule is yours. If you do not want to work Sundays, batch ahead and schedule it. I care that something goes up every day, not that you are at your desk every day. * **Script.** From my 3 titles and your research. Plain English, written to be read aloud. * **Voiceover.** I give you the account and the voice is already chosen. You generate the read, fix pacing, and regenerate lines that land wrong. You need an ear for when AI narration sounds off, because most people do not have one. * **Charts.** This is the core of the visual layer. If the script says Bitcoin dropped 12% in four hours, you pull up that exact candle range, mark it, and put it on screen at the moment the narration says it. Wrong chart on screen is the fastest way to lose this audience. * **Edit.** Cut to the script, then build the visuals on top. On-screen text, zooms, callouts. Pacing that holds someone past minute three. * **Upload.** You get YouTube editor access. You upload as private, write the description, set tags, add chapters, set the end screen. I flip it live. * **Shorts, optional seat.** One full-length video and one short a day, the short cut from that day's video. This seat pays more. * **Thumbnails, optional, a plus.** YouTube lets you test up to 3 per video. I can generate these myself for now, so you do not have to. If you can make 1 to 3 strong options per video, say so. It counts. **What you need** * **Real finished work.** Links to published videos, not a showreel montage. I want the thing a viewer actually sat through. * **You can read a chart.** You do not need to trade. You do need to look at a candlestick chart and know which part of it the script is pointing at, and you need to be able to drive TradingView. * **You source your own visuals.** I will not send you a B-roll folder. If the script describes a move, you go find the chart that shows it. * **Strong written English.** You are writing the script, the titles and the descriptions. This is a real part of the job. * **Your own machine and stable internet.** Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, or CapCut Desktop. I care about the output, not the logo. * **Reliable on a schedule** without me chasing you. **Pay** * **PHP 50,000 to PHP 93,000 per month.** The range is wide on purpose, because it depends on what you take on. One full-length video a day sits in the lower half. Add the daily short and it moves up. Run two channels and I pay you for two. Get more content out, or take over more of the process, and it keeps moving. For videos alone the top of the range is realistic. For someone who runs everything on a channel I am open to going past it. * **Paid test task first, PHP 2,000**, paid whether or not I hire you, as long as you deliver. It is a 4 minute cut, not a full video. * **Trial week** after that. Five real videos, paid per video on delivery. * **Paid weekly for the first month, then twice a month**, by Wise, PayPal or Binance. Always after the work, never in advance. A short written agreement before we start. * **I pay for the tools.** ElevenLabs seat, AI account, stock footage, thumbnail credits. You are not buying subscriptions out of your salary. * **Extras.** Running the comments, thumbnails, covering another channel while someone is off. More work, more money. We agree it when it comes up. * **If you can do both crypto and AI tools content, say so in your first line after the keyword.** I have a seat that covers both and it pays more than this one. **How to apply** **Start your message with the word CHART.** If it does not start with that word I stop there. Then there are two ways in. Either is fine. **Fast track.** Three links to published videos you edited end to end, which seat you want (video, or video plus short), and your monthly rate. That is it. If the work is good, we talk. **Full application.** The fast track plus the five below, and you go to the front of the queue: 1. Say which parts of those three videos were yours and which the client handed you. 2. What is your experience with crypto or finance content? Have you used TradingView? 3. Have you generated AI voiceover before? If yes, what do you do when a line reads wrong? If no, say no. 4. Have you published to a YouTube channel that was not your own? Which parts did you handle? 5. The channel uploads 7 days a week. How would you schedule your own week to hit that? If you cannot hold 7, say what you can hold. An honest 5 beats a fictional 7. Answer honestly. I would rather hire someone who says "I have never touched ElevenLabs" and shows me excellent editing than someone who claims everything.

Sometimes you will need to take an existing website, reference examples or loose instructions and make sensible visual decisions yourself. ## Design and image responsibilities Your design work may include: * Editing, resizing and improving images supplied by clients. * Creating or adapting simple website graphics. * Using Photoshop, Figma or equivalent design software. * Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to generate or improve suitable website imagery. * Maintaining consistency with an existing website or brand. * Recognising when specialist design or illustration work should be escalated. You do not need to be a high-level brand designer or illustrator, but you must be comfortable making everyday design decisions without needing constant direction. Your CRM work may include: * Creating and managing GoHighLevel sub-accounts. * Updating users, permissions and account settings. * Building and editing forms and calendars. * Creating and updating pipelines and opportunities. * Building and testing straightforward workflows. * Updating emails, SMS messages, triggers and workflow actions. * Managing custom fields, tags and contact lists. * Cloning assets between accounts. * Testing automations and identifying problems. * Handling routine CRM requests from clients. * Organising and segmenting our own customer database. Direct GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred. Experience with another CRM and marketing-automation platform may be considered if your other skills are strong and you can demonstrate a clear ability to learn new systems. Complex API integrations and advanced custom development will be handled separately. ## Client success responsibilities An important part of this role will be helping us provide more proactive value to our existing clients. Your responsibilities will gradually include: * Reviewing existing client websites using an agreed audit checklist. * Identifying outdated content, broken elements and potential improvements. * Preparing straightforward website and CRM recommendations. * Producing and sharing simple website, analytics or CRM reports. * Checking forms, calls to action and important customer journeys. * Keeping accurate client information inside GoHighLevel. * Segmenting clients by business, industry, service and account status. * Maintaining separate email lists for fitness clients and other client groups. * Helping prepare and send monthly client news, advice and service updates. * Drafting useful client emails using ideas and information provided by the business owner. * Recording recommendations, communication and follow-up actions. * Passing relevant commercial opportunities to the business owner. This is not a cold-sales position. The purpose is to strengthen existing client relationships, provide visible ongoing value and ensure useful opportunities are not missed. Clients will be reviewed on a manageable rotating schedule rather than every client receiving a full manual audit each month. ## Organisation and communication You will also be expected to: * Turn requests and instructions into clearly organised tasks. * Keep task statuses and deadlines up to date. * Identify missing information before starting work. * Ask focused questions when instructions are unclear. * Follow up with freelance designers and developers where required. * Check work returned by freelancers before it reaches a client. * Document repeatable processes as you learn them. * Provide concise updates covering completed work, priorities and blockers. * Eventually respond directly to straightforward client requests. Slack will be our main channel for day-to-day communication. You must be comfortable using Slack, remain responsive during agreed working hours and use the appropriate channels to provide updates, ask questions and report blockers. You will be invited to our Slack workspace. The purpose of this role is to complete work and reduce interruptions. I need someone who investigates problems, thinks about the next step and communicates clearly—not someone who waits silently for constant instructions. ## Essential skills and qualities * Commercial WordPress experience. * Experience using WordPress page builders. * A strong eye for web design, spacing and responsive layouts. * A good understanding of onsite technical SEO * Confidence making website changes independently. * Experience with Photoshop, Figma or equivalent design software. * GoHighLevel or comparable CRM/automation experience. * Excellent written English. * Strong organisation and attention to detail. * Ability to manage several different tasks and projects. * Comfortable communicating and collaborating through Slack. * Confidence using AI tools productively while checking their output. * Reliable internet, a suitable computer and a backup connection. * Proactive, dependable and willing to take ownership of work. Experience with Salient and WPBakery would be particularly valuable, but training can be provided to someone with strong transferable WordPress experience. ## Working arrangement * Approximately 30 hours per week. * Long-term, part-time contractor position. * Approximately 6 hours per day, Monday to Friday. * Some daily overlap with UK working hours is required. * A working pattern around 3pm–9pm Philippine time would be suitable. * Payment will be made weekly for the first two months. * The role may increase in hours if the arrangement works well for both sides. ## How to apply Please include: 1. Three WordPress websites you personally worked on and exactly what you did. 2. Details of the WordPress themes and page builders you have used. 3. Details of your GoHighLevel or CRM/automation experience. 4. Examples of design, image-editing or website-redesign work. 5. The design software and AI tools you currently use. 6. Your experience communicating with clients or supporting existing customers. 7. Your required hourly rate and confirmation that you can work 30 hours per week. 8. description: Type: Full-time, remote Salary: $1,200 – $1,500 USD/month, depending on experience You manage: Two customer service specialists, all supplier relationships, quality control and brand protection Reports to: The founder, directly Start: As soon as we find the right person --- READ THIS FIRST This is not a virtual assistant role and it is not a support role. We are looking for one person to run the daily operation of a growing e-commerce brand so the founder can stop doing it. If you are looking for a fixed list of tasks and a clean 9 to 5, please don't apply. You will be unhappy and so will we. If you are the person who cannot let a problem sit, who picks up the phone when something is on fire, and who takes it personally when a customer gets a bad product, keep reading. ABOUT US We are a European brand selling personalised jewelry online. Small team, fast growth, everything in English. Right now the founder is still the person suppliers call, the person the team asks, and the person chasing every open problem. That worked at a smaller size. It doesn't any more, and things that matter are slipping through. We want to hand that over to one person and never take it back. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Suppliers. We manufacture in Asia. Good partners, but they need managing. Delivery dates slip, quality drops, an order goes quiet for two weeks and nobody tells us. You are the one who spots it, raises it, and stays on it until it's solved. When a batch comes in wrong and it costs us money, you put the numbers on the table and ask for a credit note. Politely, firmly, and you don't drop it because they went quiet. This is the part of the job most people find uncomfortable. It's also the part that pays your salary. Quality. You turn complaints into data. Which supplier, which product, which fault, how often. Then you take that to the supplier with evidence instead of a feeling. That is how we stop repeating the same mistake every month. The team. Two customer service specialists report to you. You set their priorities, unblock them, review how they handle the hard cases, and make sure nobody is stuck waiting for the founder to reply before they can do their job. Brand protection. We spend serious money on marketing, and other stores copy our photos, our product pages and sometimes our entire site. You handle it end to end: collecting evidence, filing takedown requests with the right platforms, tracking every case, and working with our lawyer when it needs to go further. We have already had a competing store taken offline this way. Your job is to make that routine instead of an emergency. The founder's inbox. You become the filter. Suppliers, team questions, escalations. You solve what you can and bring the founder what genuinely needs a decision, with your recommendation attached. HOW WE WORK We don't count hours. We count what gets solved. Some weeks are calm. Some weeks a shipment is stuck, a supplier goes silent and a campaign is live. In those weeks you don't clock out at five and leave it for tomorrow. You are reachable when it matters. The founder needs to be able to call you when something is urgent. Not every evening, not every weekend, but when it counts you pick up. In return you get real flexibility on the quiet days and nobody watching your clock. You d ---------- , then tell us. We would rather you make a call and be wrong occasionally than wait three days for permission. You will be trained by the founder personally for the first weeks: how we handle suppliers, what our quality standard is, how we deal with copycats, and where the line is on decisions you make alone. This role grows. As the company grows, so does the team under you and the responsibility. WHAT YOU NEED **Required** - 3+ years in operations, supply chain or account management for an e-commerce or product brand - You have managed overseas suppliers or manufacturers yourself. You know exactly what "we will check and get back to you" means - You have led people, even a small team - Excellent written English. You write to suppliers, to your team and to the founder every day, and each needs a different tone - You can hold someone to what they promised without wrecking the relationship - Structured. You track things in writing, you follow up on a rhythm, and nothing quietly disappears **Nice to have** - Shopify - Jewelry, fashion or accessories - Copyright takedowns, marketplace disputes, or working with legal counsel HOW TO APPLY Do you really think you're the person we're looking for, and do you fit in our team? Then tell us why. If you had any doubt while reading this, it's not your role.

job_title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSLs + AI Cartoon Videos and other AI style ads + Short form videos)
description: DTC / dropshipping brand doing ~$50k/month in revenue Role: Video Editor / AI Video Producer Type: Read this part first We are not looking for someone to "make our videos look nice." We are looking for someone who understands that a video's job is to hold attention and make people buy — and who can build that video end to end, including sourcing or generating every frame of footage inside it. If you need a folder of assets handed to you before you can start editing, this role isn't for you. If you can take a script and a product and come back with a finished, conversion-ready asset, keep reading. Who we are We're a direct response DTC brand currently doing around $200k/month, almost entirely on the back of paid media and creative. Creative is our growth lever. Not the site, not the offer tweaks, not the email flows — the video. That means the editor seat is one of the highest-leverage roles in the company. When a video wins here, it wins loudly and you'll see it in the numbers within days. We're scaling, and we want to stop stitching together freelancers per project. We want one highly skilled person who becomes part of the team, learns our angles and our customer inside out, and gets sharper with every batch we ship. How this role starts (please read carefully) This does not begin as a full-time position, and that's deliberate. We start every editor on a lighter workload — a smaller number of videos per week — for the first stretch. Not because we're testing whether you can hold a job, but because we want to see how you fit: how you take feedback, how you handle a script we hand you, how you communicate when something's unclear, and whether the work holds up once the novelty wears off. It also gives you time to learn our customer, our angles, and what a "winning" video looks like in our account specifically. From there it scales. As the fit proves out and your creatives start performing, the volume goes up, the pay goes up, and the arrangement moves toward a secure, permanent full-time seat — with a defined monthly retainer rather than per-project work. To be clear about what we're offering: Phase 1 — Fit: Lower volume, paid per project or at a smaller retainer. Heavy feedback from us. We're both figuring out if this works. Phase 2 — Ramp: Volume increases, you take on the VSLs and the AI cartoon projects with less hand-holding, pay increases accordingly. Phase 3 — In-house: Full-time, secure retainer, you own the creative pipeline and have real input on direction. Room to grow into a creative lead as we bring on more editors. We're not looking for someone to fill a gap for three months. We're looking for the person who's still here in two years running our creative. The slow start is how we get there without either of us wasting the other's time. If you need immediate full-time income from day one, this probably isn't the right fit right now — and that's fine, just be upfront about it. What you'll actually be making 1. Long-form VSLs (Video Sales Letters) The core of the role. 2–7+ minute sales videos built off scripts we provide. You'll be responsible for: Pacing the entire video so retention doesn't collapse — pattern interrupts, cuts, zooms, motion, sound design, text emphasis, visual proof Sourcing your own b-roll. Stock libraries, licensed footage, UGC-style clips, screen recordings, archival, whatever the script calls for. You find it. You don't ask us to send it. In some cases we will also provide clips and we have a bunch of softwares that you can use to make this process easier aswell. Generating AI video to fill the gaps stock can't cover — visualizing mechanisms, metaphors, before/after states, scenarios that don't exist as footage. Building the visual language for a section, not just laying clips over a voiceover Kinetic text, callouts, subtitles, on-screen proof elements, testimonial treatments Sound design and music that carries emotional beats without burying the VO 2. AI cartoon / animated videos (short form AND long form) We're producing a growing volume of fully AI-generated animated content — story-driven ads, explainer content, character-led narratives. You'll take a script and: Build a consistent character and world (this is the hard part — character consistency across dozens of shots is a real skill and we'll be testing for it) Generate the shots yourself using AI image + video tools Handle lip sync, voiceover, and audio Cut it into a video that actually flows as a story rather than a slideshow of AI clips Deliver in both short form (15–60s, vertical) and long form formats 3. Short form paid ads Hook-first ads for Meta / TikTok. High volume, fast iteration. Multiple hook variants of the same body. You'll be cutting these constantly, and you'll be expected to have opinions about which hooks are worth testing. What we need you to be good at Non-negotiable: Editing that converts, not just editing that looks good. You understand hooks, retention curves, pattern interrupts, why the first 3 seconds d ---------- everything, and how to build toward a CTA. If you've never thought about a video in terms of watch time or CPA, you're not ready for this seat. Sourcing your own footage. Independently. You know where to find good b-roll, Generating AI video yourself. Not "willing to learn" — actually doing it now. You know how to prompt, how to iterate when a generation is wrong, how to maintain consistency, and how to upscale and clean up output so it doesn't look like AI slop. Strong technical craft — clean cuts, deliberate pacing, proper audio levels, colour that matches across mixed sources, subtitles that don't look like an afterthought. Speed. We ship a lot. Quality at volume is the whole game. Ownership. You get a script and a brief and come back with a finished asset. You flag problems early. You don't go quiet for four days. Tools — you should be fluent in most of these or their equivalents: Editing: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut. AI video: Higgsfield, Veo, Kling, Runway, Sora, Hailuo, Seedance — or whatever you've found works better AI image: Midjourney, Flux, Nano Banana, Ideogram Voice: ElevenLabs or similar Upscaling / cleanup: Topaz, Magnific Bonus: Descript, Adobe Podcast, motion graphics templating, basic scripting/automation for batching Removing text from video: Vmake Nice to have: You've written or restructured direct response scripts before You've worked on offers in health and wellnes niche You can take a competitor's winning ad, break down why it works, and build a better version You track what's new in AI video weekly because you find it genuinely interesting Who this is NOT for Editors who only work from supplied assets People who see AI tools as a threat or a gimmick "Cinematic" editors who make beautiful videos that don't sell Anyone who needs to be chased for updates Agencies or people who'll pass the work to a junior. We want the person doing the work. What you get A real seat on a growing team. We start light on purpose, but the destination is a secure full-time role — and if it works, we build our creative operation around you. Direct feedback loop on your work. You'll see spend, retention data, and CPA on the creatives you cut. Most editors never get this — it's the fastest way to get genuinely good. Budget for tools and subscriptions. We're not going to bottleneck you over a $50/mo AI credit plan. Performance bonuses when your creative becomes a winner. Room to grow into a creative lead role as we scale and bring on more editors under you. Fast decisions. Small team. No layers of approval. How to apply Please follow this exactly — it's the first filter. Send your portfolio. We want to see, specifically: At least one long-form VSL or long-form sales video you cut At least one AI-generated video you produced yourself (cartoon/animated preferred) Short form paid ads if you have them For 2–3 of those videos, tell us in one or two lines each: what the goal was, what you did to hold attention, and any performance numbers you're allowed to share (spend, ROAS, retention, CTR — whatever you have). Tell us your AI stack. Which tools you use for what, and one problem you've solved with them that most people get wrong. Your rate and your realistic capacity — how many long-form videos and how many short form ads per week. Turnaround time on a typical 10-minute VSL, assuming script and VO are provided. Confirm you're okay with the ramp-up structure — starting at lower volume and building toward full-time. One line is enough.

title: Accounting Manager — Month-End Close & Job Costing (US Construction, Night Shift)
job_title: Accounting Manager — Month-End Close & Job Costing (US Construction, Night Shift)
description: Republic Homebuilding and Renovations is a design-build residential construction and remodeling firm in Webster, Texas, USA, serving homeowners across the Greater Houston area. We run about ten active jobs at a time, ranging from $20,000 to $300,000. We use QuickBooks Online for accounting and JobTread for project management and job costing. We are hiring one Accounting Manager. This is a fully remote role for someone based in the Philippines, working United States Central Time hours. READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY We would rather you rule yourself out now than at offer stage. - This is a night shift, permanently. 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, with one hour unpaid lunch. - This is a direct engagement with a US company. You would work as an independent contractor, not as an employee under Philippine labor law. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions. - We do NOT provide SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, or HMO. Our pay is set above the local market rate specifically because of this. Please factor it into your decision. - This is exclusive and full time. You may not hold another job or client engagement while working with us. You will be asked to list every current engagement in your application. - We use screenshot monitoring software on work computers. Pay is $9.00 to $12.00 per hour depending on experience, 40 hours per week. At today's rate that is roughly PHP 95,700 to PHP 127,500 per month. Because pay is in US dollars, the peso value moves with the exchange rate. We also pay a year-end bonus equal to one month's pay, prorated by month of hire. THIS IS NOT A DATA-ENTRY JOB You will own the accounting function. We have separate staff who enter bills, send invoices, chase documents, and track purchase orders. Your job is to own the close, own the reconciliations, own the job cost data, and review their work - not to do it yourself. We are also going to be straightforward about something most job posts leave out: our historical books need cleanup. Costs have not been consistently coded to the right jobs, and some accounts need to be reorganized. Your first ninety days include a defined cleanup project alongside normal monthly work. You will not be inheriting a clean system and we are not pretending otherwise. If that is the kind of problem you enjoy, we want to hear from you. If it sounds like a headache, this is not the right role for you, and that is fine. REQUIREMENTS - ALL FOUR ARE REQUIRED - Bachelor's degree in Accountancy - 3+ years of accounting experience, including at least one year where you were personally responsible for closing the books every month. Not assisting someone else who closed them. - Experience assigning costs to specific projects or jobs, including d ---------- which job a cost belongs to at the time you record it - QuickBooks Online experience STRONGLY PREFERRED - Construction, remodeling, or contracting experience, especially US residential - Experience with a project management or job-costing system alongside the accounting system (JobTread, Buildertrend, Procore, CoConstruct, or similar) - Experience producing a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule using percentage-of-completion - Experience closing books for more than one related entity, including intercompany transactions - QuickBooks Online Advanced Certification / ProAdvisor - CPA (PRC) license If you do not have every item on the preferred list, apply anyway. The four requirements above are what matter. WORK SETUP REQUIREMENTS - Reliable high-speed internet AND a reliable backup connection - Backup power supply - Reliable computer plus a backup device - Willingness to use screenshot monitoring software WHAT YOU WILL OWN Monthly close - Reconcile all bank, credit card, and loan accounts every month - Produce the monthly financial package: profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow statement - Produce a monthly Work in Progress (WIP) schedule - Prepare monthly reporting packages required by outside parties - Close on a published schedule, not "when it gets done" Job costing - Ensure every cost is coded to the correct job and correct cost type at the time it is recorded - Maintain a clean separation between job costs and company overhead, and apply it consistently - Reconcile job cost data in QuickBooks against JobTread and resolve the differences - Produce per-job cost reporting the project team can rely on Bank feed and payables - You are the only person who touches the bank feed. title: AI Content & Social Media Manager
description: AI Content & Social Media Manager Long-Term Creative Partner — Seek Consciousness I’m looking for a highly capable, independent thinker to help grow Seek Consciousness, a long-term project exploring consciousness, meditation, psychology, spirituality, ancient wisdom, modern science, healing, personal transformation, and direct experience. This is not a standard social media manager position. I’m not looking for someone who waits for me to tell them what to post every day. I’m looking for someone who can learn this work deeply, understand my voice and visual style, use AI intelligently, understand how social media actually works, and increasingly take ownership of this part of the project. I can do this work myself, but it isn’t where my time is best spent. My focus needs to stay on creating the teachings, videos, writing, and larger Seek Consciousness project. I’m not looking to micromanage you. I’m looking for a creative partner who can handle their business, think for themselves, and help us build this together. ⸻ THE PROJECT Seek Consciousness brings together different paths, practices, teachings, and tools that can help people go deeper into themselves and consciousness, work through old patterns and trauma, and experience more presence, clarity, love, freedom, and aliveness in their lives. There is already a large body of original material to work from: * Long-form YouTube videos * Full scripts and transcripts * Shorts and Reels * Written teachings and ideas * Existing carousels and social posts * AI-generated imagery * Finished thumbnails * Brand references and visual assets * A growing YouTube library Your job is not to use AI to invent new Seek Consciousness teachings. The ideas come from my actual writing, videos, experiences, and body of work. AI helps us find, organize, distill, restructure, research, visualize, and communicate those ideas more effectively. For example, a 15-minute video may not contain a clean 60-second Short that can simply be clipped out. You may find a great idea spread across several parts of the script, use AI to help restructure it into a strong 45–90 second piece while preserving my actual meaning and voice, and then give it back to me to rerecord. Sometimes you’ll be extracting content. Sometimes you’ll be reorganizing it. Sometimes you’ll be helping us discover the shorter teaching hidden inside a larger one. That kind of judgment is a major part of this role. ⸻ WHAT YOU’LL DO Initially, we’re looking to create approximately 1–2 core pieces of content per day and adapt them appropriately across: * Instagram * TikTok * Facebook * YouTube Shorts Your work may include: * Finding strong Shorts and Reels inside existing scripts and videos * Creating new short-form scripts for me to rerecord * Designing finished 4–6 slide carousels * Creating single-image posts and social graphics * Writing captions, hooks, titles, descriptions, and CTAs * Creating high-quality AI-generated imagery * Learning and maintaining the Seek Consciousness visual style * Using ChatGPT extensively as part of the creative process * Carefully proofreading everything before it goes out * Recognizing factual claims that should be researched or verified * Adapting content intelligently across different platforms * Scheduling and publishing approved content * Maintaining a content calendar and backlog * Reviewing analytics and identifying what is working * Finding strong ideas that deserve additional versions or follow-ups * Helping move people from short-form content toward our YouTube channel and website As the role grows, you may also help manage: * YouTube uploads * Titles and descriptions * Shorts strategy * Playlists * Thumbnails and packaging ideas * End screens and pinned comments * Overall channel organization and optimization ⸻ SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & GROWTH This is an important part of the role. I’m still learning the social-media side of this project, so I’m looking for someone who understands not only how to make good content, but also how to help the right people discover it. You should have a strong working understanding of areas such as: * Instagram Reels, carousels, Stories, collaborations, scheduling, and analytics * TikTok discovery, search, posting, trends, and platform-specific formatting * Facebook distribution * YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube strategy * Hooks and viewer retention * Watch time * Click-through rate * Saves, shares, comments, and meaningful engagement * Search-friendly titles, captions, keywords, and descriptions * Content calendars and scheduling * Cross-platform repurposing * Organic growth strategies * Collaborations and promotion * Understanding when content should be reused and when it should be adapted * Recognizing why something worked and what we should test next I’m not looking for someone who blindly follows social-media formulas or chases every trend. I want someone who understands the platforms well enough to bring ideas to the table and help us use them intelligently. There will be things I can teach you about AI, writing, imagery, and Seek Consciousness. There should also be things we can learn from each other. ⸻ AI IS A MAJOR PART OF THIS ROLE I use ChatGPT extensively, and right now it works particularly well with my voice and existing body of work. I have also developed specific methods for: * Working with AI while preserving my actual writing style * Pulling new content from long-form material * Refining scripts * Creating AI imagery * Developing consistent visual styles * Iterating until something actually feels right I’ll teach you the methods and systems I’ve developed. I’m also interested in the tools and processes you already use. But one principle is extremely important: AI is a tool, not an authority. AI can produce something that sounds intelligent, looks beautiful, and is still wrong. You need enough judgment to know when to question it, research something, rewrite it, reject an image, or ask for clarification. ⸻ WHO I’M LOOKING FOR We’re looking for an independent thinker, not simply an operator. Someone who: * Thinks for themselves * Takes ownership of their work * Doesn’t need to be told every next step * Has excellent written English * Is an excellent proofreader * Has strong visual taste * Has real social-media management experience * Understands content strategy, distribution, analytics, and audience growth * Is highly capable with ChatGPT and other AI tools * Has real experience creating AI imagery * Can learn an established visual style * Understands that technically impressive work can still be wrong for the brand * Can receive feedback and learn from it * Has good research instincts * Knows when something should be fact-checked * Is comfortable saying when something doesn’t make sense * Brings ideas rather than only completing assigned tasks * Can prepare batches of strong work for approval * Is organized and dependable * Wants to become part of a team and help build something meaningful over time You do not need to share any particular belief system. Seek Consciousness itself is not about telling people what they must believe. But you do need to be genuinely interested in subjects such as consciousness, spirituality, psychology, meditation, healing, personal growth, and exploring your own inner life. You need to want to understand the material—not simply run it through AI and produce generic “spiritual content.” ⸻ THE TEAM You won’t be working alone. We already have a small creative team including: * An experienced videographer/editor * A webmaster * A UI/UX specialist Three members of the team are based in the Philippines, and they are genuinely wonderful people to work with. You’ll be able to collaborate with the rest of the team, exchange ideas, ask for feedback, and help us grow the project together. ⸻ HOURS & LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY This will begin as a part-time role, approximately 15–25 hours per week. The work will be largely asynchronous. We’ll schedule meetings when they’re useful for reviewing work, planning, teaching new systems, or solving problems—not simply because we need another meeting on the calendar. Ideally, you’ll prepare content in batches so I can spend an hour or two reviewing it, give you feedback, and then return my attention to creating. This is intended to be a long-term position. For the right person, it has the potential to grow into: * Full-time work * Greater responsibility * Greater autonomy * Increased compensation * A core role within the Seek Consciousness team I’m looking for someone who wants to grow with the project, not someone looking for a short freelance assignment. ⸻ PAID TRIAL After reviewing applications, I plan to select a small number of finalists for a paid trial project. The trial will use real Seek Consciousness material and may include: * Finding Short/Reel ideas inside longer content * Creating a new short-form script * Designing a finished carousel * Creating several AI-generated images * Identifying which images work and which do not—and explaining why * Writing platform-specific captions and content * Explaining how you used AI * Showing where you personally edited or improved AI output * Sharing what opportunities you see that I may be missing I’m interested in how you think, not simply how quickly you can produce something. Finalists will receive more information about my AI and creative processes before completing the trial. ⸻ HOW TO APPLY Please begin your application with the word: CREATE That lets me know you actually read this posting. Please do not send only a generic résumé or canned application. I want to hear from the actual person I may be working with. Please tell me: 1. Why do you think you’re a particularly good fit for this project? 2. What experience do you have with: * Social-media management * Instagram * TikTok * Facebook * YouTube * Writing and proofreading * ChatGPT / AI * AI image generation 3. Show me examples of work you are genuinely proud of. 4. Tell me about a social-media account you have managed. What did you actually do, what changed while you managed it, and what metrics did you pay attention to? 5. Tell me how you currently use AI in your work. 6. What do you believe you are particularly good at? 7. Where would you still like to improve? 8. If you’re comfortable sharing it, tell me a little about your own connection to consciousness, spirituality, personal growth, or your inner life. There is no correct belief or answer here. I simply want to understand the person I may be working with. 9. Tell me your current availability. 10. Please list your hourly rate. And finally, answer this: If I gave you a 20-minute Seek Consciousness video, its full transcript, and access to our visual library—but very little direction—how would you d ---------- what content to create from it and how you would distribute it across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube? I’m much more interested in a thoughtful response than a perfect résumé. If this sounds like something you would genuinely enjoy helping us build, I’d love to hear from you. description: I'm a fitness and mindset coach with 110K followers on Instagram and I post daily. I'm looking for a short-form editor who can take my raw talking-head footage and cut it into Reels that actually hold attention all the way to the end. This is a storytelling role. I'm not looking for someone to slap captions on a clip and send it back — I need someone who understands pacing, knows when a cut is dragging, and can build a video that keeps someone watching. Are detail-oriented and consistent — same quality on day 60 as on day 1. Take feedback fast and apply it permanently without needing to be told twice. Communicate proactively: if something's unclear, you ask instead of guessing. What you get: $3–4/hour, starting with a 3-day paid trial. A full SOP, Loom walkthroughs, and a reference library of my best Reels — no guesswork. Long-term role with raises for consistent performance. Direct work with me and fast feedback. How to apply: Start your application with the word "INTERRUPT" so I know you read this. Include: 2–3 examples of short-form videos you've edited (links). description: RF Consultants is a U.S.-based consulting firm that helps individuals and business owners repair their credit profiles and access business funding. We generate a high volume of consultation bookings every week — and a meaningful percentage of those prospects don't show up or cancel before the call. Those people still want help. Day to day: Work a daily list of no-showed and cancelled appointments pulled from our CRM (GoHighLevel) Call, text, and email these leads until you reach them or they're properly disqualified Handle the common objections: "I got busy," "I'm not ready," "I already found someone else," "How much does this cost?" Rebook them directly onto a closer's calendar Send confirmation and reminder touches so the rebooked appointment actually shows Log every attempt, outcome, and note in the CRM — clean data is non-negotiable Report daily on dials, contacts, rebooks, and shows Expect roughly [60–100] dials per day plus text and email follow-up. title: Firm Administrator (Operations + Billing) @ BBA Law

Can you transform operational chaos into well-oiled efficiency with minimal supervision? Is your problem-solving proactive and innovative, capturing missed opportunities for improvement? Final question: When faced with a challenge, do you get excited or run away? The Firm Administrator at BBA Law is a newly created role that aims to streamline operations, allowing firm leadership to focus on growth and client advocacy. As the operational right hand, you will have a direct impact on improving efficiencies and ensuring the smooth functioning of firm operations, all while supporting the firm's mission of delivering superior legal solutions to Michigan families. What you’ll do: - Billing and Financial Oversight: Own key aspects of the billing cycle by reviewing time entries for accuracy, capturing billable activities and expenses, preparing invoices, and maintaining consistent accounts receivable follow-up. - Operational Compliance: Monitor day-to-day staff activity and matter workflows, catching errors, missing information, and incomplete steps before they become larger operational issues. - Lead and CRM Management: Ensure leads are accurately captured, properly tracked, and followed up on promptly, while maintaining clean CRM data and identifying opportunities to improve the intake process. - Administrative Support: Serve as an operational extension of firm leadership, coordinating administrative priorities, supporting key workflows, and ensuring important follow-up does not fall through the cracks. - Process Development: Build and maintain practical SOPs and repeatable processes that improve consistency, accountability, and efficiency across the firm. What we’re looking for: - US Law Firm Experience: Experience in law firm operations, billing, bookkeeping, or office management is preferred, with an understanding of legal workflows being a strong advantage. - Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working in Clio or similar practice management software, CRM systems, spreadsheets, and reporting tools, with the ability to learn new systems quickly. - Organizational Skills: Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to stay on top of multiple workflows, catch inconsistencies, and follow through without frequent reminders. - Communication Skills: Clear and professional written and spoken English, with confidence communicating with staff, clients, vendors, and insurance providers. - Proactive Problem Solver: Able to spot issues before they become larger problems, take initiative, and find solutions independently without requiring constant direction. Remote Work Readiness & Reliability: Ability to work U.S. hours, with reliable access to necessary technology and demonstrated success working independently in a remote, structured work setting. Why you should work here: - Impactful Role: For someone who thrives on making things work better, this role offers the opportunity to create meaningful improvements that will be felt across the firm as it continues to grow. - Autonomous Environment: Ideal for someone who does their best work with trust and independence, this role offers meaningful ownership and the freedom to drive results without constant oversight. - Leadership Exposure: Work closely with firm leadership in a highly visible role, gaining firsthand exposure to the priorities, challenges, and day-to-day operations of a growing law firm. - Growth Opportunity: As the firm continues to scale, this role offers the opportunity to expand your impact and take on broader operational responsibilities in a larger operational role.

description: WHO WE ARE We are three Dutch entrepreneurs in our twenties, with over 10 years of combined e-commerce experience between us. We run a US-based Shopify fashion dropshipping store with a specific concept and niche. We are multi-platform — running active paid campaigns on Google, Facebook, and Pinterest simultaneously. With Q4 coming, we are pushing hard to extract every bit of growth this store has to offer. We work almost entirely with AI. Our creative production, ad management, and social media operations are all powered by AI tools and systems we have built ourselves. You will be working inside these systems every day — and we will train you on all of it. We already have a team — two part-timers and multiple Filipino team members. We know how to work remotely, we know how to train people, and we know how to grow with people who are willing to grow with us. THE TEAM CULTURE We communicate via Slack. That is our office. We expect fast replies — not because we micromanage, but because we are a team that moves quickly and needs to stay aligned. Being reachable and responsive on Slack is non-negotiable. You will be joining a warm, driven team. Everyone here is motivated to improve themselves, not just complete tasks. We are not looking for someone who clocks in and clocks out. We want someone who takes pride in their work and wants to get better every week. If that sounds like you — keep reading. THE ROLE This is our frontend VA role — you will be the person who brings our brand to life visually and keeps our social presence running every single day. This is not a passive role. We expect ownership, consistency, and a sharp eye for quality. You do not need your own tools or software — we provide everything. All of our creative work is AI-powered: AI-generated photos, AI-generated videos, and a full set of concepts and templates we have built. Your job is to operate these tools accurately, apply our concepts, and maintain our brand standard. YOUR DAILY RESPONSIBILITIES Create AI-generated photo and video creatives for our Meta ad campaigns — using our tools, templates, and concepts, which we will fully train you on Set up and launch Meta ad campaigns: upload creatives, enter ad copies, configure campaign settings, and go live — all based on our clear instructions Review AI-generated comment replies daily across our social media platforms — select the best option, verify brand tone, and post manually on Meta Communicate proactively on Slack when something is unclear or needs approval — do not guess, do not delay WORKING DAYS & AVAILABILITY We work Monday through Saturday. You are expected to be available and reachable on Slack on Saturdays as well. This is a remote role, but availability during working days is required — we are a team, not a group of freelancers working in isolation. WHAT WE REQUIRE Strong written English — all communication with the team and in comments is in English Available Monday through Saturday, including reachable on Saturdays via Slack An eye for design and attention to visual detail — you will be working with our brand every day Basic familiarity with Meta Business Suite or Facebook Ads Manager is a plus — but we will train you Comfortable working with AI tools — we will train you on our specific systems, but an open mindset toward AI is essential Reliable high-speed internet (speedtest screenshot required when applying) Own laptop or desktop with a working camera Comfortable with Slack and async remote communication Ability to follow SOPs and Loom video training independently Canva experience is a plus — but not required, we provide all tools COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH Starting rate: $4.00/hour (discussable) | 15–30 hours/week | Part-time to Full-time Every new team member starts at our base rate during the onboarding period. This is a 4-week onboarding phase, after which we review performance and adjust compensation accordingly. This role has real growth potential. You will gain hands-on experience with AI creative production, Meta advertising, and e-commerce at scale — skills that are increasingly valuable in today's market. We do not keep good people at a low rate. Results and loyalty are rewarded. HOW TO APPLY Send us the following — keep it concise and direct: A short introduction (3–5 sentences max — no generic copy-paste, tell us who you actually are) Any examples of creative work: designs, social media pages you have managed, or ad campaigns you have worked on — even basic ones are fine Your weekly availability in hours and your working days A speedtest.net screenshot showing your internet speed Your answer to this question: A comment on one of our posts is negative and aggressive. How do you handle it? ⚠️ Generic applications will not be reviewed. Show us who you are and what you can do. We move fast. If you are the right fit, you will hear from us within 48 hours.
