description: Do you have experience running and analyzing A/B or multivariate tests? Are you fluent in Google Sheets or Excel — pivot tables, cohort tables, charts? Do you understand statistical significance, sample size, and how to tell when a test is actually finished? Do you actively push work forward instead of waiting to be told what to do next? If yes to all four, you might be a great fit for this role. We run ongoing split tests across our marketing funnels — testing different videos, headlines, page designs, and subscription routes to see what sells best. We need one careful, proactive person to own the system that keeps every test honest, organized, and moving. WHAT YOU'D OWN - Own the system of record for split tests. We already have a foundation — you'll take it over, build on it, and keep it sharp: one clear place that shows every test across every brand and where each one stands. - Protect the data integrity of every split test. Set tests up so errors can't creep in, and on the rare occasion something slips through — a mismatched time window, a cherry-picked group, a wrong denominator — catch it before it reaches a decision. - Make results easy to act on. Present each test so the winner, the margin, and the takeaway are clear at a glance — and make sure what we learn is captured where the team will actually use it, so no lesson gets lost. - Reconcile the numbers. When two reports disagree on the same figure, find out which one is right and why, and write it down clearly so no one has to work it out again. - Keep every new test set up right before it goes live — variables clearly identified, the success metric agreed up front, and the sample size worked out in advance. - Stay on top of every running test and surface when it has enough data to call, so a winner is never picked too early. - Push the pipeline forward. Keep test slots full, rank the backlog by leverage, and look ahead at what upcoming tests will need (tech setup, design assets, copy) so nothing stalls waiting on a dependency. THE TOOLS Day to day you'll work in spreadsheets and a handful of analytics and database tools — including Google Analytics (GA4), ---------- , HasOffers/TUNE, BigQuery, and a custom dashboard of our own. We'll get you up to speed on our specific setup; you bring the fundamentals. We use AI tools in our own work, and you're welcome to use them here. What we care about is the judgment you bring on top of them. If you reach the paid test project, we'll ask which tools you used, AI included, and for the conversation logs. YOU'RE A GOOD FIT IF YOU ARE - Fluent in Google Sheets or Excel (pivot tables, cohort tables, charts). - Comfortable with statistical hypothesis testing, significance, and sample-size estimation. - Able to explain "why this test isn't done yet" to someone who isn't a statistician. - Detail-oriented and organized — you don't let numbers slip through. - Comfortable learning SQL, BI tools, or experimentation platforms. - Someone who actively manages and pushes the work forward — keeps tests moving and flags what's next without waiting to be told. TO APPLY If you've read this far and think you'd be a great fit, reply with: 1. Why you're a strong match for this role. 2. Your favorite movie (so I know you read all the way to the end). Qualified applicants will receive a short screening question, then a paid test project, then interviews with the hiring manager. One person will be chosen for the ongoing role after the trial. This is a part-time contract: 10–20 hours per week, ongoing. Pay is $10–$15/hour, up to $18/hour for the right person. This role requires you to track your hours with Time Doctor, which takes periodic screenshots of your screen while you work. If that is not comfortable for you, this is not the right fit.

title: CRM + AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO & BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US
job_title: CRM + AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO & BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US
description: CRM + AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO & BUILD THE FUTURE WITH US Full-Time Remote | GoHighLevel + Funnels + Automations + AI We are not looking for someone who simply knows how to build a workflow in GoHighLevel. We are looking for someone who is obsessed with figuring things out. Someone who sees what is happening with AI right now and thinks: “I want to learn everything I possibly can about this.” Someone who hears about a new AI tool, automation, agent, or way of building something faster and immediately wants to test it. Someone who doesn't wait for a YouTube tutorial to tell them exactly what to do. They search. They test. They troubleshoot. They ask AI. They try again. And eventually... They figure it out. If that sounds like you, keep reading. THE OPPORTUNITY Canine Conversions is a fast-growing marketing and business growth company that helps dog trainers generate leads, close more clients, and build better businesses. We already use funnels, CRM systems, automations, paid advertising, AI, and sales systems every single day. But we're going much deeper. We want to integrate AI into more of how our company operates. And I’m looking for someone who wants to help me build it. You’ll work directly with me, the Founder & CEO, Jorge Mateo, initially helping me with internal Canine Conversions projects and a small number of client projects that we use to test and refine new systems. This is NOT a role where you disappear into the background completing support tickets all day. You’ll be helping us BUILD. WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE BUILDING Some weeks you might be: • Building a new funnel inside GoHighLevel • Creating lead follow-up automations • Connecting forms, calendars, pipelines, triggers, SMS, and email campaigns • Using AI to help build landing pages and funnels faster • Building AI-powered workflows • Testing new AI tools to see whether they can improve our operations • Connecting different software using Zapier, Make, APIs, or webhooks • Helping us improve our lead qualification and appointment-setting systems • Troubleshooting an automation that isn't working • Taking something we're currently doing manually and asking: “How can we automate this?” And eventually: “How can AI make this even better?” You will also help test systems with select clients before we roll them out further. YOU DO NOT NEED TO KNOW EVERYTHING This is important. I am NOT expecting you to already be an AI expert. AI is changing too quickly for anyone to know everything. What I care about much more is whether you are the type of person who actively searches for answers. If I tell you: “I want to see if we can build an AI agent that does XYZ…” I don't want your first response to be: “I've never done that before.” I want it to be: “I haven't done that before... but let me see if I can figure it out.” That mentality matters more to me than knowing every piece of software on this job description. WHO I’M LOOKING FOR You’ll probably love this role if you: • Naturally enjoy technology • Love AI and actively follow what is happening in the space • Use ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools regularly • Get excited when you discover a new AI tool • Enjoy funnels, automation, CRM systems, and marketing technology • Are constantly trying to make things faster or more efficient • Google things you don't know • Watch tutorials when you need to learn something • Use AI to troubleshoot problems • Take ownership instead of waiting to be told every next step • Pay attention to details • Test your work before saying it's finished • Can communicate when you're stuck instead of disappearing • Want feedback • Are coachable • Want to become extremely good at what you do Most importantly: You are CURIOUS. You genuinely enjoy learning. EXPERIENCE WE'D LIKE TO SEE Ideally, you already have experience with CRM systems, funnels, marketing automation, or similar work. Experience with any of these is a big plus: • GoHighLevel (GHL) • ClickFunnels • Zapier • Make • APIs / Webhooks • ChatGPT • Claude • AI agents • AI workflow tools • Landing page builders • Email/SMS automation • Marketing funnels • ClickUp • Google Workspace You don't need to know every tool. I'd rather hire someone who knows 60% of this but is hungry to learn the other 40% than someone who knows everything today but has stopped learning. WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT I don't want to hire someone who stays a “CRM Specialist” forever. There is a much bigger opportunity here. AI is going to completely change how businesses build funnels, follow up with leads, communicate with prospects, automate operations, and deliver services. I want us on the front edge of that. And I want someone next to me who wants to learn it too. As your skills increase, your responsibilities can increase. As your responsibilities increase, your compensation can increase. And as we build more advanced AI systems inside Canine Conversions, there is an opportunity for this role to evolve into something much bigger: CRM + AI Systems Specialist Automation Builder AI Implementation Specialist AI Systems Manager And eventually potentially someone who leads this area of the company. I'm looking for someone who wants that kind of trajectory. YOU'LL WORK DIRECTLY WITH THE CEO You will work directly with me. You'll see the problems I'm trying to solve inside the company. You'll help me turn ideas into actual systems. I'll show you what we're trying to accomplish from a marketing and business perspective, and you'll help figure out the technology and implementation behind it. Sometimes I will know exactly what I want built. Other times I may tell you: “Here's the outcome I want. Let's figure out how to make it happen.” If that sounds exciting instead of scary... You're probably the type of person I'm looking for. COMPENSATION & DETAILS Position: CRM + AI Automation Specialist Type: Full-Time Remote Schedule: Monday–Friday Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time Starting Compensation: $900/month 30-Day Performance Review: Compensation will be reevaluated based on your performance, skill level, reliability, communication, initiative, and contribution. Reports Directly To: Founder & CEO, Jorge Mateo There is room to grow here. I don't want someone who stays at their starting salary while becoming dramatically more valuable to the company. If you become more valuable, I want your role and compensation to reflect that. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF... You need extremely detailed instructions for every task. You regularly say “I don't know how” without first trying to find the answer. You don't enjoy learning new technology. You avoid AI. You copy/paste AI outputs without thinking. You wait for someone else to catch mistakes. You want to do the exact same tasks every day. You are looking for the easiest possible remote job. This probably won't be a good fit. YOU SHOULD DEFINITELY APPLY IF... You've ever spent two hours trying to make an automation work because you refused to let it beat you. You have 15 tabs open because you're researching how to solve something. You genuinely get excited about what AI will be capable of over the next few years. You constantly think: “There has to be a better way to do this.” And then you try to build it. That's the person I want to talk to. HOW TO APPLY Do NOT send us a generic copy-and-paste application. Start your application with: “I like figuring things out.” Then answer these 5 questions: 1. What is the most advanced CRM, funnel, or automation you've personally built? Tell us what it did, what tools you used, and what YOU personally built. 2. Tell me about something technical you didn't know how to do but figured out on your own. What was the problem? How did you find the answer? 3. How are you currently using AI? Tell us the AI tools you use and give us specific examples. 4. What is one AI tool, update, workflow, or technology you've discovered recently that you're excited about? Why? 5. Imagine I tell you: “We have leads entering GoHighLevel. I want an AI system to qualify them, follow up with them, answer basic questions, and push qualified prospects toward booking a call.” You have never built this exact system before. Walk me through how you would figure out how to build it. I'm less interested in whether your technical answer is perfect. I want to understand how you THINK. ONE LAST THING This isn't a job for someone who just wants to check boxes. We're building something. AI is moving ridiculously fast, and I believe the people who become great at combining marketing + CRM + automation + AI over the next few years are going to become extremely valuable. If you want to become one of those people... And you want an opportunity where you'll actually be able to experiment, build, learn, make mistakes, improve, and work directly with the person making the decisions... I want to hear from you.

Our ads reach over 100 million people every month, and we launch a new product almost every day. Video is our bottleneck, so we are building a team that runs seven days a week. Because we are hiring ten, this is not a lottery where one person wins. Show a real portfolio, follow the onboarding, deliver in your first week, and you are in. Most people who do not make it here fail by ignoring instructions, not on talent. WHAT YOU EARN $200 USD per month base, guaranteed, paid weekly through PayPal. Plus $25 for every ad of yours that reaches 10,000 SEK (about $900) in ad spend while holding a ROAS above 3.0. Maximum $400 per month. We tell you the ceiling openly, because we do not promise numbers we will not pay. HOW THE BONUS WORKS Every ad you make is tracked. When one hits 10,000 SEK in spend and is still above 3.0 ROAS, that is a winner and you get $25. We check three days later, so late conversions count in your favour. Once earned it is yours, even if the ad fades afterwards. One bonus per ad. WHERE THIS GOES This role is the entry, not the ceiling. Perform as an individual - real editing skill, how well you absorb instructions, how fast you work - and you get upgraded to our experienced editors. At that level you get a personal creative strategist, and together you build brands and scale them into the millions. You also get a share of that brand's profit. That is where the real money is made, and it is why we care more about how you think than how fast you cut. THE WORK You are not building ads from scratch. You take proven formats that already work and adapt them fast for our products. References, hooks and briefs are prepared for you. Daily: work through your queue, produce one adapted version per brand, adapt voiceover, captions, hook and pacing, upload and mark done, stay responsive in the group chat. OUR NUMBER ONE RULE What the voiceover says must match what is on screen. If the voice says my ears are hurting, the viewer sees someone in pain in the ear. Editors who ignore this do not last here. WHAT WE NEED Solid short-form editing (Premiere, CapCut, DaVinci or similar) Comfortable with AI tools (ElevenLabs, ChatGPT) Good English, fast communication Clean spelling, clean cuts, no watermarks Full-time availability Applies feedback immediately WHAT ELSE YOU GET A professional video editing course worth over $9,000 USD, paid for by us and yours to keep. Every tool paid for. Using AI to work faster is encouraged here, not frowned upon. WHAT IT IS ACTUALLY LIKE TO WORK HERE We will be honest with you. We think this will be the best job you have ever had, and we do not say that lightly. We are far more like a family than a strict team. Everyone here is helpful, caring and friendly, and people genuinely look out for each other. Ask anything, as many times as you need. Nobody is precious about titles, and nobody is ever made to feel small for getting something wrong. If you make a mistake we tell you what to fix, you fix it, and we move on. That is the whole drama. Most of our team are Filipino, so you will not be the odd one out. You will be joining people who already know how we work and who will help you settle in. You will not be micromanaged, and you will never have to wonder where you stand with us, because when you do something good we say it out loud, in front of everyone. That is what a workplace should feel like, and it is the part we are most proud of. Our editors tell us it is the most fun they have ever had at work. Come and build something with us. We do not think you will regret it. HOW TO APPLY No generic applications, we delete those. Send us: A short intro Your portfolio, or 2-3 short-form ads you have edited What is one short-form ad you saw recently that was really well made, and why? Your WhatsApp number We reply to everyone who does all four. Ten seats, filling fast.

title: Recruiting & HR Coordinator — U.S. Companies
description: About Market Workforce Market Workforce provides recruiting, staffing, administrative, sales support and business operations services for a growing portfolio of U.S.-based companies. We are building the systems and teams needed to support businesses across sales, technology, branded merchandise, marketing, distribution, manufacturing and other industries. We are looking for an experienced Recruiting & HR Coordinator who can take ownership of our recruiting process. This is not a temporary project. We are looking for someone who can start by managing a high volume of sales applicants and eventually grow into a larger recruiting and HR leadership role within Market Workforce. Your First Major Assignment One of the companies we support, Aprinta, is currently building a national network of independent sales professionals across the United States. We are receiving a significant number of applicants and need someone who can organize, screen and manage candidates from initial application through interview and onboarding. You will be responsible for making sure qualified candidates move quickly through the process while unqualified applicants are identified and removed from the pipeline. The goal is simple: Management should only spend time speaking with the strongest candidates. Primary Responsibilities Applicant Management You will: Review incoming applications and resumes Manage applicants from Indeed and other recruiting sources Review candidate questionnaires Screen candidates against established requirements Categorize and score applicants Identify high-priority candidates Reject applicants who clearly do not meet requirements Maintain accurate candidate records Ensure candidates do not get lost in the recruiting process Candidate Screening For our initial sales recruiting program, you will look closely at: B2B sales experience Promotional products experience Branded merchandise experience Printing industry experience Apparel/uniform sales experience Packaging experience Existing customer relationships Existing books of business Outside sales experience Independent sales experience Communication skills Professionalism Employment history Entrepreneurial ability You must be able to look beyond keywords on a resume and determine whether someone could actually be successful in the position. Candidate Interviews After initial training, you will conduct short first-round screening interviews with qualified candidates. You will: Schedule interviews Conduct 10–15 minute screening calls Follow our interview process Ask standardized qualification questions Take detailed interview notes Score candidates Recommend whether candidates should advance Schedule qualified candidates for management interviews Recruiting Pipeline Management You will manage candidates through stages such as: New Applicant → Application Review → Qualified → Screening Interview → Management Review → Approved → Agreement → Onboarding → Active You will be responsible for keeping this pipeline clean and current. We do not want hundreds of applicants sitting in the system without a clear status. Recruiting Systems & Process Development We are building our own internal recruiting and workforce management technology. You will work with our management and technology teams to improve: Recruiting workflows Applicant scoring Interview scorecards Candidate communications Email templates Rejection templates Interview scheduling Follow-up sequences Recruiting reports Onboarding checklists Standard operating procedures Recruiting dashboards We want someone who sees a broken process and helps us improve it rather than simply working around it. Future Responsibilities This position will begin heavily focused on recruiting. As Market Workforce grows, the right person may take responsibility for recruiting and HR coordination across multiple companies. Future responsibilities may include: Recruiting for additional departments New employee onboarding Independent contractor onboarding Employee documentation Offer letters Contractor agreements Personnel records Training coordination Employee/contractor communications Recruiting analytics Hiring manager coordination Building recruiting SOPs Managing additional recruiting coordinators There is significant opportunity for the right person to grow with the company. Required Experience We are looking for someone with: 2+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition or HR coordination experience Experience reviewing resumes and applications Experience conducting candidate screening interviews Strong written English Strong spoken English Excellent organizational skills Strong attention to detail Ability to make independent decisions Experience working with U.S.-based companies preferred Experience working remotely Comfortable working with high applicant volume Experience with Indeed, LinkedIn, ATS platforms, recruiting CRMs or similar systems is strongly preferred. Who Will Succeed Here We want someone who is: Organized. You can manage hundreds of applicants without losing track of people. Decisive. You are comfortable determining that a candidate is not qualified and moving on. A strong judge of people. You understand that a good resume does not necessarily mean someone will be a good salesperson or employee. Process-oriented. You naturally think about how systems can be improved. Fast. Good candidates should not wait several days because nobody reviewed their application. Detail-oriented. Candidate records, notes, statuses and follow-ups need to be accurate. Comfortable with technology. We are building technology into nearly every part of our recruiting operation. Interested in growth. We want someone who wants to eventually take on more responsibility rather than remain an administrative assistant forever. Schedule We expect to begin at approximately 20 hours per week. Because you will interview U.S.-based candidates and communicate with our management team, you must be available for regular working hours that overlap with U.S. Eastern Time. For the right person, this position can grow into a full-time role with increasing responsibility. Compensation Compensation will depend on experience. We are willing to pay more for someone who has real recruiting experience and can independently manage applicants and conduct professional interviews. We are not looking for the cheapest applicant. We are looking for the right long-term person. How to Apply Please send the following: A brief introduction about yourself. Your resume. How many years of recruiting or HR experience you have. Approximately how many candidates/applications you have managed at one time. Whether you have used Indeed. If yes, explain what you used it for. What ATS or recruiting systems you have used. Whether you have conducted candidate screening interviews. Your experience working with U.S.-based companies. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time. Your desired hourly rate. Important Screening Question Please also answer this question: You receive 120 applications for a B2B sales position. Management only wants to interview the strongest 10–15 candidates. Briefly explain the process you would use to review, rank and narrow the 120 applicants. Please do not use a generic AI-generated answer. We are interested in understanding how you would approach the problem. Growth Opportunity This position is intended to become an important part of Market Workforce. The immediate need is recruiting and applicant management, but our longer-term goal is to build a centralized recruiting and HR operation supporting multiple U.S. businesses. Someone who demonstrates strong judgment, leadership and process management could eventually grow into a Recruiting Manager or HR leadership position within Market Workforce.

title: Claude AI Systems Builder and Specialist

description: This is not a beginner role. If you are not able to quickly navigate AI and the tools that accompany this role, I will notice immediately. This role is for someone who lives inside Claude full-time, 8 hours a day, five days a week, and becomes the resident expert on building workflows, automations, custom agents, skills, and connectors. You'll take ideas directly from leadership and turn them into working builds. You will turn each of the teams Claude's accounts into a Super Claude account, and all of our clients' Claude accounts into Super Claude accounts. Think of Jarvis from Marvel. You will host team training sessions on Claude, projects, and other items we need to be aware of. There will be times when I want something developed exactly as it is presented on social media. Social media is where I will get 80% of my ideas. If someone shows that they have built a workflow, automation, custom agent, skills, connectors, etc., I need you to figure out how they did it, tell me exactly what they did, and show me how by recreating the exact same thing they posted on social media. I want to replicate some of the most impressive AI demonstration videos to make them useful in my business. Take a demonstration video and turn it into a real-world Claude function for the business. Where something isn't feasible yet, you'll research and develop a roadmap for how it could work down the line, even if that's months out, and present that plan clearly. If you can't figure out how someone built a workflow, automation, or custom agent, I need you to explain where the bottleneck is and how you'll get around it. You'll also be responsible for structuring and organizing projects, using Claude artifacts, Claude projects, Claude Design, Google Drive, Notion, etc., and for teaching leadership how these systems work along the way. You'll collaborate closely with the assistant and broader team, handing off design or presentation work rather than building it yourself. I never want to hear "can't be done" — I want to see options. Never present me with something that doesn't work or isn't what I asked you to build. This is a hands-on, deep-focus role, not a supervisory one. I don't want to supervise you. When you're working your hours, I won't be monitoring you — I expect the work to get done and the final product shared with me. You'll never have nothing to do: if I don't have a project queued up for you, it's your responsibility to be proactive. This isn't just my business — once you join, it's our team, and if you're not actively thinking about where the team can go and what we can improve without being told, this isn't the right role for you. The business working hours are 8/9AM–5 PM PST. Please let me know your availability. There is an honor-system arrangement: consistent pay every week, in exchange for trust that the work is genuinely getting done without the business owners having to micromanage you. You'll also be client-facing at times — comfortable joining a Zoom call and answering a client's questions live, not just building behind the scenes. Familiarity with the real estate industry is a plus, and while general AI literacy is a must, the bulk of your time and expertise must be Claude-specific. You'll need to know how to use other AI systems, but the vast majority of your time — 95% of it — will be spent building and working within Claude. This is not a job where you learn how Claude works as you go. If you are not immediately familiar with every aspect of Claude, this job is not for you. I'm not hiring for something short-term. I want someone who wants to grow with the business for years, and this would be your priority. I value loyalty, look for it, and will provide you with stability and a consistent job.

description: Position: Remote Senior Bookkeeper Schedule: Initial full-time cleanup project, transitioning to long-term part-time Compensation: Hourly, based on experience Long-term workload: Approximately 5-10 hours per week ++About GrayRock Consulting++ GrayRock Consulting operates a small group of Canadian and US companies.
